chapters.title: Chapter 151 151: Jii Ling's Earthshaking Strike
paragraphs: Liang Gang's face bore shock, confusion, and unwillingness!
As Ding Ling rode past.
His tall figure also fell amidst a thunderous sound, like pushing over a mountain of gold and a pillar of jade!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Overpowered Liang Gang.]
[Note: Liang Gang was originally a second-class fierce general. He broke through to first-class in a life-and-death crisis. But before he could stabilize his realm, you slew him!
He passed away with regret and unwillingness. His awe and trepidation towards you are unprecedented!
Because the Liang Clan had a saying, "Once the Saber Lotus emerges, who can compete!" Yet even so, it couldn't stop your sword!
His beliefs and convictions collapsed in that moment!
You became a Demon God Level figure etched deep within his soul even in death!]
Another first-class?
Ding Ling was taken aback.
Then he understood.
First-class varies greatly.
Zhao Zilong is also first-class, but killing Liang Gang and Le Jiu like them is easy for him.
For players, a thousand pounds of mighty force qualify as first-class.
In this world's setting, if any attribute like physique, agility, charm, or defense meets the standard, it's considered first-class.
Of course, if overall strength is relatively strong, even lacking a benchmark attribute, it may still be first-class.
This makes it easier to understand.
A thousand pounds of might is first-class; nineteen hundred pounds is first-class too!
Yet the gap between them is considerable!
Clearly, Liang Gang and Le Jiu are the worst of first-class.
But even the worst is still first-class!
There's a qualitative difference between them and second-class fierce generals!
Seeing the two extremely brave generals from the army easily slain by one sword stroke each from Ding Ling.
Many soldiers' mental states subtly changed in that instant!
As they saw Ding Ling rushing towards them in that moment.
They no longer charged forward together, attempting to surround him, but retreated one by one, unwilling to face Ding Ling's sharp edge head-on!
Even Le Jiu and Liang Gang couldn't withstand a single sword.
How could these soldiers possibly withstand it?
They had a keen sense of self-awareness.
And their retreat, cowardice, and fear.
Made Ding Ling's charge faster and faster.
Even when slaughtering later on.
Facing a group of death warrior elite legion trained by Jii Ling.
Ding Ling was utterly fearless.
Rampantly hacking and slashing.
The Giant Que Sword in his hand danced as nimbly as a flying needle threading a flower, reaching an unbelievable level; each flip produced flashes of sword flowers, whoosh!
A sword flower pierced through a death warrior's forehead!
Each exquisite sword flower fell, and death warriors collapsed in droves, row by row.
Like Xun Wind sweeping the ground and blowing leaves!
Stars fall crushing armies!
Ding Ling charged forward like a Flood Dragon, majestic like a Divine General!
A thousand-man death warrior elite legion was utterly torn and trampled by him alone, forging a Heaven-Reaching Dao!
As he passed along the way!
Severed limbs danced in the air!
In mere moments.
Blood flowed enough to float a pestle!
Ding Ling, clad in blood, seemed like a god of death emerging from a Demon Cave, slaughtered through the grand array, killing to the front of the central army!
He sat upright on horseback; coldly watching Jii Ling who was protected by a hundred elite guards, the Giant Que Sword swung decisively towards him!
"Ah!"
Jii Ling couldn't bear it any longer!
A Three-Pointed Two-Blade spun, creating flashes of golden light, transforming into a torrent of saber light striking at Ding Ling.
"I can't believe your stamina is so strong!"
"Prepare to die!"

Jii Ling was either encouraging himself or reminding Ding Ling that his defeat was certain, with a shout that resonated through his body! The Breathing Technique accelerated, the ancestral 'Three-Pointed Two-Blade Technique' was activated with full force!
Vigorous Qi surged through his arm, rushing into the saber!
As the saber light torrent crashed down, heavily slashing towards Ding Ling's head!
This saber stroke.
Gathered all of Jii Ling's Vigorous Qi and knowledge.
It was his ultimate stroke!
When the saber fell.
The saber light astonished the world as if to shatter Heaven and Earth!
Everyone was moved by it.
Diao Chan couldn't help but cry out in worry for Ding Ling.
Such an astonishing saber stroke, had evidently reached the Super-Elite level!
Enough to crush, topple a first-class peak fierce general!
This was a saber stroke Jii Ling found nearly impossible to replicate!
He himself knew, this was a masterpiece saber stroke created out of anger, unwillingness, solitary courage, and decisiveness, either succeed or sacrifice!
After the stroke.
His entire body weakened.
His eyes fixed squarely on Ding Ling, hoping this stroke would achieve victory.
However...
Clang clang!

Ding Ling charged forward holding the Giant Que Sword, like the Erlang God splitting Mount Tao, a mighty force accompanied by the grandeur inherent in Human Emperor Swordsmanship, met Jii Ling's Three-Pointed Two-Blade head-on!
Clang clang clang!
In a very short time, the two Divine Weapons clashed thrice.
Each clash.
Jii Ling felt as if struck by lightning, after three clashes, his heart pounded like a drum, his body shivered, stiff, unable to move.
All he could do was watch helplessly as the blade of the Giant Que Sword sliced across his neck!
Puff!
A crisp sound.
Jii Ling felt his entire being fly upwards.
He saw the world spinning, Heaven and Earth overturning!
"Am I dead?"
Jii Ling sighed.
A surge of sharp pain rushed into his brain.
His head became muddled, his eyes increasingly vacant.
His life sped past before his eyes.
Learning martial arts, graduating, gaining favor from Yuan Shu, promotions and honors, glorious unlimited...
Ultimately freezing on a headless corpse!
"I have not yet achieved greatness, not touched a vast future, not gained posthumous fame. I am unwilling!"
If given another chance.
Jii Ling would surely avoid confronting Ding Ling head-on!
Because he clearly knew his Martial Arts hadn't reached peak level.
If he could train for an extended period, he might achieve Super-Elite.
But now, there's no chance left.
Even if he reached Super-Elite, would he be Ding Ling's opponent?
Thinking of Ding Ling's unstoppable scenes of slaughter.
Jii Ling closed his eyes in eternal pain.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You Overpowered Jii Ling.]
[Note: Being the strongest first-class peak martial general in Yuan Shu's army besides Sunx Jian's family, Jii Ling could be called the soul of Yuan Shu's army!
He was iron-blooded and arrogant!
You beat him head-on! And in his nearly unreplicable strongest state, you easily defeated him!
Completely shattered his confidence!
Leaving him in utter despair! His first and last time questioning life.]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Trampled Wan City!]
[Note: You and your horse traversed tens of thousands of strong armies, killing and injuring thousands of Yuan Army soldiers! Martial Arts so high, it drove the entire Yuan Army to hopelessness!
They no longer hope to defeat you!
They now show signs of dispersing like frightened birds.
If you press harder, perhaps you can completely defeat this army that lost its soul!]
A prompt echoed in Ding Ling's ear.
Ding Ling's spirit lifted; he let out a long roar and cut down the central battle flag; his eyes like a tiger swept around:
"Jii Ling is dead! Will you not surrender?"
One man, one horse!
Forcing tens of thousands of troops to surrender!!
Such scenes.
Fell into the eyes of the players.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 152: Renowned Across the Eight Directions (7/12)
paragraphs: It was like a beggar ascending to the throne to become an emperor, or a chick transforming into a phoenix!
This seemingly fantastical event unfolded right before their eyes!
The collective mind of the players was like Heart Lake, suddenly stirred into violent waves!
They couldn't believe it at all!
"One person is so incredibly strong, truly a War God walking the Mortal World!"

"You should know that the physical qualities of NPCs are not inferior to ordinary people! Even elites far surpass normal people. A phalanx of tens of thousands was pierced by a single person, Ding Ling?!"
"To be precise, only the vanguard and the central army were penetrated. The rearguard, left, and right flanks hadn't even had time to engage!"
"Even so, it's terrifying! How many years would it take for you or me to reach this level?!"
Like a nuclear bomb clearing the ground.
After the collective explosion, the players fell into speechlessness!
Sun Ce was watching with excitement and his eyes sparkling, his recognition and admiration for Ding Ling soaring rapidly. If he were to choose an idol among mortals.
Right now, Ding Ling would definitely be Sun Ce's idol!
"Ding Ling."
Diao Chan's eyes were clear, yet at this moment, they seemed to sparkle like a lake surface stirred by endless waves:
"Truly so strong."
A hundred times more majestic and overbearing than she imagined!
Such a remarkable, towering, and passionate man was truly rare to find!
Du Qingcheng was completely mesmerized as she watched.
She had already taken a liking to Ding Ling, and now seeing Ding Ling so outstanding, like a War God descending into the Mortal World, her heart unconsciously leaned crazily towards him.
Ding Ling's back was as massive and immeasurable as a mountain, giving Du Qingcheng an immense sense of security!
After experiencing the ordeal of life and death.
Du Qingcheng's view on choosing a partner quietly shifted from graceful and refined gentlemen to a man like Ding Ling, so handsome and extraordinary!
"Don't listen to him!"
A tall man standing at eight feet with a clearly defined profile stepped forward, holding a long spear, and pointed it straight at Ding Ling, shouting loudly:
"He's just one person. Fire arrows wildly! It's enough to kill him! Where are the archers? Loose arrows, loose arrows!!"
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling glanced sideways.
He hadn't expected that at this moment.
There would still be generals daring to defy him.
He looked at the man, seeing him commanding a unit of crossbowmen.
Without hesitation, Ding Ling took the Six-Stone Bow from one side of the horse's belly and swiftly plucked three arrows from the quiver.
Drew the bowstring and notched the arrows!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Tornado Arrow!
Activated together!
Suddenly released the string!
Clang!
A crisp sound.
The three sharp arrows thundered like lightning, cutting through the sky, directly targeting the eight-foot-tall man like a bolt of lightning.
The speed of the arrows was incredibly fast.
And they split into three.
The tall man couldn't fathom that Ding Ling, from over a hundred yards away, could simultaneously shoot three deadly arrows at him.
He was still shouting and commanding the scattered crossbowmen.
But the next moment.
Swish swish!
Thud!
The three arrows pierced respectively into the tall man's forehead, neck, and heart.
The three arrows hit the 'bullseye'.
The tall man's life froze at that moment.
"General Li Feng!"
Someone screamed.
Yet another historically renowned warrior followed Jii Ling's footsteps.
Ding Ling directly charged towards the archers' position.
"Surrender or face execution without mercy!"
In his hand, the Giant Que Sword swept in wide, devastating arcs, like an autumn wind blowing away fallen leaves, cutting down the spear and shield soldiers in front!
Without Jii Ling to command the central army!
Without Le Jiu, Liang Gang, Li Feng, and other fierce generals to command.
Like a person lacking a soul.
All that was left was a gigantic and useless shell!
At Ding Ling's deafening shout, the players scattered ahead of everyone else!
Their escape caused the entire army to teeter on the brink of collapse.
Amid the screams of Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin:
"Surrender, stop fighting!"
They were utterly crushed.
Defeated like a landslide!
A complete and utter defeat!
Tens of thousands of troops were slain and routed by merely a few people led by Ding Ling!
Everywhere, soldiers were fleeing in panic, abandoning their helmets and armor.
Especially those facing Ding Ling directly.
They were scared out of their wits, fleeing for their lives, and racing to escape!
Such dramatic scenes played out right under everyone's noses.
Many people truly realized for the first time what it meant to be Ten Thousand Enemies!
"Cutting off the head of the enemy general among armies like extracting something from a pocket!"
Quite a few prominent figures residing in Wan City couldn't help peering out from the windows of tall buildings to see Ding Ling at this moment:
"Is that Ding Ling? Indeed, he has an extraordinary presence, his overbearing aura shines! Quickly inform the messenger to come fetch the message. I need to report this to the lord in detail!"
[Achievement Medal Earned: Renown Echoes in All Directions]
[Note: What you did in Wan City was witnessed by the 'spies' lurking there. Soon, your deeds will spread across the Jiuzhou Territory through the messengers' pigeon post!
You will truly become renowned in all directions, known among the upper echelons of nobility!
You are no longer an obscure figure. You will completely leap out of the rivers and transform into a true dragon in the nine heavens!]
Upon hearing the notification sound.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane Strong: 12/20.]
Previously it was eight people.
Juyi, Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Sun Ce among others.
He later added four: Diao Chan, Le Jiu, Liang Gang, Jii Ling.
[3: You must make your War God title resonate across the entire Plane World. 5%/100%.]
Previously it was 4%.
Now it moved a small notch forward.
And watching how the progress bar kept changing.
It may soon jump to 6%, or even higher.
After this battle.
Ding Ling's name as a War God might completely rise to prominence.
Ding Ling's mind was as clear as a mirror, a brief thought made it clear, he didn't dwell on this matter much, instead, he led Diao Chan's small unit out of Wan City.
All along the way were fleeing soldiers!
Including some small groups attempting to sneak attack Ding Ling.
However, any group daring to come were heading to their deaths.
Either directly scattered and slain by Ding Ling charging on horseback;
Or directly shot down by Ding Ling with a Six-Stone Bow!
Moreover, Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao, two direct descendants of the Yuan Family had been 'defecting' all along, with no generals to lead, the routed soldiers could achieve nothing!
In their view.
Even Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao were telling them to stop fighting.
What reason did they have to keep fighting?
If they accidentally killed Yuan Yin or Yuan Yao, their entire families would be doomed!
And now, with a collective retreat, the Yuan Family could not possibly blame them all!
Thinking so.
The fleeing soldiers felt all the more justified in their retreat!
At this moment, chaos engulfed the entirety of Wan City.
Ding Ling seized the opportunity to lead his group far away from Wan City.
A thousand meters away, he looked back at the Ancient City.
Ding Ling felt a complexity of emotions.
Shook his head, and thought no more of it.
After regrouping with Hua Tuo.
Ding Ling and his entourage headed south.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao hesitated several times, but Ding Ling couldn't be bothered with them.
They naturally dared not say much, just followed behind Diao Chan with a depressed expression.
Several attempts to slip away failed.
Clip-clop!
The Ferghana Horse was very fast.
Diao Chan and the others also had fine horses, galloping dozens of miles.
At the sight of a village.

chapters.title: Chapter 153 153: Diao Chan Struck by Poisoned Arrows
paragraphs: In the village, they found a relatively "wealthy" family compared to others and spent some money.
They stayed for half a day.
During this time, they refreshed themselves a bit.
Then they went hunting in the wild, and after eating and drinking to their satisfaction.
Ding Ling and his party set off again.
Hua Tuo was also curious about what Ding Ling and his party experienced in Wan City.
How come upon leaving, the group included a few more people, and Ding Ling was covered in blood, looking extremely terrifying.
Zhao Yun then solemnly recounted the sequence of events.
He spoke very bluntly, without embellishment or exaggeration, but sometimes the simpler and more straightforward the words, the more intense and thrilling they can be!
Hua Tuo listened and was deeply moved.
His gaze at Ding Ling grew increasingly peculiar.
It was hard to tell if it was admiration, appreciation, or sorrow.
Ding Ling was slightly stunned but remained silent.
Hua Tuo was a kind person; even under dire circumstances, he would find it difficult to deal a fatal blow to someone.
But Ding Ling was different.
When faced with the choice between "someone else dies" or "I die."
He would unhesitatingly choose for someone else to die!
If he didn't kill others, they would kill him.
Therefore, Ding Ling felt no regret, but having killed so many people, his emotions were tumultuous and hard to settle for a while.

Fortunately, Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, and Five Animals Qigong all had remarkable effects in dispelling Evil Qi, negative emotions, etc., allowing Ding Ling to avoid being engulfed by Evil Qi and murderous intent, becoming a killing demon.
"Hero, hero."
Yuan Yao, seeing the distance from Wan City grow farther, couldn't hold back anymore and spoke with difficulty:
"We've come so far from Wan City; shouldn't we be allowed to leave?"
"The role you two played in Wan City was negligible."
Ding Ling frowned:
"We'll talk about it after we've left the Earth Realm of Nanyang."
Yuan Yin was troubled.
Yuan Yao was speechless and could only reluctantly agree.
They had never imagined that a person's martial valor could be exaggerated to such an extent!
Many people were strong, but their endurance was not high; often, they would decline after an outburst, but Ding Ling?
Advancing boldly, "Straight to the Yellow Dragon!"
One person, single-handedly, manifested the fierce momentum of a Great Army, unimpeded, unmatched, shaking the heavens and earth, unstoppable!
Such a brave warrior.
Not afraid, he isn't Chiyou reborn! Demon God passing through earth!
The two were in awe of Ding Ling, not daring to say more than a word, and if they couldn't hold back, where could they dare speak more?
Tap-tap-tap!
Racing along the way.
In the evening.
The group saw that there were no people near the main road.
So they simply lit a fire and rested nearby.
Ding Ling also needed to replenish his meat intake.
Though his strength and endurance were strong, the meat consumption was also frighteningly high, more than ten times that of ordinary people.
Zhao Yun and Ding Ling swiftly ran to the mountains to hunt.
The two were agile, climbing mountains and trees with ease.
Especially Ding Ling, his Ascending Skill, Wall-Climbing Technique, and Five Animals Qigong had reached the level of Mastery, surpassing Hua Tuo in the ability to climb cliffs!
Even a leopard couldn't escape his fist.
This time.
They hunted a tiger, a leopard, two wild boar, and a deer.
The leopard was caught by Ding Ling after a quick run, punched hard, flipped over, and punched again, directly killing it!
Such strength and speed.
Zhao Yun watched, marveling, shocked, and envious.
After returning.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were responsible for skinning, cleaning, and roasting.
After some time.
The fragrance filled the air.
Ding Ling and his party gathered together to eat barbecue.
This time Ding Ling ate quickly.
Because he found this barbecue particularly sweet and delicious.
Only after asking did he know.
It was Du Qingcheng who almost single-handedly handled the "grilling."
Diao Chan was responsible for skinning tasks.
Du Qingcheng took charge of the barbecue.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao added wood and fuel, without much need for elaboration.
Ding Ling praised Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's craftsmanship.
The two women's faces flushed, even more captivating in the firelight, breathtakingly beautiful and enticing!
Ding Ling couldn't help but be stunned.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao were even more pig-like.
But when eating, the two women removed their masks.
Hua Tuo, seeing their appearance for the first time, was also amazed by their celestial beauty, and even at that moment, he couldn't help but lapse into a daze.
And right then.
As they said, it happened suddenly.
Whoosh!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
A dozen sharp arrows suddenly shot out from the darkness at the side!
The speed was extremely fast!
As if lightning struck, more like a practice flank in mid-air!
The ordinary person couldn't react in time.
But Diao Chan noticed it first, yelling "Be careful!"
Casually throwing the deer leg, a flick of her wrist, a dagger swiftly slid out from her sleeve.
It was the Fish Guts Sword!
She gripped the Fish Guts Sword tightly, suddenly leaping towards Ding Ling, clashing!
Clang clang clang!
Her wrist moved swiftly, the gleam of the sword dazzling, a piercing clanging resounded, accompanied by a muffled hum, all the arrows were blocked by Diao Chan.
Thud!
Diao Chan's graceful body fell in front of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was stunned and then furious.
These few movements were as fast as lightning and happened in an instant.
Even though he managed to react, without a weapon nearby, fistless he had no means, having to block the arrows with his hands.
His defense was incredibly strong.
He was not afraid of surprise arrow attacks.
But what he didn't expect was that Diao Chan's reaction was so fast, her skills so smooth and quick, she suddenly blocked all the arrows for him!
He felt ashamed, and then suddenly saw Diao Chan seemed to have been hit by an arrow, her pretty face rapidly turned pale and purple.
Hua Tuo's complexion changed:
"She's been poisoned!"
Ding Ling, well-versed in Qingnang Scripture and Inner Scripture, naturally saw this too, and this was the source of his anger.
Those hidden clearly aimed at him.
Yet unexpectedly, Diao Chan took the hit for him.
"Help me save her!"
Ding Ling said solemnly, then swiftly moved to the Ferghana Horse, reaching out to take the Giant Que Sword, running quickly into the forest without looking back.
He was as fast as a racing horse, agile like an ape, swift like a crane, fierce like the Tiger King crossing the mountain stream!
In the mountain forest, there were many obstacles!
Boulders, deadwood, thickets, low hills, slopes, mountain streams...
Ding Ling leaped over them.
Running high and low!
The speed was astonishing.
No obstacle could hinder him.
Soon.
He saw a group of black-clad people ahead fleeing for their lives.
Under the dim moonlight.
Ding Ling could vaguely see the group numbered roughly thirty.
They seemed unaware that Ding Ling could run so fast.
Each with a look of shocked terror!
After running frantically for a while.
Seeing Ding Ling's pursuit growing fierce.
Their speed was closing in.
They exchanged glances, suddenly stopping, swiftly turning around, and in perfect harmony shot crossbow arrows at Ding Ling.
Whoosh whoosh!
The crossbow arrows were fast and dense, carrying eerie blue light, and shot furiously.
Ding Ling's heart was filled with intense murder.
His gaze at the black-clad men was as if looking at dead men.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 154: The Assassin Who Specializes in Killing Famous Generals
paragraphs: Clang!
Sunset Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!

The broad and heavy Giant Que Sword now moves with the agility of a butterfly, gracefully dancing, rapidly creating blooms of sword flowers, each one forming a shield against incoming crossbow arrows.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Ding Ling wielded the Giant Que Sword and swiftly dashed forward.
Every crossbow arrow was deflected, unable to come even close to him.
The black-clad figures exchanged glances. Even in the dim moonlight, they could clearly see the horror, unease, and fear in each other's eyes.
"Scatter and run!"
A black-clad figure, towering over seven feet and with a face masked by a dark cloth, suddenly said, then took the lead by sprinting towards the left.
The other black-clad figures followed suit in perfect coordination, dispersing in all directions.
None of them ran towards Ding Ling.
But within the dense forest, where the trees grew thick and numerous, the black-clad figures quickly melted into the darkness and disappeared.
Ding Ling did not pursue the other black-clad figures.
His focus was on the one who shouted 'Scatter and run,' assuming he must be the leader.
In the earlier rain of arrows.
His arrows were the fastest, most poisoned, and most piercing!
And, if his intuition was right, the arrow that struck Diao Chan was surely his!
From the recent clashes of arrow storms.
Ding Ling felt deeply, understanding the intricate nature of the battle.
Whoosh whoosh!
The black-clad man ran swiftly, his movement akin to that of a fleeing rabbit, the sound of whooshing filling the air as he dashed over a hundred meters, faster than a galloping horse.
But no matter how fast he was, he could not surpass Ding Ling.

Burning with anger, Ding Ling operated the two Breathing Techniques at full speed, amplifying his Ascending Skill and Wall-Climbing Technique, allowing his already highly agile body to leap like a crane spreading its wings, fluidly and quickly!
The Five Animals Qigong climbing skill intermittently showed its efficacy.
This made crossing hills and streams seem effortless for Ding Ling.
With no difficulty whatsoever!
In mere moments,
Ding Ling was about to catch up with the black-clad man.
The black-clad man's pupils contracted, his heart filled with immense shock, for he had always been the pursuer, this was his first time being pursued!
"Isn't Ding Ling supposed to be the unrivaled war general on horseback? How is he so fast off the horse too?!"
He was terrified.
For he realized he couldn't shake Ding Ling off.
He climbed steep walls as if it was child's play.
Ding Ling climbed even more nimbly!
He vaulted over mountains and crossed streams with casual ease, while Ding Ling seemed to breeze through the mountains like a gentle wind!
As if a favored child of nature.
Such speed in traversing mountainous terrain.
Indeed made the black-clad man change color, tremble, then find it inconceivable.
"I've subdued countless war generals off their horses, making them obedient!
This Ding Ling..."
The black-clad man trembled, the more he ran, the slower he got.
His stamina was depleting, no longer able to maintain peak speed.
Meanwhile, Ding Ling's speed never faltered.
This was proof that his physique was undoubtedly superior.
"I'll make a stand!"
Realizing he couldn't outrun Ding Ling.
The black-clad man abruptly turned around, drew his bow from both sides, and wildly shot out five or six crossbow arrows at Ding Ling.
Each arrow was swift and fierce, the sound of whooshing splitting the air, aimed at Ding Ling's face, heart, and other vital points!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!

Ding Ling swung the Giant Que Sword, the Sword God Skill unleashed its power, blooming like a hundred flowers, and swept aside the arrows, soaring dozens of meters into the air, explosively landing in front of the black-clad man, impulsively slashing down with no hesitation.
"Whoosh!"
The black-clad man nimbly dodged the strike, rapidly counterattacking.
Arrows flew through the air from unexpected angles, shooting towards Ding Ling.
One or two arrows shattered by Ding Ling, exploding into a rain of needles that descended upon Ding Ling.
This technique, for someone else, would undoubtedly be fatal.
But Ding Ling possessed exceptional defense.
He used the body of the Giant Que Sword to shield his face and vital points, bracing against the needle rain.
Whoosh whoosh!
Clang!
The needle rain had astonishing piercing power.
Several penetrated the armor, stabbing Ding Ling's skin!
But upon reaching this point, they could go no further.
Because Ding Ling's skin was akin to multiple layers of armor!
His defense was remarkably strong!
The needle rain had been dispersed by the Giant Que Sword, weakening its speed and attacking power significantly. Once it penetrated Ding Ling's armor, the attack was already extremely weak.
Naturally incapable of piercing Ding Ling's skin.
Yet this was just Ding Ling, for anyone else, this would be impossible.
"Hahaha...
The black-clad man, seeing this move effective, sprang into the air, nimbly leaping onto a boulder, laughing heartily, looking at Ding Ling with exuberance, loudly declaring:
"No matter how indomitable and unrivaled you are, sweeping through Wan City—you're still doomed to die by Ma Zhong's hand today!"
"Ma Zhong?"
Ding Ling's brow slightly raised.
He recalled a person.
In Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Eastern Wuu had a general named Ma Zhong.
During the battle of Mai City, he set a trap and captured Guan Yu and others.
When Liu Bei attacked Wuu, Ma Zhong ambushed and injured Huang Zhong, leading to Huang Zhong's demise.
In unofficial histories.
Ma Zhong was reputedly incredibly fierce.
Le Jin, Cao Ren, Xuu Chu, and Zhang Liao were rumored to have been killed by his arrows!
Of course. This was unofficial history!
But now it seems.
Ma Zhong in this game's Plane World might indeed be as formidable and terrifying as the unofficial records suggest.
Because his agility was undoubtedly super-elite!
The crossbow arrows were fast and fierce, laced with poison, with various mechanisms!
Diao Chan, agile and nimble like a dragon or phoenix, was hit by him nonetheless.
Not to mention Diao Chan.
Even Ding Ling, when prepared, was hit by one of his unexpected moves.
This was all thanks to Ding Ling's thick skin and high defense; otherwise, he might have really fallen at Ma Zhong's hand!
Such was Ma Zhong.
In forests and wilderness, which favored high agility, encountering him—nine out of ten generals would fail, a fact not to be taken lightly.
On the battlefield, one must also be wary of his stealth arrows.
For his arrows are poisoned!
"That's right."

Ma Zhong seemed confident of victory, appeared to be recovering his Primordial Qi, and seemed to await Ding Ling's eventual demise from poison. Unhurried to leave, having distanced himself from Ding Ling, he laughed heartily:

"You've already been placed on the Yuan Family's high-priced bounty list! Already, many infamous figures have attempted to secretly murder or poison you! But none are quicker than Ma Zhong. In the realm of assassination.
I claim second.
No one else dares claim first in this world!"
He looked towards Ding Ling:

"Rest assured. Your martial prowess will soon spread across the Jiuzhou Land. A general of your caliber, I won't carelessly leave your body in the wilderness. I will surely bring your remains back to Wan City. Claim my bounty, attain rank and title!"
He laughed with abandon and delight:
"I've hidden in the shadows for so many years. At last, I can emerge into the sunlight!"

chapters.title: Chapter 155 155: E-level Medal: The Trump Card of the Assassination Realm
paragraphs: Ma Zhong stared intently at Ding Ling:
"And you will be my stepping stone to advancement, and even more, my Blessed Star! With you, I will have everything."
He laughed loudly:
"You can never imagine how valuable your head is, Ding Ling! By killing you, I can say that I will immediately soar to great heights and enjoy life!"
He said fiercely:
"You can't even imagine the suffering of the people at the bottom of the world!"
He spread his arms wide, as if to embrace the whole world: "But now, I can finally escape the life at the bottom and step into the true noble class!"
Ding Ling indeed couldn't imagine how someone as skilled as Ma Zhong could lead such a hardship-filled life.
Right now, he just wanted to kill him.
"You're so powerful. Why do you still have to run?"
Ding Ling took a step forward.
Ma Zhong immediately jumped off the boulder cautiously, leaping onto another boulder.

He glanced at Ding Ling and chuckled, "Don't even think about getting close to me! Besides, I must remind you, the more you struggle and move, the faster you'll die. If you just stand still, maybe you can live a little longer. But if you move again, I can't guarantee how long you'll live. Maybe in the next blink, you'll drop dead."
Ding Ling frowned at him.
Ma Zhong raised an eyebrow and laughed:

"If not like this, how can I take all the credit alone? If not like this, how could I make you lower your guard? I want nothing but to attack when you least expect it! Because I have the confidence, even on my own, I can kill you."
"You really managed to play the part well."
"As an assassin, being able to act is a required skill. Otherwise, how could you get close to a master and suddenly strike?"
"You make a good point."
Ding Ling initiated his Full-level Acting:
"I must learn from you."
"Hehe."
Ma Zhong let out a proud smile, seeming both smug and self-confident, crossing his hands behind his back, raising an eyebrow, and said:
"In the next life maybe, because in this life you don't have the chance anymore."
"Well said."
Ding Ling sighed:
"I will have to wait for the next life."
He suddenly showed a pained expression, staggered two steps, almost falling to the ground.
But still stood firm with strong determination.
Ma Zhong's eyes lit up, he laughed and said:
"It seems the poison is taking effect."
He rubbed his hands together and said:
"Ding Ling, to say you're the World's Number One warrior is not an exaggeration. It's a pity, with all your might, you will only become my stepping stone to leap into a better future.
Rest assured, I will find a good place to lay you to rest and give you a proper burial."
"Hehe"
Ding Ling weakly let out a cold laugh.
"Laugh all you want. The more you laugh, the quicker you die."
Ma Zhong laughed indifferently.
Then he calmly waited for Ding Ling's death.
A moment later.
He saw Ding Ling kneel on the ground, his face as pale as paper.
His eyes grew brighter and brighter, and he even leaped off the boulder!
It was at the moment of his lowered guard.
Ding Ling suddenly burst into action.
Boom!
The Giant Que Sword in his hand, activated with his 'Throwing Skill' and amplified by two major Breathing Techniques, was thrown heavily with a force of three thousand jin. Boom!
Like a meteor tearing through the sky, carrying a giant wave of wind, it shot through multiple obstacles with tremendous speed and hit Ma Zhong squarely in the abdomen!
Puff!

The Giant Que Sword, incredibly sharp and heavy beyond measure, went through like an iron instrument cutting leather, with a crisp 'puff' sound, directly penetrating Ma Zhong's abdomen, emerging from the other side.
Whoosh!

A tremendous force erupted from the Giant Que Sword, carrying Ma Zhong flying backward more than twenty or thirty meters, toppling and crushing unknown numbers of flowers, thorns, and stones along the way.
Finally, with a loud boom, it embedded straight into a huge stone and stopped.
Ma Zhong looked at Ding Ling in disbelief, his mouth trembling, stammering:
"You, you, you..."
"Surprised?"
Ding Ling stood up tall, with one leap spanned several tens of meters, took two steps forward, and landed in front of Ma Zhong like a Tiger King descending, raising a light breeze and fine dust.
"You, you..."
Ma Zhong was even more shocked and shaken, his eyes bulging like copper bells.
"Hehe."
Ding Ling gently smiled, reaching out his right hand, grasped the hilt of the Giant Que Sword, and sharply pulled it out.
Puff!
The Giant Que Sword came out with a sound.
Puff!
A fountain of blood gushed from Ma Zhong's abdomen.
He clutched the hole with both hands, weakly knelt beside the huge stone, his whole body leaning crookedly against it, looking at Ding Ling.
The shock, confusion, and bewilderment in his eyes were extremely profound.
But perhaps due to the ongoing blood loss, growing weakness, and the approaching threat of the Death God,
The reluctance, panic, unwillingness, and fear in his eyes became even more intense!
Ding Ling reached out and tore away the black cloth from Ma Zhong's face.
Revealing a face as honest and sincere as that of an old farmer.
Just by his appearance, it was hard to imagine that such a person could be an assassin specializing in killing famous generals, always succeeding!
Indeed.
A good actor has a better chance of success.
Ma Zhong's acting had even fooled Ding Ling.
But as the saying goes, you hunt geese all day long, one day you risk being blinded by one!
Facing Ding Ling, someone with Full-level Acting, Ma Zhong, a master meeting a master, was careless and lost his life.
He seemed to have understood this himself, smiled bitterly, and looked at Ding Ling with eyes filled with admiration, surprise, and confusion... a myriad of emotions to the extreme.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: You gained Ma Zhong's Awe.]

[Note: Since beginning his career, Ma Zhong became an assassin hidden in the shadows. He became an assassin in the eyes of the great aristocrats. Many people tried to recruit him, but more people loathed him.
Recruitment meant making him an aristocratic assassin, not bringing him to the forefront.
In the eyes of many significant figures, he was someone who couldn't be seen in the light. Such an assassin should stay lurking underwater, serving the nobles and the lords!
Ma Zhong, naturally unsatisfied, kept striving. Continuously carrying out the tasks assigned by the organization, almost always succeeding.
In the last couple of years.
He finally became the strongest assassin in the organization. No one was his match, no one more ruthless.
At this stage.
He had ambitions to awe the world and ensure his name in history!
And he succeeded.
Countless fierce warriors and strongmen died at his hands. He became the Death God in the eyes of the common folks!
Yet now, he died at your hand, deceived by your better acting skills!
He admired your abilities, was fearful because even in acting, you surpassed him. Naturally, he feared you even more.
Because you are almost perfect in ability, with no apparent weaknesses. Even though he was dying,
he couldn't think of a way to kill you. You have completely won!]
Another E-level Achievement Medal.
And this time the note was exceptionally long.
Imagine the weight of Ma Zhong in this world!

chapters.title: Chapter 156 156: Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle! Treasure Shoes (11/12)
paragraphs: The death of Ma Zhong will definitely overturn the structure of the Assassination Realm, even completely changing the fate of many famous generals who were destined to die!
And it turns out Ma Zhong also had an E-level Medal.
Needless to say, it must mean his agility reached Super-Elite level!

Ding Ling's agility was already extremely high, bolstered further by two major Breathing Techniques, along with the Ascending Skill, Wall-Climbing Technique, and martial arts like the Five Animals Qigong, making climbing cliffs and crossing mountains seem trivial.
But even so, Ding Ling almost couldn't catch up with Ma Zhong at first!
It wasn't until Ma Zhong's endurance declined that he began to gain ground.
At this moment, Ding Ling even seriously doubted that if Ma Zhong truly wanted to escape, he might not catch him, because Ma Zhong's purpose from the beginning was to kill him!
He had been acting with him the entire time.
But no matter what the real essence was, no matter how strong Ma Zhong was, how well he acted, or how fast he ran.
Now he's about to die.
And Ding Ling survived.
Ding Ling's hand trembled, and with a clanking sound, the Giant Que Sword was sheathed!
He carried the sword on his back.
He straightened his back and looked down at Ma Zhong.
"Gurgle, gurgle..."
Ma Zhong stared wide-eyed at Ding Ling, seeming to want to say something, but from his moving throat came only a gurgling of blood.
His injuries were too severe!
Near death!
He even started having hallucinations.
But until his death, he couldn't understand why Ding Ling, who got hit by his poison needle, could be so at ease, so lively!
It should be Ding Ling who died!
How could it be him, Ma Zhong?!
Ma Zhong felt regretful, bewildered, pained, and unwilling...
As his thoughts intensified, more and more blood flowed from his mouth.
He reached out towards Ding Ling, as if he wanted to grab his arm and ask for answers.
Ding Ling ignored him.
He just took two steps back.
A dying person can sometimes have a sudden burst of energy.
He had to be cautious.
Ma Zhong looked on in astonishment, the light in his eyes growing dimmer until it completely faded away.
Even though he died.
Ding Ling didn't approach.
He just waited for several minutes.
Until he saw all the blood drain away.
A small arrow tube slipped from his sleeve and rolled to the ground, and only then did Ding Ling step forward.
He is a healer.
And a top-notch doctor with skills no less than Hua Tuo!
He naturally could see at a glance whether the person was truly dead.
Now Ma Zhong was completely dead.
He first picked up the arrow tube from the ground.
It was a small, pocket-sized cylinder.
Inside were filled with flying needles.
Each needle was coated with a vivid blue liquid.
It was obvious that these were definitely poison needles.
And judging by Ma Zhong's appearance, he was clearly planning to use this arrow tube, no, it should be the 'wooden tube for flying needles' hidden weapon to kill Ding Ling before he died.
"What a sinister, vicious, and deceitful person!"
Ding Ling was secretly glad he was a cautious physician, otherwise, he might have flipped the boat in a small ditch!
"But why does this hidden weapon look so much like the 'Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle'?"
Ding Ling was secretly astonished:
"Was there really a Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle in the Three Kingdoms Era? How eye-opening!"
Ding Ling realized this was a Game World!
And a world full of masters and fierce generals, he was relieved.
It was likely that this Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle was created by the Mo Family's skills?
The Mo Family.
They were indeed a group of ancient scientists! Inventors!
So many incredible Mechanical Skills were born from their hands.
Ding Ling had seen some secret manuals in Wang Yue's study, the Yuan Family's armory, and other places, which included frightening descriptions of the Mo Family.
"How is this hidden weapon used?"
Ding Ling examined it carefully, until he touched a raised area on the tail, and started pondering, maybe this was a button?
Better not try it casually.
This was a one-time 'Magical Treasure'!
Keep it for future use. It might have miraculous effects.
Ding Ling started searching the corpse.
Assassins like Ma Zhong surely had hidden treasures on them.
Besides, judging by Ma Zhong's selfishness and desire to claim all the credit, he was probably a unique existence in the Assassin Organization.
"Assassin Organization..."
Ding Ling frowned, growing angry in his heart, thinking:
"If you provoke me, I'll find a way to destroy you in the future!"
"Eh."
Ding Ling indeed found quite a lot of goodies in Ma Zhong's arms.
A secret manual.
A small box.
Besides these.

Ding Ling also discovered that the shoes he wore were made of Celestial Silkworm Silk, extremely tough and lightweight, not only providing strong defense but also ensuring warmth in winter and coolness in summer, allowing a person's agility and speed to reach their limit.
Without hesitation, Ding Ling put them on.
Discovering that these shoes could expand and enlarge.
The material's elasticity, flexibility, and resilience were so strong that even though Ding Ling's feet were a size larger than Ma Zhong's, he could still fit into them, perfectly and comfortably.
Feeling incredibly comfortable!
"Not bad."
Ding Ling didn't mind using the possessions of the dead, slipping on the new shoes, and kicking Ma Zhong into a mountain stream more than ten meters away.
The sky as a canopy and the earth as a bed, let nature cover his corpse.
He turned and left.
On the way, he first opened the small box.
Inside were several bottles of potions.
Ding Ling carefully observed and studied.
He found out that half of the liquid was a common poison, while the other half was an antitoxin potion.
"Diao Chan can be saved."
Ding Ling's eyes lit up slightly.
He didn't expect Ma Zhong to be carrying an antidote closely with him.
It seemed this guy's arrows might have accidentally injured others or were used for threats?
Nevertheless.
It was good news that Ding Ling got it.
Ding Ling hurriedly returned on his way back.
'The old horse knows the way,' Ding Ling followed the map and quickly returned to the original location.
The journey was calm.
Apart from encountering some wild beasts, he didn't run into any other men in black.
It was obvious they had truly all run away.
"Ding Ling."
Seeing Ding Ling return, Du Qingcheng had slightly red eyes:

"Hongchang's poison needs an antidote. But now it's late at night, in the desolate mountains, not even Hua Tuo can cook without rice. We can only temporarily stabilize Hongchang's injury and wait until tomorrow. It's just, just..."
She glanced at the pitiful face of Diao Chan, tears welling up in her eyes:
"I'm worried, worried..."
"Don't worry."
Ding Ling handed the antidote to Hua Tuo:
"Senior, please take a look if this is the antidote."
"Oh?"
Hua Tuo perked up.
Feeling guilty and sorrowful for not being able to heal Diao Chan.
After all, the few people traveling together on this journey, Diao Chan was someone Hua Tuo approved of, being spirited, sensible, and clever.
He naturally didn't want her to die.
"This is the antidote."
Hua Tuo carefully examined it for a while, overjoyed:
"How did you find it?"
"I took it from the hands of those assassins."
Ding Ling casually explained and then said:
"Hurry and let Diao Chan take the antidote."
Ding Ling frequently referred to Ren Hongchang as Diao Chan along the way.
At first, neither Du Qingcheng nor the others, nor Diao Chan herself, were accustomed to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 157 157: Diao Chan's Resolve (12/12)
paragraphs: But after hearing it a lot, they became accustomed to it.
Even Zhao Yun and Hua Tuo began calling Ren Hongchang as Diao Chan.
Simply because they also agreed with Ding Ling's opinion, feeling that Diao Chan was more fluent and pleasing to the ear, and more fitting for a beauty like her.
Ren Hongchang was too ordinary.
How could it reflect even one percent of Diao Chan's beauty?
Diao Chan had more depth, evoking vivid imaginations.
After hearing the explanation, she was initially a bit conflicted, but seeing Du Qingcheng also saying it sounded nice, she naturally went with it and let everyone call her that.
At this moment, Ding Ling took out the antidote, and Hua Tuo immediately began administering the medicine to Diao Chan.
Du Qingcheng also showed joy, wiped the corner of his eyes, and started helping.
After a while.
Diao Chan's complexion began to improve.
From pale to slightly rosy.
Suddenly, she sat up and spewed a blood arrow from her mouth.
The blood arrow hit the ground, gurgling!
It corroded the floor, leaving a hole.
Ding Ling was shocked, looking at Diao Chan with some worry.
Hua Tuo also glanced over, stroking his beard and saying:

"Don't worry, the antidote was administered timely enough. If it had been three to five more hours, even an immortal couldn't have saved her. One or two hours later, even if saved, her life would be short.
Now it's just right.
The poison hasn't reached her organs.
Moreover, Diao Chan's skills are exceedingly high, her breathing technique extraordinary, with certain detoxification abilities."
He praised:

"This is the first breathing technique I've seen with such capabilities. Remarkable. But perhaps it's due to the exceptional breathing technique that Diao Chan's injuries aren't severe, and she will be fully recovered in a day or two."
Even Hua Tuo said so.
Ding Ling completely breathed a sigh of relief:
"It's good to be alright."
Du Qingcheng was also moved to tears, repeatedly thanking Ding Ling and Hua Tuo.
Hua Tuo gestured with his hand to indicate it was not necessary.
Ding Ling felt slightly guilty.
After all, Diao Chan suffered grave injuries to shield him from the arrows.
Understanding the terrible nature of the poison.
Ding Ling also broke out in a cold sweat.
If he had directly faced those poison arrows, he might have truly fallen!
Fortunately, Ma Zhong was dead.
The world's strongest assassin and killer were dead!
The other assassins were mediocre and not to be worried about.
But even so, Ding Ling exercised extreme caution.
He decided to wear thick, tough armor even when sleeping for safety.

Moreover, he felt that after connecting with the Three Kingdoms World and entering the Martial World, he must find a way to develop an immune to all poisons physique, or else eating or drinking could be risky in the Martial World, too thrilling and dangerous!
"Huh."
Diao Chan murmured softly as she woke from unconsciousness.
Du Qingcheng rushed over and hugged her:
"Hongchang! It's truly wonderful that you're alright. Otherwise, I wouldn't know what to do."
"Qingcheng."
Diao Chan instinctively responded, then reacted, her blurry eyes gradually regaining clarity, she glanced around, then at herself, and blinked:
"I'm alright?"
"Yes. You're healed!"
Ding Ling breathed out deeply, speaking warmly:
"From now on, don't do such things anymore, too dangerous."
If Diao Chan died because of him.
While Ding Ling wouldn't say he'd feel guilty for a lifetime, he'd definitely feel guilty for a long time, possibly unable to be at peace for half his life.
He was clear on grudge and gratitude.
He always thought of repaying those who treated him well or were kind to him.
If he couldn't repay kindness and the person died saving him, how could Ding Ling be at peace?
Fortunately, Diao Chan came back to life and is about to fully recover.
For Ding Ling, this was very good news.
"It's what I should do."
Diao Chan's pretty face flushed, but soon returned to normal.
She solemnly looked at Ding Ling, speaking resolutely:
"As your follower, how can I ignore your safety and not care? If this happens again, I'll still rush in without hesitation."
As soon as she spoke.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao were so jealous and envious that their hearts twisted!
Such a stunning beauty!
If she shed a drop of blood for them, they'd be heartbroken for a long time.
And her?
How much blood did she spill for Ding Ling?
Just thinking about it is painful and unbearably envious!
How come Ding Ling got all the good fortune!
They had to follow unfortunate events?!
The heavens are blind! The heavens are biased!!
"Rushing in is fine. Provided you ensure you're safe."
Ding Ling spoke sternly:
"Otherwise, I'll have to go to great lengths to save you. Wouldn't it be more troublesome?"
He intentionally said this.
He wanted Diao Chan to pay more attention to her safety.
Diao Chan was slightly stunned hearing it, nodding earnestly after a moment:
"I will try my best not to get hurt."
"That is very good."
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting, showing a satisfied expression:
"From now on, we are teammates. Supporting and accommodating each other is necessary. Don't place yourself too low in posture and position.
Even though Diao Chan couldn't see through Ding Ling's acting.
She could sense his thoughtfulness for her.
A warm feeling filled her heart, and her gaze towards Ding Ling was quite nuanced.
Du Qingcheng, unable to join the conversation, didn't chime in.
Only after the conversation between Ding Ling and Diao Chan ended, did he inquire about Diao Chan's injuries again.
Listening for a while.
Once convinced Diao Chan was no longer abnormal, Ding Ling opened the secret manual he got from Ma Zhong by the firelight.
The secret manual was very thin.
Made of silk fabric.
Surprisingly, the secret manual contained several sheets of very new Xuan paper.
Ding Ling first looked at the Xuan paper.
Shockingly, the Xuan paper detailed the Yuan Family's bounty contents.
Thousands of words densely packed.
Among them, the criticism, denigration, and scolding of Ding Ling were extremely articulate.
The bounty rewards mainly consist of several points.
1: Promotion and nobility. Yuan Clan greatly supports! Strongly promotes the person who kills Ding Ling as Supreme General, commanding over fifty thousand troops!
2: One hundred thousand taels of gold! One million taels of silver!
3: Ten estates! All located in major cities like Ye City and Wan City.
4: Over a hundred beauties, more than a thousand servants.
5: Over ten highly profitable handicraft workshops.
6: One Top-Level Breathing Technique. Two top-level martial arts manuals.
Numerous details.
Up to ten clauses.
Don't just say Ma Zhong was tempted.
Even Ding Ling wanted to deliver himself to the sect leader of the Yuan Family.
It's too generous, too luxurious!
"Is this true?"
Zhao Yun saw clearly, his face changed.
"Truer than pure gold."
Ding Ling casually handed the Xuan paper to Zhao Yun:
"Otherwise, what do you think these assassins are here for?"
Zhao Yun read it again, involuntarily taking a deep breath:
"Aren't we facing endless pursuit next?!"
"Let me see."
Diao Chan reached out.
Zhao Yun handed her the Xuan paper.
After reading, Diao Chan frowned and said clearly:
"Doesn't the Yuan Family fear that Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao will be killed by us?"
She discreetly glanced at Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao, causing them to grin awkwardly and flatteringly.

chapters.title: Chapter 158 158: Assassin's Breathing Technique and Martial Arts (1/32)
paragraphs: Heaven knows how nervous, uneasy, and anxious Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao are now.
They cursed everyone in the Yuan Clan to death.
Their hearts were full of complaints.
If it weren't for Ding Ling and Diao Chan in front, they would have rushed to the Yuan Clan's residence, found the one offering the bounty, and slapped them dozens of times without saying a word!
This is too much!
This completely disregards the lives of Yuan Yin (Yuan Yao)! They are being roasted on a fire!
A bunch of villains!
Such intentions deserve punishment!!
There were also entanglements and internal conflicts within the clan.
Though Ding Ling was not very clear about the intricacies, he knew that Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao must have been abandoned by some of the Yuan Family.
But there were also some who chose to protect them at all costs.
Otherwise, the bounty note wouldn't specify not to harm Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao.
Ding Ling thought for a moment and said:
"Perhaps it is because of fear. That is why the man in black retreated after missing his strike."
Ding Ling, through the E-level Medal's note, already knew that Ma Zhong and his group were a group of assassins who couldn't be seen in the light, who couldn't come to the forefront.
This bounty was clearly a chance for Ma Zhong to leap to great heights.
He couldn't afford to miss it.
Naturally, he couldn't afford to make a mistake either.
The so-called mistake would be to kill Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao! This would have no benefit for Ma Zhong and his group!
Even if he killed Ding Ling, he would definitely be targeted and killed by Yuan Shu and others!
Since Ma Zhong cherished this opportunity so much, he wouldn't intentionally kill Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao.
Even concerned for their safety.
They even lured Ding Ling away, trying to deal with him from afar.
Because as long as Ding Ling left alone, they could launch a barrage of arrows without worrying about accidentally harming him.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling was suddenly enlightened and voiced his speculation.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao let out a long sigh of relief and quickly said:
"That's right, that's right, we are of some use! We definitely won't hold you back! Please don't kill us!"
They were truly afraid that Ding Ling would strike them with a sword.
In their eyes, Ding Ling was a reckless brute, a butcher!
A ruthless person who would do anything!
"Since that's the case, let them watch the night. Have them act as guards at the front. They can't wear armor, just a single layer of clothing!"
Diao Chan suggested:
"This way, even if there really is another assassin, Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao will die first."
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao stared, their expressions gloomy as they glanced at Diao Chan. Their hearts raced and trembled, once again changing their perception of Diao Chan.
Such an unimaginably beautiful woman, like a Celestial Immortal.
Turned out to be so vicious!
They felt they had misplaced their hearts, they shouldn't have fancied and liked her so much!
"Makes sense."
Du Qingcheng was the first to nod in agreement.
For her.
No one in Yuan Shu's family was a good person!
Not only did they almost cause her death,
they also poisoned Diao Chan, nearly killing her!
Such a family shouldn't exist in this world!
"Then it's settled."
Ding Ling nodded, thus setting the plan in place.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao wanted to cry but had no tears.
But facing Ding Ling and Zhao Yun's group of 'Werewolves' with menacing eyes, they could only swallow their bitterness.
They secretly hoped that the clan members would quickly retract the Wanted Order.
And hurry to save them!
Otherwise, it's too hard to endure.
If this continues any longer.
They feel they will be played to death!
Rustle!
Ding Ling opened the Secret Manual for a detailed look.
The Secret Manual recorded the methods of nurturing assassins.
The pain, torture, and imprisonment they went through were beyond the imagination of ordinary people!
"This Assassin Organization's inhumane methods can surely nurture batch after batch of cold-blooded killers."
Ding Ling was deeply moved after reading the chapter on nurturing assassins:
"I just don't know if they will send assassins again. If they do, we must be prepared."
Ding Ling immediately shared his guess with everyone.
Then strictly ordered everyone to not leave their armor or weapons, to better handle any enemy at any moment.
As for Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao, naturally, they had no armor and no weapons.
Seeing Ding Ling's group fully armed while they were in single garments, they couldn't help but feel increasingly desolate. Their liking for the one offering the bounty diminished even further.
They secretly vowed that if they could return alive this time, they would surely fight to the death with those in the clan trying to kill them!
Swish!
Ding Ling flipped to the Cultivation Technique section for assassins:
"Shadow Breathing Technique"
"Sleeve Arrow"
"Shadow Arrow Skill"
Three Techniques.
Ding Ling first looked at the Shadow Breathing Technique.
After reading once.
He closed his eyes.
A new illusory book appeared on the bookshelf, inscribed with the words Shadow Breathing Technique.
It stood alongside the illusory Flying Bear Breathing Technique and others.
At this moment, Ding Ling felt very clearly.
The Shadow Breathing Technique was definitely a top-tier Breathing Technique! It was an assassin's exclusive Breathing Technique!
What he didn't expect was.
That Ma Zhong would carry such an important Cultivation Technique with him.
Why?
He was puzzled.
But that didn't prevent him from continuing to look on.
After finishing Sleeve Arrow.
He closed his eyes.
A book quickly manifested on the library's bookshelf:
"Sleeve Arrow"!
In an instant.
[Sleeve Arrow Full Level]
A surge of warmth rushed through his entire body and quickly dissipated.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel.
Strength, Agility, Constitution, Defense all had not increased by even 0.1 Attribute Points.
Currently, Ding Ling's strength was:
[Strength 30, Agility 23.1, Constitution 24.9, Defense 30]
Upon reaching 20 points.
Low-tier Martial Arts could no longer increase Strength, Agility, or Constitution Attribute Points. They could only focus all energy on Defense, to increase Defense Attribute Points.
And now Defense had already reached 30 points!
So low-tier Martial Arts obviously couldn't increase Defense Attribute Points anymore.
None of the Four-dimensional Attribute Points could increase.
But Ding Ling still sensed the warmth.
It was clear.
This was because the energy intensity wasn't large enough.

Perhaps once he learned enough low-tier Martial Arts, this energy would eventually accumulate like grains of sand into a tower, forming rivers and seas, allowing Ding Ling to truly achieve Attribute Points improvement.
"Though the Attribute Points can no longer be increased, low-tier Martial Arts are still useful to me."
The various skills of Sleeve Arrow were already ingrained in Ding Ling's mind, instinctively familiar!
At this moment.
He had become a master in the aspect of Sleeve Arrow.
'Continue.'
Ding Ling carefully looked at "Shadow Arrow Skill"
After one reading.
A book appeared on the library's bookshelf.
In an instant.
[Shadow Arrow Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.2]
The warmth Ding Ling felt this time was very strong, lasting for a little while before dissipating.
Ding Ling could distinctly feel himself becoming more nimble, and his vitality and endurance had also greatly increased!
"Very nice."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
To know that after the Overlord Halberd Technique reached Full Level, it only provided Agility +0.4, Constitution +0.4.
And now his strength compared to the past was far greater.
Reaching his current level of strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 159 159: Arrows Fired by the Shadow Arrow Skill Are Silent and Unseen (2/32)
paragraphs: Many martial arts can no longer increase Attribute Points.
However, the Shadow Arrow Skill can still increase his agility by 0.3 and constitution by 0.2.
This is already quite rare.
It also shows the remarkable nature of the Shadow Arrow Skill.
Ding Ling's mind was filled with the essence, esoteric truth, and techniques of the Shadow Arrow Skill.
Soon it became integrated into his instincts.
Became a skill deeply engraved in Ding Ling's heart.
"Shadow Arrow Skill."
Ding Ling walked up to the Ferghana Horse, took out the Six-Stone Bow from its side, and quickly used the Shadow Arrow Skill. Whoosh, whoosh!
An arrow appeared like a ghost in the night, silently, suddenly before a large tree, thud!
It pierced the tree more than three inches deep.
This sound of piercing finally awakened everyone.
Diao Chan was taken aback, glancing sideways:
"This archery skill is terrifying! You can't hear any sound!"
"It's not that you can't hear it, but the sound is mostly overshadowed and covered by a vigorous qi in the arrow, leaving only a little sound barely audible."
Hua Tuo's ears moved slightly, realizing something, emotionally said:

"This archery skill definitely belongs to a top divine skill! Ordinary families can't possibly possess this skill. Ding Ling, it seems you didn't know this skill before, but after flipping through that Assassin's Secret Manual, you learned it. Could it be that this skill is a divine skill recorded on the Secret Manual?"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling handed the Secret Manual to Hua Tuo.
Hua Tuo waved his hand, not wanting to take advantage of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling smiled and tucked it into his arms:

"Just take a look, it doesn't matter. It contains the Assassin's cultivation techniques, which you must be guarded against next time. You can get an impression of the techniques from the Secret Manual, making it easier to recognize who is an assassin and who isn't, so as not to let an assassin come close while being unaware."
With Ding Ling's words.
Hua Tuo could only accept the Secret Manual and began to study it carefully.
He finished reading and sighed deeply, gaining a deeper understanding of the inhumane and cold-hearted nature of assassins:

"The martial arts of assassins are indeed extraordinary. This assassin could keep such martial arts hidden close to the body. It shows his high status within their organization; he was definitely a leader. Now that he is dead, I'm afraid the assassin organization won't let this go easily."
Ding Ling showed the Secret Manual to Zhao Yun and others, asking them to share it among themselves.
To Ding Ling.
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng were like his own people now.
Since Hua Tuo could read it, there was no reason they couldn't.
Besides, he had mastered the techniques on the Secret Manual at Full Level, so it was useless to him.
The most important thing is.
The contents of this Secret Manual are known to all assassins!
If his own people didn't know, it would be too detrimental. If Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, or Du Qingcheng fell victim to it and lost their lives, it would be too late to regret.
That's why Ding Ling had no intention of keeping the Assassin's Secret Manual to himself.
So many assassins know the Assassin's Secret Manual; keeping it as a trump card is self-deception, isn't it?
It's best to give this Secret Manual to Zhao Yun and the others to enhance their foundation.
If they learn Sleeve Arrow and Shadow Arrow Skill, then that's even better.
After all, they are a team. If everyone becomes a Divine Archer, their journey across the world will definitely be smoother.
"This Shadow Arrow Skill is so difficult."
Diao Chan, after looking through it, immediately recognized that Ding Ling had just used the Shadow Arrow Skill and was shocked and confused, looking at Ding Ling:
"You learned the Shadow Arrow Skill to the level of mastery in such a short time?"
Ding Ling nodded.
Diao Chan gasped.
Du Qingcheng was even more astounded.
Yuan Yin had a look on his face as if Ding Ling was fooling a fool.
Hua Tuo was quite calm, clearly having long accepted Ding Ling's miraculous talent.
Zhao Yun was used to it, but seeing Diao Chan and others like this, he couldn't help but feel honored as part of the group, with a sense of collective pride, saying with some self-satisfaction:

"Ding Ling's talent is unrivaled in the world, a true child of the era. Both my master and Sword God elder, Medicine King elder, highly recognize his gift, predicting that he will definitely achieve the position of Martial God in the future."
"Such talent is bound to become a Martial God, it's genuinely justified."
Diao Chan looked at Ding Ling with bright eyes, filled with admiration and respect.

Although she has not been in contact with Zhao Yun for long, she knew Zhao Yun was definitely not someone who speaks carelessly, and furthermore, Hua Tuo was also calm, Diao Chan thought slightly and understood the truth.
She couldn't help but be more amazed and impressed.
At this moment, she even remembered the commotion in the Armory.
At the time, she was on the top floor, couldn't hear clearly, and now it seemed it must've been the strange noise Yuan Yao made when Ding Ling quickly learned the Yuan Family Secret Technique.
Yuan Yao at this moment also looked bemused.
He remembered the scene when Ding Ling learned Human Emperor Swordsmanship.
Couldn't help but feel uncertain, thinking:
"Could it be that Ding Ling is not a descendant of Liu Bang, not a Dragon Child or Dragon Descendant, but simply has a swift pace in martial arts training?"
Is this even possible?!
Learning top divine skills in such a short time?
Whom is he fooling?
Does he really think Yuan Yao is a fool?
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin looked at each other, neither believing that Ding Ling's talent was so terrifyingly supreme. Absolutely, he learned the Shadow Arrow Skill by chance before!
"The main thing is to be able to kill an assassin who has cultivated the Shadow Arrow Skill to mastery, which really is not easy."
Hua Tuo pondered for a while, then said:

"The arrow that shot at Diao Chan, although not as powerful and fast as Ding Ling's arrow, still in terms of ghostliness and being hard to defend against, can be considered neck and neck. Shows that the opponent's practice of Shadow Arrow Skill has also reached the Transformation Realm."
He sighed:
"Fortunately, this person is dead. Otherwise, with his archery skill, in the dark, in the forest, in chaotic armies, many great generals would die at his hands!"
A number of assassins know the Shadow Arrow Skill.
The previous men in black clearly did.
But only Ma Zhong practiced the Shadow Arrow Skill to mastery!
Shows Ma Zhong's talent in archery!
Such a genius falling.
Also, it makes Hua Tuo both regretful and relieved. Because he knows that as long as this killer exists in the world, he would take many more lives.
He's not like Ding Ling who kills openly and rightly on the battlefield, or those deserving of death.
He assassinates, moving in the shadows. He couldn't be exposed to the light.
Hua Tuo has no particular liking for such a person.
"Indeed."
Diao Chan looked at Ding Ling with a beautiful glance:

"I really didn't notice that arrow at all. Otherwise, with my skills, I could have blocked it completely. Now that you've learned the Shadow Arrow Skill, it seems countering these assassins won't be a big issue."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Would you like to learn?"
"Can I?"
Diao Chan was delighted.
"Of course."
Ding Ling nodded:
"I can teach you."
Diao Chan quickly thanked him.
Ding Ling looked at Zhao Yun and Du Qingcheng, who were eagerly expecting:
"I can teach you too."

However, the Shadow Arrow Skill can still increase his agility by 0.3 and constitution by 0.2.
This is already quite rare.

chapters.title: Chapter 160 160: Uncle, Listen to My Explanation (3/32)
paragraphs: Hua Tuo was very envious:

"Just by glancing at the Secret Manual, you've cultivated the Divine Skill to the level of Mastery. It's something I wouldn't even dare to dream of! Still, now that you've learned this Shadow Arrow Skill, you are indeed qualified to be a mentor to the likes of Zhao Yun. You guys practice the Divine Skill on the side. I'll go into the woods to hunt some game and look for some wild vegetables.
I'll make some barbecue.
Get the food ready for tomorrow."
"Thank you, senior."
Ding Ling nodded.
Then he took Diao Chan and the others aside to teach them the Shadow Arrow Skill.
He carefully analyzed the esoteric truths, essence, and principles of the Shadow Arrow Skill for them to understand.
Most of the Divine Skills in this world require guidance, teaching, and enlightenment to be mastered.
Otherwise, even with a Secret Manual in hand and high talents, it's difficult to reach a very high level.
It's like a kindergarten student being handed a university mathematics textbook. Even with explanations, someone with limited aptitude may not learn it, let alone without any guidance.
The thing that reassured Ding Ling was that Diao Chan and the others already had a foundation in Archery Skill and were incredibly gifted in Martial Dao.
Du Qingcheng, although lagging behind Diao Chan in mastering Sword Skill and Body Technique.
In Archery Skill, however, her comprehension and learning ability were not inferior to Diao Chan and Zhao Yun at all.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin stood not far away, watching, not daring to run, just exchanging glances.
"Do you believe it?"
Yuan Yao asked Yuan Yin.
"Anyone who believes it is a fool."
Yuan Yin said in a low voice:
"I've always thought Ding Ling and the others are a bit reckless and naive. We should be careful not to get dragged into their mess. Stay alert and find a chance to escape at any moment."
"Hmm."
Yuan Yao let out a sigh of relief.
He thought he was the only one who didn't believe it.
But is Ding Ling really naive?
He glanced at Yuan Yin with doubt, recalling his earlier behavior, causing him to twitch at the corner of his eye.
"What's with that look?"
Yuan Yin said dissatisfied.
"No, it's nothing."
Yuan Yao waved his hand.
"Do you think my actions at the Yuan Mansion earlier were foolish?"
Yuan Yin noticed it.
Yuan Yao awkwardly laughed.
"Hmph."
Yuan Yin snorted disdainfully:

"It's because I often mingle with the upper echelons that I encountered such terrifying Martial Arts for the first time, daring to disregard the reputation of the Three Ministers brawny man! If I weren't so confident in the Yuan Family's reputation, I wouldn't be standing here with you, facing the cold winds from the northwest!"
As he spoke, he became more and more discontented:
"I stood up for you, and you still mock me. Yuan Yao, you've disappointed me greatly!"
"Uncle, let me explain..."
Ding Ling's comprehension of the Shadow Arrow Skill had reached an extraordinary level.
His explanations were gradual, straightforward, and easy to understand.

To help Diao Chan and the others master the Shadow Arrow Skill more deeply, quickly, and effectively, he even explained parts of the essence from the Double Extreme Arrow Skill and Tornado Arrow Technique to assist in their understanding of the Shadow Arrow Skill.
Compared to the Double Extreme Arrow Skill and Tornado Arrow Technique,
the Shadow Arrow Skill was evidently a higher level!
It not only had faster speed and more formidable attack power but was also more concealable!
Upon mastering it to the level of Mastery,
using the Breathing Technique, one could activate an extraordinarily peculiar protective Vigorous Qi while employing the Shadow Arrow Skill.
This Vigorous Qi could make the arrows faster and more rapid, almost silencing the sound of them breaking through the air.
It was as if a silencer had been attached to the arrows.
Extremely magical and excellent.
If not for this,
the Shadow Arrow Skill would not be ranked above the Double Extreme Arrow Skill and Tornado Arrow Technique!
It's known that the Double Extreme Arrow Skill paired with the Tornado Arrow Technique, when amplified with the Breathing Technique, could hold its ground against Lü Bu's Archery Skill!
This demonstrates the extraordinary nature of these two Archery Skills.
Yet the Shadow Arrow Skill is even stronger!
If these two Archery Skills were paired with it,
at a glance, three Shadow Arrows would burst forth, definitely acting like a lawnmower on the battlefield!
Generally, the Shadow Arrow Skill is only capable of shooting one arrow.
At its limit, it can shoot two arrows.
However, shooting two arrows with it is not cost-effective.
Because its attack speed is extremely fast, the speed of changing arrows is as swift as a Thunderbolt!
One can rapidly switch between two arrows within the span of a breath, with the attack power of each arrow reaching its peak.
However, shooting two arrows evidently reduces their attack power.
Therefore, those proficient in the Shadow Arrow Skill typically shoot only one arrow when facing experts.
But they'll pull the bowstring at a high frequency and speed to shoot more arrows to kill enemies.
Previously when facing off with Ding Ling,
several assassins among them used the Shadow Arrow Skill against him. But more used the Sleeve Arrow.
The Sleeve Arrow can be automatically fired with a crossbow, making it more convenient for firing from both left and right like it was nothing.
Of course, those who have mastered the Shadow Arrow Skill to Ma Zhong's level typically do not prefer the Sleeve Arrow.
But Ma Zhong's Sleeve Arrows were more numerous, denser, and concealing more mysteries.
It was natural for him to use the Sleeve Arrow.
And Ding Ling also speculated that Ma Zhong must be proficient in at least one Hidden Weapon Technique or Lightweight Body Technique that could pair with the Sleeve Arrow.
However, it wasn't recorded in this Secret Manual.
This left Ding Ling with slight regret.
If he could learn Ma Zhong's Hidden Weapon Technique and Lightweight Body Technique, he would be truly invincible in forest combat.
Time passed like water.
Within the blink of an eye, several hours had gone by.
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng all looked at Ding Ling with extreme admiration.
Zhao Yun wasn't too surprised, already accustomed to it.
But for Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng, it was the first time they were taught by Ding Ling in this manner, leaving them utterly speechless.
Simply because they discovered Ding Ling's teaching was no less than their mentors, hitting the nail on the head in some places, was very rare!
Moreover, they were full of sighs.
When facing a super assassin proficient in Shadow Arrow Skill,
Ding Ling had been able to counterattack and kill even before learning the Shadow Arrow Skill.
Now that he had learned it...
Doesn't that mean any coming assassins are doomed?
They were inexplicably looking forward to it.
The next dawn.
After resting for a while, Ding Ling and his group continued on their journey after having their fill.
All were top horses.
Ding Ling's and Zhao Yun's horses were especially the finest steeds in this world, extremely fast.
A thousand miles a day might be exaggerated for the Ferghana Horse, but running seven or eight hundred miles was still achievable.
Ding Ling's mount, the Ferghana Horse, perhaps due to this world having a better environment than reality with more Great Medicine available, was much better than fine horses in reality.
Thus, running several hundred miles daily was usual for the Ferghana Horse.
An extreme sprint of a thousand miles was possible, but this could potentially damage the Ferghana Horse's body.
Ding Ling's group didn't need to rush and gallop so hurriedly.
After traveling for several hours.
It was noon.
Ding Ling found an opportunity to return to reality.
With this return,
he intended to test whether he could bring the Martial Arts he learned back to reality without using the Achievement Medal.
He actually wanted to test it before.
But his strength wasn't sufficient at the time...
