chapters.title: Chapter 161 161: Why Can't We Instantly Become Strong in the Real World
paragraphs: Ding Ling had a constant sense of urgency, feeling like he could be targeted for kidnapping by the rich first generation or foreign mercenary groups at any moment.
So every time he returned to reality,
he would use Achievement Medals to exchange for strength.
The enhancement of his strength brought him a strong sense of security.
And now, back in reality, he could climb walls and leap across rooftops as easily as walking, and lifting a cauldron with both hands was as effortless as eating and drinking.
This slightly increased his sense of security.
He naturally had a notion to test it out a bit.
Don't think his 'persecution complex' is too severe.
Reality is often more dramatic than imagined!
And more brutal!
Ding Ling was well aware of this.
Especially after he accidentally learned online that many were searching for him, his sense of crisis skyrocketed.
He had a Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat.
The speed of enhancing his skills was incredibly fast.
It was only natural for people to notice and investigate.
For safety, Ding Ling was eager to enhance his skill level, which was very normal.
For this reason,
he moved multiple times.
All his residences were far from monitored urban areas, heading towards mountain villages instead.
Even if he looked up information online and mastered 'Makeup Skill' to the point of being indistinguishable from real,
in reality, makeup was only basic and couldn't change one's bone structure unless Ding Ling resorted to surgery on his face.
But Ding Ling would never do such a thing.
Because with the transformation of martial arts and the enhancement of his strength, his height, appearance, and aura subtly changed, making facial alteration unnecessary.
And because of the large number of players in the game, Ding Ling's changes in appearance were also crystal clear online.
Now more and more people knew he was Ding Ling.
They knew his workplace, study location, etc.
Why wouldn't they know, seeing as he had topped the power rankings in every major list?
Whether it was the strength, agility, or other Attribute Points ranking,
or the Divine Weapon, Martial Arts, and comprehensive rankings, etc.,
he was first.
Crushing the second and third places!
His rate of improvement was akin to a rocket, and many big families wanted to replicate another Ding Ling.
As such, the search for Ding Ling never ceased.
But with his Makeup Skill Full Level, Hacker Skills Full Level, etc.,
his disguise abilities had reached a pinnacle in the real world.
Even so.
Ding Ling remained very cautious.
He never went to the city.

No matter how well he disguised, it was almost impossible to fully conceal his aura, and if someone truly wanted to find him, they could easily spot him through monitoring and other screening methods.
After all, in the city, one had to buy groceries, food, etc., which involved social interactions.
Interacting meant the risk of exposure.
Even if the chance of risk exposure was one in a million!
Ding Ling didn't want to take that risk!
Whereas the rural villages were much better.

Especially the deep mountain areas, particularly impoverished village regions, usually with only a few households, and rarely communicating with the outside world even once or twice a year, were the safest.
Ding Ling lived in such places, spending very little money.
He could occasionally venture deep into the mountains to hunt for some game.
The only solace for Ding Ling was that the Blue Star World wasn't as harsh as Earth.
There were many wild species there, so hunting wild boar, leopards, etc., wasn't illegal.
If it were on Earth in his previous life, he would never dare to do such a thing!
Don't think he's cowardly.
No matter how strong he was, could he withstand bullets and artillery?
He couldn't.
So he had to be cautious!
At this moment.
Ding Ling returned to reality.
Recollecting the 'Sleeve Arrow' and 'Shadow Arrow Skill' martial arts in his mind.
"Hmm? It is indeed at full level,"
Ding Ling could feel that he could use the Sleeve Arrow and Shadow Arrow Skill any time, anywhere!
But it seemed that the Attribute Points brought by the enhancement of the Shadow Arrow Skill did not return.
"Apparently, that's not possible."
Ding Ling frowned, pondering:
"In the game, martial arts that are full level remain in that state when returning to reality.
Even without the Achievement Medal, they are still full level!
This shows the power of the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat!
But it seems like this full level cheat won't let me quickly become stronger."
Ding Ling remembered the Makeup Skill and other skills he had learned recently.
They hadn't increased his Attribute Points at all.
Completely different from the beginning.
At first, he was puzzled.
But recalling the situation in the game, he suddenly understood:
"In the game, low-tier martial arts no longer increase the Four-dimensional Attribute Points.
Even high-tier martial arts.
Their Attribute Points gain is continuously weakening now!
In reality, all skills are basic!
They can't even compare to low-tier martial arts!
Just like the archery skills in reality, etc.
Compared to the Double Extreme Arrow Skill, Tornado Arrow Technique, they're nothing but trash!
And the Double Extreme Arrow Skill, Tornado Arrow Technique belong to low-tier martial arts.
Currently, these low-tier martial arts can't directly increase Ding Ling's Attribute Points!
It's easy to imagine the condition of basic skills in reality.
It was just because Ding Ling was too weak initially that basic skills could enhance his physical abilities.
But as he continued to grow stronger, basic skills first lost their effect of increasing Attribute Points.
Next would be low-tier martial arts.
Soon enough, it might turn to high-tier martial arts!
How things turn out needs further investigation.
"But strangely, even if basic skills are useless, the Shadow Arrow Skill, logically a high-tier martial art, why can't it increase Attribute Points in reality?"
Ding Ling took a deep breath, activating the two Breathing Techniques.
His entire body felt lighter.
At the same time.
The unique Vigorous Qi of the Shadow Arrow Skill flowed from his arm to his palm as Ding Ling mimicked a bow and arrow stance, carefully sensing the Vigorous Qi of the Shadow Arrow Skill.
After a long while.
He found relief:
"It seems the real world is lacking a kind of Spiritual Mechanism?"
It's a difficult feeling to describe.
Speaking in hypothetical terms.
It's like the Spiritual Qi in novels.
Ding Ling could only think this way.
Because he didn't know what the special Vigorous Qi substance unique to practicing martial arts in the Three Kingdoms World was either.
He temporarily called it Spiritual Mechanism.
"The real world also has this Spiritual Mechanism. It's just so sparse it's almost invisible!"
"This Spiritual Mechanism is fine for practicing basic skills."
"To cultivate high-tier martial arts? It would probably take a hundred years, or even longer."
To put it vividly.
Practicing basic skills needs one point of Spiritual Mechanism.
High-tier martial arts might require 1,000, or even 10,000 or 100,000 points of Spiritual Mechanism.
The difference is a thousandfold, ten-thousandfold, and possibly even more.
For ordinary people, the difficulty is imaginable.
Even with cheats, Ding Ling found the real world's Spiritual Mechanism extremely limited and couldn't satisfy him at all.
Frankly speaking.
With cheats, Ding Ling was like a dragon capable of swallowing rivers and seas;
while the Spiritual Mechanism of the real world was like a small fish pond.
When the dragon was extremely weak, perhaps the small fish pond could satiate him a bit.
But when the dragon grew to a certain degree, the small fish pond couldn't meet his needs at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Diao Chan’s Sword Is Swift
paragraphs: Make it more vivid.
Ding Ling is like a big-bellied man, but the food at home is only a loaf of bread.
No matter how much he can eat, how strong his digestive ability is, or how amazing his growth potential is.
It’s useless!
This is the typical case where a shallow pond can’t nurture a true dragon!
After considering it thoroughly.
Ding Ling picked up the game helmet and returned once more to the Game World.
Then, by consuming the Achievement Medals to exchange for a set of strength, he returned to the real world.
Sure enough.
His guess was correct.
After the game exchange.
His real self indeed immediately became stronger.
And during the process of becoming stronger, it seemed to have absorbed a mysterious energy unique to the Three Kingdoms World.
Ding Ling called this energy the Spiritual Mechanism.
"Hu."
Ding Ling exhaled a long breath, no doubts left, no more thinking, or dwelling on the matter.
However, he became increasingly sure of one thing:
"The Three Kingdoms World seems like a Game World. But it could be a real great world!"
He was shocked:
"How did this Game World make it possible to travel to the Three Kingdoms World using the game helmet?"
He was bewildered, puzzled.
But most likely could imagine the invincible and powerful nature of the people behind the scenes.
Once again, a sense of urgency rose in his heart.
No matter how things are now.
It’s still best to enhance oneself first.
As long as he becomes stronger.
Some fog will naturally dissipate.
Just like why Martial Arts in the game can’t directly strengthen us in the present world.
If it were before, he definitely wouldn’t understand.
But as his strength and defense reached the limit values of the Breathing Technique, his perception of the Spiritual Mechanism became more profound.
This is also why he could assess the reason for the lack of Spiritual Mechanism in the present world.
If it were before.
He lacked the strength of such tangible perception.
He might rack his brain and still not figure out the reason!
Even if he figured it out, it would be a guess, unable to be proven at all.
But now he has proven it!
"This is just the beginning. Once I become powerful enough, all truths may surface!
Ding Ling’s eyes shone with determination, and after eating and drinking in reality.
He once again returned to the Game World.
After returning.
He sought out the group.
And once again mounted the horse to journey on.
By noon that day.
He reached the border of Nanyang.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin once again requested to return.
Ding Ling ignored them.
Continued to gallop.
Only stopped near Langling City, within the Earth Realm of Runan.
Langling City was very close to Nanyang. It was a ’border’ town connecting Nanyang and Runan.
After passing Langling City, and traveling for another half day’s journey, they would reach the destination.
The place where the plague broke out.
Ding Ling didn’t plan to enter the city.
But thinking about how their daily necessities had been exhausted along the way, he intended to enter the city to purchase some items.
Especially salt.
This item is indispensable.
Going too long without salt, even someone as sturdy as Ding Ling couldn’t bear it.
He hadn’t yet reached the fasting stage.

Diao Chan proactively took over this matter, saying that Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s profile was too large, appearing would surely cause a sensation, leading to more unnecessary trouble. Thus, having her go was the most convenient.
Diao Chan knew about the Alien group.
Among their group.
She was the one who had the least contact with Aliens, almost zero contact.
Also, because she wore a visor along the way.
Apart from Ding Ling’s group, almost no one knew what Diao Chan looked like.
Considering this, Ding Ling agreed.
"I’ll be back soon!"
Diao Chan changed into a peasant woman’s attire, wrapped her face with a light veil, and wore a straw hat as she headed into the city.
She didn’t ride a horse.
Because the horse would draw attention.
This trip was only for purchasing supplies, surely swift and decisive, not drawing attention.
She understood this well.

When there was no one outside the city, she activated the Breathing Technique, operated the Flying Swallow Technique, moving like a nimble flying swallow, rapidly soaring as if a bird gliding just above the ground, with great beauty.
Although dressed as a peasant woman, when operating the technique, her refreshing aura was hard to control and spread.
Only by not activating the Breathing Technique and not using techniques could her ugly attire barely suppress her aura somewhat.
But even so.
Standing among people, she was a presence akin to a crane among chickens.

Fortunately, as the Alien group continued to ’invade’ the Three Kingdoms, signs of chaos became more apparent, many beautiful player women with different temperaments also entered this world, Diao Chan’s attire, although peculiar, wasn’t overly noticed for the time being.
This was naturally a good thing for Diao Chan.
She exhaled deeply, holding the silver, she quickly made her way to a long street in Langling City.
There were many shops here.
She headed straight for one shop, buying salt and other daily supplies.
Upon exiting.
Carrying a small bag, she was about to leave.
Suddenly overheard someone speaking in low tones.
Her unique Breathing Technique made her ears and eyes remarkably sharp, exceeding those of a First-class Fierce General, hence she heard it quite clearly:
"I heard Ding Ling, Zhao Yun and their group have arrived in our Runan. The General is gearing up to ambush them! Is this true?"

"Absolutely true. One of the Generals has already arrived in Langling City. Within a few hours, the other Generals may also come. Our army’s elite will join, this time we won’t engage in brute force, but use tactics, surely we can capture and kill Ding Ling and Zhao Yun!"
Upon hearing this, Diao Chan’s fair face changed color, glaring angrily.

She delayed her departure, flicking her wrist, the Fish Guts Sword slipped out from her sleeve, grasped in her hand, she operated the Breathing Technique, Flying Swallow Technique reinforcing herself, as a Phantom Assassin in the shadows, swiftly circumventing over a dozen people, reaching a side alley of the shop.
It was a dead end.
There were five large men whispering upfront.
Seeing Diao Chan approach, they all stared, then collectively scrutinized her, upon seeing, each of their eyes gleamed, chuckling:
"Little lady, staring at us fiercely, what do you intend? Could it be that we offended you? Seeking revenge? If so, we’ll ensure you experience another unforgettable night."
Judging by their expressions.
Listening to their words.
Clearly a case of molesting women.
They had done more than once.
Diao Chan didn’t speak, having quite an experience dealing with such folks.
Whoosh!

Under the Flying Swallow Technique’s operation, Diao Chan surged like a graceful butterfly in flight, wielding the Fish Guts Sword, unfolding the Rouyun Saber Technique, transforming the Divine Sword at this moment into seemingly a knife blade!
The saber light was splendid.
Amidst the clattering sounds, Diao Chan fluidly navigated, dodging rapidly, quickly slicing through the squad of five.
Four of them clutched their throats, looking at Diao Chan in horror.
Blood seeped through their fingers, uncontrollably gushing.
They wanted to speak.
But no sound emerged.
Diao Chan’s Divine Weapon, the Fish Guts Sword, was incredibly sharp, complemented by her nimble Rouyun Saber Technique, unhindered and peerless.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Diao Chan vs. Yellow Turban General Gongdu
paragraphs: Diao Chan made a decisive strike.
Severing their vocal cords, the dagger sliced through their necks.
They were beyond saving.
Diao Chan looked at the last surviving burly man.
The burly man retreated several steps in fright.
He was utterly terrified and panicked! If the path behind him weren’t a dead end, he would undoubtedly run away with all his might.
But now Diao Chan blocked the exit.
He could only laugh dryly and plead:
"Mercy, heroine, spare my life. I was just joking before; my mouth was foul, I deserve a beating, deserve it."
As he spoke, he heavily slapped his own face.
The sound of slapping echoed loudly.
This drew the attention of many passersby, and when they realized what was happening, their faces changed drastically, and they quickened their pace to leave.
There were almost no screams.
It was evident that such incidents were common in Langling City.
The chaos in Runan, seen through a glimpse, revealed a fraction.
"Take me to see your General."
Diao Chan said coldly.
Even though she was disguised.
Her voice remained as clear and cold as a spring flowing into one’s heart, causing the burly man to shiver.
For a moment.
He couldn’t tell if this was a thrill or a fear.
But Diao Chan’s voice was undoubtedly the most beautiful voice he had ever heard.
Even in the midst of fear, he subconsciously displayed a lecherous expression, wanting to see Diao Chan’s true appearance.
Diao Chan was stunned, then humiliated and angry.
Clang!
Fish Guts Sword trembled, the Rouyun Saber Technique transformed into a flicker of saber light, midst the clang, poof!
In an instant, it sliced off the burly man’s ear completely.
"Ah!"
The burly man screamed in pain.
"Scream again and I’ll slice off the other ear too!"
Diao Chan said coldly.
The burly man’s screams abruptly stopped, looking at Diao Chan with terror, as if seeing a cold-faced Asura.
"Lead the way!"
Diao Chan turned her body.
The burly man dared not disobey.
Trembling, he walked ahead, walking slowly, as if saber light flashed before his eyes.
This forced him to run quickly along the way.
Making several turns.
They arrived at a tavern on the east side of Langling City.
The tavern owner was also perceptive, seeing the burly man’s bleeding ear and frightened face leading the way.
A female hero in a straw hat and a valiant demeanor followed, carrying a short sword, unhurried, yet with a plan, daring not to obstruct.
Ordered the staff to quickly move aside too.
The first floor of the tavern was emptied.
Apart from a few burly men drinking near the window on the first floor, there were almost no people.
"General."
The burly man with the severed ear hurriedly ran to a stalwart man with a full beard, over eight chi tall, and full of power, pointed at Diao Chan, and briefly recounted the situation.
"Oh?"
The General grabbed the large chopping knife on the table, glaring at Diao Chan, loudly shouting:
"You little wench, you have some guts, daring to kill my men!"
He drew his knife and strode towards Diao Chan:
"Let me witness your skills today."
"I was just about to show you!"

Diao Chan advanced instead of retreating, coldly replying, activating the Flying Swallow Technique, deploying Rouyun Saber Technique, like Kun passing through flowers and sea, midst the clang, rays of saber light flashed like illusions.
"Huh?!"
The General stared, roared, the heavy chopping knife in his hand struck towards Diao Chan.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Fish Guts Sword and the chopping knife competed for speed, exchanging three bouts in the blink of an eye.
After three bouts.
The two crossed paths.
Diao Chan’s Fish Guts Sword stained with a touch of crimson blood.
The General’s neck bore a red line.

He looked forward in disbelief, opened his mouth as if wanting to say something, ultimately unable to utter a word, with his strength dissipated, his tall body collapsed like Gold Mountain and Jade Pillar, falling to the ground with a clang!
The chopping knife fell to the ground too.
"General!"
The other burly men were stunned.
They looked at Diao Chan with horror and fury.
But glimpsing Diao Chan’s icy gaze like looking at a corpse, it was like being drenched with cold water, waking them instantly, two of them crashed through the window, flipped over, and escaped.
But they were faster.
How could they be faster than Diao Chan?

Diao Chan kicked once with one foot, picking up the fallen chopping knife, while it was still in midair, pang! Her foot struck the hilt’s head, causing the knife to shoot through the window like a Cloud-Piercing Arrow, swiftly catching up with one of the burly men, poof!
The chopping knife pierced through the burly man’s chest and abdomen!
The burly man staggered two steps forward before collapsing powerlessly to the ground.
Diao Chan activated the Flying Swallow Technique, like a bird in the sky, a butterfly in midair!
Agile as a galloping horse, twisting and turning, she had already slain the escaping burly men, stabbing and slaying them on the ground.
Afterward.
She returned to the tavern, swiftly looked at the burly man with one ear cut off.
This man was curled up in the corner, seeing Diao Chan, he quickly responded with a smile mingling fear and sycophancy, appearing extremely complex.
Diao Chan ignored it, coldly said:
"What’s your General’s name?"
"Gongdu."
"Gongdu?"
Diao Chan recalled Hua Tuo mentioning, it was the Yellow Turban General raging through Runan, the main source of the Runan epidemic was these Yellow Turban Generals.
Thinking of this, she couldn’t help but snort coldly, saying:
"Mere Yellow Turban Thieves, scabies and itching diseases, dare to kill my master. Truly reckless!"
She raised her voice, sounding more sonorous:
"Go back and tell your General Liu Pi! If he dares to harbor any ill will toward my master again, I won’t spare him!"
"May I ask, heroine, who is your master?"
The burly man asked tremblingly.
"Ding Ling!"
Diao Chan enunciated clearly, forcefully.
The burly man’s pupils enlarged.
"Heroine, how, how should I address you, you?"
"Diao Chan!"
Diao Chan initially wanted to say Ren Hongchang.
But remembering Ding Ling and others calling her Diao Chan.
Having accepted the meaning of this name herself, she also found it quite pleasant, and made up her mind to use the name Diao Chan while traveling the world in the future.
Diao Chan grabbed the package on the table, left without looking back.
Until Diao Chan’s figure was no longer visible.
Only then did the burly man dare step out of the tavern.
He touched his ear, and glanced at his deceased General’s unseeing expression, feeling inexplicably fortunate.
The General was dead.
Some higher-ups were dead too!
Yet, he, a mere lackey, survived!
But recalling Diao Chan’s words.
He shivered, quickly ran to the ’ambush area’ discussed, based on memory.
He needed to promptly relay this news to General Liu Pi.
There was no doubt.
Diao Chan quickly assassinating Gongdu with a short sword, or dagger, caused a tremendous stir within the Runan Yellow Turban Army.
Both Natives and players were unsettled.
The players were thinking:
"When did Ding Ling subdue Diao Chan?! This is too terrifying!"
"What’s more terrifying is that Diao Chan could instantly kill Gongdu! Don’t you think that’s absurd?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Yellow Turban Thieves of Runan and Yingchuan
paragraphs: In players’ memories, Diao Chan is an enchanting woman who only knows how to dance and play her charms.
But the Diao Chan now?
She is completely different from what they remember!
They seriously doubt if this Diao Chan is the same as the one they remember.
However, based on the reports from some players in Luoyang, indeed, Diao Chan, one of the Four Beauties, is not in Luoyang!
What does that indicate?
It indicates that the woman who instantly killed Gongdu might really be Diao Chan!
Even if the probability isn’t high.
It still caused a massive wave among the player community!
The envy and jealousy towards Ding Ling at this moment have reached a new peak!
Though it’s not yet confirmed whether it’s true.
If it is confirmed, the result is indisputable.
As for the players.
The natives, on the other hand, were shocked and infuriated.
Especially Liu Pi.
This high and mighty general, holding a long sword, clad in heavy armor, fierce and intimidating, was now furious beyond compare:
"A mere slip of a girl dares to talk so brazenly! Truly foolish!"
He raised the long sword in his hand, with murderous intent flashing in his eyes:
"When the Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man, and Jizhou’s fierce generals Yan Liang and Wen Chou arrive, I will make this woman pay the price she deserves! Avenge brother Gongdu!"
A brawny man of seven feet furrowed his brows and said:
"If we wait for them to arrive before taking action, we won’t get much of the Yuan Family’s bounty."
"Huang Shao."
Liu Pi looked sharply at this seven-foot man and said coldly:
"Our plan has already been leaked! And an ally as close as Gongdu was killed by a woman! Do you think we can kill Ding Ling and Zhao Yun with just us?"
"Rumors are rumors. I still find it hard to believe Ding Ling is that terrifyingly strong."
Another general, with a nose like a hanging gall, and clear eyes, interjected suddenly:
"Perhaps with the forces we have, we might really be able to take them down."
"Hex Yi."
Liu Pi looked at him coldly and said:

"No one wants revenge more than I do! But we should be rational; there’s no smoke without fire. I have already sent someone to Wan City to investigate. Counting the time, the messenger pigeon should be returning today! Once we see the spy’s report, we’ll naturally know the truth."
"Fine."
Hex Yi nodded:
"We’ll make a conclusion after we see the report."
A few hours later.
The messenger pigeon arrived.
They retrieved a bamboo tube from its leg and extracted a piece of rolled-up xuan paper.
Liu Pi shook his wrist, unfolding the paper and studying it closely.
Upon reading.
His look turned grim.
Hex Yi, Huang Shao, and others without exception were extremely shocked, faces full of disbelief.
"The rumors are true!"
Liu Pi handed the paper to the other high-ranking figures among the Yellow Turban Army, and said solemnly:

"General Jii Ling stationed in the middle army, Le Jiu, Liang Gang, and other fierce generals commanding the charge, with tens of thousands of troops besieging them, yet even so, Ding Ling picked off their heads one by one amidst the thousands of troops from the Great Han!"
His eyes were piercing as he looked at Hex Yi, Huang Shao, and others:
"You know that generals like Jii Ling and Le Jiu aren’t any weaker than Hex Man! They led elite troops and still perished in battle. Do you think our forces can stop them?"
Compared to Wan City’s well-equipped corps.
The Yellow Turban Army’s equipment was pitifully limited; apart from a few thousand elites worth mentioning, the rest could be described as a disorderly horde with low combat effectiveness.
Hex Yi and others were also aware of this.
Bullying civilians and plundering territories, these troops were no problem at all.
Using them to fight fierce generals like Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, likely, would be beyond their capabilities.
Yet Huang Shao seemed to have an idea, suggesting:
"That Jii Ling’s tens of thousands of troops dared not use overwhelming arrow fire to annihilate Ding Ling’s group. Otherwise, they definitely wouldn’t have gotten out of Wan City."
"Do you dare use it now?"
Hex Yi sneered:
"The Yuan Family’s wanted order clearly stated not to kill Yuan Yao or Yuan Yin! If we kill them, how will we claim the reward?"
"If all else fails, we can do without the reward."
Liu Pi, eager for revenge:
"Directly shoot with covering fire from a distance. I don’t believe Ding Ling and Zhao Yun can withstand it."
"Ha."
Hex Yi chuckled softly:

"Liu Pi, why is your mindset more impatient than mine now? You were the one who said to wait, and now you’re anxious to kill. You’re the Yellow Turban General from Runan! Don’t disrupt the troops’ morale!"
Liu Pi took a deep breath, sat down, and said with furrowed brows:
"I’ve waited for hours, growing angrier and more restless by the moment. I hope everyone understands. I still can’t accept that Gongdu died just like that!"
"Understood."
Hex Yi said frankly:

"But to catch and kill someone as fierce as Ding Ling isn’t something that can be solved by sheer numbers. I initially thought the rumors were exaggerated, but now that we’ve investigated and confirmed the truth, we must proceed cautiously and steadily. We cannot act rashly or engage Ding Ling head-on.
When Yan Liang and Wen Chou arrive, during the siege of Ding Ling, the disorderly troops will charge out, rescue Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin, and leave!
At that moment.
We can unleash a relentless arrow barrage without restraint.
If we do this.
How can Ding Ling and the others survive?"
He paused and said:

"If Ding Ling’s strength is truly beyond imagination and even Yan Liang and Wen Chou cannot handle them, then we won’t care about the fate of Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin, nor the Yuan Family’s bounty. Our priority will be self-preservation, directly killing Ding Ling and Diao Chan!"
"Quite right."
Huang Shao agreed:
"Diao Chan is ruthless and highly skilled. She warned us that if we make a move on them, there will surely be thunderous revenge.
So if we act, it must be earth-shattering! Use absolute annihilation tactics! Destroy their party on the road, leaving them no chance to rise again!"
Liu Pi and his men discussed for a long time.
Then they settled on the plan.
When Yan Liang and Wen Chou, along with Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man, arrive.
They will take action to encircle and kill.
Yan Liang, Wen Chou, and Hex Man, three generals, will lead an elite charge against Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
The rest will charge out of the disorderly troops and seize Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin.
Then use distant arrow fire to annihilate.
The plan is simple.
Yet the simpler, the better!
Because they have the numbers!
"For just a few people, making us go to such lengths, even if they die, they will definitely go down in history!"
Hex Yi sighed.

"Ding Ling’s achievements may have already been known by major forces. Not just in the future, but in this era, he will be famous throughout Jiuzhou! Such a terrifying person, can Yan Liang and Wen Chou defeat them?"
Huang Shao expressed some doubt.
"Yan Liang and Wen Chou are Super-Elite experts, what do you think?"
Liu Pi sneered:

"Although they claim to have reached only super-elite power, slightly weaker in other aspects, even so, they are extremely formidable. When the two join forces, if not invincible, they’re close enough!"

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Splitting Into Two Groups (8/32)
paragraphs: "I believe we will definitely win this time!"
Liu Pi was very confident.
Hex Yi, Huang Shao, and others thought of the war achievements since Yan Liang and Wen Chou appeared, and couldn’t help but nod.
Even Jizhou’s Unrivaled Divine General Pan Feng dared not claim to surely defeat Yan Liang and Wen Chou.
It shows how terrifying Yan Liang and Wen Chou are.
This is the record from a pigeon post.
It’s information obtained by Jizhou’s spies through investigation.
It’s precisely because we know this.
Only then did Liu Pi and his group consider speaking after Yan Liang and Wen Chou arrived, following their plan being uncovered by Diao Chan.
As Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man was one of the top elite generals in the Yellow Turban Army, how strong was he?
Liu Pi and his group were even clearer.
With these three fierce generals charging.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, no matter how strong, might find it difficult to win immediately.
When the plan is implemented one by one.
Even if Ding Ling and Diao Chan had nine lives, they would surely be dead without a doubt.
After Diao Chan specially investigated many matters.
She then returned.
Upon her return.
She told Ding Ling about what happened in Langling City.
She didn’t withhold anything.
After listening, Ding Ling nodded and said:
"Since we have already caught the attention of the Yellow Turban Thieves in Runan, we can’t just wait to be killed."
Du Qingcheng interjected and said:
"Didn’t Diao Chan say she already warned those Yellow Turban Thieves? If they are sensible, they shouldn’t be pestering us, right?"
All of Ding Ling’s people called her Diao Chan.
Du Qingcheng simply changed their address as well.
Just because she also thought Diao Chan sounded better than Hongchang.
"It’s easier to change mountains and rivers than to change one’s nature. Talking about etiquette, morals, and promises with a group of Yellow Turban Thieves stirring up chaos in Runan?"
Ding Ling shook his head and said:

"Yuan Family has placed a substantial reward on me. It’s normal for Yellow Turban Thieves to be tempted. Now that we’ve killed Gongdu, there’s even a grudge involved. They are even less likely to let us go easily. After all, speaking fundamentally, Runan is their territory, and we are just outsiders.
Outsiders, only a few of us.
The Yellow Turban Thieves are numerous, if they are afraid. It might be difficult to pass."
Hua Tuo couldn’t help himself, sternly saying:

"Ding Ling, I think you might be underestimating your influence. The battle in Wan City was enough to make your name famed throughout the world! Runan isn’t far from Wan City. The Yellow Turban Thieves here might have already learned about your detailed battle situation in Wan City, and they definitely wouldn’t dare to move against you casually. If they knew how terrifying you were in the battle of Wan City.
They would surely know that no one among them could restrain you!
How can they dare to fight?
"Is that so?"
Ding Ling was thoughtful.
"Exactly."
Zhao Yun also very much agreed with Hua Tuo’s words:

"The Yellow Turban Army in Runan have survived till now which proves their capabilities. They definitely wouldn’t, after knowing that we’ve uncovered their plan, recklessly attack us again. That would be suicide. After all, Ding Ling your moves to seize enemy generals from midst of armies isn’t just a one-time feat.
The battle in Wan City further proved your capabilities in this regard.
If the great marshal of the Yellow Turban Army doesn’t wish to die.
They wouldn’t hastily launch an attack."
"Perhaps."
Ding Ling nodded, acknowledging Zhao Yun and Hua Tuo’s words, but he also had a different viewpoint:
"It’s better to be safe than sorry. If there’s someone among the Yellow Turban Thieves who persistently harasses us, it might cause significant trouble. How about this."
Ding Ling looked at Hua Tuo, Du Qingcheng, and Diao Chan:

"I’ll trouble the elder to first take Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan to the destination. I, along with Zhao Yun, Yuan Yao, and Yuan Yin, will look for opportunities here, and investigate the Yellow Turban Thieves’ camp. If there’s no issue, we’ll meet up quickly.
If there are issues.
I’ll solve them before coming to you."
Hua Tuo nodded in agreement, knowing his combat power wasn’t very high.
Even if his physique was Super-Elite, without matching strength, his combat skills were too low-end, making him just a target!
Staying here would only be a hindrance.
Du Qingcheng, although reluctant, raised no objections.
Only Diao Chan disagreed:
"I believe I can help if I stay."
She spoke firmly:
"In terms of stealth and assassination, I’m no worse than anyone. I was the first to discover Ma Zhong’s assassination before."
Ding Ling was speechless.
He recalled the scenes when Diao Chan suddenly emerged at the Yuan Family Armory.
Diao Chan’s body technique, stealth, and other aspects were indeed very strong.
He agreed.
Diao Chan showed a joyful expression.
Du Qingcheng was somewhat troubled, secretly vowing to train diligently to keep up with Ding Ling, or else she would feel like a burden, too useless, leading to much disappointment and oppression.
Hua Tuo took Du Qingcheng and several fine horses and left.
The fine horses carried many medicinal herbs.
These herbs were specifically picked from the deep mountains by Hua Tuo, as well as many taken from the Yuan Family’s pharmacy.
Hua Tuo mentioned that treating the plague required these medicines, so Ding Ling took plenty without hesitation, knowing it wouldn’t cost him anyway!
As for Ding Ling and the remaining few.
Each was mounted on a horse.
Except for Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin, who weren’t equipped with weapons or armor.
Ding Ling and the three others were equipped with thick armor and Divine Weapons.
As the sky was about to darken.
They rode towards the vicinity of Que Mountain north of Langling City.
Moving forward.
They would reach Que Mountain.
This was the temporary resting place of the Yellow Turban Thieves.
Also, their strategic point to watch Ding Ling and could depart anytime towards various directions!
This place held significant importance.
Controlling this area facilitated advancing to various regions.
Ding Ling knew they hid here, which was naturally also due to Diao Chan’s contribution.
After killing Gongdu and leaving the inn.
She specially followed the Yellow Turban Thief whose ear she had cut off, until she saw him interacting with others.
She approached.
After hearing many secrets, she returned.
Initially, she wanted to interrogate the Yellow Turban Thief, but later decided seeing and hearing personally would be more convincing, so she chose to follow him herself.
Sure enough.
She obtained a significant secret.
Liu Pi and his group lived in Que Mountain City.
"Let’s stop the horses here."
Ding Ling glanced at Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin, took out ropes:
"Tie them to the trees before we explore the city."
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin wore faces of bitterness.
"Do not try to shout or yell; if I notice, I’ll deal with you immediately."
Ding Ling’s expression was cold, showing no warmth:
"If you wish to die soon, don’t cooperate. If you cooperate well, anything is possible."
"We’ll certainly cooperate."
Yuan Yao was rather obedient:
"Just hoping to be spared."
He was ordered around throughout the journey.
Falling from a high noble position to dust.
His mindset shifted from breakdown, surging killing intent, dissatisfaction, annoyance, regret, all the way to laying flat.
The extent of change was imaginable.
The root cause was Ding Ling’s formidable strength.
The Yuan Family had pitted him several times.
Although he hoped for the Yuan Family’s rescue, his hopes weren’t as fervent as initially.

sentences.text: "I believe we will definitely win this time!"
Liu Pi was very confident.
Hex Yi, Huang Shao, and others thought of the war achievements since Yan Liang and Wen Chou appeared, and couldn’t help but nod.
Even Jizhou’s Unrivaled Divine General Pan Feng dared not claim to surely defeat Yan Liang and Wen Chou.
It shows how terrifying Yan Liang and Wen Chou are.
This is the record from a pigeon post.
It’s information obtained by Jizhou’s spies through investigation.
It’s precisely because we know this.
Only then did Liu Pi and his group consider speaking after Yan Liang and Wen Chou arrived, following their plan being uncovered by Diao Chan.
As Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man was one of the top elite generals in the Yellow Turban Army, how strong was he?
Liu Pi and his group were even clearer.
With these three fierce generals charging.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, no matter how strong, might find it difficult to win immediately.
When the plan is implemented one by one.
Even if Ding Ling and Diao Chan had nine lives, they would surely be dead without a doubt.
After Diao Chan specially investigated many matters.
She then returned.
Upon her return.
She told Ding Ling about what happened in Langling City.
She didn’t withhold anything.
After listening, Ding Ling nodded and said:
"Since we have already caught the attention of the Yellow Turban Thieves in Runan, we can’t just wait to be killed."
Du Qingcheng interjected and said:
"Didn’t Diao Chan say she already warned those Yellow Turban Thieves?
If they are sensible, they shouldn’t be pestering us, right?"
All of Ding Ling’s people called her Diao Chan.
Du Qingcheng simply changed their address as well.
Just because she also thought Diao Chan sounded better than Hongchang.
"It’s easier to change mountains and rivers than to change one’s nature.
Talking about etiquette, morals, and promises with a group of Yellow Turban Thieves stirring up chaos in Runan?"
Ding Ling shook his head and said:
"Yuan Family has placed a substantial reward on me.
It’s normal for Yellow Turban Thieves to be tempted.
Now that we’ve killed Gongdu, there’s even a grudge involved.
They are even less likely to let us go easily.
After all, speaking fundamentally, Runan is their territory, and we are just outsiders.
Outsiders, only a few of us.
The Yellow Turban Thieves are numerous, if they are afraid.
It might be difficult to pass."
Hua Tuo couldn’t help himself, sternly saying:
"Ding Ling, I think you might be underestimating your influence.
The battle in Wan City was enough to make your name famed throughout the world!
Runan isn’t far from Wan City.
The Yellow Turban Thieves here might have already learned about your detailed battle situation in Wan City, and they definitely wouldn’t dare to move against you casually.
If they knew how terrifying you were in the battle of Wan City.
They would surely know that no one among them could restrain you!
How can they dare to fight?
"Is that so?"
Ding Ling was thoughtful.
"Exactly."
Zhao Yun also very much agreed with Hua Tuo’s words:
"The Yellow Turban Army in Runan have survived till now which proves their capabilities.
They definitely wouldn’t, after knowing that we’ve uncovered their plan, recklessly attack us again.
That would be suicide.
After all, Ding Ling your moves to seize enemy generals from midst of armies isn’t just a one-time feat.
The battle in Wan City further proved your capabilities in this regard.
If the great marshal of the Yellow Turban Army doesn’t wish to die.
They wouldn’t hastily launch an attack."
"Perhaps."
Ding Ling nodded, acknowledging Zhao Yun and Hua Tuo’s words, but he also had a different viewpoint:
"It’s better to be safe than sorry.
If there’s someone among the Yellow Turban Thieves who persistently harasses us, it might cause significant trouble.
How about this."
Ding Ling looked at Hua Tuo, Du Qingcheng, and Diao Chan:
"I’ll trouble the elder to first take Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan to the destination.
I, along with Zhao Yun, Yuan Yao, and Yuan Yin, will look for opportunities here, and investigate the Yellow Turban Thieves’ camp.
If there’s no issue, we’ll meet up quickly.
If there are issues.
I’ll solve them before coming to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Graceful Entry into the City (9/32)
paragraphs: Yuan Yao only hoped to suffer less torment, so he was very cooperative along the way, afraid that Ding Ling would kill him out of displeasure.
Because Ding Ling said himself that keeping one hostage was actually quite sufficient.
This left Yuan Yao in fear, and his performance often outshone Yuan Yin’s.
He hoped that if someone must die, it would be Yuan Yin.
Initially, Yuan Yin didn’t sense it, but later noticed, becoming sorrowful and furious, naturally despising and scornful of Yuan Yao, along with a sense of anger and disappointment!
Yuan Yao was indifferent.
As long as one is alive, anything is possible; if dead, then truly nothing remains.
Diao Chan and Ding Ling set off light this time.
Both wore only leather armor.
This allowed their speed and reflexes to reach their limits.
Wearing heavy armor on horseback was advantageous for defense.
But wearing it after dismounting was unwise, since this time Ding Ling and the others were on a reconnaissance mission, not confronting the enemy head-on.
Of course.
If it does come down to a direct confrontation, they must have reliable support.
Considering this point.
Ding Ling had Zhao Yun wear heavy armor, waiting in the dense woods outside Que Mountain City gate.
He and Diao Chan used the body technique, silently soaring like drifting clouds to the corner of the city wall.
Seeing them, Zhao Yun was envious.
He hoped to one day master Lightweight Body Technique to such proficiency.
Because his Lightweight Skill was lacking, he did the support role.
Whizz!

Ding Ling motioned for Diao Chan to go up first, striking a pose while Diao Chan lightly nodded, rapidly utilizing the Breathing Technique, activating the Flying Swallow Technique, and leaped over one zhang high as Ding Ling jumped and lifted her feet heavily with both hands.
Taking advantage, she spun gracefully, her lithe body soared higher, leaping over another zhang, gently landing on the edge of the city wall like a feather, swiftly scanning around.
Seeing people guarding the front, she immediately hid and followed as the guards moved to the other side.
She then waved to Ding Ling.

Ding Ling, more direct, activated Ascending Skill, Wall-Climbing Technique, and Five Animals Qigong simultaneously, leaping over three zhang, lightly tapping the wall, easily landing on the city wall.
Diao Chan watched with admiration.
Such ease.
She admitted she couldn’t do it.
At most, she could leap over three zhang with full effort, but the commotion would be significant, alerting the soldiers.
Ding Ling, on the other hand, effortlessly completed it.
Obviously, he didn’t exert full power!
"Let’s go."

Ding Ling, carrying the Six-Stone Bow, arrow pouch, holding the Giant Que Sword, activated Ascending Skill, Wall-Climbing Technique, and Five Animals Qigong simultaneously, enhanced by two Breathing Techniques.
He became swift like lightning, agile like a crane, steady like Mount Tai, unmoving but momentarily darting out tens of meters like a rabbit.
Diao Chan followed closely.
Graceful like a maple leaf!
Her speed was equally fast.
The two moved one after another, circling the city wall, their figures ghostly, hard for outsiders to notice.
After finishing a lap.
Ding Ling, high above, locked onto a spot.
The military camp at the city west.
Where lanterns brightly lit.
People busily moved around, bustling with activity.
Yet in the middle, a large tent saw few visit, guarded by nearly a hundred elite troops.
Ding Ling desired going there, he could only knock out soldiers and infiltrate disguised in their armor.
And seeing the camp seemingly lax, unchecked, increased his confidence.
No wonder the Yellow Turban Army was renowned for chaos and disorganization!
No wonder Zhang Jiao’s death led to their swift defeat.
Only Zhang Feiyan’s Black Mountain Army had some achievements; the rest were weak, not without reason.
Ding Ling already targeted armor of a soldier resembling him.

Circling the city wall again, upon passing by him, decisively knocked him out, dragging him into a concealed corner, Ding Ling then donned his armor, helmet, casually smeared black soot on his face making one unable to discern his original appearance upon casual glance before stopping.
Helped Diao Chan put on armor as well.
With Makeup Skill mastery, to avoid Diao Chan’s face revealing too striking, Ding Ling simply used black soot, white ash to turn her into a "Cinderella".
"Alright, let’s go."
The two moved swiftly, avoiding Yellow Turban Thieves along the way.
If unavoidable.
They openly walked past.
Unexpectedly no one questioned.
Ding Ling sighed relief while musing: Such corruption and lack of discipline. They deserved annihilation!
Perhaps thinking no one would attack now?
Relaxed then?
Had guards at the gate and stationed on the walls, maybe for the Yellow Turban Thieves, not wartime, this sufficed?
Speculated Ding Ling, smoothly reaching the military camp.
Finally scrutinized and casually questioned.
Ding Ling’s full-level acting activated, casually replying.
Being so composed, even though his answers seemed nonsensical, arousing suspicion, upon bribing the other with silver, his doubts quickly vanished.
And patting Ding Ling’s shoulder said:
"All brothers from the same camp, you didn’t know the rules, from Yingchuan perhaps?"
"Correct."
"Hmm."
He spoke to himself:

"Recently many Yingchuan brothers arrived, unfamiliar to me. Different rules there are normal. But soon, when Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Marshal Hex arrives. Might tighten control over us, so won’t be as easy."
Ding Ling realized.
No wonder seeming lax.
Multiple Yellow Turban Thieves Great Army mixed together.
No unified command, chaos inevitable.
Understanding now, instantly expressed admiration for the master, sought station at Marshal’s camp, offering more gold and silver for assistance.
His eyes brightened, promptly assured him it’s handled.
Finishing words, ran swiftly.
Soon.
Returned, brought two soldiers resembling Ding Ling, Diao Chan in height and build.
"Brother, see, replace them both..."
Exchanged words.
Paid generously.
Other satisfied left.
Musing Yingchuan brothers wealthy.
Ding Ling knew secrets don’t last, this wouldn’t remain hidden long.
Led Diao Chan immediately by Marshal’s camp, eavesdropping inside conversation.
Now Liu Pi discussed dealing with Ding Ling.
Thus Ding Ling heard clear.
Surprised, angry, musing such coincidence, why discuss him now?
Or perhaps?
They discussed long ago.
Exact details unknown to Ding Ling.
Since they intended harm.

chapters.title: Chapter 167 167: Diao Chan and Ding Ling Overturn the Command Tent
paragraphs: Ding Ling had no reason to spare this group of Yellow Turban Thieves.
He took down the Six-Stone Bow, plucked three arrows from the quiver, and gave Diao Chan a glance.
Diao Chan nodded, and the Fish Guts Sword slipped out from her sleeve.

With a swift step, Flying Swallow Technique and Rouyun Saber Technique unfolded simultaneously, akin to a snake-like movement, she dashed gracefully like a lightning bolt, accompanied by the sound of swooshing past the ears.
The Fish Guts Sword was already stained with blood!
That very instant.
Diao Chan simultaneously took down three guards, her swift movements truly decisive and extremely deft.
Ding Ling quickly rushed in as Diao Chan opened the tent's entrance for him.
He barged in.
Before Liu Pi and the other commanders could shout.
He released the already drawn bowstring.
Thwack! Thwack!
Shadow Arrow Skill was unleashed, and the three arrows shot out like streaks of light, slicing through seven to eight meters instantly, hitting the bodies of three commanders.
The arrows contained immense power.
After striking the three commanders, the powerful force sent them flying off their seats, penetrating their armor and directly entering their chests and abdomens!
"Who!"
Liu Pi was spared, the first to react, shouting loudly:
"Help! Assassins!"
As he spoke, he grabbed the long saber beside him, adopting a defensive stance.
Under Liu Pi's signal, other Yellow Turban Army leaders charged at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling laughed loudly, instead of retreating, he advanced, and with a clang, drew the Giant Que Sword, held it single-handedly, and charged at the Yellow Turban Army generals.
There were more than thirty generals, each with immense strength and extreme boldness!
A fierce thug-like aura hit him.
When enraged, they roared like lions.
All thirty plus lunged at Ding Ling, making the scene look extremely terrifying.
However, after Ding Ling activated the Sword God Skill, he swiftly killed five or six men like chopping vegetables, causing someone to respond in shock, yelling:
"It's Ding Ling!!"
"Ding Ling?!"
Liu Pi was taken aback:
"How did you get here?!"
"I already told you. Don't think about harming my lord."

Diao Chan activated Flying Swallow Technique, darting about the tent, Fish Guts Sword flickering, slicing through clouds and waves, arriving before Liu Pi, the Fish Guts Sword turned into a brilliant saber light, slashing at him!
"You ignored my words. This is the price!"
"It's you, you brat!"
Liu Pi realized it immediately, enraged, swung his long saber at Diao Chan: "I'll cut you down today!"
"We'll see who cuts down whom!
Diao Chan, neither angry nor happy, coldly gazed at Liu Pi, her calm voice contrasting sharply with the chaos and distress in the tent.
Like a white lotus falling into the mud.
Clang!
Liu Pi and Diao Chan quickly clashed.
Compared to Gongdu, Liu Pi was evidently much stronger.
In his fury, his long saber danced impenetrably.
Blade light flashed, evil qi accompanying the fierce saber edge, captivating hearts and souls.

Diao Chan moved swiftly, akin to a fluttering jade butterfly, wielding the Fish Guts Sword like soft clouds drifting across the sky, light and effortless, yet with astonishing killing intent that made one's hair stand on end.
Diao Chan used the Fish Guts Sword to perform the Rouyun Saber Technique, exhibiting flexibility against rigidity to its fullest.
Both fought with speed.
For a moment, they were evenly matched.
But as time passed.
With Ding Ling wielding the Giant Que Sword, he unstoppable rammed through and slew everyone in the tent. Liu Pi's pressure increased, and in a moment of carelessness, Diao Chan struck his arm.
His right hand shook, unable to grip the saber, dropping it with a clatter to the floor.
Swish!
Clang!
Diao Chan seized the moment with a swift move, brushed past Liu Pi, accompanied by a squelching sound.
Liu Pi clutched his neck, feeling unwilling, pained, angered, regretful as he fell.
His expression extremely complex.
At this moment, he was evidently pondering many things.
Perhaps he regretted accepting the Yuan Family's Wanted Order, or he lamented not waiting for Yan Liang and Wen Chou to come set up an ambush to trap and kill Ding Ling.
No matter his thoughts.
He was now dead.
As for Huang Shao and Hex Yi, they also fell dead after Ding Ling used a Shadow Arrow on them.
Crash!

Outside, the Yellow Turban Army surged, leading rogue warriors pushed open the tent, saw the corpses littered, then spotted Ding Ling and Diao Chan casually standing, and couldn't help but feel angry:
"Are you the assassins?"
Their answer came from Ding Ling's Shadow Arrow Skill!
Swish! Swish!
The leading soldier was shot through the forehead, dying instantly from a shattered skull!
"Gasp!"
The rushing soldiers retreated in shock, stepping back ten-plus steps.

The few soldiers who accepted bribes, recognizing Ding Ling and Diao Chan, seeing the corpses, instantly realized, fearfully, their legs weakened, they swiftly turned and fled before Ding Ling noticed.
If it became known they let the assassins in, they'd surely be hacked to death by angry members of the army.
At least they were rich now.
Quickly leave to other places, no worry about sustenance for a while.
"Avenge the commander!"
A Death Warrior shouted loudly.
Ding Ling sprung out of the tent, landed atop a giant boulder, drew the bow and arrows, aiming directly at the yelling soldier, swish, swish!
Three arrows shot forth.
The yelling soldier was penetrated, not to mention the massive force carried him, crashed through five or six people before stopping.
"Anyone willing to risk their lives, can try."
Ding Ling shouted.
His hands kept drawing the Six-Stone Bow.
His strength, reflexes, endurance were astonishing.
A lone archer.
Drawing arrows, emulating an archery squad's simultaneous release sensation.
Swish! Swish!
Arrows flew chaotically, leaving devastation in their wake!
An arrow could penetrate one man's abdomen, yet still have the force to shoot into another man's body!
Not everyone wore armor in the Yellow Turban Army here.
Ding Ling's shooting precision was extremely striking.
Under bright lights.
Aiming at neck, heart, and other parts, shooting directly.
In mere moments.
No less than a hundred ended up shot dead or wounded.
The rest were shaken, scared, in awe, instinctively retreating and dodging.
Ding Ling snorted, swiftly returned to the tent.
Diao Chan had already gathered the spoils.
Took two Secret Manuals, two Great Medicines, two Gold pieces, and more.
Each was precisely two portions.
Evenly divided.
Apparently, either it was the Yuan Family's bounty for killing Ding Ling, or they had looted wealthy households in Runan and Yingchuan, recently split the spoils.
No matter the real situation.
These spoils now belonged to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling gave Diao Chan a 'very good' look.
Diao Chan rejoiced.
It was from Zhao Yun that she learned Ding Ling had a habit of looting corpses.

sentences.text: Ding Ling had no reason to spare this group of Yellow Turban Thieves.
He took down the Six-Stone Bow, plucked three arrows from the quiver, and gave Diao Chan a glance.
Diao Chan nodded, and the Fish Guts Sword slipped out from her sleeve.

With a swift step, Flying Swallow Technique and Rouyun Saber Technique unfolded simultaneously, akin to a snake-like movement, she dashed gracefully like a lightning bolt, accompanied by the sound of swooshing past the ears.
The Fish Guts Sword was already stained with blood!
That very instant.
Diao Chan simultaneously took down three guards, her swift movements truly decisive and extremely deft.
Ding Ling quickly rushed in as Diao Chan opened the tent's entrance for him.
He barged in.
Before Liu Pi and the other commanders could shout.
He released the already drawn bowstring.
Thwack!
Thwack!
Shadow Arrow Skill was unleashed, and the three arrows shot out like streaks of light, slicing through seven to eight meters instantly, hitting the bodies of three commanders.
The arrows contained immense power.
After striking the three commanders, the powerful force sent them flying off their seats, penetrating their armor and directly entering their chests and abdomens!
"Who!"
Liu Pi was spared, the first to react, shouting loudly:
"Help!
Assassins!"
As he spoke, he grabbed the long saber beside him, adopting a defensive stance.
Under Liu Pi's signal, other Yellow Turban Army leaders charged at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling laughed loudly, instead of retreating, he advanced, and with a clang, drew the Giant Que Sword, held it single-handedly, and charged at the Yellow Turban Army generals.
There were more than thirty generals, each with immense strength and extreme boldness!
A fierce thug-like aura hit him.
When enraged, they roared like lions.
All thirty plus lunged at Ding Ling, making the scene look extremely terrifying.
However, after Ding Ling activated the Sword God Skill, he swiftly killed five or six men like chopping vegetables, causing someone to respond in shock, yelling:
"It's Ding Ling!!"
"Ding Ling?!"
Liu Pi was taken aback:
"How did you get here?!"
"I already told you.
Don't think about harming my lord."

Diao Chan activated Flying Swallow Technique, darting about the tent, Fish Guts Sword flickering, slicing through clouds and waves, arriving before Liu Pi, the Fish Guts Sword turned into a brilliant saber light, slashing at him!
"You ignored my words.
This is the price!"
"It's you, you brat!"
Liu Pi realized it immediately, enraged, swung his long saber at Diao Chan: "I'll cut you down today!"
"We'll see who cuts down whom!
Diao Chan, neither angry nor happy, coldly gazed at Liu Pi, her calm voice contrasting sharply with the chaos and distress in the tent.
Like a white lotus falling into the mud.
Clang!
Liu Pi and Diao Chan quickly clashed.
Compared to Gongdu, Liu Pi was evidently much stronger.
In his fury, his long saber danced impenetrably.
Blade light flashed, evil qi accompanying the fierce saber edge, captivating hearts and souls.

Diao Chan moved swiftly, akin to a fluttering jade butterfly, wielding the Fish Guts Sword like soft clouds drifting across the sky, light and effortless, yet with astonishing killing intent that made one's hair stand on end.
Diao Chan used the Fish Guts Sword to perform the Rouyun Saber Technique, exhibiting flexibility against rigidity to its fullest.
Both fought with speed.
For a moment, they were evenly matched.
But as time passed.
With Ding Ling wielding the Giant Que Sword, he unstoppable rammed through and slew everyone in the tent.
Liu Pi's pressure increased, and in a moment of carelessness, Diao Chan struck his arm.
His right hand shook, unable to grip the saber, dropping it with a clatter to the floor.
Swish!
Clang!
Diao Chan seized the moment with a swift move, brushed past Liu Pi, accompanied by a squelching sound.
Liu Pi clutched his neck, feeling unwilling, pained, angered, regretful as he fell.
His expression extremely complex.
At this moment, he was evidently pondering many things.
Perhaps he regretted accepting the Yuan Family's Wanted Order, or he lamented not waiting for Yan Liang and Wen Chou to come set up an ambush to trap and kill Ding Ling.
No matter his thoughts.
He was now dead.
As for Huang Shao and Hex Yi, they also fell dead after Ding Ling used a Shadow Arrow on them.
Crash!

Outside, the Yellow Turban Army surged, leading rogue warriors pushed open the tent, saw the corpses littered, then spotted Ding Ling and Diao Chan casually standing, and couldn't help but feel angry:
"Are you the assassins?"
Their answer came from Ding Ling's Shadow Arrow Skill!
Swish!
Swish!
The leading soldier was shot through the forehead, dying instantly from a shattered skull!
"Gasp!"
The rushing soldiers retreated in shock, stepping back ten-plus steps.

The few soldiers who accepted bribes, recognizing Ding Ling and Diao Chan, seeing the corpses, instantly realized, fearfully, their legs weakened, they swiftly turned and fled before Ding Ling noticed.
If it became known they let the assassins in, they'd surely be hacked to death by angry members of the army.
At least they were rich now.
Quickly leave to other places, no worry about sustenance for a while.
"Avenge the commander!"
A Death Warrior shouted loudly.
Ding Ling sprung out of the tent, landed atop a giant boulder, drew the bow and arrows, aiming directly at the yelling soldier, swish, swish!
Three arrows shot forth.
The yelling soldier was penetrated, not to mention the massive force carried him, crashed through five or six people before stopping.
"Anyone willing to risk their lives, can try."
Ding Ling shouted.
His hands kept drawing the Six-Stone Bow.
His strength, reflexes, endurance were astonishing.
A lone archer.
Drawing arrows, emulating an archery squad's simultaneous release sensation.
Swish!
Swish!
Arrows flew chaotically, leaving devastation in their wake!
An arrow could penetrate one man's abdomen, yet still have the force to shoot into another man's body!
Not everyone wore armor in the Yellow Turban Army here.
Ding Ling's shooting precision was extremely striking.
Under bright lights.
Aiming at neck, heart, and other parts, shooting directly.
In mere moments.
No less than a hundred ended up shot dead or wounded.
The rest were shaken, scared, in awe, instinctively retreating and dodging.
Ding Ling snorted, swiftly returned to the tent.
Diao Chan had already gathered the spoils.
Took two Secret Manuals, two Great Medicines, two Gold pieces, and more.
Each was precisely two portions.
Evenly divided.
Apparently, either it was the Yuan Family's bounty for killing Ding Ling, or they had looted wealthy households in Runan and Yingchuan, recently split the spoils.
No matter the real situation.
These spoils now belonged to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling gave Diao Chan a 'very good' look.
Diao Chan rejoiced.
It was from Zhao Yun that she learned Ding Ling had a habit of looting corpses.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Dominating All Directions (11/32)
paragraphs: I understand what Ding Ling wants.
So, after killing Liu Pi and others this time.
She immediately searched the large tent and indeed found some good things.
These items were found on Marshal Liu Pi, Huang Shao, Hex Yi, and others; Diao Chan’s keen eyes could discern the location of the treasure quickly, making her speed in searching the bodies very fast.
Once she found the items.
Ding Ling happened to enter, seeing the encouraging gaze from him.
Diao Chan was overjoyed.
If it were anyone else, she wouldn’t be as happy, but Ding Ling was different; she was his follower!
Receiving his approval and praise made Diao Chan feel a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction.
At that moment.
She even considered, after returning, whether to find an appropriate opportunity to discuss with her sisters about teaching the Rouyun Saber Technique to Ding Ling.
After all, Ding Ling’s martial dao talent is terrifying.
The stronger Ding Ling is, the safer they feel.
Moreover, knowing Ding Ling was searching for secret manuals, how could they not give or support it?
"Let’s go!"
Ding Ling casually packed the spoils and carried them on his back.
Holding the Giant Que Sword, he charged forward.
Along the way, anyone who dared to block was effortlessly struck and sent flying by him.
The Human Emperor Swordsmanship was most suited for large, open spaces for slaughter.
Ding Ling laughed loudly, rushing through the Yellow Turban Army’s camp.
Anywhere he went, it was like a wave breaking through the river; no one could block his strike.
Even those secretly shooting cold arrows were casually blocked by Ding Ling.
"Shoot arrows, kill him!"
Still, some dared to stand out:
"We have the numbers, let’s kill them to avenge the Marshal."
Ding Ling leapt, shooting over two meters high, landing with his right foot on someone’s head, the immense force directly crushed the person, causing a grim scream as the skull cracked.
Ding Ling executed the Ascending Skill and Wall-Climbing Technique, stepping on the heads of Yellow Turban Army soldiers, quickly soaring to the loudly shouting general of the Yellow Turban Army.
As he fearfully swung his saber toward Ding Ling.
Ding Ling laughed long, the Giant Que Sword shuddering as it condensed into flower patterns.
Puff!
Before the Yellow Turban Army’s general’s saber could fall, his head was already swept away by the Giant Que Sword, soaring into the sky.
A pillar of blood spouted from the neck.
Ding Ling leapt, avoiding the spray of blood, grabbing the falling head mid-air, with tiger eyes full of power, he scanned in all directions:
"Those who don’t want to die, feel free to try standing out!
Such scenes.
Occurred in a flash.
Many hadn’t reacted before the general died.
Their hair stood on end.
Some cowardly Yellow Turban generals saw Ding Ling was as badass as rumored, easily taking the head of the war general from the midst of armies!
No one dared to stick their head out anymore.
Simply wished to quickly send Ding Ling and Diao Chan, these two Plague Gods, away.
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed, casually tossing the head, speaking loudly:
"Seems you still have sense. Before leaving, I want to say a couple of things to you."
He activated his full-level acting, glancing arrogantly, his majestic aura spreading, his voice sonorous and powerful, exceptionally vigorous:

"I know you surely have spies from the Yuan Family among you. Go back and tell the Sect Leader of the Yuan Family, if you wish to sleep peacefully, not wanting to be unexpectedly beheaded at midnight, feel free to continue to issue the wanted orders to kill me."
He leapt, arriving beside Diao Chan, grabbing her, sprinting away, the Giant Que Sword dancing, the sword light dazzling, and no one along the way dared to obstruct:
"Make way for me!"
A roaring shout.
Those who heard it were terrified, retreating violently.

Ding Ling laughed long, in Diao Chan’s somewhat intoxicated and admiring eyes, pulling her, sprinting all the way to the foot of the city wall, activating his body technique, stomping heavily, actually pulling Diao Chan into the air, climbing over the city wall several yards high, directly onto the wall, then a few strides, they ’flew’ straight over the wall.
Such scenes.
Observed by many players who were astounded and tongue-tied, declaring:
"Holy! How did Ding Ling train? How come he’s soaring through the air like characters in martial arts novels!"

"Incredible. That graceful figure beside him is Diao Chan, right? So strong! She’s a heroine among women. I saw her in action; ordinary Yellow Turban generals are like chicks in her hands, completely powerless to resist!"
"Isn’t Ding Ling the strongest one? Really overbearing, really amazing!"

"Sorry, I unintentionally uttered our cultural essence. Aside from those two words, I can’t think of any other words for my shock! I can only say Ding Ling truly embodies the figure of a hero in my imagination!"
Players were like this.
The natives were even more shocked, each looking at each other, clearly seeing confusion, bewilderment, and fear in each other’s eyes...
"All the Marshals are dead. What to do?"
"Heard Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Marshal Hex should arrive soon, then we’ll join him."
"That’s all we can do. Really, with no other option, we’ll join the army. But we’re Yellow Turban born; who knows if the regular army would accept us?"
Some Yellow Turban soldiers worried about their future.
Some haven’t recovered from what just happened:
"Ding Ling alone broke into our great army, killed so many Marshals and left calmly. He’s so strong! He’s stronger than the rumors said!"
"From now on, avoid him at all costs!"
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Awe the Yellow Turban Army]
[Note: Your actions thoroughly intimidated the Yellow Turban Army! They will surely sing of your mighty name! Your War God name will undoubtedly spread wider and further!]
Ding Ling heard the notification sound.
Glanced at the character panel.
[3: You must make your War God name resound throughout the entire Plane World. 10%/100%.]
It was previously 5%.
After this period’s fermentation.
The matters of Wan City have already spread to many realms.
Ding Ling’s notoriety is increasingly louder.
The progress bar of the War God’s name keeps rising these days.
Recently it climbed to 9%.
It hardly moved.
And just after leaving the Yellow Turban Army’s camp.
It seemed to immediately rise to 10%.
Moreover, looking at the situation, there’s still room for growth.
Perhaps it will increase further soon.
Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, nodding quietly.
Once he learns the method of restraint.
When he defeats the strongest in the Plane.
If the related quests are completed.
He might not need to join forces with any lords.
Then going to a higher level world is not impossible.
But how exactly to proceed.
It will be discussed when that step is reached.
As his strength evolves, Ding Ling’s mentality and planning continuously change.
"How’s it going?"
Zhao Yun rode in and asked.
"Smoothly."
Diao Chan crisply replied.
As Zhao Yun relaxed, he also felt a bit disappointed.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Farewell Approaches
paragraphs: Such a grand battle.
He didn’t join in!
Upon thinking this, Zhao Yun said:
"Next time something similar happens, it’s best to take me along."
"Then you’ll need to practice your Lightweight Skill."
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"If the city wall isn’t too high and there’s no risk of being heard, I can carry you over it. But if it’s like today, we’ll have to go over one by one."
He fully exerted his Lightweight Body Technique.
Ding Ling could leap far beyond three zhang.
With his current strength.
And the enhancement of Breathing Technique and several major Lightweight Body Techniques.
He could indeed be considered a Martial God.
"Alright."
Zhao Yun nodded solemnly, saying:
"I will definitely do that."
After he finished speaking, he felt a bit troubled:
"There’s just too much to learn. It feels like there’s not enough time."
He didn’t feel this on the mountain.
But coming down the mountain.
Following Ding Ling.
Watching Ding Ling engage in bloody battles everywhere, rapidly increasing in strength.
While his progress felt like a snail’s pace, naturally causing anxiety and a sense that there was never enough time.
Often, even before he could focus on practicing, he had to travel and fight again.
Due to the tight schedule and Ding Ling pulling further ahead in strength and cultivation, Zhao Yun was continuously training in the Breathing Technique, whether standing, sitting, or lying down.
He aimed to master the Breathing Technique, reaching an instinctual level of the Transformation Realm as soon as possible!
His practical combat experience was growing at an astonishing rate.
The growth in his strength was also far superior to his time on the mountain.
But on the mountain, there was no one to compare to, and even if there was, they were quite ordinary, making him seem unparalleled and unmatched.
Coming down the mountain, constantly witnessing Ding Ling’s terrifying progress.
Zhao Yun’s pride had long been worn down, and now he was extremely humble, pragmatic, and steady!
In his words: "In front of Ding Ling, I’m just a mediocre talent. Besides working harder, being more humble, and practical, I can’t think of anything else to do!"
The next day.
Ding Ling and his group encountered Hua Tuo and Du Qingcheng in Runan Shenyang City.
"We haven’t been here long either."
Du Qingcheng was surprised:
"How did you all get here so fast?"
"We came as soon as we finished the task.
Diao Chan explained:
"The opponents seemed numerous and strong, but they were no match for Ding Ling. They were beaten back and dared not advance!"
Because they were teammates.
Ding Ling signaled that Diao Chan didn’t need to call him ’master’.
So Diao Chan changed the form of address.
However, if there were others present, she would usually still call him ’master’.
"What happened? Can you tell me?"
Du Qingcheng was curious.
Diao Chan recounted everything in detail.

Du Qingcheng was astounded, growing even more respectful of Ding Ling, while her heart pounded excitedly when looking at him, her face blushing from time to time, with no one knowing what she was thinking.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin wore frustrated expressions.
Yesterday, they were tied up in the wild, terrified for a long time, fearing wolves would eat them.
Today, arriving at Shenyang City, they had to help treat the plague.
The horror of the plague was self-evident.
Yet, they dared not resist in the least.
Ding Ling’s daunting presence increasingly impressed them.
He ventured into the Yellow Turban Army’s camp and soon overturned it, killing the chief and all higher-ups, leaving leisurely.
Such courage, capability, and skill indeed left Yuan Yao in awe.
He longed for such a life of roaming the Jianghu alone.
Sadly, reality didn’t permit it.
Because he was just inept!
Regarding the treatment of the plague.
With Ding Ling joining, progress advanced rapidly.
Not only was Ding Ling highly skilled in Medical Dao.
His reflexes, hand speed, endurance, and stamina were also astonishing!
He could tirelessly maintain high-speed treatment for two days and nights!
Even at a slightly slower pace.
He could likely go on for seven to eight days without issue.
His remarkable endurance and speed made Hua Tuo admire him immensely.
Hua Tuo’s endurance was also strong, but his speed was far inferior to Ding Ling’s.
Therefore, the patients he could save were far fewer than Ding Ling’s.
The group stayed in Shenyang City for six to seven days.
Finally treating all the patients.
Hua Tuo expressed his desire to stay for several more months.
To ensure the plague wouldn’t resurge before leaving.
Ding Ling couldn’t stay that long.
After receiving a Pigeon Post from Songh County.
Learning that Pan Feng was safe, and Zhao Feng was protected by Tian Feng, Jushou, Xun Chen, and others, he breathed a sigh of relief, but with some urgency.
He couldn’t guarantee how long the Yuan Family’s tolerance for Xun Chen and the others would last, or whether Pan Feng, after hearing his advice, would still fall into a trap.
These matters were hard to say.
To thoroughly resolve these troubles, he must return to Northern Land Yecheng once more.
However, before that.
He had to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
With this in mind.
That day.
Ding Ling mentioned to Hua Tuo his intention to visit Yangzhou to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.

Hua Tuo understood and said: "Your Martial Dao mastery is outstanding, your ambition is lofty; your brilliant future has limitless potential, soaring to the skies may just be ordinary to you. There’s nothing much else I can say.
Just wish you a smooth journey, good luck in all endeavors.
Also, if you encounter trouble on the road, be cautious! Prioritize your life!"
"Yes, senior."
Ding Ling replied seriously:
"If anything important happens, you can send a Pigeon Post to Songh County. I have hired people there. They will send a message to me through certain channels."
Sending a Pigeon Post requires staying in one place for several days.
Ding Ling stayed those seven days in Shenyang City.
Just enough time to send and receive a Pigeon Post from Songh County.
He took the chance to send a Pigeon Post and contacted people in Songh County, learning of Pan Feng and the others’ situation.
"However..."
Hua Tuo thought for a moment and said:
"You’re going to Yangzhou to see Yhiuu Ji, right?"
Ding Ling had previously mentioned this to Hua Tuo.
"That’s right."
"I’ve met him before."
Hua Tuo stroked his beard and said:

"His temperament is extremely aloof! He guards his family’s secret techniques tightly and will not teach them to anyone who doesn’t meet his standards. If you rashly approach him for the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, you might anger him."
"Then..."
Ding Ling was taken aback.
"You can go to Zhang Zhongjing."
Hua Tuo suggested:
"To my knowledge, Zhang Zhongjing has a good relationship with Yhiuu Ji. With him as an intermediary, you should have a chance to learn Yhiuu Ji’s skills."
Zhang Zhongjing, a native of Nanyang County, Nieyang. A medical scholar from the late Eastern Han Dynasty, honored by later generations as the "Medical Saint".
His most praised achievement is his monumental work left to future generations: "Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases".
Ding Ling felt puzzled:
"Didn’t Zhang Zhongjing go to become an official on the basis of filial piety?"
"Haha."
Hua Tuo chuckled:
"A few months ago, I met him in Nanyang. He has already resigned from office. His goal, like mine, is to completely cure the great plague in this world!"
