Ding Ling and his group encountered Hua Tuo and Du Qingcheng in Runan Shenyang City.
"We haven’t been here long either."
Du Qingcheng was surprised:
"How did you all get here so fast?"
"We came as soon as we finished the task.
Diao Chan explained:
"The opponents seemed numerous and strong, but they were no match for Ding Ling.
They were beaten back and dared not advance!"
Because they were teammates.
Ding Ling signaled that Diao Chan didn’t need to call him ’master’.
So Diao Chan changed the form of address.
However, if there were others present, she would usually still call him ’master’.
"What happened?
Can you tell me?"
Du Qingcheng was curious.
Diao Chan recounted everything in detail.

Du Qingcheng was astounded, growing even more respectful of Ding Ling, while her heart pounded excitedly when looking at him, her face blushing from time to time, with no one knowing what she was thinking.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin wore frustrated expressions.
Yesterday, they were tied up in the wild, terrified for a long time, fearing wolves would eat them.
Today, arriving at Shenyang City, they had to help treat the plague.
The horror of the plague was self-evident.
Yet, they dared not resist in the least.
Ding Ling’s daunting presence increasingly impressed them.
He ventured into the Yellow Turban Army’s camp and soon overturned it, killing the chief and all higher-ups, leaving leisurely.
Such courage, capability, and skill indeed left Yuan Yao in awe.
He longed for such a life of roaming the Jianghu alone.
Sadly, reality didn’t permit it.
Because he was just inept!
Regarding the treatment of the plague.
With Ding Ling joining, progress advanced rapidly.
Not only was Ding Ling highly skilled in Medical Dao.
His reflexes, hand speed, endurance, and stamina were also astonishing!
He could tirelessly maintain high-speed treatment for two days and nights!
Even at a slightly slower pace.
He could likely go on for seven to eight days without issue.
His remarkable endurance and speed made Hua Tuo admire him immensely.
Hua Tuo’s endurance was also strong, but his speed was far inferior to Ding Ling’s.
Therefore, the patients he could save were far fewer than Ding Ling’s.
The group stayed in Shenyang City for six to seven days.
Finally treating all the patients.
Hua Tuo expressed his desire to stay for several more months.
To ensure the plague wouldn’t resurge before leaving.
Ding Ling couldn’t stay that long.
After receiving a Pigeon Post from Songh County.
Learning that Pan Feng was safe, and Zhao Feng was protected by Tian Feng, Jushou, Xun Chen, and others, he breathed a sigh of relief, but with some urgency.
He couldn’t guarantee how long the Yuan Family’s tolerance for Xun Chen and the others would last, or whether Pan Feng, after hearing his advice, would still fall into a trap.
These matters were hard to say.
To thoroughly resolve these troubles, he must return to Northern Land Yecheng once more.
However, before that.
He had to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
With this in mind.
That day.
Ding Ling mentioned to Hua Tuo his intention to visit Yangzhou to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
Hua Tuo understood and said: "Your Martial Dao mastery is outstanding, your ambition is lofty; your brilliant future has limitless potential, soaring to the skies may just be ordinary to you.
There’s nothing much else I can say.
Just wish you a smooth journey, good luck in all endeavors.
Also, if you encounter trouble on the road, be cautious!
Prioritize your life!"
"Yes, senior."
Ding Ling replied seriously:
"If anything important happens, you can send a Pigeon Post to Songh County.
I have hired people there.
They will send a message to me through certain channels."
Sending a Pigeon Post requires staying in one place for several days.
Ding Ling stayed those seven days in Shenyang City.
Just enough time to send and receive a Pigeon Post from Songh County.
He took the chance to send a Pigeon Post and contacted people in Songh County, learning of Pan Feng and the others’ situation.
"However..."
Hua Tuo thought for a moment and said:
"You’re going to Yangzhou to see Yhiuu Ji, right?"
Ding Ling had previously mentioned this to Hua Tuo.
"That’s right."
"I’ve met him before."
Hua Tuo stroked his beard and said:
"His temperament is extremely aloof!
He guards his family’s secret techniques tightly and will not teach them to anyone who doesn’t meet his standards.
If you rashly approach him for the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, you might anger him."
"Then..."
Ding Ling was taken aback.
"You can go to Zhang Zhongjing."
Hua Tuo suggested:
"To my knowledge, Zhang Zhongjing has a good relationship with Yhiuu Ji.
With him as an intermediary, you should have a chance to learn Yhiuu Ji’s skills."
Zhang Zhongjing, a native of Nanyang County, Nieyang.
A medical scholar from the late Eastern Han Dynasty, honored by later generations as the "Medical Saint".
His most praised achievement is his monumental work left to future generations: "Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases".
Ding Ling felt puzzled:
"Didn’t Zhang Zhongjing go to become an official on the basis of filial piety?"
"Haha."
Hua Tuo chuckled:
"A few months ago, I met him in Nanyang.
He has already resigned from office.
His goal, like mine, is to completely cure the great plague in this world!"

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Forum Inquiry (13/32)
paragraphs: Hua Tuo sighed deeply:

"How many people can you cure by becoming an official? Furthermore, the world is so chaotic now! Being an official is not easy, and there’s always a danger of losing your life. Zhang Zhongjing didn’t want to be an official; he chose to devote himself entirely to the Medical Dao. I fully agree with him."
He seemed to think of something, a look of pain and anger in his eyes:

"The war is endless, and more people die from the epidemics than from the fighting! So epidemics are a great harm! Someone must stand up. Zhang Zhongjing can rise in such a crisis. I admire him so much! I’m also gratified that there are kindred spirits like him in the world."
Ding Ling concurred, sincerely praising Zhang Zhongjing.
But soon.
He changed the subject.
"However..."
Ding Ling asked puzzled:
"Isn’t Zhang Zhongjing from Nanyang? How did he come to know and have dealings with someone like Yhiuu Ji?"
"Hehe."
Hua Tuo chuckled:

"As a true healer, traveling the world, curing diseases and saving lives is common. It’s true for me, and naturally for Zhang Zhongjing as well. While in Yangzhou, he unexpectedly discovered that some villagers who contracted the epidemic were cured after drinking Talisman Water! He was greatly shocked.
After inquiring about the villagers.
He went personally to Yhiuu Ji to ask about the Talisman Water Technique.
Initially, Yhiuu Ji was unwilling to respond to him!
Later, seeing Zhang Zhongjing as a man of great benevolence, courage, and righteousness, someone who was kind and likable.
The two spent over a year together, and thus became friends.
When Zhang Zhongjing again asked to learn the technique for using Talisman Water to treat epidemics.
Yhiuu Ji taught him.

Unfortunately, the method of treating diseases with Talisman Water must be accompanied by the Vigorous Qi of Inner Refining Breathing Technique, and the ability to make talismans must enter the Transformation Realm.
Otherwise, even if mastered, it’s useless. It can’t treat major epidemics at all!
Zhang Zhongjing had long mastered External Refining Breathing Technique, learning Inner Refining Breathing Technique was naturally unachievable for him.
His talent in the Medical Dao was extraordinary, but his talent in the Martial Dao was rather ordinary..."
Hua Tuo slowly narrated.
He gave a general account of Zhang Zhongjing’s story.
Ding Ling understood.
He hadn’t thought there were such stories within.
But it was normal upon reflection.
A person like Zhang Zhongjing, who would be keen on a better, faster method of healing, is quite normal.

"...Having found the Talisman Making Technique unusable, Zhang Zhongjing abandoned this avenue, and realized that the difficulty of making talismans was as high as reaching heaven. Ordinary people simply couldn’t learn it. If there’s a major epidemic in the world, it’s most likely still requires medicinal treatment!
So he left Yhiuu Ji, continued to travel and gather prescriptions and medical books, while visiting famous doctors, going to places of major epidemics, to cure the plagues..."
From Hua Tuo’s words, one can see.
Zhang Zhongjing is someone who is never satisfied with himself.
His skills in the Medical Dao have been progressively improving.
Hua Tuo even frankly admitted that in this aspect, he is far inferior to Zhang Zhongjing.
He couldn’t be obsessed with collecting medical books and prescriptions like Zhang Zhongjing, visiting various famous doctors and people.

"Fortunately, Zhang Zhongjing knew I was proficient in the Medical Dao, and many years ago specifically sought me out to deeply exchange insights on the Medical Dao for several months before departing. So my friendship with him is still quite good."
Ding Ling felt relieved.

"You should go find Zhang Zhongjing and have him take you to see Yhiuu Ji. The chances of success will definitely be much higher! Though Yhiuu Ji is hard to talk to and guards his skills extremely closely.
He is, however, thin-skinned and has a very strong sense of self-esteem.
Zhang Zhongjing knows how to get along with him..."
Hua Tuo said quite a bit more.
Ding Ling nodded.

Then Hua Tuo said that Zhang Zhongjing is now traveling the Four Seas, and to find him, you most likely need to head to Jingzhou Changsha County because there have been quite a few seriously ill people there in recent years, and Zhang Zhongjing is like him, going wherever there are major epidemics.
Since the exchange with Hua Tuo.
Basically, Hua Tuo treats major epidemics in the North.
Zhang Zhongjing in the South.
Of course, if some regional situations are very severe, Hua Tuo might also go to the southern Earth Realm.
It’s the same for Zhang Zhongjing.

"Take my letter to the Zhang Mansion in Changsha County, Changsha City to find him. You should be able to find him. If you really can’t, tell Yhiuu Ji you are Zhang Zhongjing’s friend. With this letter, Zhang Zhongjing will certainly not deny this connection."
Hua Tuo spoke.
Producing pen and paper, he began writing the letter swiftly.
Finished, he handed it to Ding Ling.
After receiving it, Ding Ling naturally expressed his gratitude.
"No need for that."
Hua Tuo stroked his beard and smiled:

"You and I can be considered kindred spirits. Your talent is unparalleled, your determination in the Martial Dao is extremely solid, so I will not hinder your pursuit of the Dao. I just hope that one day, if you truly become the Martial God in this world, you can alleviate the burdens of the people a little. After all, in this chaotic world, it’s the common folks who suffer."
Ding Ling naturally nodded in agreement.
If he had the opportunity in the future, he also hopes for the Three Kingdoms World to unite soon.
A unified environment would be beneficial to his friends!
Even if one day he truly goes to another world, in a united world, Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Pan Feng, Zhang Hex, and others will be more stable.
Ding Ling naturally doesn’t want those who have cared for him so much to meet a tragic end.
He also hopes they can become characters of Martial God level.
But how to unify?
Join Cao Mengde? Or Liu Bei? Sun Ce?
Or perhaps strike out alone?
Ding Ling didn’t think too much now.
Because differing strengths lead to differing thoughts,
Everything should wait until he has learned the Inner Refining Breathing Technique to consider.
After bidding farewell to Hua Tuo.
Ding Ling took some time to return to the real world.
He tidied himself up.
Took a laptop, went to villages with WIFI to borrow internet!
Then logged into certain game forums, using hacker techniques to steal someone’s account, anonymously posting to ask ’Where is Zhang Zhongjing now’.
And also used hacking techniques to pin the post to the top.
So everyone could see!
Indeed.
Ding Ling just wanted to use this method to find out.
Otherwise, would he really have to go to Jingzhou Changsha County and search meticulously?
That would be too time-consuming, too exhausting.
Where could be quicker?
Fortunately, there are indeed many people who visit the Daily Water Game Forum.
Very soon, people started replying to the post.
Asking the poster why he was looking for Zhang Zhongjing?
And pointed out where Zhang Zhongjing was.
"So it really is in Changsha City?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows:
"That’s great."
"By the way, ask where Huang Zhong is?"
Ding Ling thought for a moment but didn’t ask.
Instead, he used computer technology to quickly search forum keywords.
Then found that Huang Zhong was also in Changsha City.
And a player even cured Huang Zhong’s son’s illness and became Huang Zhong’s direct disciple! Learning Huang Zhong’s Breathing Technique, Saber Technique, Archery Skill.
Ding Ling was speechless.
The player truly had already done everything he wanted to do.
He began searching for keywords ’Yuan Family’, ’Pan Feng’, ’Zhao Yun’, ’Ding Ling’.
Soon.
He received a lot of information.
As he expected.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Famous General Wen Chou
paragraphs: The Yuan Family actually hasn’t given up on the Wanted Order!
To know after he issued the warning in Que Mountain City.
It’s already been seven days since then.
Seven days.
With the background of Pigeon Post, the key figures of the Yuan Family must have already understood what happened in Que Mountain City.
To still dare to issue a bounty.
Seems like they really don’t take his threat seriously.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, sneered twice, closed the laptop, turned around, and sped away.
As his exchanged abilities grew stronger.
Now, his strength in the real world is exactly the same as in the Game World!
Crossing mountains and ridges as if it’s nothing.

With the blessing of Lightweight Skill, similar to a Spirit Crane or a flying eagle, one leap can easily cross more than ten meters, such ability, even Olympic champions are just Fuyun before Ding Ling.
However, Ding Ling was not complacent about this.
Because he knows, he hasn’t reached the point where he can withstand bullets and artillery.
As long as he can’t withstand a nuclear bomb!
He can’t easily stand out.
Low profile.
Practical.
Be cautious!
This is Ding Ling’s most genuine thought.
The story of the early bird gets shot, Ding Ling is very clear about it.
Entered the Game World.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Pioneer in Treating and Preventing Epidemics!]
[Annotation: You assisted Hua Tuo in completing a treatment and prevention work in terms of epidemics!]
Is this possible?
Ding Ling was astonished.
It seems Achievement Medals are indeed everywhere.
It’s just if anyone can find them and accomplish them.
Treating and preventing epidemics, regular healers can’t handle that. So this Achievement Medal is not something that ordinary people can get.
Ding Ling relaxed.
Gathered Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Yuan Yao, Yuan Yin, and others.
And prepared the arrow quiver, etc.
The group mounted the horses and set off.
Hua Tuo escorted them to the city gate.
Click-clack!
Gradually distant.
"With this farewell, who knows when we will meet again."
Diao Chan turned back for one last look at Shenyang City.
The setting sun slanted down.
Shenyang City was enveloped in the sunset’s afterglow, and Hua Tuo’s silhouette at the city gate was fading, no longer visible as they galloped away.
"If we’re destined, we’ll meet again.
Ding Ling was open-minded.
"Eh."
Diao Chan suddenly exclaimed, sharply looking forward:
"Something’s wrong, there’s an ambush ahead."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling quickly reined in his horse, whinnying! The Ferghana Horse reared on its hind legs for a mere two moments before heavily landing on the ground, kicking up dust and dispersing smoke.
Regarding Diao Chan’s miraculous Sixth Sense, and her superior keen perception, hearing, and eyesight, Ding Ling was very impressed.
In this regard, he felt inferior.
Therefore, he believed Diao Chan’s words without a doubt.
If she said there was an ambush, there must be one.
"Whoosh!"
As if knowing their side had found the ambush.
More than a dozen sharp arrows suddenly shot out from the front, each aiming at Ding Ling’s heart, forehead, and other vital parts.
Woohoo!
Among the dozen arrows, three seemed capable of splitting mountains and earth, the roaring sound was deafening!
"Humph!"
Ding Ling snorted coldly and drew his sword.
Sunset Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
The sword blossoms bloomed, the Flowers in Bloom pattern, Setting Sun Diagram flashed and disappeared in the air.
Transforming into a sword shield clashing with the sharp arrows!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
The dozen arrows were easily blocked, with the three whistling Mountain-Piercing Arrows drilling into the void like electric drills, sputtering with sparks!
Violently colliding with the Floral Sword Shield for about two breaths before dispersing, turned to dust, blown by the wind across the place.
"Such powerful arrows!"
Ding Ling was shaken.
This is an Archery Skill that is in no way weaker than the Shadow Arrow Skill!
Although in stealth, silence, and speed it couldn’t match the Shadow Arrow!
But in terms of power, force, and piercing ability, it exceeded the Shadow Arrow by far!
The person who knew this Archery Skill, is definitely a super expert!
Might even be stronger than Ma Zhong!
Ding Ling solemnly called out loudly:
"Which coward dares to ambush, why not show your face!"
At this time.
Diao Chan had already pushed Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin to the front.
Sure enough, after two rounds of arrows.
The opponent immediately stopped.
Clearly.
The opponent didn’t want to shoot Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin.
"It’s the Yuan Family’s cowards again!"
Zhao Yun immediately understood, his Dragon Gall Silver Spear twirled, blossoming with gunflowers, and shouted:
"Relying on the advantage of numbers, repeatedly surrounding and intercepting, if you want a real fight, I Zhao Zilong am ready to accompany at any time.
"Hahaha..."
A long shout sounded from ahead.
Not long after.
Accompanied by the thudding of hooves.
A squad of Iron Cavalry suddenly charged out from a dense forest ahead.
The three leading them, each stood over nine feet tall.
The one on the left, bald and bearded, over nine feet high, holding an iron rod, with glaring eyes, extremely fierce and vicious, resembling a beast leaping through the wild mountains.
The one in the middle, clad in black armor, broad and burly, wielding a long sword, looking ugly but naturally authoritative;
The one on the right, holding a long spear, bow and arrows on his back, carrying an aura of sharpness and invincibility, appearing extremely valiant.
These three without exception all had ferocious appearances, like fierce monsters.
At this moment.
The one on the right looked at Ding Ling and laughed loudly:
"You are indeed famous in Wan City, overturning the Yellow Turban Army in Runan and Yingchuan. Your Sword Skill is very impressive. You can even block my Cloud-Piercing Arrow!"
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling frowned.
"I am Wen Chou, the renowned general of Jizhou!"
The one on the right said loudly:
"You are destined to die by our hands today! Don’t expect to leave alive!"
"Wen Chou?"
Ding Ling’s pupil slightly contracted.
In Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Wen Chou defeated Gongsun Zan in more than ten rounds!
Could withstand Zhao Yun head-on for sixty rounds!
Zhang Liao and Xu Huang fought against Wen Chou, Wen Chou strung the bow and shot, an arrow knocked down Zhang Liao, then battled Xu Huang, beating Xu Huang into retreat.
Later died at the hands of Guan Yu.

It was truly because Guan Yu’s reputation was great, Wen Chou fought Guan Yu for three rounds, felt fearful and dared not to battle further, turned his horse to bypass the river and flee, but was caught and killed by the fast horse of Guan Yu.
And it’s widely known that Guan Yu’s first three strikes are the strongest, after surviving these, battling dozens of rounds with him wouldn’t be a problem.
Wen Chou didn’t know this, survived the first three strikes, would surely think Guan Yu’s every strike is like the first three, felt afraid and fled, this is normal behavior.
Based on the depiction in Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Wen Chou is very strong, just unstable in mentality.
"Looks like you know my fame."
Wen Chou was stunned, then laughed loud, proudly saying:
"Even Ding Ling knows my name, Wen Chou. Seems like my prowess is already well known."
As if being known by Ding Ling was worthy of praise.
This was indeed the case.
In the eyes of Wen Chou and his men, Ding Ling is a very fierce and formidable character.
If it were not so.
They wouldn’t have joined forces to come here.
"So, the one beside you is Yan Liang?"
Ding Ling looked at the middle spearman.
"Correct."

[Annotation: You assisted Hua Tuo in completing a treatment and prevention work in terms of epidemics!]
Is this possible?
Ding Ling was astonished.
It seems Achievement Medals are indeed everywhere.
It’s just if anyone can find them and accomplish them.
Treating and preventing epidemics, regular healers can’t handle that.
So this Achievement Medal is not something that ordinary people can get.
Ding Ling relaxed.
Gathered Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Yuan Yao, Yuan Yin, and others.
And prepared the arrow quiver, etc.
The group mounted the horses and set off.
Hua Tuo escorted them to the city gate.
Click-clack!
Gradually distant.
"With this farewell, who knows when we will meet again."
Diao Chan turned back for one last look at Shenyang City.
The setting sun slanted down.
Shenyang City was enveloped in the sunset’s afterglow, and Hua Tuo’s silhouette at the city gate was fading, no longer visible as they galloped away.
"If we’re destined, we’ll meet again.
Ding Ling was open-minded.
"Eh."
Diao Chan suddenly exclaimed, sharply looking forward:
"Something’s wrong, there’s an ambush ahead."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling quickly reined in his horse, whinnying!
The Ferghana Horse reared on its hind legs for a mere two moments before heavily landing on the ground, kicking up dust and dispersing smoke.
Regarding Diao Chan’s miraculous Sixth Sense, and her superior keen perception, hearing, and eyesight, Ding Ling was very impressed.
In this regard, he felt inferior.
Therefore, he believed Diao Chan’s words without a doubt.
If she said there was an ambush, there must be one.
"Whoosh!"
As if knowing their side had found the ambush.
More than a dozen sharp arrows suddenly shot out from the front, each aiming at Ding Ling’s heart, forehead, and other vital parts.
Woohoo!
Among the dozen arrows, three seemed capable of splitting mountains and earth, the roaring sound was deafening!
"Humph!"
Ding Ling snorted coldly and drew his sword.
Sunset Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
The sword blossoms bloomed, the Flowers in Bloom pattern, Setting Sun Diagram flashed and disappeared in the air.
Transforming into a sword shield clashing with the sharp arrows!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
The dozen arrows were easily blocked, with the three whistling Mountain-Piercing Arrows drilling into the void like electric drills, sputtering with sparks!
Violently colliding with the Floral Sword Shield for about two breaths before dispersing, turned to dust, blown by the wind across the place.
"Such powerful arrows!"
Ding Ling was shaken.
This is an Archery Skill that is in no way weaker than the Shadow Arrow Skill!
Although in stealth, silence, and speed it couldn’t match the Shadow Arrow!
But in terms of power, force, and piercing ability, it exceeded the Shadow Arrow by far!
The person who knew this Archery Skill, is definitely a super expert!
Might even be stronger than Ma Zhong!
Ding Ling solemnly called out loudly:
"Which coward dares to ambush, why not show your face!"
At this time.
Diao Chan had already pushed Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin to the front.
Sure enough, after two rounds of arrows.
The opponent immediately stopped.
Clearly.
The opponent didn’t want to shoot Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin.
"It’s the Yuan Family’s cowards again!"
Zhao Yun immediately understood, his Dragon Gall Silver Spear twirled, blossoming with gunflowers, and shouted:
"Relying on the advantage of numbers, repeatedly surrounding and intercepting, if you want a real fight, I Zhao Zilong am ready to accompany at any time.
"Hahaha..."
A long shout sounded from ahead.
Not long after.
Accompanied by the thudding of hooves.
A squad of Iron Cavalry suddenly charged out from a dense forest ahead.
The three leading them, each stood over nine feet tall.
The one on the left, bald and bearded, over nine feet high, holding an iron rod, with glaring eyes, extremely fierce and vicious, resembling a beast leaping through the wild mountains.
The one in the middle, clad in black armor, broad and burly, wielding a long sword, looking ugly but naturally authoritative;
The one on the right, holding a long spear, bow and arrows on his back, carrying an aura of sharpness and invincibility, appearing extremely valiant.
These three without exception all had ferocious appearances, like fierce monsters.
At this moment.
The one on the right looked at Ding Ling and laughed loudly:
"You are indeed famous in Wan City, overturning the Yellow Turban Army in Runan and Yingchuan.
Your Sword Skill is very impressive.
You can even block my Cloud-Piercing Arrow!"
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling frowned.
"I am Wen Chou, the renowned general of Jizhou!"
The one on the right said loudly:
"You are destined to die by our hands today!
Don’t expect to leave alive!"
"Wen Chou?"
Ding Ling’s pupil slightly contracted.
In Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Wen Chou defeated Gongsun Zan in more than ten rounds!
Could withstand Zhao Yun head-on for sixty rounds!
Zhang Liao and Xu Huang fought against Wen Chou, Wen Chou strung the bow and shot, an arrow knocked down Zhang Liao, then battled Xu Huang, beating Xu Huang into retreat.
Later died at the hands of Guan Yu.

It was truly because Guan Yu’s reputation was great, Wen Chou fought Guan Yu for three rounds, felt fearful and dared not to battle further, turned his horse to bypass the river and flee, but was caught and killed by the fast horse of Guan Yu.
And it’s widely known that Guan Yu’s first three strikes are the strongest, after surviving these, battling dozens of rounds with him wouldn’t be a problem.
Wen Chou didn’t know this, survived the first three strikes, would surely think Guan Yu’s every strike is like the first three, felt afraid and fled, this is normal behavior.
Based on the depiction in Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Wen Chou is very strong, just unstable in mentality.
"Looks like you know my fame."
Wen Chou was stunned, then laughed loud, proudly saying:
"Even Ding Ling knows my name, Wen Chou.
Seems like my prowess is already well known."
As if being known by Ding Ling was worthy of praise.
This was indeed the case.
In the eyes of Wen Chou and his men, Ding Ling is a very fierce and formidable character.
If it were not so.
They wouldn’t have joined forces to come here.
"So, the one beside you is Yan Liang?"
Ding Ling looked at the middle spearman.
"Correct."

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Zhao Yun Slays the Heaven-Cutting Yaksha
paragraphs: Yan Liang’s tense face finally relaxed a little.
He thought Ding Ling didn’t recognize him.
Now it seems, his fame is in no way inferior to that of Wen Chou!
He became noticeably more cheerful:
"In light of you knowing our prestigious names, we’ll make sure you have an intact corpse later."
He pointed at Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin:
"Provided that you release the direct descendants of the Yuan Family immediately!"
Ding Ling ignored him and instead looked at the person on the left:
"And who are you?"
"You don’t know who I am?"
The person’s face on the left instantly darkened, clearly displeased.
Yan Liang laughed heartily:

"It is quite normal that Wen Chou and I are known throughout the world. Ding Ling not knowing you, Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man, who is just another fierce general of the Yellow Turban Army, is not surprising."
Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man.
A fierce general who could fight Cao Hong for dozens of rounds without a clear winner.
Ding Ling felt a realization dawn on him.
The three people before him.
Not to mention how ferocious Wen Chou was.
Yan Liang, who was a super powerful figure capable of slashing Song Xian in three moves, cutting down Wei Xu in one strike, and defeating Xu Huang in twenty rounds!
It was very unjust that he was killed by Guan Yu.
Just because during that time, Liu Bei was still in Yuan Shao’s camp, and Liu Bei personally told Yan Liang that he had a brother named Guan Yu, and described Guan Yu’s appearance in detail.

When Yan Liang indeed saw Guan Yu, he mistook him for someone who came to join them, and under this relaxed vigilance, he was cut down by Guan Yu in one slash. How suffocating his death must have been can be imagined.
Of course, this is just according to some versions of the records.
The exact facts are unknown.
However, looking at Yan Liang and Wen Chou’s aura and demeanor, it was obvious they were extraordinary, and Ding Ling dared not underestimate them for fear of mishap.
"Heh heh."
Hex Man felt extremely jealous, and sneered coldly:
"Ding Ling, a frog in a well, actually doesn’t know my name, Heaven-Cutting Yaksha."
He raised his iron staff high, charged out of the formation on horseback, shouting loudly:
"It’s said that you and Diao Chan together took on Wan City and Que Mountain City. I’m very curious about how strong you really are. If you have guts, come out and duel with me!"
"Such stupidity."
Yuan Yao sighed.
"Ignorant."
Yuan Yin completely agreed. Ding Ling is an unmatched mighty general!
How many seemingly powerful figures had he killed?
And here was Hex Man, a mere Yellow Turban Thief, daring to rant in front of the formation?
Diao Chan glanced at Ding Ling, preparing to ride out and fight.
But Zhao Yun was one step ahead, galloping and poised with a Dragon Gall Silver Spear aimed at Hex Man:
"You, Hex Man, dare challenge Ding Ling! You must first pass through me."
"Hmph. A little thief with a milk stink dares clamor here."
Hex Man roared in anger.
The iron staff smashed heavily towards Zhao Yun.
His weapon was extremely heavy! Every strike seemed to cause ripples in the air, like an earth-supporting staff rolling Heaven and Earth!

Zhao Yun’s long spear seemed to weave through the clouds and waves, elusive and swift. When the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique was unleashed, a series of spear flowers flashed by, converging into a sharp pattern resembling the "Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix" pushed downward like a rain of arrows.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
In a breath’s time, the two exchanged several rounds.
One wielded a world-shaking giant staff;
The other wielded a Thunderbolt Spear, making Heaven and Earth unstable!
For a moment, it was a battle without a clear winner.
Just as Yan Liang and Wen Chou were about to cheer, thud!
Zhao Yun’s spear technique suddenly accelerated, accompanied by a spear flower breaking through the defensive circle of the iron staff with a crisp sound.
The spearhead pierced into Hex Man’s forehead.
Thud!
Zhao Yun withdrew the spear and rode past Hex Man.
Hex Man’s towering frame swayed on horseback before crashing heavily to the ground!
"Hex Man!"
Yan Liang and Wen Chou were shocked and turned pale.
Then they were enraged.
Ding Ling hadn’t even made a move, and a small general beside him had already killed a major general on their side, preventing them from understanding Ding Ling’s true capabilities!
If one Zhao Yun was already so formidable,
then what of Ding Ling, who surpassed Zhao Yun by countless degrees?
Yan Liang and Wen Chou grew solemn, their hearts heavy, for no one understood Hex Man’s prowess better than they did.

Yet Hex Man died just like this, leaving them shaken, and Wen Chou, without another word, picked up three arrows, quickly grabbed the bow, and aimed them at Zhao Yun, firing three Cloud-Piercing Arrows with a swoosh.
Whoosh!
Clang!
Just as the three Cloud-Piercing Arrows shot through the void, Ding Ling’s three Shadow Arrows appeared, colliding mid-air with the Cloud-Piercing Arrows, resulting in a thunderous explosion.
"A sneak attack from the shadows."
Ding Ling sneered, bending his bow and drawing more arrows, shooting them with another three swooshes towards Yan Liang and Wen Chou.
His Shadow Arrows were faster, although their attributes couldn’t match the Cloud-Piercing Arrows in terms of penetration.
But who could underestimate the Shadow Arrow Skill wielded by Ding Ling?
If it were Ma Zhong, he might retreat.
But not Ding Ling.

With massive force of three thousand pounds pulling the bowstring, and amplifying the Shadow Arrow Skill with two Breathing Techniques, he achieved an equilibrium of power and penetration matching the Cloud-Piercing Arrows.
Perhaps even surpassing it!
Clang!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Wen Chou’s expression turned grim, swiftly retaliating.
The two rapidly fired at each other, bows drawn at incredible speeds.
Both mastered at a high tier of Archery Skill.
The sky was filled with arrow rain, and amidst the thunderous clashes, each side’s arrows collided like raging dragons, creating splendid fireworks and lightning in the void!
Evidently, it was only two people.
Yet it seemed like two units of Divine Archers fiercely attacking each other!
The scene was extremely terrifying.
Cloud-Piercing Arrows seemed to break through clouds and waves with a deafening whistling, as if tearing through the air, roaring towards Ding Ling;
Whereas Shadow Arrows, silent and ghostly, like a leopard in the dark or a falcon in the sky, moved astoundingly once unleashed.
Two types of Skills.
On this day, they erupted with a thrilling and tragic momentum!
Just a moment’s time.
The two shot through several arrow quivers, over a hundred arrows!
The air was filled with the leftover powdery residue of clashed arrows.
The more Wen Chou drew the bow, the worse his expression became. As he could no longer tolerate, he signaled to Yan Liang with a look.
Yan Liang cast a sidelong glance, shocked.
He knew it was because Wen Chou’s stamina was lagging, and couldn’t help feeling a chill down his spine.
It was bad enough that Ding Ling was so formidable.
The foolishness of their ally, Hex Man, charging to duel Ding Ling and getting killed by Zhao Yun from the onset lost them the initial advantage, leaving even Yan Liang feeling the strain.
Without a word, he waved his hand.
The cavalry lined up, and immediately hundreds of men drew their bows, aiming at Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and others:
"Stop, or I’ll shoot you all dead."
Ding Ling indeed stopped.
Wen Chou also ceased, panting heavily. Seeing Ding Ling’s calm and unflustered face, he couldn’t help but be perplexed, beginning to more readily believe the rumors.
Such capability, being able to raid through Wan City while holding Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin hostage, seemed not entirely impossible!
He started to feel a trembling unease.
Just because at this very moment, he...

chapters.title: Chapter 173 173: Yuan Yin's Death (16/32)
paragraphs: There was no longer any certainty in being able to take down Ding Ling.
Initially, it was thought that the ambush would be effective.
Unfortunately, it was seen through.
Afterward, we figured that the two of us were renowned generals of Jizhou. If we joined forces to kill Ding Ling, it would surely be an easy task.
But after a round of arrow exchanges.
All of Wen Chou's confidence was shattered.
He began to feel uneasy and anxious, his face naturally becoming more unsightly.
Earlier boasting to surely kill Ding Ling!
Recalling that now, Wen Chou couldn't help but feel uneasy!
"Do you dare to kill Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin?"
Ding Ling asked coldly.
"Previously, of course, we didn't dare."
Yan Liang held a saber, his words resounding:
"Otherwise, we would have already covered you with a rain of arrows."
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin heaved a huge sigh of relief upon hearing Yan Liang say this.
They really feared encountering some reckless fools!
Just like that Heaven-Cutting Yaksha earlier, who seemed not quite right, too arrogant, too foolish!
"However..."
Yan Liang shifted the topic, raising his voice:

"You people have been holding Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin hostage until now, clearly intending to use them against our assault. The Yuan Family Patriarch has given orders: if the situation proves futile, those two can be killed."
"What?!"
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin were shocked, incredulous:
"We are the direct descendants of the Yuan Family! How could the Patriarch possibly?!"
"That's what the Patriarch instructed us to do."
Yan Liang remained expressionless, not batting an eye:
"So apologies to you both, if the situation is unsalvageable, we won't hold back!"
He paused, raising an eyebrow:

"We are the Yuan Family's most formidable generals that can be presented! If even we can't handle Ding Ling, do you think anyone else can? Compared to the life of the Patriarch, no matter how important you both are, how can you be more important than the Patriarch?"
His saber pointed directly at Ding Ling:

"You can blame Ding Ling for being too arrogant and daring to threaten the Yuan Family Patriarch in broad daylight, even claiming he would take the Patriarch's head. Such big talk, he's already at daggers drawn with the Yuan Family, and the Patriarch is furious, vowing to destroy Ding Ling at all costs."
"So we are just sacrifices?"
Yuan Yao was enraged:
"My father is Yuan Shu! How could the Patriarch!"
'Why not?'
Yan Liang seemed reluctant to say more to Yuan Yao, simply waved his hand.
Hundreds of archers once again drew their bows together, aiming at Ding Ling's group:

"I am giving you one more chance, Ding Ling, release Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin. I can give you a proper burial, erect a monument! Otherwise, your end will surely be being dismembered, bodies left to rot in the wilderness!"
"Oh, really?
Ding Ling drew the Giant Que Sword.
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng, seeing this, also prepared themselves solemnly, assuming their positions and readying defenses.
"So you want to fight to the end with us?"
Yan Liang shouted clearly:
"Then today either you die or we die!"
Wen Chou also shouted out:
"Do not hold back! Otherwise, Ding Ling will surely kill us. Go all out! Fire!"
Seeing Ding Ling draw his sword to charge.
Wen Chou's heart trembled, and without another word, he gave the order.
Crunch! Crunch!
With the sound of bow strings cutting through the sky, echoing in the Celestial Extreme.
Arrows fell like a waterfall.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin bore the brunt, shot into porcupines!
Yuan Yao's pupils dilated, filled with horror, disbelief, unwillingness, regret, remorse... all complexities reaching the extreme.
Yuan Yin was even more unwilling and remorseful than Yuan Yao.
He regretted to the point of despair.
If only time could turn back.
He would never again foolishly step forward to stop and reproach Ding Ling.
He truly didn't expect the Patriarch's fear and intent to kill Ding Ling to be so profound!
Even going so far as to kill them for the sake of eliminating Ding Ling.
Originally, Yan Liang and Wen Chou didn't want to kill them either; who wouldn't want to complete the task perfectly?
But Ding Ling's strength exceeded imagination, Wen Chou and Yan Liang had no confidence in taking down Ding Ling.
The only course was to strike first with an arrow barrage!
They now even deeply regretted.
If they'd known earlier that they would have to kill Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin, they should have unleashed the arrow rain right from the start, catching Ding Ling off guard.
Now to once again launch an arrow barrage.
Hoping it achieves a good effect.
Wen Chou also bent his bow, shooting explosively at Ding Ling's Ferghana Horse.
Capture the chief before capturing the bandits!
Shoot the horse before shooting the man!
If he couldn't hit Ding Ling, surely he could hit his horse?!
Wen Chou was not convinced!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Ding Ling led the charge! With the Giant Que Sword wielded tightly, nothing could penetrate it, not even a needle!
Sunset Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!

Various sword techniques cycled in Ding Ling's hands, sometimes grand and magnificent, as if the Human Emperor was creating the world anew, with each sword stroke, the sword light shone, slicing through and breaking countless arrows;
Sometimes mysterious and elusive as if a celestial mist, each sword forming blossoming flowers and falling snow!
Wherever it went.
All arrows were swept aside!
It was as if a deity splitting the sea with a sword.
Unstoppably powerful!
Irresistible!
The Ferghana Horse sped quickly; in a few blinks, it covered seventy to eighty meters, arriving in front of Wen Chou.
Wen Chou's three arrows failed to succeed.
He intended to shoot again.
But seeing Ding Ling charging on horseback, his hackles stood on end as if being stalked by a bloodthirsty Taotie, poised to be devoured at any moment!

He roared furiously, shaking his spear as he invoked the Inherited Breathing Technique while displaying the Swift Wind Lightning Spear Technique, his spear like lightning breaking through the void, or a beam of light piercing the dark night.
Clang!
With one thrust, the spear flowers bloomed, gathered into light, and collided heavily with Ding Ling's Giant Que Sword.
Bang!
With just one strike, it seemed as if Mars collided with Earth!
Ding Ling's body trembled slightly but continued to wield the Giant Que Sword, slashing at Wen Chou without changing expression.
Wen Chou, however, was struck as if by thunder, his spear unsteady, nearly flying out of his hands.
He was frightened, shouted loudly:
"Such tremendous strength. Yan Liang, help me!"
Clang!
Yan Liang, who was commanding cavalry to surround Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng, upon hearing Wen Chou's call, immediately rode hard, saber in hand, charging at Ding Ling.
"Shattered Star Blade Technique!"
With one slash.
The blade light gleamed brightly, dots of starlight converged into a galaxy, then suddenly burst apart, as if the world shattered and stars exploded.
A burst of explosive destructive energy transmitted directly from the blade tip, slicing heavily toward Ding Ling's head!
Ding Ling snorted coldly, flicked his left hand.
The Heaven-piercing Halberd was tightly gripped in his hand.
The Overlord Halberd Technique was unleashed.
Bang!
The Heaven-piercing Halberd clashed with the blade tip, electric sparks bursting forth.
Ding Ling's body trembled slightly.
Yan Liang nearly couldn't remain steady, almost being thrown off his horse.
"Hiss!"
He gasped, his Heart Lake rippling, unable to remain calm:
"This guy, truly possesses divine power!"
He initially thought that the two brothers were already extraordinarily strong in this world!
Unexpectedly, Ding Ling's strength far surpassed theirs!

Initially, it was thought that the ambush would be effective.
Unfortunately, it was seen through.
Afterward, we figured that the two of us were renowned generals of Jizhou.
If we joined forces to kill Ding Ling, it would surely be an easy task.
But after a round of arrow exchanges.
All of Wen Chou's confidence was shattered.
He began to feel uneasy and anxious, his face naturally becoming more unsightly.
Earlier boasting to surely kill Ding Ling!
Recalling that now, Wen Chou couldn't help but feel uneasy!
"Do you dare to kill Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin?"
Ding Ling asked coldly.
"Previously, of course, we didn't dare."
Yan Liang held a saber, his words resounding:
"Otherwise, we would have already covered you with a rain of arrows."
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin heaved a huge sigh of relief upon hearing Yan Liang say this.
They really feared encountering some reckless fools!
Just like that Heaven-Cutting Yaksha earlier, who seemed not quite right, too arrogant, too foolish!
"However..."
Yan Liang shifted the topic, raising his voice:
"You people have been holding Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin hostage until now, clearly intending to use them against our assault.
The Yuan Family Patriarch has given orders: if the situation proves futile, those two can be killed."
"What?!"
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin were shocked, incredulous:
"We are the direct descendants of the Yuan Family!
How could the Patriarch possibly?!"
"That's what the Patriarch instructed us to do."
Yan Liang remained expressionless, not batting an eye:
"So apologies to you both, if the situation is unsalvageable, we won't hold back!"
He paused, raising an eyebrow:
"We are the Yuan Family's most formidable generals that can be presented!
If even we can't handle Ding Ling, do you think anyone else can?
Compared to the life of the Patriarch, no matter how important you both are, how can you be more important than the Patriarch?"
His saber pointed directly at Ding Ling:
"You can blame Ding Ling for being too arrogant and daring to threaten the Yuan Family Patriarch in broad daylight, even claiming he would take the Patriarch's head.
Such big talk, he's already at daggers drawn with the Yuan Family, and the Patriarch is furious, vowing to destroy Ding Ling at all costs."
"So we are just sacrifices?"
Yuan Yao was enraged:
"My father is Yuan Shu!
How could the Patriarch!"
'Why not?'
Yan Liang seemed reluctant to say more to Yuan Yao, simply waved his hand.
Hundreds of archers once again drew their bows together, aiming at Ding Ling's group:
"I am giving you one more chance, Ding Ling, release Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin.
I can give you a proper burial, erect a monument!
Otherwise, your end will surely be being dismembered, bodies left to rot in the wilderness!"
"Oh, really?
Ding Ling drew the Giant Que Sword.
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng, seeing this, also prepared themselves solemnly, assuming their positions and readying defenses.
"So you want to fight to the end with us?"
Yan Liang shouted clearly:
"Then today either you die or we die!"
Wen Chou also shouted out:
"Do not hold back!
Otherwise, Ding Ling will surely kill us.
Go all out!
Fire!"
Seeing Ding Ling draw his sword to charge.
Wen Chou's heart trembled, and without another word, he gave the order.
Crunch!
Crunch!
With the sound of bow strings cutting through the sky, echoing in the Celestial Extreme.
Arrows fell like a waterfall.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin bore the brunt, shot into porcupines!
Yuan Yao's pupils dilated, filled with horror, disbelief, unwillingness, regret, remorse... all complexities reaching the extreme.
Yuan Yin was even more unwilling and remorseful than Yuan Yao.
He regretted to the point of despair.
If only time could turn back.
He would never again foolishly step forward to stop and reproach Ding Ling.
He truly didn't expect the Patriarch's fear and intent to kill Ding Ling to be so profound!
Even going so far as to kill them for the sake of eliminating Ding Ling.
Originally, Yan Liang and Wen Chou didn't want to kill them either; who wouldn't want to complete the task perfectly?
But Ding Ling's strength exceeded imagination, Wen Chou and Yan Liang had no confidence in taking down Ding Ling.
The only course was to strike first with an arrow barrage!
They now even deeply regretted.
If they'd known earlier that they would have to kill Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin, they should have unleashed the arrow rain right from the start, catching Ding Ling off guard.
Now to once again launch an arrow barrage.
Hoping it achieves a good effect.
Wen Chou also bent his bow, shooting explosively at Ding Ling's Ferghana Horse.
Capture the chief before capturing the bandits!
Shoot the horse before shooting the man!
If he couldn't hit Ding Ling, surely he could hit his horse?!
Wen Chou was not convinced!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Ding Ling led the charge!
With the Giant Que Sword wielded tightly, nothing could penetrate it, not even a needle!
Sunset Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!

Various sword techniques cycled in Ding Ling's hands, sometimes grand and magnificent, as if the Human Emperor was creating the world anew, with each sword stroke, the sword light shone, slicing through and breaking countless arrows;
Sometimes mysterious and elusive as if a celestial mist, each sword forming blossoming flowers and falling snow!
Wherever it went.
All arrows were swept aside!
It was as if a deity splitting the sea with a sword.
Unstoppably powerful!
Irresistible!
The Ferghana Horse sped quickly; in a few blinks, it covered seventy to eighty meters, arriving in front of Wen Chou.
Wen Chou's three arrows failed to succeed.
He intended to shoot again.
But seeing Ding Ling charging on horseback, his hackles stood on end as if being stalked by a bloodthirsty Taotie, poised to be devoured at any moment!

He roared furiously, shaking his spear as he invoked the Inherited Breathing Technique while displaying the Swift Wind Lightning Spear Technique, his spear like lightning breaking through the void, or a beam of light piercing the dark night.
Clang!
With one thrust, the spear flowers bloomed, gathered into light, and collided heavily with Ding Ling's Giant Que Sword.
Bang!
With just one strike, it seemed as if Mars collided with Earth!
Ding Ling's body trembled slightly but continued to wield the Giant Que Sword, slashing at Wen Chou without changing expression.
Wen Chou, however, was struck as if by thunder, his spear unsteady, nearly flying out of his hands.
He was frightened, shouted loudly:
"Such tremendous strength.
Yan Liang, help me!"
Clang!
Yan Liang, who was commanding cavalry to surround Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng, upon hearing Wen Chou's call, immediately rode hard, saber in hand, charging at Ding Ling.
"Shattered Star Blade Technique!"
With one slash.
The blade light gleamed brightly, dots of starlight converged into a galaxy, then suddenly burst apart, as if the world shattered and stars exploded.
A burst of explosive destructive energy transmitted directly from the blade tip, slicing heavily toward Ding Ling's head!
Ding Ling snorted coldly, flicked his left hand.
The Heaven-piercing Halberd was tightly gripped in his hand.
The Overlord Halberd Technique was unleashed.
Bang!
The Heaven-piercing Halberd clashed with the blade tip, electric sparks bursting forth.
Ding Ling's body trembled slightly.
Yan Liang nearly couldn't remain steady, almost being thrown off his horse.
"Hiss!"
He gasped, his Heart Lake rippling, unable to remain calm:
"This guy, truly possesses divine power!"
He initially thought that the two brothers were already extraordinarily strong in this world!
Unexpectedly, Ding Ling's strength far surpassed theirs!

chapters.title: Chapter 174 174: Yan Liang Falls
paragraphs: One should know they have reached a strength of 2,200 pounds!
Such incredible strength!
Ordinary second-class fierce generals can't withstand even a single move from them!
But even using the Inherited Breathing Technique, a strike blessed with Divine Skill!
It still couldn't withstand a single strike from Ding Ling!
And this was Ding Ling countering with his left hand on a split mind. What if he was fully committed?
Yan Liang could hardly imagine!
At this moment, he completely believed the rumors! The tales!
Only such a ferocious man could so easily take Ji Ling's head amid thousands of troops!
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!

Ding Ling swept his Heaven-piercing Halberd over the two, and the Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix pattern formed by the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique instantly forced Yan Liang and Wen Chou apart.
Then Ding Ling sheathed his sword, holding the halberd with both hands, shouted, and the Overlord Halberd Technique displayed its might!
Immortal Slaying Soul Destruction!
Godslaying Shattering!
Demon-Slaying Shadowless!
Devouring Heaven and Earth!
The various ultimate techniques of the Overlord Halberd Technique were unleashed by Ding Ling one after another, and the entire sky was filled with the sharpness of the halberd! Halberd shadows!
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!
Yan Liang and Wen Chou roared repeatedly, executing the Shattered Star Blade Technique and Swift Wind Lightning Spear Technique to the fullest.
The three circled around, attacking speed with speed!
No one dared to approach!
Whoever got a little closer, the sharp vigorous qi could directly inflict severe injuries, dismembering one!
The three quickly reached a heated stalemate in their battle.
They seemed like three Xun Winds swirling around the earth!
Wherever they passed, grass and trees swayed, and the earth trembled ceaselessly!
It was just a matter of moments.
The three had already fought no less than twenty rounds!
Boom!
Suddenly, a thunderous roar echoed through everyone's ears.
Upon looking again.
They saw a figure being beaten off the horse's back.
That person was none other than Wen Chou!
"How is this possible?!"
The cavalry members turned their heads, shocked.
But they were also overwhelmed themselves.
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng teamed up, charging into the cavalry ranks, invincible, any blocking them was either dead or disabled!
Among the three, only Du Qingcheng was slightly weaker and needed protection.
Wherever Zhao Yun pointed his long spear, spear flowers bloomed, and no one could withstand a single blow from him.
Diao Chan's body technique was extremely high, and her Fish Guts Sword flickered, with every sweep, she easily reaped the lives of one cavalryman after another.
The trio formed a cone formation! Advancing all the way through! They forcibly pierced through the cavalry ranks and charged back in for another assault!
The cavalry team was left in utter disarray!
Boom!
After sending Wen Chou flying,
Ding Ling's Heaven-piercing Halberd appeared even more overbearing, flamboyant!
One move of Demon Subduing Chaotic Dance was unleashed.
He seemed like a deity wielding a Divine Weapon, with immense halberd shadows pressing down on Yan Liang like mountains, and Yan Liang's eyes nearly popped as he swung his knife to counter!
Boom!
A loud crash.
Yan Liang let out a tragic cry, his wrist burst open, unable to hold onto his long knife, and with splattering blood, it was hurled away.
Boom!
With another strike, Yan Liang was also directly knocked off the horse's back, crashing into several cavalry members before tumbling heavily to the ground!
Pft!
Ding Ling rode up, casually waving his halberd, as if a poet effortlessly composing verses, his path cut through like dividing the sea, heads flew skyward one by one.
The cavalry blocking the way were all beheaded by his halberd.
Clang!
The halberd finally thrust toward Yan Liang's forehead amidst a resonating hum.
Yan Liang's eyes widened like bronze bells, scenes of his life flashing rapidly before settling on the halberd's tip.
"Do you want to live or die?"
Ding Ling demanded.
"I want to live."
Yan Liang instinctively replied.
"Tell them to stop."
"Stop!"
Yan Liang immediately shouted loudly.
Wen Chou had already staggered up, looking somewhat bewildered at Ding Ling.
By the tenth round, he was already unable to hold on, each weapon clash felt like being crushed by a mountain, excruciating, numb! Unbearable!
By the twentieth round, he couldn't hold onto his weapon anymore, his wrist veins burst open, and he was utterly overwhelmed, one strike and his weapon was sent flying!
He used his hand to block the halberd's sharpness, otherwise, he could have already returned to the Underworld.
But seeing Ding Ling's demeanor now?
Not going to kill them?
Not just him.
All the remaining cavalry were equally astonished, looking at Ding Ling.
Among them were some players.
Ding Ling didn't know who the players were, and even if he did, he wouldn't care, he looked at Yan Liang and Wen Chou:
"Hand over your supreme skills to me. I will spare your lives."
Yan Liang and Wen Chou's supreme skills were indeed immensely powerful!
And they seemed to not have fully cultivated to the true Mastery Realm.
Even so, they had already reached the Super-Elite level!
Which showed the extraordinary nature of these cultivation techniques and supreme skills.
Ding Ling thought it only normal to want to seize them.
But to his surprise, Yan Liang and Wen Chou shook their heads in unison:
"Absolutely impossible!"
"That's a pity."
Ding Ling sighed, then without hesitation, swung his halberd.
Pft!
Yan Liang's head was decapitated.
Wen Chou stared wide-eyed, his courage shattered, hysterically:
"Ding Ling!"
He wanted to run.
But he knew he couldn't outrun a Ferghana Horse!
In shock and fear, he instinctively wanted to say 'I can hand over the cultivation technique,' but remembering ancestral teachings and family laws, the words were swallowed back.
Clip-clop!
The Ferghana Horse burst forward, reaching Wen Chou.
Pft!
The halberd swung down.
Wen Chou's head soared skyward with a plume of blood, spinning mid-air a few times, plummeting to the ground, trampled into remnants, blood dust by iron hooves.
His eyes were filled with complex emotions like 'unwillingness, shock, regret, annoyance, pain, fear...'
Difficult to describe in words.
[E-level Achievement Medal earned: Intimidate Wen Chou.]
[E-level Achievement Medal earned: Intimidate Yan Liang.]

[Note: In this Plane World's Super-Elite General count, they are as rare as phoenix feathers. Yan Liang and Wen Chou occupy two positions. They are self-confident, flamboyant, obstinate, unruly! Together, not even Pan Feng could withstand their edge!
They were confident that as long as they acted together, there were no fierce generals they couldn't kill, no enemies they couldn't defeat!
But your appearance.
Shattered their worldview!
Brutally crushed their pride!
Trampled their conceit, nonconformity underfoot.
Made them terrified, remorseful, even regretful!
If time could rewind.
They would certainly not agree to come to kill you for the sake of being famously known and the huge bounty on the wanted order from the Yuan Family's patriarch!]
A notification sounded.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Two E-levels.
Quite rare indeed.
He abruptly turned his gaze toward the other cavalry members.
Seeing him, the players among the cavalry decisively bolted!
Clip-clop!

They had already slipped to the battlefield's edge when Yan Liang and Wen Chou were defeated, and now seeing Ding Ling about to rage, hearing a shout of 'Run,' the first batch spurred their horses into the forest.
As players.
Their purpose in the Game World was to improve themselves.
