chapters.title: Chapter 175 175: Ghost Prison Spear Technique and Calm Wind Swordsmanship (18/32)
paragraphs: Let the players go all out against fierce generals and feudal lords?
That's too difficult.
At this moment, the minds of these fleeing players are in turmoil, unable to settle down:

"Ding Ling, this guy, is precisely as described by those forum posters, no, perhaps even more fierce and terrifying than they said! He's not even human! What difference is there between him and a savage beast? Too fierce! That's Yan Liang and Wen Chou! Fierce generals like them that even Xu Huang and others dare not challenge!"
"How did he train?"
They were itching with curiosity.
Desperate to find Ding Ling and ask him.
But they dared not.
Because they know, if there really are secrets, Ding Ling wouldn't share them, might even get angry, resulting in deadly consequences!
Players are truly everywhere, in every nook and cranny.
Even within Yan Liang and Wen Chou's cavalry are players.
It's better that players don't shout.
Once they shout, Ding Ling distinguishes them from the natives.
But they ran, and Ding Ling did not give chase.
Including those cavalry who scattered and fled like defeated soldiers.
This time, Ding Ling didn't even bother to speak harsh words.
He had already made up his mind.
If he doesn't remove the head of the Yuan Family Patriarch.
Ding Ling definitely won't rest until justice is served!
It had become a life-and-death enmity.
Either the Yuan Family people die.
Or Ding Ling dies.
Naturally, Ding Ling chooses for the Yuan Family people to die!

"Once I've learned the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, breaking through the limits of strength and stepping into the Celestial Human Realm that Wang Yue and others described! Perhaps then I can more easily complete all tasks, breaking the world's barriers and stepping into a more advanced plane world!"
Ding Ling was invigorated.
Diao Chan, after searching the corpses, came over and handed Ding Ling three secret manuals, saying:
"I found these on Yan Liang and Wen Chou."
She was becoming more and more aware.
Ding Ling looked at Diao Chan with appreciation.
He almost forgot about this.
After all, he asked Yan Liang and Wen Chou, and they were unwilling to hand over the ancestral techniques, so how could they carry secret manuals on them?
But unexpectedly, there was hope in the darkness.
Diao Chan unexpectedly found the secret manuals with luck against the odds.
A blessed one!
With Zhao Yun and Diao Chan as the fortunate ones in the group, Ding Ling felt that if there was a Luck Value attribute, his luck now certainly wouldn't be bad!
He immediately opened the secret manual.
"Confucian Breathing Technique"
This is a top-level breathing technique secret skill.
A technique every top Confucian scholar must learn!
Learn this technique.
The body will possess Vast Energy.
Not only healthier but also significantly stronger, able to fight on horseback and govern offhorse!
"It's impossible for Yan Liang and Wen Chou to learn this breathing technique.
Ding Ling pondered deeply, slightly closing his eyes.
Soon.
A new, illusory secret manual appeared on the library shelf.
Though due to physical reasons, he couldn't immediately learn another External Refining Breathing Technique.
But Ding Ling's insight and quality now far surpassed ordinary people.
Naturally, he saw the strength and uniqueness of this breathing technique at a glance.
"It's truly a flawless breathing technique!"
After thorough examination, Ding Ling understood.
Incredibly surprised.
"Yan Liang and Wen Chou's breathing technique clearly exudes ferocity, savage aura, and intimidating presence, absolutely unlikely to be this Confucian Dao Technique. Where did they get it from?"
A bolt of lightning flashed across Ding Ling's mind.
"Could it be... the Yuan Family's Wanted Order?"
He was somewhat puzzled.
Yan Liang and Wen Chou didn't even complete their tasks, yet received rewards.
How much trust did the Yuan Family Patriarch have in them to do this?
Thinking of Yan Liang and Wen Chou's prowess, Ding Ling understood.
Super-Elite experts are rare across Jiuzhou Land!
The Yuan Family having Yan Liang and Wen Chou, indicates their formidable strength!
They believed Yan Liang and Wen Chou could capture and kill Ding Ling, surely because they had seen their methods and strength, otherwise, how would they grant rewards first?
"It must be to impart some reward as a show of trust and commendation."
Ding Ling nodded inwardly.
This is a common tactic by rulers to manage their subordinates.
But now.
It's to his benefit.
He continued browsing the secret manuals.
The second one:
"Ghost Prison Spear Technique"
After thoroughly browsing, he closed his eyes.
A new book appeared on a library shelf, it was the Ghost Prison Spear Technique.
In an instant.
[Ghost Prison Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
Ding Ling could noticeably feel his endurance and reaction improve slightly.
His skin membrane, muscles and bones were being refined by mysterious energy.
Becoming increasingly resilient.
"Very nice."
Ding Ling was pleased.
After reaching Full Level in Shadow Arrow Skill: Agility +0.3. Constitution +0.2.
After reaching Full Level in Overlord Halberd Technique, Agility +0.4, Constitution +0.4.
Now Ding Ling's power is incomparable to before.
This Ghost Prison Spear Technique still boosts agility and constitution by 0.2.
Demonstrates its exceptional quality.
"Another high-tier spear technique!"
Ding Ling flicked his wrist, causing his halberd to produce blooms of spear flowers, emitting extreme cold light, seemingly creating a chilling prison from thin air!
The chilling prison plunged, crackling!
In an instant.
Cut several corpses into shreds!
"Such a powerful spear technique!"
Zhao Yun marveled, filled with envy:
"This talent is unbelievably powerful!"
Though witnessed many times, accustomed to it, Zhao Yun still couldn't conceal his envy and admiration.
If only he had such talent.
It would be unimaginable!
In dreams.
Zhao Yun occasionally fantasizes.
"Too strong."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng showed expressions of worship and admiration.
Even though Zhao Yun had already told them about Ding Ling learning martial arts in Penglai Mountain and Luoyang City.
Their firsthand experiences were few, hence they were amazed yet uncertain.
But witnessing Ding Ling instantly learn high-tier spear techniques again.
They were astonished!
Finally realized how Ding Ling acquired his profound martial arts.
Though they had known for a while, the impression wasn't deep.
But at this moment, their amazement was embedded deeply within.
Especially after Ding Ling's victorious might over Yan Liang and Wen Chou, further heightened their admiration!
"Continue."
Ding Ling opened the third secret manual.
"Calm Wind Swordsmanship"
After examining carefully.
A new book appeared on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Calm Wind Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This time the heat sensation was still very potent, lasting for a while before fading.
Ding Ling once again felt an improvement in his vitality and endurance!
Enhancement of the toughness of muscles, skin membrane, internal organs, etc.!
"Very good."
Ding Ling nodded inwardly, greatly surprised.
He didn't expect all three secret manuals to be top-tier.
This Calm Wind Swordsmanship is also a high-tier Divine Skill Secret Manual!
Not inferior to the Ghost Prison Spear Technique in the slightest!
Though the increase in constitution is 0.1 less.
But in terms of attack power and speed, it's not any weaker than Ghost Prison Spear Technique.

Ding Ling drew the Giant Que Sword, emitting crisp sounds, shaking out sword shadows, akin to gentle breezes or flowing clouds, as if weightless, and floating so ethereally that their trajectory seemed imperceptible!

sentences.text: Let the players go all out against fierce generals and feudal lords?
That's too difficult.
At this moment, the minds of these fleeing players are in turmoil, unable to settle down:
"Ding Ling, this guy, is precisely as described by those forum posters, no, perhaps even more fierce and terrifying than they said!
He's not even human!
What difference is there between him and a savage beast?
Too fierce!
That's Yan Liang and Wen Chou!
Fierce generals like them that even Xu Huang and others dare not challenge!"
"How did he train?"
They were itching with curiosity.
Desperate to find Ding Ling and ask him.
But they dared not.
Because they know, if there really are secrets, Ding Ling wouldn't share them, might even get angry, resulting in deadly consequences!
Players are truly everywhere, in every nook and cranny.
Even within Yan Liang and Wen Chou's cavalry are players.
It's better that players don't shout.
Once they shout, Ding Ling distinguishes them from the natives.
But they ran, and Ding Ling did not give chase.
Including those cavalry who scattered and fled like defeated soldiers.
This time, Ding Ling didn't even bother to speak harsh words.
He had already made up his mind.
If he doesn't remove the head of the Yuan Family Patriarch.
Ding Ling definitely won't rest until justice is served!
It had become a life-and-death enmity.
Either the Yuan Family people die.
Or Ding Ling dies.
Naturally, Ding Ling chooses for the Yuan Family people to die!
"Once I've learned the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, breaking through the limits of strength and stepping into the Celestial Human Realm that Wang Yue and others described!
Perhaps then I can more easily complete all tasks, breaking the world's barriers and stepping into a more advanced plane world!"
Ding Ling was invigorated.
Diao Chan, after searching the corpses, came over and handed Ding Ling three secret manuals, saying:
"I found these on Yan Liang and Wen Chou."
She was becoming more and more aware.
Ding Ling looked at Diao Chan with appreciation.
He almost forgot about this.
After all, he asked Yan Liang and Wen Chou, and they were unwilling to hand over the ancestral techniques, so how could they carry secret manuals on them?
But unexpectedly, there was hope in the darkness.
Diao Chan unexpectedly found the secret manuals with luck against the odds.
A blessed one!
With Zhao Yun and Diao Chan as the fortunate ones in the group, Ding Ling felt that if there was a Luck Value attribute, his luck now certainly wouldn't be bad!
He immediately opened the secret manual.
"Confucian Breathing Technique"
This is a top-level breathing technique secret skill.
A technique every top Confucian scholar must learn!
Learn this technique.
The body will possess Vast Energy.
Not only healthier but also significantly stronger, able to fight on horseback and govern offhorse!
"It's impossible for Yan Liang and Wen Chou to learn this breathing technique.
Ding Ling pondered deeply, slightly closing his eyes.
Soon.
A new, illusory secret manual appeared on the library shelf.
Though due to physical reasons, he couldn't immediately learn another External Refining Breathing Technique.
But Ding Ling's insight and quality now far surpassed ordinary people.
Naturally, he saw the strength and uniqueness of this breathing technique at a glance.
"It's truly a flawless breathing technique!"
After thorough examination, Ding Ling understood.
Incredibly surprised.
"Yan Liang and Wen Chou's breathing technique clearly exudes ferocity, savage aura, and intimidating presence, absolutely unlikely to be this Confucian Dao Technique.
Where did they get it from?"
A bolt of lightning flashed across Ding Ling's mind.
"Could it be... the Yuan Family's Wanted Order?"
He was somewhat puzzled.
Yan Liang and Wen Chou didn't even complete their tasks, yet received rewards.
How much trust did the Yuan Family Patriarch have in them to do this?
Thinking of Yan Liang and Wen Chou's prowess, Ding Ling understood.
Super-Elite experts are rare across Jiuzhou Land!
The Yuan Family having Yan Liang and Wen Chou, indicates their formidable strength!
They believed Yan Liang and Wen Chou could capture and kill Ding Ling, surely because they had seen their methods and strength, otherwise, how would they grant rewards first?
"It must be to impart some reward as a show of trust and commendation."
Ding Ling nodded inwardly.
This is a common tactic by rulers to manage their subordinates.
But now.
It's to his benefit.
He continued browsing the secret manuals.
The second one:
"Ghost Prison Spear Technique"
After thoroughly browsing, he closed his eyes.
A new book appeared on a library shelf, it was the Ghost Prison Spear Technique.
In an instant.
[Ghost Prison Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
Ding Ling could noticeably feel his endurance and reaction improve slightly.
His skin membrane, muscles and bones were being refined by mysterious energy.
Becoming increasingly resilient.
"Very nice."
Ding Ling was pleased.
After reaching Full Level in Shadow Arrow Skill: Agility +0.3.
Constitution +0.2.
After reaching Full Level in Overlord Halberd Technique, Agility +0.4, Constitution +0.4.
Now Ding Ling's power is incomparable to before.
This Ghost Prison Spear Technique still boosts agility and constitution by 0.2.
Demonstrates its exceptional quality.
"Another high-tier spear technique!"
Ding Ling flicked his wrist, causing his halberd to produce blooms of spear flowers, emitting extreme cold light, seemingly creating a chilling prison from thin air!
The chilling prison plunged, crackling!
In an instant.
Cut several corpses into shreds!
"Such a powerful spear technique!"
Zhao Yun marveled, filled with envy:
"This talent is unbelievably powerful!"
Though witnessed many times, accustomed to it, Zhao Yun still couldn't conceal his envy and admiration.
If only he had such talent.
It would be unimaginable!
In dreams.
Zhao Yun occasionally fantasizes.
"Too strong."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng showed expressions of worship and admiration.
Even though Zhao Yun had already told them about Ding Ling learning martial arts in Penglai Mountain and Luoyang City.
Their firsthand experiences were few, hence they were amazed yet uncertain.
But witnessing Ding Ling instantly learn high-tier spear techniques again.
They were astonished!
Finally realized how Ding Ling acquired his profound martial arts.
Though they had known for a while, the impression wasn't deep.
But at this moment, their amazement was embedded deeply within.
Especially after Ding Ling's victorious might over Yan Liang and Wen Chou, further heightened their admiration!
"Continue."
Ding Ling opened the third secret manual.
"Calm Wind Swordsmanship"
After examining carefully.
A new book appeared on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Calm Wind Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This time the heat sensation was still very potent, lasting for a while before fading.
Ding Ling once again felt an improvement in his vitality and endurance!
Enhancement of the toughness of muscles, skin membrane, internal organs, etc.!
"Very good."
Ding Ling nodded inwardly, greatly surprised.
He didn't expect all three secret manuals to be top-tier.
This Calm Wind Swordsmanship is also a high-tier Divine Skill Secret Manual!
Not inferior to the Ghost Prison Spear Technique in the slightest!
Though the increase in constitution is 0.1 less.
But in terms of attack power and speed, it's not any weaker than Ghost Prison Spear Technique.

Ding Ling drew the Giant Que Sword, emitting crisp sounds, shaking out sword shadows, akin to gentle breezes or flowing clouds, as if weightless, and floating so ethereally that their trajectory seemed imperceptible!

chapters.title: Chapter 176 176: Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng Pass Down Their Arts
paragraphs: Not only light and ethereal, but also incredibly fast, if you don't look closely, you can't even see where the sword blade is, only the faint shadow of a sword passes along with a slight breeze.
Clang!
The sword shadow swept through a corpse, instantly dismembering it into eight pieces!
"So powerful!"
Zhao Yun was moved.
"Another Supreme Sword Technique has been mastered."
"And it's been trained to the realm of innate mastery!"
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's almond-shaped eyes were as luminous as water, the admiration on their exquisitely beautiful faces almost penetrating to the bone, without any disguise.
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed heartily:
"Indeed extraordinary. Come, take this."
Ding Ling tossed three secret manuals to Diao Chan:
"Once you've read them, keep them."
Diao Chan was a bit worried:
"The techniques of my sect have not reached the realm of innate mastery, if I train in these techniques as well, I'm afraid it will be difficult to step into the Super-Elite realm in this lifetime."
Du Qingcheng nodded repeatedly.
Greed leads to indegestion, precisely targeting people like her!
"Just looking won't hurt. When the sect's magic techniques are trained to innate mastery, then we can train in these."
Ding Ling said.
To him, Diao Chan and the others are all teammates.
He also hopes that Diao Chan and the others can be stronger, as it would greatly enhance his support.
The facts have proven that Diao Chan and Zhao Yun are both extraordinarily gifted and lucky generals. With their assistance, things have gone much smoother.
Furthermore.
Ding Ling's greatest reliance is the automatic full-level cheat.
To him, this cheat cannot be disclosed or given to anyone.
But some martial arts secret manuals being passed around is harmless. Especially those obtained from families like the Yuan Family.
Ding Ling would bet.
The Yuan Family definitely has copies of these three secret manuals! It's likely that what they gave to Yan Liang and Wen Chou were copies, not originals.
Since others have them, they are not rare treasures, and Ding Ling naturally has no reason to enjoy them alone.
"Hmm."
Diao Chan nodded, carefully leafed through them several times, and then handed them to Zhao Yun.
She's sharp-eared and keen-eyed, with an extremely high memory.
She remembered them firmly after a few readings.
Ding Ling seriously suspected that not only was Diao Chan's charm Super-Elite, but perhaps her wisdom was also extraordinarily high!
Otherwise, how could her memory be so exaggerated?
Simply a genius among geniuses!
Ding Ling could not achieve what Diao Chan could; he purely relied on cheat codes!
"Ding Ling..."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng exchanged glances.
Du Qingcheng spoke:
"We sisters have decided to pass on our sect's martial arts to you."
Diao Chan had been discussing this matter with Du Qingcheng for a long time.
In the end, emotion triumphs over reason.
Furthermore, there are only the two of them left in their sect now.
They could make decisions entirely on their own!
Even if their master knew of this, they would surely support their actions.
With this thought, their idea became even more resolute.
"Hmm?"
Ding Ling turned his gaze:
"That's your sect's closely guarded secret. This..."
Du Qingcheng then explained the reasons, finally biting her lip and said crisply:

"Ding Ling, your martial arts talent is too amazing. We can't even dream of someone like you practicing martial arts! It's just too incredible. You're so strong, achieving the status of Land Martial God is only a matter of time.
Our sect's techniques are quite decent.
In contributing bricks and tiles on your path to becoming a Martial God, I think the master would be very thankful. You shouldn't refuse this."
Ding Ling is not a hypocrite, upon hearing this, he nodded and sincerely thanked them.
Du Qingcheng quickly waved her hand, blushing as she said:
"Then I'll pass on my master's Charming Fox Breathing Technique to you now. Hmm... this is a technique for women. Maybe, let's focus on other things first."
She realized halfway through her words, quickly changing her tune.
"It's okay. Go ahead."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Although I know many breathing techniques, I don't mind learning one more, just as accumulation. Maybe it will be useful in the future?"
If, in the future, all breathing techniques could be fused together!
That breathing technique would surely be immensely powerful!
Ding Ling was quite looking forward to it.
Each breathing technique has different effects, and the enhancement on martial arts can be quite remarkable.
The Charming Fox Breathing Technique has created two peerlessly beautiful women, Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng, who are as beautiful as sinking fish and falling geese; its power is evident.
After listening to Du Qingcheng's explanation.
His heart was also quite stirred.
He thought that if he learned this Charming Fox Breathing Technique, he would definitely become an unrivaled handsome man like 'Pan An' or 'Song Yu'!
This Charming Fox Breathing Technique has no limits in enhancing charm!
No wonder Diao Chan's charm is Super-Elite.
Ding Ling was at ease.
He glanced at the library, indeed, there suddenly appeared a book of indeterminate nature, precisely the Charming Fox Breathing Technique.

"Next is the Flying Swallow Technique. This is an extraordinary lightweight skill. Once mastered, you'll be like a flying swallow, incredibly accomplished in short-distance sprints and long-distance raids."
Du Qingcheng explained carefully.
Diao Chan listened by the side, occasionally filling in the gaps.
After Ding Ling listened once.
He slightly closed his eyes.
A book immediately condensed on the library shelf: "Flying Swallow Technique"
In an instant.
[Flying Swallow Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.1]
The Flying Swallow Technique was indeed as Diao Chan and they described.
It is a high-tier lightweight body technique!
Although the constitution increase isn't much.
But the agility actually increased by 0.3 points!
One must know that Hua Tuo's Ascending Skill at full level is: Agility +0.4, Constitution +0.1.
And the recently mastered Calm Wind Swordsmanship at full level: Agility +0.2, Constitution +0.1.
The increased agility of the Flying Swallow Technique even surpasses high-level Calm Wind Swordsmanship, showing how extraordinary it is!
Especially after Ding Ling's strength had grown by a small margin, the enhancement from high-tier martial arts was becoming weaker, yet it still increased so much!
This shows how remarkable the Flying Swallow Technique is.
The truth is indeed so.
It is a lightweight skill comparable to Ascending Skill.
And in terms of battlefield slaughter, short-distance sprinting, long-distance raids, it surpasses Ascending Skill.
Ascending Skill is more adept at mountain raids and climbing.
Each has its strengths.
Whoosh!

Ding Ling ran the Flying Swallow Technique, his body like a graceful swallow, lightly tapping the ground and floated away tens of meters like a dandelion in the air, spreading wings like a swallow, graceful and free, enough to make everyone look sideways.
"Is this Great Success into Innate Ability?"
Du Qingcheng was dumbfounded.
Although she was very shocked before.
But not as deeply felt as at this moment.
One must know she had studied the Flying Swallow Technique for over ten years, yet never reached innate mastery.
Even though Diao Chan's skill in the Flying Swallow Technique was extremely profound and she studied it for over ten years, she hadn't achieved Ding Ling's nonchalant and natural state.
The two looked at each other, clearly seeing the astonishment, admiration, and disbelief in each other's eyes.
"As if a divine being descended to the mortal realm."
Diao Chan sighed.
"Ding Ling can definitely become the Land Martial God!"
Du Qingcheng was extremely confident.
"Hmm."
Zhao Yun proudly smiled and said:
"That's what my master says as well."
He just loved seeing others stunned to the point of near speechlessness by Ding Ling's martial arts progress.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 177: Chen's Breathing Technique (20/32)
paragraphs: It's not that he has some malicious interest.
It's because he was like this before too.
Feeling deeply resonant about this, he had a high degree of recognition for Ding Ling.
Others were shocked by Ding Ling.
He then felt a strong sense of collective pride and achievement!
Over time.
It became natural.
This explains why he enjoyed watching others be amazed by Ding Ling's progress in martial arts.
Zhao Yun was like this.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng didn't notice.
They just sighed at their own inadequacy after Ding Ling returned to his position, and couldn't help but praise him profusely.
In the end, they said:
"If Master has a spirit in heaven, seeing you master the Flying Swallow Technique so quickly would surely be extremely gratified and surprised!"
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude again.
Du Qingcheng blushed and waved it off, saying:
"Ding Ling, you really don't need to be so polite with us. If you keep this up, I'll be too embarrassed to keep following you."
"Alright."
Ding Ling laughed and said:
"Then I won't be polite with you."
"That's more like it."
Du Qingcheng immediately began to describe the Rouyun Saber Technique to Ding Ling.
Knowing that Ding Ling only needed to glance at the secret manual to master it to the level of innate ability.
She did not overestimate herself by explaining, just proceeded methodically.

It turned out she made the right choice. After Ding Ling listened, he rapidly mastered the Flying Swallow Technique to the level of innate ability, even more perfectly and excellently than her own practice.
This level, speed, and standard left her in awe, even causing her worldview to scatter a bit.
She couldn't believe there truly existed such a divine being in this world.
Luckily, after seeing it happen more often.
She gradually became relieved and adapted, just like Zhao Yun.
After listening to the Rouyun Saber Technique, Ding Ling.
Closed his eyes slightly.
A new book appeared on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Rouyun Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
The various esoteric truths of the Rouyun Saber Technique surged and flowed in his mind.
Soon integrating into an instinct engraved between his limbs and bones.
Instantly, Ding Ling realized he had completely understood and could perform the Rouyun Saber Technique.
"A very excellent saber technique."
Ding Ling praised.
After reaching full level in Calm Wind Swordsmanship: Agility +0.2, Physique +0.1.
Although Rouyun Saber Technique was just 0.1 less in agility.
But it was in no way inferior to Calm Wind Swordsmanship in terms of power and esoteric truths!
After all, Ding Ling's multiple enhancements now were stronger than when he practiced Calm Wind Swordsmanship, and the effect of high-tier martial arts on him had continued to diminish.
Yet Rouyun Saber Technique still managed to increase significantly. Quite remarkable.
Clang!
Ding Ling drew his sword.
Using the sword as a saber.

But seeing the saber light, dazzling like a bolt of cloth in the void, swirling uncertainly, floating like wind, like clouds, seemingly weak and soft, but ready to burst forth with astonishing lethality at any moment.
The occasional flashing of startling saber light confirmed this point.
After truly mastering the Rouyun Saber Technique.
Only then did Ding Ling understand why Diao Chan used the Fish Guts Sword with this saber technique.
Because this saber technique indeed suited the use of a sword!
It was too floaty like clouds; only a lightweight sword was more suitable for its surprise attacks and fast assaults!
The same person.
Using a saber or a sword to perform this martial art, the power was decidedly different.
"It's mastered already?!"
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were incredulous.
They felt as if their years of painstaking practice had been futile.
Truly struck by Ding Ling!
It was like a poor student scoring 1 point, while a top student scores full marks.
And Ding Ling was exaggerated a thousand times more than a top student.
Without having to study, just glancing through a book once, and then acing the test!!
This was outrageous!
How could a poor student not be shocked, dizzy, or headachy?
"Hehe."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly and said:
"Having mastered it also makes it easier for me to instruct you guys."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's eyes lit up, nodding in unison.
Ding Ling then continued to look at the secret manual.
Earlier, Diao Chan had found two secret manuals, two great medicines, and some gold among the Yellow Turban Army.
Because they were always busy dealing with the plague and various inquiries upon returning to reality.
This caused Ding Ling to forget this matter for a while.
His memory was not as good as Diao Chan's, and his shortcomings were evident!
Moreover, he wasn't a very meticulous person; not losing things was already pretty good, let alone remembering everything at every moment.
Unless one day his wisdom reaches an exceptionally high level!
Currently, his wisdom wasn't particularly high, seemingly just 1.1 points more than an ordinary person.
But considering a typical person's strength is 1 point, it could be understood.
In real life, some people's strength could definitely reach 5 or 6 points!
Similarly.
The same applies to wisdom; some geniuses could likely have wisdom above 5 points too.
Compared to them.
Ding Ling was truly the most ordinary.
His physical condition was akin to those of sub-healthy office workers.
Sitting for a few more minutes would make them feel oxygen-deprived and dizzy types!
Of course, one cannot deny there are office workers who have exercised regularly or have excellent physical constitutions.
But earlier, Ding Ling belonged to the sub-health group, a person who would pant after carrying a barrel of water upstairs, so how much strength could one expect from him?
But now it's different.
Times have changed, and Ding Ling is already a strong man!
His wisdom had also slightly improved, but not by much. Not remembering everything could naturally be understood.
He took out the great medicine, which seemed to be two sets, but actually consisted of six treasure medicines.
Evenly divided into two sets.
Each set with three plants.
Ding Ling used the Giant Que Sword to cut a small piece from one treasure medicine to chew and swallow.
No feeling at all.
Ding Ling was disappointed.
This wasn't the great medicine he needed.
Could only be a centennial great medicine. And centennial great medicines were treasures to many people.
But to Ding Ling, they were completely useless.
He cut small pieces from the other treasure medicines, equally ineffective.
Then he divided these six treasure medicines among Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng, giving two to each.

Diao Chan and the others were amazed to learn that the great medicine was ineffective for Ding Ling, but still accepted them to use for medicinal baths and self-enhancement once a safe place was found.
Ding Ling took out the secret manual and began to read.
There were two in total.
Each manual consisted of two booklets.
The content of the booklets was identical.
It was evident that when Hex Yi, Liu Pi, and other Yellow Turban Generals split the loot, they copied a version of the secret manual for each other.
"Liaoyuan Spear Technique"
"Chen's Breathing Technique"
Hmm?
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
Chen's Breathing Technique.
Not Yuan Clan.
Nor Liu Clan, Hex Clan, etc.
It seems it was something looted from a family by the Runan Yellow Turban Army.
But to have found a breathing technique.
It shows that family must have been slaughtered entirely by them; otherwise, how could the ancestral divine skill secret manual have ended up in the hands of Yellow Turban Thieves?
Like Yan Liang and Wen Chou wouldn't be willing to hand it over even if they died!
Ding Ling examined the manual carefully.
Soon.
A new illusory book appeared on the library shelf, precisely Chen's Breathing Technique.
Its flashing light was no weaker than the Charming Fox Breathing Technique or the Medicine King Breathing Technique.
This clearly was a genuine top-level breathing technique secret manual.

sentences.text: It's not that he has some malicious interest.
It's because he was like this before too.
Feeling deeply resonant about this, he had a high degree of recognition for Ding Ling.
Others were shocked by Ding Ling.
He then felt a strong sense of collective pride and achievement!
Over time.
It became natural.
This explains why he enjoyed watching others be amazed by Ding Ling's progress in martial arts.
Zhao Yun was like this.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng didn't notice.
They just sighed at their own inadequacy after Ding Ling returned to his position, and couldn't help but praise him profusely.
In the end, they said:
"If Master has a spirit in heaven, seeing you master the Flying Swallow Technique so quickly would surely be extremely gratified and surprised!"
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude again.
Du Qingcheng blushed and waved it off, saying:
"Ding Ling, you really don't need to be so polite with us.
If you keep this up, I'll be too embarrassed to keep following you."
"Alright."
Ding Ling laughed and said:
"Then I won't be polite with you."
"That's more like it."
Du Qingcheng immediately began to describe the Rouyun Saber Technique to Ding Ling.
Knowing that Ding Ling only needed to glance at the secret manual to master it to the level of innate ability.
She did not overestimate herself by explaining, just proceeded methodically.
It turned out she made the right choice.
After Ding Ling listened, he rapidly mastered the Flying Swallow Technique to the level of innate ability, even more perfectly and excellently than her own practice.
This level, speed, and standard left her in awe, even causing her worldview to scatter a bit.
She couldn't believe there truly existed such a divine being in this world.
Luckily, after seeing it happen more often.
She gradually became relieved and adapted, just like Zhao Yun.
After listening to the Rouyun Saber Technique, Ding Ling.
Closed his eyes slightly.
A new book appeared on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Rouyun Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
The various esoteric truths of the Rouyun Saber Technique surged and flowed in his mind.
Soon integrating into an instinct engraved between his limbs and bones.
Instantly, Ding Ling realized he had completely understood and could perform the Rouyun Saber Technique.
"A very excellent saber technique."
Ding Ling praised.
After reaching full level in Calm Wind Swordsmanship: Agility +0.2, Physique +0.1.
Although Rouyun Saber Technique was just 0.1 less in agility.
But it was in no way inferior to Calm Wind Swordsmanship in terms of power and esoteric truths!
After all, Ding Ling's multiple enhancements now were stronger than when he practiced Calm Wind Swordsmanship, and the effect of high-tier martial arts on him had continued to diminish.
Yet Rouyun Saber Technique still managed to increase significantly.
Quite remarkable.
Clang!
Ding Ling drew his sword.
Using the sword as a saber.

But seeing the saber light, dazzling like a bolt of cloth in the void, swirling uncertainly, floating like wind, like clouds, seemingly weak and soft, but ready to burst forth with astonishing lethality at any moment.
The occasional flashing of startling saber light confirmed this point.
After truly mastering the Rouyun Saber Technique.
Only then did Ding Ling understand why Diao Chan used the Fish Guts Sword with this saber technique.
Because this saber technique indeed suited the use of a sword!
It was too floaty like clouds; only a lightweight sword was more suitable for its surprise attacks and fast assaults!
The same person.
Using a saber or a sword to perform this martial art, the power was decidedly different.
"It's mastered already?!"
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were incredulous.
They felt as if their years of painstaking practice had been futile.
Truly struck by Ding Ling!
It was like a poor student scoring 1 point, while a top student scores full marks.
And Ding Ling was exaggerated a thousand times more than a top student.
Without having to study, just glancing through a book once, and then acing the test!!
This was outrageous!
How could a poor student not be shocked, dizzy, or headachy?
"Hehe."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly and said:
"Having mastered it also makes it easier for me to instruct you guys."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's eyes lit up, nodding in unison.
Ding Ling then continued to look at the secret manual.
Earlier, Diao Chan had found two secret manuals, two great medicines, and some gold among the Yellow Turban Army.
Because they were always busy dealing with the plague and various inquiries upon returning to reality.
This caused Ding Ling to forget this matter for a while.
His memory was not as good as Diao Chan's, and his shortcomings were evident!
Moreover, he wasn't a very meticulous person; not losing things was already pretty good, let alone remembering everything at every moment.
Unless one day his wisdom reaches an exceptionally high level!
Currently, his wisdom wasn't particularly high, seemingly just 1.1 points more than an ordinary person.
But considering a typical person's strength is 1 point, it could be understood.
In real life, some people's strength could definitely reach 5 or 6 points!
Similarly.
The same applies to wisdom; some geniuses could likely have wisdom above 5 points too.
Compared to them.
Ding Ling was truly the most ordinary.
His physical condition was akin to those of sub-healthy office workers.
Sitting for a few more minutes would make them feel oxygen-deprived and dizzy types!
Of course, one cannot deny there are office workers who have exercised regularly or have excellent physical constitutions.
But earlier, Ding Ling belonged to the sub-health group, a person who would pant after carrying a barrel of water upstairs, so how much strength could one expect from him?
But now it's different.
Times have changed, and Ding Ling is already a strong man!
His wisdom had also slightly improved, but not by much.
Not remembering everything could naturally be understood.
He took out the great medicine, which seemed to be two sets, but actually consisted of six treasure medicines.
Evenly divided into two sets.
Each set with three plants.
Ding Ling used the Giant Que Sword to cut a small piece from one treasure medicine to chew and swallow.
No feeling at all.
Ding Ling was disappointed.
This wasn't the great medicine he needed.
Could only be a centennial great medicine.
And centennial great medicines were treasures to many people.
But to Ding Ling, they were completely useless.
He cut small pieces from the other treasure medicines, equally ineffective.
Then he divided these six treasure medicines among Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng, giving two to each.

Diao Chan and the others were amazed to learn that the great medicine was ineffective for Ding Ling, but still accepted them to use for medicinal baths and self-enhancement once a safe place was found.
Ding Ling took out the secret manual and began to read.
There were two in total.
Each manual consisted of two booklets.
The content of the booklets was identical.
It was evident that when Hex Yi, Liu Pi, and other Yellow Turban Generals split the loot, they copied a version of the secret manual for each other.

Soon.

Its flashing light was no weaker than the Charming Fox Breathing Technique or the Medicine King Breathing Technique.
This clearly was a genuine top-level breathing technique secret manual.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 178: Liaoyuan Spear Technique (21/32)
paragraphs: Ding Ling was extremely astonished.
Such a top divine skill secret manual.
Logically speaking, the family should spare no effort to cultivate a true expert, so how could they be wiped out entirely by the Yellow Turban Thieves of Runan and Yingchuan?!
Ding Ling found it inconceivable and was quite puzzled.
However, this did not prevent him from continuing to read.
After finishing the Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling read the Liaoyuan Spear Technique.
After one pass.
A new book appeared on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Liaoyuan Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
The essence and esoteric truths of various spear techniques poured into his organs, transforming into instinct.
After truly understanding this spear technique.
Ding Ling realized its terrifying power.
This is a top-level spear skill even more powerful than the Calm Wind Swordsmanship.
It's known that after reaching full level in Calm Wind Swordsmanship: Agility +0.2, Constitution +0.1.
Yet the Liaoyuan Spear Technique surpasses it!
Ding Ling's strength is now even greater, but the attribute points gained are more than Calm Wind Swordsmanship!
It's evident that the Liaoyuan Spear Technique has reached the pinnacle in the field of spear techniques!
Clang!
Ding Ling used a halberd as a spear, executing the Liaoyuan Spear Technique.

The clanging sound resonated, as if a Spear God was manipulating heaven and earth, the spear's shadow swept across, resembling a prairie fire, the intense evil qi was something ordinary people could not withstand!
"What an excellent spear technique."
Zhao Yun praised:
"This Liaoyuan Spear Technique isn't far from the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear. Its heritage must trace back to the ancient era!"
Ding Ling nodded and gave the Liaoyuan Spear Technique to Diao Chan.
Once she had finished reading and memorizing it, she passed it to Zhao Yun.
She was with Du Qingcheng, and once she memorized it, it was as if Du Qingcheng memorized it too.

Moreover, compared to her, Du Qingcheng's aptitude in martial arts was weaker. Taking on too much at once would be counterproductive; Diao Chan also knew Du Qingcheng did not want to delve too deeply into other martial arts for now, so she naturally wouldn't let her read too many martial arts secret techniques, lest it muddles her mind, which would be counterproductive.
Zhao Yun was deeply engrossed in studying the Liaoyuan Spear Technique!
Since he followed Ding Ling down the mountain.
He had come into contact with many top secret techniques.
Ding Ling did not hide the secret skills he obtained, he usually got a share too, so currently, he wasn't lacking in secret techniques, what he lacked was the time needed for evolution and growth!
As long as he had enough time and resources.
Zhao Yun was confident he could become a top-level master in the Super-Elite class!
And what he excelled at, cherished, and enjoyed the most was spear techniques.
The Liaoyuan Spear Technique suited his taste and preference, so it was normal for him to be captivated.
Ding Ling did not interrupt him.
He just picked up some quivers on the battlefield.
And brought over the warhorses and weapons of Yan Liang and Wen Chou.
These superior warhorses and divine weapons being abandoned in the wilderness was such a pity.
They could be kept for friends;
Or given as favors, which would be great.
Diao Chan knew Ding Ling's intention, and she collected many rare items on the battlefield, wrapped them in bundles, and placed them on the sides of some superior warhorses.
This time when they left.
They would be taking more horses.
Fortunately, all of them were experts with extraordinary equestrian skills, controlling this batch of horses was not a problem.
"It's a pity about Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin..."
Ding Ling saw the corpses of Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin, sighing:
"Initially, I was planning to keep them as hostages."

"The Yuan Family's Patriarch knows the terrifying strength of Yan Liang and Wen Chou. As they said, if they couldn't kill us, who could they expect to? When choosing between keeping Yan Liang and Wen Chou or Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin. The Patriarch of the Yuan Family picking Yan Liang and Wen Chou is quite normal.
Because they knew that this time, Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin were unlikely to be saved. Most likely they would never be saved.
Instead of leaving a handle in our hands.
It's better to cut the matter cleanly, directly eliminate. Without constraints. They can launch even more rapid attacks on us!"
Diao Chan said crisply.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded, saying nothing more.
He also speculated on some thoughts of the Yuan Family's Patriarch.
Being threatened by someone without power, how could they tolerate it?
Moreover.
The Yuan Family had many descendants. Losing one or two, they can be reborn later.
As long as they could eliminate their deadly enemy, whilst removing future troubles, and shock a region.
For the Yuan Family's Patriarch, it's worth it!
'Seems like in the heart of the Yuan Family, my Tiger Valor General isn't worth a damn.'
Ding Ling frowned.
He glanced at his Character Panel:
Strength:
[Root 1 (ordinary people are 1 point), Intelligence 2.1, Strength 30, Agility 23.1+0.3+0.2+0.2+0.3+0.1+0.2 (24.4), Constitution 24.9+0.2+0.2+0.1+0.1+0.1+0.2 (25.8), Defense 30, Charm 5.3.]
Weapons:
[Giant Que Sword, Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle, Six-Stone Bow, etc.]
Mount:
[Ferghana Horse]
Skills:

[Human Emperor Swordsmanship (10th level), Sleeve Arrow (10th level), Shadow Arrow Skill (10th level), Ghost Prison Spear Technique (10th level), Calm Wind Swordsmanship (10th level), Flying Swallow Technique (10th level), Rouyun Saber Technique (10th level), Liaoyuan Spear Technique (10th level)...]
[Achievement Medal: Ordinary 25, E-level 10]
Not counting the achievement medals consumed during the first return to reality.
Ding Ling's Ordinary Medals accumulated along the way amounted to over fifty.
These medals were continually consumed with every exchange of strength during Ding Ling's return to reality.
Now only 25 remained.
[Glory Medal: 0]
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane Powerhouses: 15/20.]
Counting Ma Zhong, Yan Liang, Wen Chou.
Reached 15 people.
[3: You must make your War God's name resound throughout the Plane World. 19%/100%.]
Previously it was 10%.
Now it jumped to 19%.
It's evident that his reputation has been spreading more and more widely.
Ding Ling was clear.
"If things continue like this, perhaps it won't be long before my War God's name reaches 100% progress?"
Ding Ling was quite expectant.
After Zhao Yun regained consciousness.
They continued to head south.
Jingzhou is next to Yangzhou.
All heading south.
Heading to Jingzhou to find Zhang Zhongjing, then have him help find Yhiuu Ji.
This way, the chances are greater.
Ding Ling is someone who listens to advice.
Hua Tuo said this, surely for a reason.
He was quite fortunate that Hua Tuo was a kind-hearted person and easy to talk to.
If it were someone else, he might not have had this opportunity.
Even if he went to Yangzhou, he might return empty-handed. That would be too regrettable.
After all, in the Three Kingdoms World.
Not many understand the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
These worldly high sages are elusive, Yhiuu Ji is the easiest to find, so Ding Ling could only go to him.
All the way south.
There were many disasters.
Encountered several assassination attempts along the way.
All were detected by Diao Chan's vigilance, and then hunted down by Ding Ling and the others all the way!
They killed or wounded many of the black-clad assassins.
As the killings continued.
The black-clad assassins sent to kill them became fewer and fewer.
Moreover, every time they came, they brought Ding Ling a lot of equipment.
Currently, Ding Ling's Sleeve Arrows and Poison Arrows were increasing, all placed on the horse's side.
These arrows, using the Shadow Arrow Skill against assassins, were extremely effective.
The assassins were initially bewildered upon seeing his Shadow Arrow Skill!

chapters.title: Chapter 179 179: Real-Name Fame Explodes (22/32)
paragraphs: Simply because Ding Ling, as a battlefield warrior, actually mastered their hidden archery skills!
When those killed by Ding Ling were thrown off their horses, fleeing in defeat, they even loudly asked Ding Ling if he was one of their own, or if he was also an assassin by origin?
How could Ding Ling respond to them?
He greeted them directly with Shadow Arrows, sending them to hell.
As for this group of incessantly harassing black-clad assassins.
Ding Ling had no fondness for them.
Fortunately, Diao Chan was alert, his Shadow Arrow Skill was also extremely strong, constantly killing the black-clad men, making them tremble with fear, with fewer and fewer assassins being sent.
Till today.
They were almost nonexistent, nearly vanished.
In response to this.
Ding Ling could only attribute the ledger to the Yuan Family.
On this day.
The group arrived at Jiangxia County in Jingzhou, facing the vast expanse of the Yangtze River.
Ding Ling and the others could only cross by boat.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had plenty of gold and silver.
He threw down a pile of gold.
And hired two large boats.
According to the locals, the large boats could directly sail to Changsha County, saving Ding Ling a lot of trouble.
He only needed to rest on the boat.
And during this period of rest.
Ding Ling constantly guided Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng in martial arts, and prepared herbal baths for them to enhance themselves through soaking in the baths.
The main herbs for the herbal baths were from the Great Medicine obtained earlier.
Ding Ling had no use for this Great Medicine.
Perfectly suitable for Diao Chan and the others to use.
And since Ding Ling's Divine Skill automatically reached Full Level, he was the most bored on the boat.
Beyond teaching the three of them.
He was also frequently logging in and out during this period.
He almost learned every skill he could in reality.
And he also made quite a bit of money during this period.
Skilled in hacking, computers, and other technologies, making money online was becoming increasingly easy for Ding Ling.
Of course, the earned money was mostly transferred to a neighbor's bank card, and to avoid attracting too much attention, it was kept within the tolerance range of investigators.
Besides this.
When Ding Ling checked information online, he found that his fame on the internet was growing larger and larger.
Everywhere was filled with news about him.
Opening any influencer's account casually, he could see them expressing their views on the 'Ding Ling Incident':
"Recently, it's spread online that Ding Ling is the biological son of the myth game company's owner! I just want to say, you guys are right! Because I think so too!
Otherwise, there's no way to explain Ding Ling's cheat-like speed of progress!
The thing I'm most curious about now is whether Ding Ling has become a Superman-like powerful presence in reality too?"
The influencer was very handsome, facing the camera, respectfully made a worshipful gesture, smiling obsequiously:
"I don't know if Brother Ding Ling is watching my video, but even if there's only a one in a million chance he'll see it. I just have to say.
If there's a chance, take me along in the Three Kingdoms World!
I met you in Runan. Wanted to talk to you, but you were too aloof.
I'm a bit scared!
Hope next time we meet, I can hug Brother's leg, Brother, please be a bit gentle..."
He raised his hand, speaking seriously:
"I swear, I would certainly become your loyal lackey! Clear all obstacles before you..."
Seeing this.
Ding Ling didn't continue watching, directly swiped past.
And saw another similar video.
Even the words weren't changed.
Just the expressions and actions were more exaggerated!
The like count was high.
Ding Ling was speechless.
This group of comedians, truly started performing!
But to see one leaf and know it's autumn.
From this aspect.
He's indeed explosively popular.
To say he's the top superstar in the real world is not an exaggeration!
He climbed over the wall to check foreign websites.
Same situation.
All discussing him.
But more were skeptical:
"I'm in the Guishuang Kingdom, our country's bravest warriors can punch a cow to death! I don't believe Ding Ling is that strong!"

"I'm in the Tianzhu Kingdom. There are monks who can split a person's head with one palm. Is Ding Ling really that fierce? He's just a player! I think it must be exaggerated by the Eastern Ancient Kingdom!"

"I'm in the Ancient City of Jingjue. The fierce people from your country seem very strong. Our country's first war general seems to only fight a hundred anyways. Can Ding Ling take on ten thousand? Isn't it a joke? Eastern Ancient Kingdom's netizens love bragging the most, no need to take it seriously!"
Seeing this.
Ding Ling realized.
Late Eastern Han Dynasty's Great Han had frequent internal chaos.
Other countries were similar in some cases.
Although not as prominent in talent as the Three Kingdoms, every country surely had National Guardian level heroes and generals.
And these foreign players might be learning martial arts under the military camps of these people.
He carefully looked into it.
Indeed.
Foreigners' martial arts progress was generally much slower than those in the Eastern Ancient Kingdom.
"This is only the beginning. Truly ascending to the Martial World. Starting to identify meridians, vital points, read ancient texts, cultivation techniques—that's absolute torture for foreigners!"
Only because not every Oriental can understand Martial Arts Secret Manuals.
Even if they can understand, it doesn't mean they can learn.
If they can learn, their aptitude might not be good; if aptitude is good, it might not be well-learned; if well-learned, it might not be mastered; if mastered, it might not be Full Level...
We can only say.
The path of seeking Dao is harder than ascending to heaven!
"Luckily, I have cheats."
Ding Ling let out a long breath.
After handling affairs in the real world.
He returned to the Game World.
Thus a few days of peaceful days passed.
On this day.
Diao Chan suddenly found Ding Ling and said:
"The Brocade Sail Pirates are here."
"Brocade Sail Pirates?"
Ding Ling listened intently.
Indeed, he could hear the jangling bell sounds, and the chaotic cries and shouts of the sailors.
Without much thought, he turned to grab the Six-Stone Bow and Giant Que Sword hanging on one side, and strode out of the cabin to the bow of the ship.
"Master."
The boatmen saw Ding Ling, as if seeing their mainstay, suddenly their panicked hearts calmed somewhat, pointing forward at the vast waters:
"The Brocade Sail Pirates' ship is directly targeting us, it's obvious they're coming for us. What should we do? We might be hard to avoid and will surely be blocked by them."
"Don't worry."
Ding Ling casually reassured:
"With us around, you'll be safe."
The boatmen remained apprehensive, although Ding Ling and the others looked very fierce, the Brocade Sail Pirates are notorious, their leader Gan Ning is awe-inspiring, remarkably brave.
His eight hundred thugs under him, each comparable to river ghosts, their combat power in water is strong enough to terrify people!
He immediately recounted Gan Ning's exploits, concluding:
"If worse comes to worst, just surrender. Give them the supplies, horses, gold on the ship, they will surely let us pass."
"What kind of joke is that?"

When those killed by Ding Ling were thrown off their horses, fleeing in defeat, they even loudly asked Ding Ling if he was one of their own, or if he was also an assassin by origin?
How could Ding Ling respond to them?
He greeted them directly with Shadow Arrows, sending them to hell.
As for this group of incessantly harassing black-clad assassins.
Ding Ling had no fondness for them.
Fortunately, Diao Chan was alert, his Shadow Arrow Skill was also extremely strong, constantly killing the black-clad men, making them tremble with fear, with fewer and fewer assassins being sent.
Till today.
They were almost nonexistent, nearly vanished.
In response to this.
Ding Ling could only attribute the ledger to the Yuan Family.
On this day.

Ding Ling and the others could only cross by boat.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had plenty of gold and silver.
He threw down a pile of gold.
And hired two large boats.
According to the locals, the large boats could directly sail to Changsha County, saving Ding Ling a lot of trouble.
He only needed to rest on the boat.
And during this period of rest.
Ding Ling constantly guided Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng in martial arts, and prepared herbal baths for them to enhance themselves through soaking in the baths.
The main herbs for the herbal baths were from the Great Medicine obtained earlier.
Ding Ling had no use for this Great Medicine.
Perfectly suitable for Diao Chan and the others to use.

Beyond teaching the three of them.
He was also frequently logging in and out during this period.
He almost learned every skill he could in reality.
And he also made quite a bit of money during this period.
Skilled in hacking, computers, and other technologies, making money online was becoming increasingly easy for Ding Ling.
Of course, the earned money was mostly transferred to a neighbor's bank card, and to avoid attracting too much attention, it was kept within the tolerance range of investigators.
Besides this.
When Ding Ling checked information online, he found that his fame on the internet was growing larger and larger.
Everywhere was filled with news about him.
Opening any influencer's account casually, he could see them expressing their views on the 'Ding Ling Incident':
"Recently, it's spread online that Ding Ling is the biological son of the myth game company's owner!
I just want to say, you guys are right!
Because I think so too!
Otherwise, there's no way to explain Ding Ling's cheat-like speed of progress!
The thing I'm most curious about now is whether Ding Ling has become a Superman-like powerful presence in reality too?"
The influencer was very handsome, facing the camera, respectfully made a worshipful gesture, smiling obsequiously:
"I don't know if Brother Ding Ling is watching my video, but even if there's only a one in a million chance he'll see it.
I just have to say.
If there's a chance, take me along in the Three Kingdoms World!
I met you in Runan.
Wanted to talk to you, but you were too aloof.
I'm a bit scared!
Hope next time we meet, I can hug Brother's leg, Brother, please be a bit gentle..."
He raised his hand, speaking seriously:
"I swear, I would certainly become your loyal lackey!
Clear all obstacles before you..."
Seeing this.
Ding Ling didn't continue watching, directly swiped past.
And saw another similar video.
Even the words weren't changed.
Just the expressions and actions were more exaggerated!
The like count was high.
Ding Ling was speechless.
This group of comedians, truly started performing!
But to see one leaf and know it's autumn.
From this aspect.
He's indeed explosively popular.
To say he's the top superstar in the real world is not an exaggeration!
He climbed over the wall to check foreign websites.
Same situation.
All discussing him.

I don't believe Ding Ling is that strong!"
"I'm in the Tianzhu Kingdom.
There are monks who can split a person's head with one palm.
Is Ding Ling really that fierce?
He's just a player!
I think it must be exaggerated by the Eastern Ancient Kingdom!"

The fierce people from your country seem very strong.
Our country's first war general seems to only fight a hundred anyways.
Can Ding Ling take on ten thousand?
Isn't it a joke?
Eastern Ancient Kingdom's netizens love bragging the most, no need to take it seriously!"
Seeing this.
Ding Ling realized.
Late Eastern Han Dynasty's Great Han had frequent internal chaos.
Other countries were similar in some cases.
Although not as prominent in talent as the Three Kingdoms, every country surely had National Guardian level heroes and generals.
And these foreign players might be learning martial arts under the military camps of these people.

chapters.title: Chapter 180 180: Gan Xingba, Tiger Minister of Jiangbia
paragraphs: Zhao Yun frowned, about to refute.
Ding Ling waved his hand and said:
"Surrender is not an option. Boatman, if you're scared, you can hide in the cabin to avoid being accidentally injured by the Brocade Sail Pirates later."

He raised his eyebrows, the Breathing Technique activated, and a fiercely unrivaled domineering aura surged out from his tall body, spreading in all directions, shaking the Giant Que Sword in his hand slightly.
The sword gleamed, making the very air seem to crackle with sound:
"With me here, mere Brocade Sail Pirates, what can they do to me?"
The boatmen's spirits lifted, deeply moved.
They had long realized that Ding Ling and his party were extremely formidable, and now it seemed indeed true.
But the boatmen, thinking of Gan Ding and his subordinates' reputation, still felt intimidated, and retreated into the boats' cabins.
"Gan Ning?"
Ding Ling recalled information about Gan Ning.
Gan Ning, styled Xingba, was a Ba County Lingjiang person, a renowned general of Sunx Wu during the Three Kingdoms Period, who became the Governor of Xiling and General Zhechong.
In his youth, he caused trouble locally, dominating the waterways, seizing ships and goods, and was called the Brocade Sail Pirate.
Later, he mended his ways, seeking meritorious service, but faced hardships and wasn't put to good use.
Only when he led his troops to join Sunx Quan did he rise to fame!

He broke through Huang Zu's defenses at Chu Pass, attacked Cao Ren to capture Yiling, and held Yiyang against Guan Yu... He led over a hundred men in a night raid on Cao's camp, achieving notable victories.
Later, he was honored by the world as the "Tiger official of the lands beyond the river."
However, this tiger official is clearly still in the piracy stage with the Brocade Sail Pirates.
Jingling and clanging!
The sound of bells grew louder as fast boats swiftly approached.
Ding Ling's gaze was like a torch, seeing everything clearly.
The number of fast boats was no less than dozens.
All were small boats.
On each boat stood between ten to twenty men.
Each was bare-chested, wielding sharp knives, all energetic, with strange howls and shouts topping the air.
And on the prow of the lead boat.
Stood a man.

This man was tall and burly, with the back of a tiger and waist of a bear, draped in embroidered clothing, a copper bell hanging from his waist, colorful bird feathers in his hair, carrying a large bow, holding two iron halberds, truly awe-inspiring and domineering!
Although he was dressed in splendor, it couldn't hide the fierce courage emanating from his nature.
From a distance, he shouted towards Ding Ling's direction:
"I heard a few heroes boarded the ship. I specially came to have a look. I hope I didn't disturb you!"
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed heartily:
"If you want to see, there's no problem. But you come grandly in full force, with everyone carrying knives, do you want to have a big fight with us?"
"Haha..."
The one cloaked in brocade changed his expression slightly and laughed loudly:
"Was it you, Ding Ling, who just spoke?"
"Yes!"
"I've long heard of Ding Ling's great name!"

The brocade-cloaked man solemnly said: "It's said you rode alone to Wan City, repelling the Runan Yellow Turban Army, and defeated the formidable generals Yan Liang and Wen Chou in Jizhou! Isn't that true?"
"What if it's true? What if it's false?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows:
"Will you, Gan Ning, Gan Xingba, forfeit a fight with me?"
"No."
The brocade-cloaked one, with a shining gaze and face full of enthusiasm, said loudly:

"I boast as the world's number one, invincible across Jingzhou and Yizhou's domains! You come from the Northern Lands and travel south without encountering a match! Many say you are the top warrior of the Northern Lands. I, Gan Ning, wish to meet you!"
His voice fell.
The small boat where Gan Ning stood was no more than fifty meters from Ding Ling.
So close.
Both could even see the hairs on each other's faces!
At their current Cultivation Realm.
Sensitivity in hearing and sight was fundamental!
"Ding Ling, you indeed have extraordinary style, imposing and skyward."
Gan Ning laughed loudly:
"Haha, good. Here in the Yangtze River Waters, if you can defeat me, I'll let you pass, otherwise, don't blame me for being discourteous!"
"Heh."
Ding Ling gave a cold smile:
"What do you have in mind?"
"You've come from the Northern Lands, riding peerless steeds. The Southern Lands lack horses, let alone such fine ones. If I defeat you, you must give me your horse."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"And if you lose?"
"How could I possibly lose?"
Gan Ning glared, full of arrogance, tossing his cape, the bells at his waist jingling loudly in the air:
"Since I set out, I've known no defeats, nor faced obstacles! How could I lose to you!"
"You've spent your career as the Brocade Sail Pirate."
Diao Chan mocked coldly:
"The ships and travelers you raided on the river of course spelled constant victories. But my lord is different from you! What makes you so confident?!"
Gan Ning was momentarily stunned, his face turning red with frustration, just about to retort when Ding Ling was already pointing his sword at Gan Ning:
"Gan Xingba, come!"
"Alright."

Gan Ning immediately forgot Diao Chan's mockery, brandishing the iron halberds, issuing an order, the lead boat instantly dashing towards Ding Ling. Without waiting for the boat to get closer, Ding Ling, holding the Giant Que Sword, touched down at the prow of the large ship.
The Flying Swallow Technique activated.
Like a graceful swallow, with one leap he was tens of meters away, landing in front of Gan Ning on his boat:
"No need for you to come over. We'll do it here."
"What courage."
Gan Ning's face changed slightly, with a wave of his hand, the Brocade Sail Pirates on the boat jumped to other boats, each staring intently at Ding Ling, Gan Ning, becoming spectators.
Among the Brocade Sail Pirates, there were also a dozen players, now exceedingly excited, their mood for watching like eating melons was intense.
They regretted not having mobile phones at that moment.
Otherwise, capturing this scene and spreading it online would surely become incredibly viral!
In the current real world, who doesn't know that the hottest person isn't a movie or TV star, but Ding Ling?
Such a top figure, elusive in real life.
Even in the game world, he is hard to encounter!
Capturing him battling Brocade Sail Pirate Gan Ning, how could it not be sensational?
"Deservedly, Ding Ling, who disregards the Yuan Family's wanted order!"
Gan Ning looked appreciatively:
"Originally, I didn't understand why the Yuan Family offered such a generous reward. But now I partially understand. Come, come."
He clanged the double halberds against each other heavily in the air, sparks flying:
"Let me test your Divine Skill, Ding Ling!"
"As you wish!"

Without another word, Ding Ling swung the Giant Que Sword, the Vigorous Qi of Calm Wind Swordsmanship flew out with the sword. In just a moment, sword shadows attacked and slashed in the air, transforming into an all-encompassing calm breeze sweeping towards Gan Ning, seemingly intent on engulfing him in sword shadows, tearing him into pieces!
The spectators were shocked.
Gan Ning was moved, not daring to hold back, with a loud shout, the double halberds fiercely struck the prow, accompanied by a booming sound, both Gan Ning and Ding Ling fell into the water.
The previously heavy iron halberds, at the moment they entered the water, instantly seemed to transform into waterborne Flood Dragons, accompanied by faintly audible dragon roars...

chapters.title: Chapter 181 181: Giant Que Sword vs. Water Dragon Double Halberd (24/32)
paragraphs: The iron halberd came crashing down towards Ding Ling like Mount Tai pressing down.
Such a strike.
Sudden and fierce.
If it were generals like Yan Liang and Wen Chou, they might have to eat dirt, feel scared, and surrender.
But Ding Ling is different.
His skills in swimming, diving, and the like have long reached full level;
In the water, he's like a fish, his water combat ability is no less than his land combat!
Seeing Gan Ning smash the bow of the ship, he anticipated that Gan Ning would want to battle on the water, so he went with the flow and entered the water.
At this moment, seeing the double halberds swirl up water vortices like two flood dragons rushing at him, Ding Ling's expression remained unchanged, as he flicked the Giant Que Sword in his hand.
He unfolded the Rouyun Saber Technique.
All over the sky appeared the shadows of the sword, like floating clouds, weightless, yet every clash with the iron halberd produced tremendous booming sounds!
"What?!"
Gan Ning's expression changed, and he took a deep look at Ding Ling, not expecting Ding Ling to be as if walking on flat ground in the waters of the river!
So incredible!
How is this possible?!
Aren't warriors from the Northern Lands supposed to be landlubbers?

Although it was surprising, Gan Ning quickly composed himself, shouted loudly, gathered up his spirit to its peak, and sped up his Inherited Breathing Technique Water Dragon Breathing Technique, making himself even more at ease in the water.
The inherited divine skill Water Dragon Double Halberd Technique exerted its power!
Splash, splash!
The strikes raised waves.

Ding Ling was unafraid, wielding the Giant Que Sword that flowed like clouds at times, swift as a hunting leopard at times, heavy like Mount Tai pressing down at times, cold as the chilling depths of a prison descending upon the world!
Rouyun Saber Technique, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Liaoyuan Spear Technique, Ghost Prison Spear Technique, all perfectly executed with just one sword!
Clearly just one sword!
Yet it could turn into a long spear, a sharp blade, a saber!
Moves unpredictable, without pattern.
Every move was astonishingly powerful, and extraordinarily mysterious to the extreme!
Each stroke was instinctive, bringing with it thousands of pounds of force!
Even if he couldn't leverage the river's power like Gan Ning!
Yet various divine skill techniques were at his fingertips!
With two breathing techniques enhancing Ding Ling.
He was still incredibly powerful, like a real dragon in the water, overturning rivers and seas as if it were trivial!
Rumble, rumble!
Splash, splash!

Gan Ning and Ding Ling, one like a flood dragon in the water, every move with the double iron halberds stirred up the surging river, each strike fell like a waterfall crashing down from the heavens, the booming sound ear-splitting before the halberd even hit, the momentum was enough to intimidate anyone;
One like a fish in the water, diving smoothly, treading water as swift as moving on land, wielding the Giant Que Sword, like the Sword God manipulating heaven and earth.
Both had extremely high martial power.
In this battle in the river, it was like dragon and tiger clashing, a battle of heroes!
Upon contact, in merely a moment, it had reached a white-hot stage.
Everywhere the eye could see.
Were billowing white waves rolling in all directions, with clanging sword shadows falling!
Both fought fast with fast!
Clanging sounds echoed in all directions, the booming explosions shook the fish in the water, causing an unknown number to die and float belly-up!
Wherever the two passed.
The river split, ships gave way!
Like two Water Gods in combat, upon closer look, they didn't seem like mere mortals!
The players were dumbfounded, unable to believe this was real:
"Feels like watching a martial arts movie. So exciting!"
"Who do you think will win?"
"It must be Gan Xingba. He's famous as the Water Dragon King. In the Yangtze River region, he has no opponent, especially in the river where he's unbeatable! Everyone knows that!"
"Yes, but for Ding Ling, being a northern person to fight Gan Xingba in the water like this, it's unimaginable how his land combat skills must be! If it were land-based, Gan Xingba might have lost!"
Players speculated endlessly, their eyes unblinking as they watched the battle between Gan Ning and Ding Ling.
So exciting.
No one wanted to miss it.
It's much more thrilling than watching a martial arts movie in the cinema.
Really exhilarating!
The players felt this way.
The Brocade Sail Pirates cheered for Gan Ning:
"Gan Xingba will win!"
They shouted, all high-spirited and extremely fervent!
Diao Chan felt a bit angry, wanting to retort 'My lord will win!'
But seeing the Eight Hundred Brocade Sail Pirates, each tall and loud-voiced.
Her side had only a few people; their voices couldn't compete, so she thought for a moment, rushed into the cabin, tore off a piece of silk cloth, took out a brush, and quickly wrote a large line:
"Ding Ling is invincible!"
Using a spear as the flagpole, she tied the silk cloth on top, and fastened it!
Thus, a large flag was made.
She carried the flag to the bow of the ship, waving it back and forth.
Zhao Yun was speechless.
For the first time, he found Diao Chan so competitive, even the slogan had to surpass others; if not, at least match them!
Rumble, rumble!
Splash, splash!
The battle between Ding Ling and Gan Ning continued for the time it takes to drink a cup of tea.
As a chilling prison formed of sword shadows descended from nowhere, clanging! The Giant Que Sword once again struck Gan Ning's iron halberd.
Gan Ning let out a muffled sound, his tiger's mouth burst open, blood flowed.
He stared wide-eyed, roaring as another halberd strike came at Ding Ling.
Ang!
It was as if there was a water dragon roaring, as Gan Ning's final desperate strike came forth, immense waves accompanied by the halberd's blade rushed towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling let out a long shout: "Well done!"
Stepping on the waves.
Not retreating but advancing.

Waving the Giant Que Sword, seeming like a wildfire spreading across the fields, clanging! The shadow of the sword seemed to turn into a spear shadow amidst the illusion, the incoming heatwave seemed to evaporate many of the waves, accompanied by the sword's blade of the Giant Que Sword slicing through the water dragon's head, with a booming sound hitting the halberd's blade.
Clang!
A screeching noise pierced the ears.
Gan Ning, as if struck by lightning again, his left hand's tiger's mouth burst open.
He could no longer hold the halberd, with a heavy sound, the halberd was struck flying, splashing! It fell into the water, rolled away by the waves, disappearing in an instant.
"Thanks for letting me win!"
Ding Ling retreated two steps, stepped on the waves, the clanging sound ongoing, sheathed the sword, and cupped his hands towards Gan Ning, speaking.
Gan Ning's face turned ugly, opening his mouth to say something, but ultimately said nothing.
He turned silently, stepping on the waves, like a lone Water God gradually walking away in the river.
He didn't even get on his own subordinate's ship, just went off alone like this.
"He is not yet the mature, brave later version of Gan Ning."
Ding Ling shook his head.
The current Gan Ning was still indulging in the fun of being a Brocade Sail Pirate.
He had strong pride and vanity.
Especially cared about face.
Being defeated by Ding Ling in public.
Would have such a reaction.
Ding Ling wasn't surprised at all.
He turned, stepping on the waves, towards the big ship, leaping up, landing at the bow.
"Ding Ling, you won!"
Diao Chan, full of joy and pride, said with pride and a sense of honor.

sentences.text: The iron halberd came crashing down towards Ding Ling like Mount Tai pressing down.
Such a strike.
Sudden and fierce.
If it were generals like Yan Liang and Wen Chou, they might have to eat dirt, feel scared, and surrender.
But Ding Ling is different.
His skills in swimming, diving, and the like have long reached full level;
In the water, he's like a fish, his water combat ability is no less than his land combat!
Seeing Gan Ning smash the bow of the ship, he anticipated that Gan Ning would want to battle on the water, so he went with the flow and entered the water.
At this moment, seeing the double halberds swirl up water vortices like two flood dragons rushing at him, Ding Ling's expression remained unchanged, as he flicked the Giant Que Sword in his hand.
He unfolded the Rouyun Saber Technique.
All over the sky appeared the shadows of the sword, like floating clouds, weightless, yet every clash with the iron halberd produced tremendous booming sounds!
"What?!"
Gan Ning's expression changed, and he took a deep look at Ding Ling, not expecting Ding Ling to be as if walking on flat ground in the waters of the river!
So incredible!
How is this possible?!
Aren't warriors from the Northern Lands supposed to be landlubbers?

Although it was surprising, Gan Ning quickly composed himself, shouted loudly, gathered up his spirit to its peak, and sped up his Inherited Breathing Technique Water Dragon Breathing Technique, making himself even more at ease in the water.
The inherited divine skill Water Dragon Double Halberd Technique exerted its power!
Splash, splash!
The strikes raised waves.

Ding Ling was unafraid, wielding the Giant Que Sword that flowed like clouds at times, swift as a hunting leopard at times, heavy like Mount Tai pressing down at times, cold as the chilling depths of a prison descending upon the world!
Rouyun Saber Technique, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Liaoyuan Spear Technique, Ghost Prison Spear Technique, all perfectly executed with just one sword!
Clearly just one sword!
Yet it could turn into a long spear, a sharp blade, a saber!
Moves unpredictable, without pattern.
Every move was astonishingly powerful, and extraordinarily mysterious to the extreme!
Each stroke was instinctive, bringing with it thousands of pounds of force!
Even if he couldn't leverage the river's power like Gan Ning!
Yet various divine skill techniques were at his fingertips!
With two breathing techniques enhancing Ding Ling.
He was still incredibly powerful, like a real dragon in the water, overturning rivers and seas as if it were trivial!
Rumble, rumble!
Splash, splash!

Gan Ning and Ding Ling, one like a flood dragon in the water, every move with the double iron halberds stirred up the surging river, each strike fell like a waterfall crashing down from the heavens, the booming sound ear-splitting before the halberd even hit, the momentum was enough to intimidate anyone;
One like a fish in the water, diving smoothly, treading water as swift as moving on land, wielding the Giant Que Sword, like the Sword God manipulating heaven and earth.
Both had extremely high martial power.
In this battle in the river, it was like dragon and tiger clashing, a battle of heroes!
Upon contact, in merely a moment, it had reached a white-hot stage.
Everywhere the eye could see.
Were billowing white waves rolling in all directions, with clanging sword shadows falling!
Both fought fast with fast!
Clanging sounds echoed in all directions, the booming explosions shook the fish in the water, causing an unknown number to die and float belly-up!
Wherever the two passed.
The river split, ships gave way!
Like two Water Gods in combat, upon closer look, they didn't seem like mere mortals!
The players were dumbfounded, unable to believe this was real:
"Feels like watching a martial arts movie.
So exciting!"
"Who do you think will win?"
"It must be Gan Xingba.
He's famous as the Water Dragon King.
In the Yangtze River region, he has no opponent, especially in the river where he's unbeatable!
Everyone knows that!"
"Yes, but for Ding Ling, being a northern person to fight Gan Xingba in the water like this, it's unimaginable how his land combat skills must be!
If it were land-based, Gan Xingba might have lost!"
Players speculated endlessly, their eyes unblinking as they watched the battle between Gan Ning and Ding Ling.
So exciting.
No one wanted to miss it.
It's much more thrilling than watching a martial arts movie in the cinema.
Really exhilarating!
The players felt this way.
The Brocade Sail Pirates cheered for Gan Ning:
"Gan Xingba will win!"
They shouted, all high-spirited and extremely fervent!

But seeing the Eight Hundred Brocade Sail Pirates, each tall and loud-voiced.
