"Ding Ling is invincible!"
Using a spear as the flagpole, she tied the silk cloth on top, and fastened it!
Thus, a large flag was made.
She carried the flag to the bow of the ship, waving it back and forth.

For the first time, he found Diao Chan so competitive, even the slogan had to surpass others; if not, at least match them!
Rumble, rumble!
Splash, splash!
The battle between Ding Ling and Gan Ning continued for the time it takes to drink a cup of tea.
As a chilling prison formed of sword shadows descended from nowhere, clanging!
The Giant Que Sword once again struck Gan Ning's iron halberd.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 182: Shocking Both Banks of the Great River
paragraphs: Du Qingcheng was the same, looking quite accomplished and honored.
Obviously, she held Ding Ling in very high regard.
She had already automatically put herself in Ding Ling's situation.
Taking Ding Ling's defeat of Gan Ning as a collective effort.
Naturally, a sense of honor arose, feeling joy and pride for Ding Ling's strength and victory.
After all, Ding Ling could be considered the captain of their team!
Zhao Yun also nodded secretly, feeling an increasing sense of belonging to the team.
The Eight Hundred Brocade Sail Pirates collectively fell silent.
The players' worldviews seemed to shatter, each one's jaw almost hitting the ground.
"How could it be Ding Ling who won?! Gan Xingba, who has the reputation of the Water Dragon King, actually lost! This is unbelievable!"

"Indeed. In the area around the Yangtze River, Gan Xingba is invincible! Otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to challenge Ding Ling, knowing how strong he is. Obviously, he had absolute confidence in his naval combat skills, yet he was defeated by Ding Ling in a water battle! Is Ding Ling really that strong?!"
"Ding Ling is even more overbearing and terrifying than imagined. I really want to become his disciple!"
"... Wake up! Ding Ling is the son of the myth game's behind-the-scenes boss!"
"Heh. One moment he's the boss's son, the next he's the inheritor of a hidden clan. I even said he's the creator of the game! Could you be any more ridiculous?!"
"Let's go!"

When Ding Ling looked at the Eight Hundred Brocade Sail Pirates, every pirate he glanced at couldn't help but feel their hair stand on end and their scalp tingle. Their previous wildness, arrogance, and wantonness completely vanished at that moment, each terrified to the extreme, frantically rowing away!
Their confidence came from Gan Ning!
Now that even the invincible Gan Ning had lost!
They had no courage to face Ding Ling!
At Gan Ning's level, fighting eight hundred people single-handedly was completely normal.
Ding Ling defeated Gan Ning!
Slaughtering them, numbering in the hundreds, would be child's play!
Thinking of this.

The Eight Hundred Brocade Sail Pirates were all terrified, rowing ever more vigorously. The sound of water splashing echoed as their small boats speedily dashed away like arrows, gradually disappearing into the distance.
Only then.
The boatmen dared to step out of the cabin.
The way they looked at Ding Ling had completely changed.
Becoming increasingly respectful, awed, and shrinking back.
This was the instinctual reaction of the weak towards an absolute powerhouse.
Like sheep facing a tiger, knowing full well the tiger might not eat the sheep, but the sheep would still be afraid!
Ding Ling had no intent of conversing with the boatmen, and walked straight into the cabin.
He began to continue instructing Diao Chan and the others in martial arts.
The event of Ding Ling defeating Gan Xingba of the Brocade Sail Pirates spread like wildfire across the banks of Jiangnan!
Especially among the river pirates and merchants making a living in the Yangtze River waters, who were the first to hear of it.
In no time.
Everyone was speechless.
The river pirates who previously had thoughts towards the Yuan Family's wanted order completely gave up at this moment.
Such a fierce man.
Anyone who encounters him is doomed!
This was also why Gan Ning had no desire to kill.
If not, he might have been killed by Ding Ling in the Yangtze River waters. Know that Ding Ling is not a soft-hearted person; he came killing all the way from the north to the south!
With Ding Ling's reputation growing!
Many of the things he had done in the past, big and small, were uncovered one by one.
The more that came to light.
His fame in the Yangtze River basin grew even larger!
Eventually.
It nearly intimidated all the notable figures.
There was not a single person who didn't take notice of Ding Ling!
Nor did anyone dare to underestimate this small team of only a few people that Ding Ling had!
With this battle.
Ding Ling accumulated strength over time for a sudden surge.
His fame entered a phase of rapid growth, exceeding his imagination at times.
[E-level Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating Gan Ning]
[Note: Since Gan Ning's (Gan Xingba's) emergence, he may encounter opponents on land battles, but in water battles, he is unmatched! He is among the few super-elite powerful figures of this era!
He is proud, overbearing, and self-confident!
But your appearance completely shattered his self-confidence!
Made him question life! Begin to doubt himself!
He might need some time to walk out of the shadow of being defeated by you!
But once he does, he will surely experience a transformation. At that time, he may come forth to challenge you again!]
Ding Ling heard the notification sound.
Relaxed.
It really was Gan Xingba.
His mental resilience was indeed different.
Ding Ling's presence might accelerate Gan Xingba's growth and evolution!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating the Eight Hundred Brocade Sail Pirates!]
[Note: The Eight Hundred Brocade Sail Pirates were rampant and unrestrained! They roamed the Yangtze River waters unchallenged! You showed them what a true Water Dragon King is!]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Dominating the Banks of the Yangtze!]
[Note: Your fame has become well-known across both banks of the great river! You have become the supreme War God in their hearts!]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating the River Pirates.]

[Note: Your reputation surpassed that of Gan Ning, you became the new Water Dragon King and Overlord. River pirates change color when they hear your name! When they encounter you, they are sure to detour out of respect!]
Three achievement medals in a row.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows.
Couldn't help but glance at the character panel:
[1: Defeat more than 20 strong beings of the Plane: 16/20.]
[3: You must make your War God's name resound throughout the entire Plane World. 29%/100%.]
It was 19% before.
Jumping forward by a whole 10 small blocks.
Ding Ling nodded secretly.
Completing the task was just around the corner.
And as time goes on.
His fame would only continue to grow larger!
On this day.
Ding Ling and his group's boat docked on the shore.
After disembarking.
They rode their horses straight to Changsha City.
Before disembarking, Ding Ling specifically returned to the real world once more.
Having confirmed that Zhang Zhongjing was still in Changsha City, he felt at ease heading to the location.
The journey went relatively smoothly.
Perhaps due to player reminders.
Or perhaps due to the songs of travelers and river pirates passing through the Yangtze River waters about him!
The Prefect, generals, and others of Jingzhou Changsha County actually knew of him.
Seeing him coming.
They took the initiative to welcome him.
"My name is Wen Pin."
The Defensive General was a scholarly, handsome, and heroic young man.
Hearing his name, Ding Ling was slightly surprised.
The name Wen Pin was familiar to him.
A future renowned general!
He guarded Jiangxia and repeatedly thwarted Guan Yu! And repelled Sun Quan's attacks!
Famed and leaving his mark in history!
Unexpectedly, he was now the Defensive General of Changsha County.
This was somewhat inconsistent with his memory of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms history.
But considering the various anomalies after players invaded,
Ding Ling felt relieved, not bothering to overthink it, and greeted Wen Pin straight away.
Wen Pin was somewhat flattered, hurriedly returning a grand salute!
To him.
Ding Ling was the unrivaled top general, the future War God!
Such a grand figure being so friendly to him, how could Wen Pin not feel both bewildered and secretly delighted.
This is Ding Ling!
The legendary figure who defeated Lü Bu!
Although the authenticity of defeating Lü Bu was unknown, it seemed Lü Bu had never denied it!
Consequently, the matter once caused quite a stir in Luoyang.

chapters.title: Chapter 183 183: The Renowned General Wen Pin (26/32)
paragraphs: Wen Pin knows about this matter because Ding Ling's deeds have spread throughout Jingzhou, especially in Changsha County, where Ding Ling's name is practically thunderous, although not everyone knows him, among the upper class, almost no one is unaware of Ding Ling's accomplishments!
After all, there's pigeon post and so on.
Who doesn't have some relatives or friends?
After some exchange of information.
The more they learned about Ding Ling.
The deeper and more they understood, the more they revered Ding Ling!
Among this information, Wen Pin paid particular attention to one thing: that Ding Ling had defeated Lü Bu!
The Battle of Hulao Pass!
Lü Bu's single battle startled the whole world!
There was even a saying among people: "Among men, Lü Bu; among horses, Red Hare!"
It shows the prestige of Lü Bu!
Even Lü Bu is such.
Then what about Ding Ling who defeated Lü Bu?
It is precisely because of considering this point.
Coupled with recalling Ding Ling's actions along the way, Wen Pin instinctively believed Ding Ling to be a wild, unfettered, audacious, egotistical, and overbearing persona!
How was he to know that meeting face to face he would find the rumors wrong, Ding Ling turned out to be a man of manners, polite and dealing with people very appropriately!
Especially, Ding Ling being so friendly to someone like him, a nobody like Wen Pin!
While Wen Pin felt wildly joyful, he felt a kind of 'Ding Ling actually knows there's someone like me Wen Pin in Jingzhou?!' clarity and transparency!
Like drinking sweet spring water, refreshing to his heart!
This is quite understandable.
An ordinary person suddenly one day receives a greeting from Xiang Yu, Emperor Qin Shi Huang, one can imagine this ordinary person's surprise and bewilderment!
Wen Pin now feels similar!
Feeling entirely refreshed all over!
Ding Ling's recognition rate visibly skyrocketed!
Originally, he didn't quite welcome Ding Ling but was only in awe of him, now Wen Pin's attitude towards Ding Ling underwent a complete 180-degree change, becoming extremely warm and considerate.
Knowing Ding Ling wanted to see Zhang Zhongjing, he even offered to personally lead the way.
"How can I bother you like this?"
Ding Ling said.
"It's alright. I'm just free and idle!"
Wen Pin laughed heartily and said:
"Besides, I also want to pay my respects to Zhang Zhongjing."
"Then I'll bother you."
"Polite, you're too polite!"
Wen Pin walked and chatted with Ding Ling all the way.
The more they talked, the more shaken Wen Pin felt.
Only because Ding Ling's knowledge of astronomy, geography, culture, and history, seemed to know everything.
Originally thought he was a martial artist.
Now it seems Ding Ling even appears to have more cultural standards than many Prefects!
Thinking of some things Ding Ling did in Jizhou.
Wen Pin was secretly shocked.
Are all those rumors possibly true? If it is indeed so, then this Ding Ling youngster is too monstrous and frightening.
Literary talent to defeat Jizhou's renowned scholars!
Martial arts capable of crossing Jiuzhou!
Such a remarkable talent!
Searching the entire era, it's hard to find another one!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You have gained high recognition from Wen Pin]

[Annotation: Your literary talent and martial arts make Wen Pin awe you. Your attitude delights and convinces Wen Pin! After a thorough conversation, his recognition of you has risen to a deep degree.
Unexpectedly.
If you spend a few good days talking, he will definitely consider you a friend!]
Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
Eyebrows raised slightly, with amazement: Is this possible?!
But considering Wen Pin is a first-class expert.
Ding Ling then directly proposed to have some martial arts sparring with him tomorrow.
Wen Pin gladly agreed.
Just sparring.
Besides, it's sparring with the world's number one general, what reason does he have not to be happy:
"I hope for your guidance."
He believed his martial arts were acceptable.
Though in front of Ding Ling, he had no confidence in winning at all, purely wanting to gain some experience fighting a real general.
"Mutual guidance."
Ding Ling said this.
Wen Pin increasingly felt delight, Ding Ling such a fierce man, but attitude so well, truly unexpected for him!
The lower the expectation.
But the bigger the contrast, the more easily one develops feelings of bewilderment and joy.
Wen Pin didn't expect much from Ding Ling on the 'good attitude' aspect.
The result was extremely contrasting, naturally, making him impressed and eye-catching.
A period later.
They arrived at Zhang Mansion.
Wen Pin voluntarily stepped forward to knock on the door.
The one opening the door was an old steward.
Seeing Wen Pin, he willingly led Ding Ling and party inside, prepared tea, and said:
"Please wait, my master is currently treating and healing someone. Once he's done, he'll come over."
"It's alright. No rush."
Ding Ling came to request a favor.
Needs a good attitude.
The old steward glanced sideways, confused:
"Who is this gentleman?
Wen Pin stood up to introduce Ding Ling and the others.
The old steward moved, with a shudder, nearly falling, showing the current reputation and weight of Ding Ling in ordinary people's hearts.
The old steward quivered.
Ding Ling quickly calmed him.
Then the old steward ended up in a state like Wen Pin, even more exaggerated!
The treatment Ding Ling and the group received obviously improved significantly.
Even Wen Pin expressed that he basked in Ding Ling's glory to enjoy such medicinal tea.
Not bad.
The tea got upgraded.

It's Zhang Zhongjing's specially configured top-grade medicinal tea, with the effects of soothing the liver, regulating qi, clearing the meridians, strengthening vigorous qi, and so on. Extremely outstanding.
Ding Ling genuinely did not expect his reputation to be so effective.
Wen Pin explained:

"Ding Ling, you probably don't know, now Luoyang is still embroiled in war, Dong Zhuo already showing signs of relocating the capital. Moreover, the Yuan Family's patriarch and others almost got massacred by Dong Zhuo!
Even though the Yuan Family's prestige hasn't diminished.
But people with insight can see it clearly.
The era of heroes competing is already here!
Ding Ling, as a general who can defeat Lü Bu and Gan Ning!
Not to say the whole world knows, but many prominent figures along the Yangtze River already know you.
The feats you achieved leading just a few troops to break through Wan City and Runan Yellow Turban Army are spread enthusiastically along the Yangtze River.
Now or soon in the future, surely many will try to recruit you.
Now not taking the initiative because your attitude isn't clear, also it's not wise to openly feud with the Yuan Family, but building a connection with you is fine.
My current presence here.
It's following orders from the Governor of Jingzhou, Liu Biao..."
Ding Ling listened. Besides feeling relieved, he was quite puzzled.
A person like Liu Biao knowing to recruit him, a martial artist?
Unless he also knows what he did in Jizhou, extremely admiring his literary talent, thus taking the initiative to show goodwill?
Or maybe this world's Liu Biao changed, displaying friendliness towards martial artists?
Specifics unknown to Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling is not one-dimensional, a person who doesn't think around, if Liu Biao offers goodwill, he naturally accepts gladly.
Able to avoid fighting.
Able to avoid conflict.
For Ding Ling, that's extremely good.
Along the way, the number of fights is countless. Ding Ling desires no more unwarranted battles.
This wait.
Was two hours.
Midway, Ding Ling even sparred once with Wen Pin.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 184: Medical Saint Zhang Zhongjing (27/32)
paragraphs: The task's progress had moved forward just a little bit.
[1: Defeat over 20 powerful entities from the plane: 17/20.]
Previously it was 16.
It became 17 after defeating Wen Pin.
The task 1 completion was within reach.
"Sorry to keep you all waiting."
Zhang Zhongjing came hurriedly, filled with fatigue and apology.
He looked to be around forty, in the prime of his life.
His face was clear and refined, his frame thin, carrying an air of empathy for the world, much like a saint descending to the mortal realm.
Ding Ling's heart trembled, and he rose to greet him respectfully.
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, Du Qingcheng, and Wen Pin all greeted him as well.
Zhang Zhongjing was indeed a contemporary divine doctor, the future Medical Saint!
A compassionate heart respected through the ages, immortal!
Worthy of Ding Ling's admiration and respect!
"No need for formalities."
Zhang Zhongjing waved his hand, took the main seat, and looked at Ding Ling:
"This must be the world-renowned unparalleled mighty warrior, Ding Ling?"
"I wouldn't dare claim to be unparalleled. But yes, I am Ding Ling."
Zhang Zhongjing nodded and smiled:
"No need to be so humble. I've already heard of your deeds."
He paused and continued:
"Forgive my straightforwardness, but what brings you to seek me out this time?"
Ding Ling handed over a letter written by Hua Tuo.
Zhang Zhongjing took it, opened it, and read it carefully.
After finishing.
He looked at Ding Ling with some surprise and doubt, glanced again at the letter, and then pondered thoughtfully stroking his beard.
For a moment.
He said:
"This indeed is written by Hua Tuo. He rarely praises someone like this. Are you sure you are well-versed in medical dao?"
"It should be correct."
Wen Pin solemnly affirmed:
"Ding Ling recently assisted Hua Tuo in Runan to manage an epidemic; many people can verify that, it's impossible to fake."
"Since even Wen Pin has confirmed it, it seems it's truly correct."
Zhang Zhongjing didn't hesitate and directly took out a secret manual from his bosom and handed it to Ding Ling:

"Take a look at the 'Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases' which I composed combining the knowledge of various medical schools. Though it hasn't reached great success, it encapsulates all I've learned in my life. It's quite remarkable. If you truly possess the extraordinary medical talent Hua Tuo mentioned,
I will take you to find Yhiuu Ji!"
Ding Ling was in a daze.
He really didn't expect Zhang Zhongjing to act so unconventionally.
So straightforward!!
But he didn't hesitate much.
He decisively stepped forward to take the secret manual, ready to read it.
Zhang Zhongjing, however, said:
"Hua Tuo said whatever you learn, you master quickly, and once you master it, it becomes second nature. I trust Hua Tuo's character; he wouldn't speak recklessly or aimlessly!"
He looked deeply at Ding Ling and stroked his beard, saying:

"But I can't believe there exists such an extraordinary talent defying the norms of this world. Because it doesn't align with normal logic and worldview! I'll give you three years, no, three months. If within that time, you can learn and master all the medical knowledge points in the 'Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases,' I will immediately take you to find Yhiuu Ji and actively persuade him to teach you Inner Refining Breathing Technique!"
Ding Ling's face lit up with joy.
"Don't be too happy just yet."
Zhang Zhongjing said:

"The 'Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases' is extremely difficult. There are two versions: one that ordinary people in the mortal world can learn, and the version I gave you is extremely in-depth and complex. Even I can't say I've mastered all the medical knowledge to the level of mastery.
If you truly are as terrifying as Hua Tuo says,
Then all I can say is that your existence is enough to overturn the normal assumptions of countless people in this world!"
"We'll see if it's true three months later."
Zhang Zhongjing stood up and said:
"We'll meet again in three months."
He glanced at Ding Ling:

"I initially intended to personally teach you medical dao. But Hua Tuo said you don't need anyone to teach you to quickly learn and master medical skills! I truly want to see how you manage to do all this!"
"Rest assured, I won't disappoint you."
Ding Ling said solemnly.
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng watched and listened with strange expressions but didn't interrupt.
Wen Pin, however, was somewhat astonished:
"Zhang Zhongjing, this... isn't it a bit too demanding? Many people can't even reach entry-level in three months. How could they master it?"
"I didn't believe it either."
Zhang Zhongjing sighed:
"But that's what Hua Tuo said. Ding Ling learned all his skills in less than a month! Originally, I wanted to say one month, but I thought that would be too outrageous. So I said three months."
"I've heard of Hua Tuo's great name; he wouldn't speak nonsense."
Wen Pin was astonished.
"Exactly."
Zhang Zhongjing said:

"Hua Tuo and I are friends, confidants. I know his character better than you. That's why I'm willing to pass on all I've learned to Ding Ling. Otherwise, how could an ordinary person get such an opportunity?"
Ding Ling thanked him again.
"Thank Hua Tuo."
Zhang Zhongjing waved his hand:
"It was he who strongly recommended you and sincerely hoped I would pass on all I've learned to you. I couldn't refuse him! So..."
Ding Ling understood and immediately saluted in the direction where Hua Tuo was.
Zhang Zhongjing was gratified:

"You are so formidable and courageous yet so humble and courteous. No wonder Hua Tuo strongly recommended you! You should thoroughly study the 'Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases.' I must get going."
Ding Ling stepped aside.
Zhang Zhongjing then hurriedly left.
Wen Pin was speechless and looked at Ding Ling:
"Why not stay at my place for three months? This Zhang Mansion is a bit too shabby. I'm afraid it can't accommodate so many of you."
He didn't mention Ding Ling's mounts.
But everyone knew.
"No need."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"We'll stay here for at most two days."
"Two days?"
Wen Pin was puzzled:
"According to Zhang Zhongjing, it seems you intend to find Yhiuu Ji to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique. Are you planning to give up?"
"I won't give up."
"Exactly."
Wen Pin said:

"The ancients said, if one unifies the Inner and Outer Breathing Technique, they would become unrivaled in the world, invincible! But the success rate is too low. Many who attempted ended up dead or crippled."
He looked at Ding Ling:
"In this era, if there's truly someone who can successfully unify the Inner and Outer Breathing Technique, it can only be you, Ding Ling."
Wen Pin held Ding Ling in such high regard.
Ding Ling's cheeks flushed a bit.
Fortunately, his thick skin had grown over time. He soon regained his composure and accepted his genius label calmly.
He knew himself to be just ordinary.
So when praised excessively, he often felt embarrassed and quite uncomfortable.
But over time, he got used to it.
And he comforted himself: Having a cheat is also a type of genius. Others want it but can't have it!
This gradually thickened his skin; today it was much stronger than before.
After some time.
Wen Pin continued his heartfelt invitation.
Ding Ling asked him to wait a moment.
Wen Pin was puzzled, but he still waited nearby.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 185: Full Level Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases
paragraphs: Ding Ling began flipping through the medical book "Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases".
Wow!

As he opened the first page, a wealth of profound, mysterious, and unfathomable medical knowledge filled his sight. Even with Ding Ling's current level of medical expertise, he still found it remarkable and extraordinary.
His heart was stirred.
He couldn't help but feel a deeper sense of reverence for Zhang Zhongjing!
Such an elder, truly generous and admirable!
He truly held nothing back in imparting all he had learned in his lifetime to him!
Ding Ling sighed inwardly, his reading speed quickened a bit.
Wow!
Reading the book was essentially just flipping through it, skimming swiftly through line after line!
After one pass.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A book immediately materialized on the bookshelf, with several large words engraved on it:
"Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases"
In an instant afterward.
[Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases Full Level]
[Charm +0.6]
All the secrets and esoteric truths of the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases surged and roared within his Sea of Consciousness.
Then, like lightning, they transformed into instinct, rushing into every part of Ding Ling's body.
In just an instant.
Ding Ling had thoroughly mastered the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases.
He took a gentle breath.
Sensing the uniqueness of this medical skill.
Similar to the Qingnang Scripture, the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases covers all aspects of the Medical Dao, including internal medicine, surgery, and more!
Unlike the Qingnang Scripture, it focuses more on the study, analysis, and treatment of internal organs, placing more emphasis on medications.
The Qingnang Scripture, on the other hand, emphasizes the use of 'tools', such as massage, acupuncture, and other techniques!
Having mastered both the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases and the Qingnang Scripture.
Ding Ling had reached the pinnacle of internal and external medical knowledge, achieving a level of consummate mastery, incomparable to any!
At this moment, calling him a true Divine Doctor would not be an exaggeration.
Moreover, the most surprising to Ding Ling was that the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases also contained a Breathing Technique.
Named:
"Medical Saint Breathing Technique"
On the bookshelf, it had also condensed into a vague and illusory book.
Zhang Zhongjing's statement of imparting all he had learned in his life to Ding Ling was indeed no exaggeration.
Aside from the Breathing Technique.
There were even chapters on the Inner Scripture, Bian Que's Pulse Diagnosis Technique, and more.
Needless to say, this must have been passed to Zhang Zhongjing by Hua Tuo during their interactions.
In this respect.
Ding Ling could only admire.
In his place, he definitely couldn't be so unrestricted in passing on all he had learned in his life.
Yet Zhang Zhongjing, Hua Tuo, and others achieved just that.
These talents are worthy of being called true Grandmasters, Sages, and noble figures of virtue!

"Learning all the points of knowledge in the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases can increase charm by 0.6, which is quite rare. After all, I am no longer the same as before. My level, compared to the past, has increased significantly. At my current stage, high-tier medical techniques adding this many points is already quite good."
After reaching the full level in the Inner Scripture, charm +0.3.
The Qingnang Scripture increased by 0.8.
Evidently, the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases is definitely not weaker than the Qingnang Scripture.
It's just that Ding Ling's skill is much stronger now, so the increase is slightly less.
Swish!
Ding Ling opened his eyes.
"How is it?"
Diao Chan asked curiously with her eyes full of wonder.
She wore a face mask to avoid causing a stir and attracting attention, yet even then, she was an outstanding presence.
"It's done."
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
"Is that so?"
Diao Chan took a breath and praised:
"Both your talent in the Medical Dao and Martial Dao is extraordinary, making one marvel. It's truly unimaginable."
Zhao Yun and Du Qingcheng also were not stingy with their praise, each voicing their agreement.
Wen Pin looked bewildered, puzzled at Diao Chan and the others:
"What, what are you all doing?"
"It's that my lord has mastered the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases."
Diao Chan, full of spirit, eyes dancing, her joy and pride palpable even with a face mask:

"In terms of talent in the Medical Dao, my lord is unparalleled throughout history, even Hua Tuo couldn't help but praise him, admitting there was nothing more he could teach him. If not for this, my lord wouldn't have been able to acquire Hua Tuo's handwritten letters."
Wen Pin was shaken, speechless, and chuckled:
"How, how can that be?!"
"It's true."
Diao Chan's almond-shaped eyes widened:
"Don't you doubt it. Whether my lord has mastered it, just call Zhang Zhongjing here to test it and you'll know! I have no reason to lie."
"This, this..."
Wen Pin thought for a moment and became more and more uncertain, increasingly curious, looking at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, is this true?!"
"It's true."
Ding Ling's expression was calm.
"You, you, you..."
Wen Pin began to stutter, full of disbelief.
Although he didn't know how difficult the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases was to learn.
Observing that in the current age, only Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and a few others are known as Divine Doctors, he could gauge the difficulty of the Medical Dao!
That Ding Ling had so quickly mastered all of Zhang Zhongjing's life's learning.
Was he being treated like a fool?
In his shock, he thought of this and felt a bit displeased, his expression becoming unpredictable.
"Alright.
Ding Ling didn't continue:
"Go and call Zhang Xianbei here."
"I'll go."
Du Qingcheng said excitedly, immediately running out.
Wen Pin sat restlessly, displaying anticipation, confusion, and puzzlement on his face.
After a while.
Du Qingcheng called from afar, waving her hand:
"My lord, my lord, I've brought Zhang Xianbei here."
In front of others, Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan generally addressed him as lord.
Sometimes they used his name as well.
Ding Ling let them be.
Call him whatever they liked.
It was just a title after all.
"Huff huff!"
Zhang Zhongjing came hastening over, moving quickly.

As he walked, traces of the Five Animals Qigong were visible. It's clear that even if Hua Tuo didn't pass the Five Animals Qigong to Zhang Zhongjing, he must have discussed its foundational essence with him.
Combined with the Medical Saint Breathing Technique, one could say Zhang Zhongjing's physical abilities were only a bit lesser than Hua Tuo's.
But as time goes on, when he reaches Hua Tuo's age, Zhang Zhongjing's physical abilities would definitely match Hua Tuo's!
At this moment, his breath was somewhat disordered.
Arriving in front, he stared intently at Ding Ling:
"Miss Du said you've mastered the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases?!"
"Yes."
Facing the gaze of a sage like Zhang Zhongjing, Ding Ling still felt a bit guilty, activating his full-level acting skills to respond calmly.
He sighed inwardly: His skin was still not thick enough!
The day he could remain calm in front of sages, matching his outward demeanor.
That would be when he'd refined his face to the level of Great Success.
Zhang Zhongjing's eye twitched, taking a deep breath, he quickly said:
"Alright, I'll test you."
He quickly posed a few difficult questions from the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases.
Ding Ling answered them all smoothly, like flowing water, with no hesitation or obstacles.
Zhang Zhongjing was astonished and asked more and more difficult questions.
Ding Ling also responded perfectly, without flaw.
Surpassing even Zhang Zhongjing's expectations.
Later.
Zhang Zhongjing had more and more questions.
It turned into Ding Ling explaining and analyzing.
Zhang Zhongjing probing, inquiring, and seeking the way.
Wen Pin, seeing this, was astonished, moved, and secretly thought:
"This, this is actually true! So incredible! How could such a genius exist in this world?!"

Wow!
As he opened the first page, a wealth of profound, mysterious, and unfathomable medical knowledge filled his sight.
Even with Ding Ling's current level of medical expertise, he still found it remarkable and extraordinary.
His heart was stirred.
He couldn't help but feel a deeper sense of reverence for Zhang Zhongjing!
Such an elder, truly generous and admirable!
He truly held nothing back in imparting all he had learned in his lifetime to him!
Ding Ling sighed inwardly, his reading speed quickened a bit.
Wow!
Reading the book was essentially just flipping through it, skimming swiftly through line after line!
After one pass.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A book immediately materialized on the bookshelf, with several large words engraved on it:

In an instant afterward.
[Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases Full Level]
[Charm +0.6]
All the secrets and esoteric truths of the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases surged and roared within his Sea of Consciousness.
Then, like lightning, they transformed into instinct, rushing into every part of Ding Ling's body.
In just an instant.
Ding Ling had thoroughly mastered the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases.
He took a gentle breath.

Similar to the Qingnang Scripture, the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases covers all aspects of the Medical Dao, including internal medicine, surgery, and more!

At this moment, calling him a true Divine Doctor would not be an exaggeration.
Moreover, the most surprising to Ding Ling was that the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases also contained a Breathing Technique.
Named:

In this respect.

These talents are worthy of being called true Grandmasters, Sages, and noble figures of virtue!

After all, I am no longer the same as before.
My level, compared to the past, has increased significantly.
At my current stage, high-tier medical techniques adding this many points is already quite good."
After reaching the full level in the Inner Scripture, charm +0.3.
The Qingnang Scripture increased by 0.8.

It's just that Ding Ling's skill is much stronger now, so the increase is slightly less.
Swish!
Ding Ling opened his eyes.
"How is it?"
Diao Chan asked curiously with her eyes full of wonder.

"Is that so?"
Diao Chan took a breath and praised:
"Both your talent in the Medical Dao and Martial Dao is extraordinary, making one marvel.
It's truly unimaginable."
Zhao Yun and Du Qingcheng also were not stingy with their praise, each voicing their agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Light of the Medical Dao (29/32)
paragraphs: "It’s too defying of common sense."
Wen Pin’s Heart Lake was in turmoil, unable to calm down.
Zhang Zhongjing was even more shocked and moved than Wen Pin.
Ultimately, he was already astounded, changing expression!
"Unbelievable, it’s too unbelievable!"
Zhang Zhongjing’s hand stroking his beard was trembling slightly, his gaze at Ding Ling was as if he was looking at a deity or a true dragon:
"Are you sure you’ve never studied the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases before?"
He had just asked this question.
Then he denied himself:

"No, no, no. The version of the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases that has been circulated is only the ordinary version. This profound version, I have just partly shared the content so far.
And you are the only one I’ve ever taught all the contents of the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases!
Hence, it is evident that you have indeed just learned it?!"
His eyes widened, his mouth agape, his face twitching incessantly:
"Unbelievable, unbelievable indeed! There truly exists such a prodigy in this world. No wonder Hua Tuo speaks so highly of you!"
He seemed to realize something:
"Hua Tuo said you learned everything he knew in less than a month! I already found it absurd. If Hua Tuo claimed you mastered all his skills in less than a day.
I would certainly think Hua Tuo’s letter was forged, and subsequently would be furious and kick you out of the Zhang Family!
Hua Tuo knows me!
Knows I’m a person who values logic and reasoning. That’s why he said a month?
If it is indeed so, his consideration was right. I had underestimated you far too much."
He looked deeply at Ding Ling, sighed and said:

"You have comprehensively learned all I have acquired in my lifetime within such a short moment. Moreover, many medical knowledge points are mastered better than I am. I truly cannot comprehend how you’re able to achieve this! It is too absurd!"
"Is this true?"
Wen Pin could not help but interrupt and ask:
"Did Ding Ling really learn the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases?! And even mastered to a more profound level than you, Zhang Zhongjing?!"
"Absolutely true."
Zhang Zhongjing said solemnly:
"I have just tested it. Many points that I haven’t fully understood, Ding Ling has found solutions for and smoothly resolved my confusion. Say, I should actually thank him."
Ding Ling quickly said:
"I wouldn’t dare. I should be thanking the elder instead."
"Such a peerless talent yet so humble and composed."
The more Zhang Zhongjing looked at Ding Ling, the more pleasing he found him:
"No wonder Hua Tuo fervently recommended you. Now, I am increasingly optimistic about you!"
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You have earned Zhang Zhongjing’s recognition]
[Notes: As the future Medical Saint, Zhang Zhongjing has been rigorous and meticulous throughout his life! He is extremely demanding towards the Medical Dao!
However, you have overturned his worldview in an utterly brief time. Disrupted his regular logical line.
Made him doubt life. Thought in chaos, unable to remain calm.
After one exchange.
He has been profoundly impressed by you! The shock in his heart is beyond words.
It is foreseeable that he will certainly regard you as the future Medical God! He will definitely extol you greatly!]
Upon hearing this notification.
Ding Ling was secretly delighted.
Gaining recognition from the Medical Saint Zhang Zhongjing, in the matter of seeking Yhiuu Ji to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, Zhang Zhongjing will surely spare no effort!
This certainty is much greater now!
Just like this meeting with Zhang Zhongjing.
If it weren’t for Hua Tuo’s letter.
Even if Ding Ling met Zhang Zhongjing, Zhang Zhongjing might not necessarily pay attention to him.
Having a recommendation is completely different from having no recommendation.
Ding Ling deeply understood this principle, therefore throughout his journey, he never shies away from using the back door!
Being able to use the back door is a blessing.
How many people seek it but never succeed?
"Leave the matter of Yhiuu Ji to me."
Zhang Zhongjing was indeed a man of his word and immediately declared:
"Even if I have to kneel before Yhiuu Ji! I must have him teach you the Inner Refining Breathing Technique!"
Ding Ling was moved and hastened to bow deeply in gratitude.
"There’s no need for that."
Zhang Zhongjing immediately helped Ding Ling up, looking at him with eyes full of comfort, praise, and acknowledgment.
He sighed long:
"Previously, I suspected your talent. I ought to apologize to you instead."
Ding Ling quickly said he wouldn’t dare.
"Enough, let’s not utter these hypocritical courteous words."
Zhang Zhongjing patted Ding Ling’s shoulder, saying:
"And do not be too polite to me. With your talent, I am ashamed of myself! If you continue being polite, I will feel deeply embarrassed!"
"Elder."
"Enough."
Zhang Zhongjing waved his hand, saying:
"Let me see your medical skills."
He pointed to the left front:
"There are many patients that need treatment and diagnosis. Help me out and open my eyes."
"No problem."
Ding Ling agreed readily.
"Since you’re so skilled, you should first diagnose and treat those with difficult and severe illnesses.
Zhang Zhongjing led the way ahead, speaking as he walked:
"For these people, I find them quite tricky; you are better than me. You can try. If you can’t resolve it, I will intervene personally; if you solve it perfectly, I may ask you for advice myself."
"Mutual learning."
"You’re too courteous, too polite!"
Zhang Zhongjing was pleased:
"Really don’t understand. Why do some geniuses appear arrogant and condescending, while others can be as humble and courteous as Ding Ling. You’re truly excellent, very rare."
Not understanding it is normal.
Ding Ling thought: because not long ago, I was just an ordinary person, what some would call a mediocre talent!
How can a mediocre person possibly possess the prideful arrogance of a genius?
Unless this mediocrity is overly conceited!
Ding Ling had self-awareness, so it’s impossible for him to possess the arrogance of a genius!
Certainly.
This is something Ding Ling would never reveal. The matter of cheats, even if rotten, must rot in the stomach!
Some time later.
Ding Ling finished diagnosing various severely ill patients one by one.
He prescribed various prescriptions and diagnostic methods for them.
Zhang Zhongjing reviewed each, and when confused, he would ask questions.
Like why a particular illness requires adding such a common medicine; why another requires this acupuncture technique...
Various questions.
Ding Ling answered each one.
Zhang Zhongjing’s eyes grew brighter and brighter, looking at Ding Ling as if he was witnessing the descending Medical God!
When all the patients had taken their prescriptions and left.
Some who could be treated on the spot were already healed.
The time had already come to the next day’s morning.
Ding Ling’s constitution was extraordinary, not feeling weary.
But Zhang Zhongjing’s face was exhausted, though his eyes were gleaming with spirit, seemingly containing endless energy ready to burst forth at any moment.
He had completely recognized Ding Ling by this time.
His attitude towards Ding Ling was extremely amicable, and due to frequent exchanges with Ding Ling.
He even considered Ding Ling a confidant in the Medical Dao.
And not once had he exclaimed:
"Should Ding Ling stay with me always, it wouldn’t take three years, no, not even three months. My medical skills would surely advance leaps and bounds, breaking into another level of expertise!"
His gaze on Ding Ling was ablaze with blazing light:
"Ding Ling, you’re the light of the Medical Dao! The future of the Medical Dao!"

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Farewell to Yangzhou
paragraphs: "You should devote yourself to the Medical Dao, rather than learn the Martial Dao."
Zhang Zhongjing advised:
"How many people can Martial Dao save? Only Medical Dao can save countless people from plagues, illnesses, and other disasters!"
Ding Ling fell silent.
"Ding Ling, my sincere advice is for you to do this."
There was a touch of sorrow in Zhang Zhongjing’s sigh:

"There are too few true Divine Doctors nowadays. Even I have many patients whom I cannot cure, and I am at a loss with some serious diseases, yet you are so young and already much better than me! But of course, that’s not the key."
His face radiated with hopeful light:

"Your talent in the Medical Dao is what’s crucial! If you could master all the medical skills in this world, innovate and study stronger medical skills, write better and more easily understood medical books, then the future world would surely see countless Medical Gods emerge. Only then can the people be saved!"
He looked at Ding Ling:

"You are the light of the Medical Dao, and also the light of the world, the future light of the people, Ding Ling! You cannot abandon the Medical Dao, you should devote yourself to it. If you do, the structure of the world will be rewritten because of you..."
Zhang Zhongjing spoke eloquently.
At first, Wen Pin found it disagreeable, but the more he listened, the more it made sense.
His gaze at Ding Ling was also filled with encouragement and expectation.
There was no way around it.
He couldn’t be blamed for feeling this way.
In such a short time of merely a day or so.
Wen Pin had already been stunned by Ding Ling’s medical talent and level, and he couldn’t help but admire him immensely!
For such a gifted doctor not to learn medical skills, not to save people—that would be too unfortunate, a loss for the era, a regret for the world!
"This..."
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun glanced at each other, momentarily at a loss for words.
They were exceedingly proud to be associated with him!
After all, for someone like Zhang Zhongjing to hold Ding Ling in such high esteem.
They, as Ding Ling’s teammates and friends, naturally felt joy and honor for this!
However, to suggest Ding Ling abandon the Medical Dao, they felt was impossible.
Because the more they interacted with Ding Ling.
The more they could sense Ding Ling’s desire and pursuit for great power!
Sure enough.
When Zhang Zhongjing finished speaking with anticipation, looking at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling solemnly said:
"Senior. I agree with your viewpoint. But I cannot solely devote myself to the Medical Dao, as I believe merely practicing medicine cannot truly save the people from dire straits."
’You!’
Zhang Zhongjing was somewhat disappointed.
"Senior, please rest assured."
Ding Ling said seriously:

"If I become invincible, I will certainly find a capable leader, help remove obstacles for him, assist him in restoring harmony to the world as early as possible! In that way, without warfare, plagues, and similar disasters can greatly decrease or even disappear!
People won’t be displaced, and suffering and disease will naturally diminish rapidly!"
"Are you speaking the truth?"
Zhang Zhongjing turned his head, moved.
"Of course, it’s true."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, very sincerely:
"I have no need to lie."
Zhao Yun heard this, his spirits lifted, rejoicing greatly. He had been looking forward to this day for a long time.
"Very well."
Zhang Zhongjing nodded:

"What you say makes a lot of sense too. Compared to the Medical Dao, if you devote yourself to Martial Dao, become the world’s number one, and take the enemy’s head among thousands of troops as easy as picking something from a bag.
That would indeed be fortunate for the world."
He sighed:
"My talent for Martial Dao is inadequate, and I do not excel in governance, so I can only devote myself to the Medical Dao. While your talent in the Medical Dao is so astonishing..."
He shook his head, sighed:
"It’s really regrettable!"

"Senior. There are countless paths to save the country and the people. Being able to follow any one of them is a blessing. Why must you be hung up on whether or not I should devote myself to the Medical Dao? If I devote myself to the Martial Dao, become the world’s number one, I can still save the country and the people! Isn’t that right?"
"Indeed."
Zhang Zhongjing nodded, yet still found it difficult to calm his thoughts; he was really uneasy! With such talent, Ding Ling chooses not to pursue the Medical Dao; it’s too regrettable, too wasteful!
If he, Zhang Zhongjing, had such talent...
He shook his head, not daring to think further.
Ding Ling’s talent is too frightening.
Zhang Zhongjing wouldn’t even dare dream like this usually.
Thinking further, he feared his already shattered worldview would be crushed into shards again by Ding Ling!
"I won’t dawdle any longer."
Zhang Zhongjing straightened his clothes:
"After lunch, we’ll pack our bags and head to Yangzhou to seek Yhiuu Ji!"
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
Just waiting for this moment!
After lunch.
Ding Ling and his group rode on horseback.
Wen Pin personally led the team and escorted them thirty miles out of the city gates before reluctantly taking leave.
During this period, Ding Ling also asked about Huang Zhong.
Only then did he learn that Huang Zhong, due to player involvement, gained fame and was favored by Liu Biao, who had just set out for Xiangyang this morning.
Ding Ling felt a little regret for missing Huang Zhong.
But he didn’t dwell on it.
Players had already learned Huang Zhong’s skills.
And Huang Zhong’s son had recovered.
Ding Ling found it hard to think of other ways to repay Huang Zhong’s kindness.
Even if he thought of something, if the method were ineffective in the short term, Ding Ling wouldn’t adopt it.
After all, Ding Ling couldn’t stay long in Changsha County.
He still had to find Yhiuu Ji to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
"By missing this chance, perhaps I might never have the opportunity to learn Huang Zhong’s Martial Arts Skill."
Ding Ling felt slightly regretful.
But he didn’t probe further.
He wasn’t lacking in Breathing Technique.
He had top-level Sword Technique, Saber Technique, Spear Technique, and Archery Skill.
So missing Huang Zhong’s skill was just slightly regrettable for him, not significant.
If learned, it’s great.
If not, so be it.
It’s not worth Ding Ling spending too much time building rapport with Huang Zhong to exchange favors for the Martial Arts Skill.
Jiangnan has many waterways.
The next period.
Ding Ling was either on a boat or on the road.
And more time was spent on the boat.
Fortunately, he wasn’t short of money.
He could hire boats to take the horses he brought along.
Along the way.
Feeling bored.
Ding Ling frequently returned to reality to gather useful information.
Simultaneously considering whether he could learn more advanced Techniques.
As his hacking skills grew ever stronger.
His presence on the internet became increasingly mysterious, able to uncover more secrets.
But wanting to uncover truly significant secrets remained very unlikely.
Because those secrets are not stored on the internet, rather in some secret chambers and other more secure places.
Even so.
Ding Ling vaguely learned a secret: that is, the developers of the myth game might not be Blue Star People?!
Who could they be?
Aliens?
Ding Ling found it bizarre!
Yet, considering the realism of this myth game, he had a moment of pondering.
However, he quickly extinguished the thought; dwelling on it was pointless.
With the time spent on these musings, it was better to acquire more useful knowledge points and secrets.

sentences.text: "You should devote yourself to the Medical Dao, rather than learn the Martial Dao."
Zhang Zhongjing advised:
"How many people can Martial Dao save?
Only Medical Dao can save countless people from plagues, illnesses, and other disasters!"
Ding Ling fell silent.
"Ding Ling, my sincere advice is for you to do this."
There was a touch of sorrow in Zhang Zhongjing’s sigh:
"There are too few true Divine Doctors nowadays.
Even I have many patients whom I cannot cure, and I am at a loss with some serious diseases, yet you are so young and already much better than me!
But of course, that’s not the key."
His face radiated with hopeful light:
"Your talent in the Medical Dao is what’s crucial!

If you could master all the medical skills in this world, innovate and study stronger medical skills, write better and more easily understood medical books, then the future world would surely see countless Medical Gods emerge.
Only then can the people be saved!"
He looked at Ding Ling:
"You are the light of the Medical Dao, and also the light of the world, the future light of the people, Ding Ling!
You cannot abandon the Medical Dao, you should devote yourself to it.
If you do, the structure of the world will be rewritten because of you..."
Zhang Zhongjing spoke eloquently.
At first, Wen Pin found it disagreeable, but the more he listened, the more it made sense.
His gaze at Ding Ling was also filled with encouragement and expectation.
There was no way around it.
He couldn’t be blamed for feeling this way.
In such a short time of merely a day or so.
Wen Pin had already been stunned by Ding Ling’s medical talent and level, and he couldn’t help but admire him immensely!
For such a gifted doctor not to learn medical skills, not to save people—that would be too unfortunate, a loss for the era, a regret for the world!
"This..."
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun glanced at each other, momentarily at a loss for words.
They were exceedingly proud to be associated with him!
After all, for someone like Zhang Zhongjing to hold Ding Ling in such high esteem.
They, as Ding Ling’s teammates and friends, naturally felt joy and honor for this!
However, to suggest Ding Ling abandon the Medical Dao, they felt was impossible.
Because the more they interacted with Ding Ling.
The more they could sense Ding Ling’s desire and pursuit for great power!
Sure enough.
When Zhang Zhongjing finished speaking with anticipation, looking at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling solemnly said:
"Senior.
I agree with your viewpoint.
But I cannot solely devote myself to the Medical Dao, as I believe merely practicing medicine cannot truly save the people from dire straits."
’You!’
Zhang Zhongjing was somewhat disappointed.
"Senior, please rest assured."
Ding Ling said seriously:
"If I become invincible, I will certainly find a capable leader, help remove obstacles for him, assist him in restoring harmony to the world as early as possible!
In that way, without warfare, plagues, and similar disasters can greatly decrease or even disappear!
People won’t be displaced, and suffering and disease will naturally diminish rapidly!"
"Are you speaking the truth?"
Zhang Zhongjing turned his head, moved.
"Of course, it’s true."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, very sincerely:
"I have no need to lie."
Zhao Yun heard this, his spirits lifted, rejoicing greatly.
He had been looking forward to this day for a long time.
"Very well."
Zhang Zhongjing nodded:
"What you say makes a lot of sense too.
Compared to the Medical Dao, if you devote yourself to Martial Dao, become the world’s number one, and take the enemy’s head among thousands of troops as easy as picking something from a bag.
That would indeed be fortunate for the world."
He sighed:
"My talent for Martial Dao is inadequate, and I do not excel in governance, so I can only devote myself to the Medical Dao.
While your talent in the Medical Dao is so astonishing..."
He shook his head, sighed:
"It’s really regrettable!"
"Senior.
There are countless paths to save the country and the people.
Being able to follow any one of them is a blessing.
Why must you be hung up on whether or not I should devote myself to the Medical Dao?
If I devote myself to the Martial Dao, become the world’s number one, I can still save the country and the people!
Isn’t that right?"
"Indeed."
Zhang Zhongjing nodded, yet still found it difficult to calm his thoughts; he was really uneasy!
With such talent, Ding Ling chooses not to pursue the Medical Dao; it’s too regrettable, too wasteful!
If he, Zhang Zhongjing, had such talent...
He shook his head, not daring to think further.
Ding Ling’s talent is too frightening.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Xiao Qiao Lifts the Curtain (31/32)
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s actions and whereabouts were very secretive.
Every time, it was like thunder online and lightning offline.
Even so.
The secrets he uncovered brought him considerable benefits.
Meanwhile.
He also learned online that many high-profile figures were searching for him!
His heart tightened involuntarily!

"More and more people are benefiting from the Game World. Many gravely ill and dying people found their physical condition elevated, escaping the brink of death. As they became stronger, their immunity and other aspects rapidly improved!"
"And this is only the beginning. After realizing the Game World’s impact on reality, many prominent figures have started forming groups and teams to earn achievement medals, among other things."

"It can be foreseen that in the future, more high-profile figures and leaders will obtain top-tier Breathing Techniques and Martial Arts, gradually distancing themselves from ordinary people! But my existence has made these high-profile figures realize something was amiss."
Ding Ling’s eyes sparkled with brilliance:

"I clearly entered the Game World later than many players, yet my progress was astonishing, having defeated Lü Bu, killed Jii Ling, and eliminated famous generals Yan Liang and Wen Chou. These deeds have been spreading wildly on the internet. Even my recent studies in medicine at Zhang Zhongjing’s residence and treating illnesses have been intentionally spread."

’And the ones intentionally spreading my deeds are actually some foreign high-profile figures stirring trouble among them! They intentionally released the news to have oriental prominent figures find me; then, like praying mantises hunting cicadas, sparrows waiting behind!’
Ding Ling sneered:
"Don’t say you can’t find me now. Even if you find me, you might not be able to catch me! But to be safe, I’ll change locations again. Go deeper into remote mountains. Where people are scarce!"
Ding Ling thought this way.
And acted likewise.
He aimed to find a village with few inhabitants.
Moreover, the village’s residents should reside year-round in the mountains, rarely interacting with outsiders.
Only in such mountain villages could he avoid quick detection.
It also allowed him to stay peacefully for a longer period.
Apart from attending to various matters in reality.
In the Game World.
Ding Ling would still often guide Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng, and prepare medicinal baths for them.
Though there was no Great Medicine.
Regular medicinal baths were still effective for Diao Chan and the others.
They did not have the ability to directly enhance their physique like Ding Ling, so there was no worry of the herbs losing effectiveness in the short term.
Everything developed in an orderly manner.
The strength of Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng steadily rose.
Ding Ling, however, made no progress.
He wasn’t bothered by this.
He just needs to find more advanced Martial Arts to make rapid progress again.
On that day.
Ding Ling and his entourage arrived at Wan County in Lujiang County.
Yhiuu Ji remained tens of miles outside Wan County Town at a Daoist Temple.
The entourage rode on horseback.
Led by Zhang Zhongjing personally, they smoothly reached the Daoist Temple.
Ding Ling raised his eyes for a closer look.
The Daoist Temple sat on a small hill.
The dense forests and lush vegetation of the mountain were ’piled’, luxuriant and vibrant.
The Daoist Temple was small, but amidst the vibrant scenery, it exuded an extraordinary and unworldly charm.
Like a white crane amid a flock of chickens;
A white lotus rooted in mud.
Very refreshing, distinctive, and refined.
One glance gives insight into the owner’s nature as someone who had reached an ultimate level of self-cultivation.
"It’s here."
Zhang Zhongjing dismounted and said to Ding Ling and the others:
"Wait here now. I’ll meet Yhiuu Ji and explain everything. If he’s willing, that’s fine. If not, it might take more time, so be patient as you wait."
"Yes."
Ding Ling responded solemnly.
"Mm."
Zhang Zhongjing nodded, adjusting his attire, and strode forward, ascending the steps. In no time, he was engulfed by the greenery of the mountain.
Ding Ling and the others weren’t impatient either.
They waited by the side.
During this, Ding Ling occasionally saw some commoners or dignitaries walking out of the Daoist Temple with cheerful faces;
He also saw some people entering the Daoist Temple in distress.
Listening closely for a while.
Ding Ling understood.
They were all people coming to see Yhiuu Ji for treatment.
Apparently, the rumors weren’t false.
Though Yhiuu Ji was a practitioner of the Dao, he did numerous good deeds.
Such a person had principles, morals, and discipline.
They were easier to deal with.
What he feared most was encountering a rogue without principles.
Of course.
That was just Ding Ling’s personal opinion.
He recalled the words of Hua Tuo and Wang Yue, and his heart couldn’t help but grow anxious again.
He could only hope Zhang Zhongjing would be effective.
If things were indeed as Wang Yue and others described.
Should Ding Ling rashly approach to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, he would likely be turned away!
This was easy to understand.
If it were anyone Ding Ling didn’t know, suddenly approaching him to learn his Supreme Skill, Ding Ling would definitely think the person was an overconfident lunatic!
Consider things from different perspectives.
Ding Ling didn’t think being shunned by Yhiuu Ji for approaching him was unreasonable.
Thus, Zhang Zhongjing’s role became essential at this moment.
Time flowed like water.
In the blink of an eye, several hours passed.
Zhang Zhongjing still hadn’t descended the mountain.
Diao Chan’s stomach began to growl.
Ding Ling glanced at her.
Her face turned red:
"It’s okay. I can wait a bit longer."
Ding Ling was about to say something.
Da da!
Trot trot!
Suddenly, there was a burst of urgent hoofbeats.
The sound made quite a commotion.
Ding Ling instinctively turned his head to look.
He saw two carriages speeding towards them.
First, five or six young men, either handsome or heroic, paved the way.
Followed by a dozen or so neatly armored guards.
Clearly from a wealthy and prestigious family!
Whinny!

Upon reaching the foot of the hill, a tall and extraordinary young man at the forefront reined in his horse, causing it to rear up. Amidst the whinnying, its front hooves landed heavily on the ground.
"Hoo."
The young man exhaled, instructing the other young men beside him a few times.
Then dismounted, quickly approached the first carriage, and spoke in a clear voice:
"Xiao Qiao, we’ve arrived. How is your sister feeling now? Doing well?"
Xiao Qiao?!
Upon hearing this name.
Ding Ling’s body shook, his initially indifferent expression turned noticeably more focused. He looked closely.
The curtain of the first carriage was opened by a delicate hand.
A figure emerged from it.
The figure’s owner had a willowy build, beauty akin to a celestial Luoshen, alluring yet noble, an exceptionally rare beauty.
In terms of appearance, she was in no way inferior to Du Qingcheng.
She appeared young.
Yet it was clear, as she matured, she would become even more exquisitely beautiful.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Diao Chan vs. Ling Cao (32/32)
paragraphs: "Is she Xiao Qiao?"
Ding Ling turned his head slightly.
"Could this young man trying to curry favor be...?"
Ding Ling’s pupils narrowed slightly.
"My sister is in a dire situation. We need to take her up the mountain to see Daoist Yhiuu Ji and plead for his mercy."
Xiao Qiao, usually a feast for the eyes, wore an anxious expression, her brows furrowed in worry, making one involuntarily want to reach out and smooth her brows.
"Is it convenient for her to go up the mountain now?"
The young man asked.
"I’m afraid it’s not convenient."
"Then hurry up."
The young man called back:
"Bring the stretcher I had made earlier so Da Qiao can lie on it and go up the mountain."
So it really is Da Qiao.
Ding Ling’s brow twitched.
He had never expected to be so lucky to encounter such a group of people here!
There doesn’t seem to be such a record in history.
If there were, Yhiuu Ji wouldn’t have been killed by Sun Ce.
But thinking of the players who penetrate everything, Ding Ling understood.
Needless to say, there must be players stirring up trouble again. Perhaps Da Qiao came to seek Yhiuu Ji’s help because of an injury. It’s all the work of the players.
Just like Du Qingcheng.
Kidnapped by players and handed over to Yuan Shu!
It’s not something ordinary ’heroes’ could do!
And now, it seems he’s encountered another hero of a similar kind.
What could this hero be after?
Could it be merely to trouble Da and Xiao Qiao, or is it a heroic rescue mission?
Or perhaps another motive?
Ding Ling couldn’t make sense of it, but he didn’t meddle much.
In general.
Ding Ling wouldn’t take the initiative to cause trouble.
Of course, if someone provoked him, no matter who it was, he would find a way to destroy them, especially in this game world.
In the real world, there was no choice but to endure.
Endure even in the game world?
Especially now that he’s become a bona fide absolute expert! No need to endure in the Three Kingdoms World, right?
Ding Ling had never considered this point.
If he had.
He wouldn’t have fought all the way from the north to the south.
When it’s time to endure, he will endure; when it’s not, he absolutely will not!
"Quickly, be careful."
The stretcher was placed in the carriage.
Before long.
Amid the young man’s shouts.
A woman, pale as paper and seemingly incredibly weak, was brought out.
Although seriously ill, her natural beauty and delicately sculpted features were captivating, like a lotus emerging in full bloom, truly breathtaking!
Ding Ling, who had seen Diao Chan’s beauty many times, also couldn’t help but light up upon first seeing Da Qiao, silently admiring her.
No wonder she’s recorded in history.
Da and Xiao Qiao.
Without exception, truly stunning!
Their charm and allure might be slightly less than Diao Chan’s but comparable to Du Qingcheng.
A woman who can be compared to Du Qingcheng.
Rarely found across Jiuzhou Land.
Seeing these two take spots, no wonder they left their mark in history, cherished by Cao Mengde.
Clip-clop!
A group carried Da Qiao quickly past.
As they passed by Ding Ling’s group, the leading young man couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling a few times; the more he looked, the deeper his apprehension grew.
Seeing Ding Ling gaze at Da and Xiao Qiao, he felt displeased, snorted coldly, cast a disdainful glance at Ding Ling, and left with a flick of his sleeve.
"Who is that?"
Diao Chan was momentarily stunned, then furious:
"How dare he be so rude to our lord!"
Fish Guts Sword slipped from her sleeve; with a delicate shout, she prepared to dismount and teach the young man a lesson.
Ding Ling stopped her, indicating there was no need to make trouble.
Diao Chan remained indignant:
"That person’s gaze is too presumptuous. All the way here, who would dare to ignore and disdain our lord like this? I can’t stand it!"
"Let it go."
Ding Ling smiled faintly, watching the young man’s figure disappear into the depths of greenery, and said:

"Different people have different tastes. Some cherish and like me, and naturally, some despise and wish to kill me. There’s no need to clash with them over a mere glance. The world is vast, there are too many people who dislike me. I can’t argue with all of them, can I? Let this matter pass."
"The master is magnanimous."
Diao Chan retracted the Fish Guts Sword, glanced at the few standing by the carriage, and coldly said:
"Had it been any other court official, they wouldn’t have been as reasonable as the lord. These people should be grateful it was you they encountered."
"Heh heh.
The few on guard were fiery youth; one couldn’t help but retort:

"Our young master is the son of the Luoyang Prefect. His father is a high-ranking court official! His grandfather even served as Grand Commandant, one of the Three Ministers! What kind of figure is your lord? How dare you compare backgrounds with our young master? Truly oblivious, ignorant, deserves disdain and contempt!"
"Insolent!"
Diao Chan raised her eyebrows sharply, with Fish Guts Sword in hand, pointing at the young man:
"I am a follower of my lord, and you are followers of your young master. If it’s a matter of followers, my lord could certainly surpass your young master."
"A young lass dares to boast so shamelessly here."
A vibrantly spirited youth suddenly galloped out, shaking a long blade, its resounding clang ringing in all directions:
"I, Ling Cao, would like to see what gives you the courage to speak such big words."
"I’ll satisfy you!"
Diao Chan galloped out too, with Fish Guts Sword flashing like lightning through the clouds, aiming straight at Ling Cao as she rode forward.
Clang!
Soon, the two clashed together.

Diao Chan’s horse was fast, and adept in close-combat and footwork, as she faced Ling Cao, she leapt from the saddle, Fish Guts Sword shivered, holding the opponent’s blade while a leg thrust using Flying Swallow Technique struck hard on Ling Cao’s waist.
Bang!
Ling Cao was kicked flying away, rolling on the ground a few times, diffusing the Vigorous Qi, looking at Diao Chan with astonishment and anger:
"There’s some skill indeed, seems I’ve underestimated you! Shouldn’t have used just three parts of my skill. Next, I’ll go all out. If you’re struck dead by me, don’t blame me for showing no mercy!"
"Bring it on if you can."
Diao Chan showed no fear.

Her Fish Guts Sword flickered ambiguously, executing Rouyun Saber Technique, transforming into floating clouds in the sky, rushing with Diao Chan’s Flying Swallow Technique, thrusting sharply like a bolt toward Ling Cao.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
The two fought rapidly, exchanging over a dozen blows in just a few blinks.
Suddenly, Diao Chan executed a powerful Cloud Strike Saber Technique!
Boom!
Striking Ling Cao’s wrist squarely.
Ling Cao cried out in pain, unable to hold onto his weapon any longer, the long blade clattering to the ground.
Diao Chan leaped back onto her mount, sat upright on horseback, and looked down at Ling Cao:
"Clearly, my lord is superior to your young master!"
She had won.
But she didn’t boast of her own strength.
Instead, she wholly upheld Ding Ling’s status and honor.
This showed Ding Ling’s status in Diao Chan’s heart now.
"You!"

sentences.text: "Is she Xiao Qiao?"
Ding Ling turned his head slightly.
"Could this young man trying to curry favor be...?"
Ding Ling’s pupils narrowed slightly.
"My sister is in a dire situation.
We need to take her up the mountain to see Daoist Yhiuu Ji and plead for his mercy."
Xiao Qiao, usually a feast for the eyes, wore an anxious expression, her brows furrowed in worry, making one involuntarily want to reach out and smooth her brows.
"Is it convenient for her to go up the mountain now?"
The young man asked.
"I’m afraid it’s not convenient."
"Then hurry up."
The young man called back:
"Bring the stretcher I had made earlier so Da Qiao can lie on it and go up the mountain."
So it really is Da Qiao.
Ding Ling’s brow twitched.
He had never expected to be so lucky to encounter such a group of people here!
There doesn’t seem to be such a record in history.
If there were, Yhiuu Ji wouldn’t have been killed by Sun Ce.
But thinking of the players who penetrate everything, Ding Ling understood.
Needless to say, there must be players stirring up trouble again.
Perhaps Da Qiao came to seek Yhiuu Ji’s help because of an injury.
It’s all the work of the players.
Just like Du Qingcheng.
Kidnapped by players and handed over to Yuan Shu!
It’s not something ordinary ’heroes’ could do!
And now, it seems he’s encountered another hero of a similar kind.
What could this hero be after?
Could it be merely to trouble Da and Xiao Qiao, or is it a heroic rescue mission?
Or perhaps another motive?
Ding Ling couldn’t make sense of it, but he didn’t meddle much.
In general.
Ding Ling wouldn’t take the initiative to cause trouble.
Of course, if someone provoked him, no matter who it was, he would find a way to destroy them, especially in this game world.
In the real world, there was no choice but to endure.
Endure even in the game world?
Especially now that he’s become a bona fide absolute expert!
No need to endure in the Three Kingdoms World, right?
Ding Ling had never considered this point.
If he had.
He wouldn’t have fought all the way from the north to the south.
When it’s time to endure, he will endure; when it’s not, he absolutely will not!
"Quickly, be careful."
The stretcher was placed in the carriage.
Before long.
Amid the young man’s shouts.
A woman, pale as paper and seemingly incredibly weak, was brought out.
Although seriously ill, her natural beauty and delicately sculpted features were captivating, like a lotus emerging in full bloom, truly breathtaking!
Ding Ling, who had seen Diao Chan’s beauty many times, also couldn’t help but light up upon first seeing Da Qiao, silently admiring her.
No wonder she’s recorded in history.
Da and Xiao Qiao.
Without exception, truly stunning!
Their charm and allure might be slightly less than Diao Chan’s but comparable to Du Qingcheng.
A woman who can be compared to Du Qingcheng.
Rarely found across Jiuzhou Land.
Seeing these two take spots, no wonder they left their mark in history, cherished by Cao Mengde.
Clip-clop!
A group carried Da Qiao quickly past.
As they passed by Ding Ling’s group, the leading young man couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling a few times; the more he looked, the deeper his apprehension grew.
Seeing Ding Ling gaze at Da and Xiao Qiao, he felt displeased, snorted coldly, cast a disdainful glance at Ding Ling, and left with a flick of his sleeve.
"Who is that?"
Diao Chan was momentarily stunned, then furious:
"How dare he be so rude to our lord!"
Fish Guts Sword slipped from her sleeve; with a delicate shout, she prepared to dismount and teach the young man a lesson.
Ding Ling stopped her, indicating there was no need to make trouble.
Diao Chan remained indignant:
"That person’s gaze is too presumptuous.
All the way here, who would dare to ignore and disdain our lord like this?
I can’t stand it!"
"Let it go."
Ding Ling smiled faintly, watching the young man’s figure disappear into the depths of greenery, and said:
"Different people have different tastes.
Some cherish and like me, and naturally, some despise and wish to kill me.
There’s no need to clash with them over a mere glance.
The world is vast, there are too many people who dislike me.
I can’t argue with all of them, can I?
Let this matter pass."
"The master is magnanimous."
Diao Chan retracted the Fish Guts Sword, glanced at the few standing by the carriage, and coldly said:
"Had it been any other court official, they wouldn’t have been as reasonable as the lord.
These people should be grateful it was you they encountered."
"Heh heh.
The few on guard were fiery youth; one couldn’t help but retort:
"Our young master is the son of the Luoyang Prefect.
His father is a high-ranking court official!
His grandfather even served as Grand Commandant, one of the Three Ministers!
What kind of figure is your lord?
How dare you compare backgrounds with our young master?
Truly oblivious, ignorant, deserves disdain and contempt!"
"Insolent!"
Diao Chan raised her eyebrows sharply, with Fish Guts Sword in hand, pointing at the young man:
"I am a follower of my lord, and you are followers of your young master.
If it’s a matter of followers, my lord could certainly surpass your young master."
"A young lass dares to boast so shamelessly here."
A vibrantly spirited youth suddenly galloped out, shaking a long blade, its resounding clang ringing in all directions:
"I, Ling Cao, would like to see what gives you the courage to speak such big words."
"I’ll satisfy you!"
Diao Chan galloped out too, with Fish Guts Sword flashing like lightning through the clouds, aiming straight at Ling Cao as she rode forward.
Clang!
Soon, the two clashed together.
