chapters.title: Chapter 190 190: It Makes Sense If It's Zhou Yu (1/21)
paragraphs: Ling Cao's face burned hotly, unable to argue further, he turned and walked away.
The other young men stationed by the side were dumbfounded, even more incapable of saying anything further. One by one, they stayed silent, no longer daring to meet Ding Ling's gaze.
It should be known that Ling Cao was already the strongest among them.
Ling Cao was defeated.
On what basis could they challenge?
At this moment.
Ding Ling's image instantly became towering in the hearts of these young men.
Even a mere follower, a woman at that, could defeat Ling Cao!
Imagining this, one could tell that the other followers must be quite extraordinary too!
To have followers this powerful, would the person be ordinary?
They were solemn, anxious, and uneasy, fearing Ding Ling would bear a grudge; some young men got off their horses immediately and apologized to Ding Ling.
To them.
Big figures are not to be provoked.
Saying a word of apology meant avoiding the big figure's grudge against them, an undeniably worthwhile trade.
It is apparent.
They were all smart individuals, skilled at analyzing and calculating gains and losses.
Ding Ling glanced at them deeply, gesturing with a wave that it was nothing.
Only then did they breathe a sigh of relief, once again bowing to Ding Ling before returning to their original positions.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You subdued Ling Cao.]
[Note: Due to Diao Chan's challenge and victory, Ling Cao's attitude greatly changed, and subtle shifts occurred in his perception of you.
He began speculating on your true identity. How could a follower, let alone a woman, be so formidable? He regards you with considerable reverence!
For a short period, he would not dare to provoke or challenge you.]
Ding Ling gasped.
He hadn't done anything.
Yet he received the Achievement Medal.
This was the first time acquiring the Achievement Medal like this.
His eyes shone brightly, feeling that he seemed to have found a new method of earning achievement points.
Of course, the premise is to have followers like Diao Chan, who are loyal and protective!
He truly hadn't expected to gain Achievement Medals this way.
If this were really the case.
With plenty of followers, wouldn't he be invincible?
But it seemed it wouldn't be that easy.
There must be many stringent conditions involved.
Yet without much hint, figuring this out might require personal exploration.
At first, Ding Ling didn't understand why some famous individuals had achievement medals while others did not.
Later, through extensive experimentation, he figured out that achievements already earned by others couldn't be earned again. At least not within a short span of time.
As for the future, whether or not they could be earned,
remains unknown.
The recently acquired achievement medal likely requires extensive experimentation.
Otherwise, why did Zhao Yun intimidate many experts initially, yet receive no achievement medal?
There's surely a lot of intricacies and subtleties involved.
Ding Ling couldn't be bothered with exploration.
He opts to let fate decide.
He doesn't have ample time or inclination to conduct these experiments.
Getting it would be great, but not getting it is inconsequential.
"However..."
Ding Ling thought of Ling Cao and the identity background of the youth they mentioned earlier, feeling his guesses solidifying.
"If I'm not mistaken, that person earlier should have been Zhou Yu."
Zhou Yu, styled Gongjin, a renowned general of the late Eastern Han Dynasty, from Lujiang Shu County.
His father was none other than Luoyang Prefect Zhou Yii, his great-uncle Zhou Jing, and uncle Zhou Zhong were high-ranking officials.
"Worldly heroes and gallant gentlemen from Jiangzuo."
This describes Zhou Yu.
He was later ranked among the sixty-four generals of the Tang's military temple, and seventy-two generals of the Song's military temple. A truly unrivaled general!
And Ling Cao?
He was a renowned general of the late Eastern Han Dynasty, father of Ling Tong.
Ling Cao now mingling with Zhou Yu?
No surprise, it must be due to player intervention. Or perhaps they originally had ties?
Ding Ling couldn't know, nor did he care to ponder.
But given Zhou Yu's presence, it can be certain that players are stirring trouble.
Players are particularly obsessed with breathing techniques and martial arts of famous figures.
Many players are crowding around figures like Huang Zhong and Tong Yuan.
Zhou Yu couldn't possibly be an exception, could he?
It's possible that even a child Zhuge Liang is being tricked by some players as well.
However, given Zhuge Liang's high intellect, who outsmarts who is uncertain.
"Zhou Yu's jealousy is truly intense. I merely glanced at Da and Xiao Qiao, and he couldn't bear it. No wonder Zhuge Liang later angered him to death.
With such a narrow-minded temperament, no matter how ambitious or talented, there's no long-term survival!"
Ding Ling reached clarity at this moment.
It's Zhou Yu, and it makes sense.
Nonetheless, Ding Ling didn't want to engage Zhou Yu in a magical battle until absolutely necessary.
For Ding Ling knew well that in terms of wisdom, he was definitely inferior to Zhou Yu. If he was played for a fool, it would be too embarrassing.
To deal with clever individuals like Zhou Yu, only Thunderbolt Martial Power could decisively suppress and kill before his schemes unfolded.
Tap tap tap!
A series of rapid footsteps suddenly sounded.
"Ding Ling, Ding Ling..."
It was Zhang Zhongjing.
Ding Ling followed the voice to look.
Sure enough.
Zhang Zhongjing approached quickly, waving at Ding Ling with a joyful expression:
"Come quickly with me. I'll take you to see Yhiuu Ji."
"Phew."
Ding Ling let out a long breath.
Giving Zhang Zhongjing a big thumbs up in his heart.
Good job, Medical Saint!
He hurried down his horse and walked toward Zhang Zhongjing.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng followed suit.
Zhao Yun remained in place, guarding the gifts, horses, etc.

He possessed righteous qi, and with recent continuous medicinal baths and Ding Ling's full guidance and teaching, his martial prowess was advancing rapidly, his sharpened spirit growing more intense recently.
One might say he's on the verge of breaking into super-elite expert status.
"Sigh. Yhiuu Ji is too stubborn."
Zhang Zhongjing walked alongside Ding Ling, lamenting:
"I nearly knelt before him. Fortunately, he is somewhat good-hearted. He recognized our friendship and didn't make me reach that point."
Ding Ling promptly expressed sincere gratitude.
Zhang Zhongjing smiled and said:
"We're connected, you and I, no need for formalities."
He paused and said:

"However, Yhiuu Ji might test you shortly; ideally, you'll pass flawlessly. Only then will he impart his knowledge to you. Otherwise, he'll likely dismiss you with superficial teachings, unlikely to disclose treasured breathing techniques or talisman-making methods."
Ding Ling nodded in comprehension:
"I'm not afraid of tests."
Zhang Zhongjing stroked his beard, smiling:
"That's also what I believe, with your talent, if you can't pass the tests, others would have no chance. In my opinion, Yhiuu Ji's skills surely belong to you!"
"I'll take your blessed words, senior."
Ding Ling revitalized himself.
Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan stood slightly behind, watching this unfold with smiling eyes.
They naturally felt heartfelt joy for Ding Ling being so recognized, harboring an extraordinary sense of pride.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 191: Daoist Yhiuu Ji (2/21)
paragraphs: Clatter clatter clatter!
Ding Ling, Zhang Zhongjing, and their group walked up the mountain path, climbing the steps and disappearing into the greenery. Moments later, they appeared at the entrance of the Daoist Temple.
In front of the entrance, many people were queuing, and a steady stream of people was exiting the temple.
As the Great Sun hung high.
The weather turned pleasant.
More and more people came to the temple seeking medical treatment.
The place was bustling, nothing more than this.
Under Zhang Zhongjing's leadership, Ding Ling and the others bypassed various queues and entered the temple.
This scene naturally drew dissatisfaction from many people.

But seeing a Daoist Child leading Ding Ling and the others deeper into the temple, many couldn't help but be puzzled and whispered among themselves, all speculating about the identity of these people from the mountain's foot who were receiving such careful attention from the temple's master.
Even the illustrious Da and Xiao Qiao and Zhou Yu from Lujiang County didn't receive such treatment!
Though Zhou Yu didn't receive such treatment, he still managed to secure a spot at the front of the line.
Seeing this contemptuous Ding Ling actually heading into the temple's inner courtyard, Zhou Yu was stunned, and amidst his shock and anger, he was somewhat perplexed:
"Who exactly is this person? How could he be treated this way by Yhiuu Ji, a secluded master who disregards worldly matters and disdains joining official ranks?!"
Xiao Qiao shook her head in confusion:
"I don't know either. It's my first time seeing him."
"It's my first time seeing him too."
Zhou Yu, puzzled and baffled:
"A foreigner can receive such courtesy from Daoist Yhiuu Ji; it must be related to that physician who just led them inside."
"Physician?"

"Correct. I see he exudes an air of compassion and creation. Undoubtedly, he has practiced a Medical Dao Skill similar to the Medicine King Breathing Technique. Otherwise, he wouldn't have such an outstanding aura. That person came and went swiftly, and in just a moment, brought those few people in. If not for him, who else could it have been?"
Zhou Yu pinpointed the crux in a few words:

"But if you think about it, it makes sense. A person who can earn Daoist Yhiuu Ji's favor would be a physician, and this is logical. However, for those few on the mountain to get into Daoist Yhiuu Ji's inner courtyard through this physician, the cheating is just too blatant."
Zhou Yu sneered, scornful:
"It's clear they are lively individuals, yet they brazenly seek out Daoist Yhiuu Ji in broad daylight during this time when patients need him. It's really selfish and shameless!"
Xiao Qiao was startled but, seeing her elder sister's pained look, nodded in agreement:
"It's indeed a bit selfish. If you want to visit Daoist Yhiuu Ji, shouldn't you wait until we patients are done? It's taking too long; what if something happens to the patients?"
"Exactly."
Zhou Yu whispered furiously:
"You mustn't associate with such selfish, self-centered people. Their eyes only see themselves and ignore others. If Diao Chan gets sicker because of them, they'll be the culprits."
Xiao Qiao, dumbfounded by Zhou Yu, just nodded blankly.
Unbeknownst to Ding Ling, visiting Yhiuu Ji through the backdoor caused Zhou Yu to further misunderstand him, deepening their misunderstanding several times.
He had now become a thorn in Zhou Yu's side.
If he knew.
Ding Ling would surely feel wronged.
What had he even done?
How did he become a foe?
At this moment.
Ding Ling, with Daoist Child and Zhang Zhongjing, had arrived at the deepest part of the inner courtyard to meet Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
He was like an Immortal with white hair and youthful face, light and nimble as the wind, as if ready to ride the wind away at any moment.
His aura was extraordinarily extraordinary.
His presence was profound and deep.
Standing there, majestic and awe-inspiring, he commanded respect!
His eyes were bright, seemingly containing a blazing sun.
He nodded toward Zhang Zhongjing, gestured for the Daoist Child to leave, then sharply turned to Ding Ling, scrutinizing him up and down, and said:
"So you are the super genius praised by Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, the unparalleled medical stronghold Ding Ling?"
"I dare not accept such praise."
Ding Ling solemnly saluted and said:
"I am Ding Ling, greetings to the senior!"
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng also hurriedly greeted with grace.
"Alright then."
Yhiuu Ji waved a hand:
"I am just a wild hermit in the mountains, unaccustomed to formalities, no need to be courteous to me. Let's be direct."
He paused and said:

"I have never met you before and have no relations! Logically speaking, if you seek the Dao from me, without doing a Daoist Child's work for ten or eight years, I would absolutely never teach you my Supreme Skill."
Ding Ling's expression tightened.
Zhang Zhongjing glared at Yhiuu Ji.
Yhiuu Ji coughed lightly, promptly adding:

"Of course, since Zhang Zhongjing is my friend, I can't disregard his face. On his account, I can give you an opportunity. Pass my assessment, and I'll teach you the Technique. Fail, and I must ask you to turn away and leave! From then on, our paths will not cross again. Each may fare well."
Ding Ling's eye twitched twice, Yhiuu Ji's aloof, indifferent, reclusive nature, treating his own Supreme Skill like a treasure, was indeed no different from what Wang Yue and Hua Tuo had said.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had mentally prepared for this.
Thus, he didn't dwell on it excessively, merely nodding:
"Perfectly reasonable."
He cupped his hands:
"Please, senior, present the test!"
"Very well."
Yhiuu Ji slightly raised his eyebrows:
"Your mentality is quite good; if you were too anxious, even if I taught you the Technique, your chances of failure would be huge. Here's what I'll do."
He pointed outside:
"Within the next three days, help me perfectly treat all the patients. That will count as passing the first challenge."
"Can you help out?"
Zhang Zhongjing frowned and asked:
"There's so many people."
"He must do it himself."
Yhiuu Ji smiled wryly:

"If you help him, how could I assess and test him? I just want to see if he truly has reached the Realm of Creation in the Medical Dao as you claim! If his Medical Dao is as you describe, how could I ignore such a genius? I would certainly give you face."
Since Yhiuu Ji said so.
Zhang Zhongjing couldn't say much else, only giving Ding Ling an encouraging and appreciative look.
Ding Ling solemnly nodded.
Then he started asking about procedures and details.
Once he understood.
He strode directly to the front courtyard, took charge from a Daoist Child, and began treating patients.
Initially, upon seeing the tall, imposing Ding Ling, patients assumed he was just passing by. But when Ding Ling sat down and signaled he could see patients, everyone was amazed.
Neither patients nor their families could understand.
How could someone seemingly a mighty general become a physician?
"We're here to see Daoist Yhiuu Ji!"
Someone shouted.
Ding Ling was speechless. Is it necessary to judge based on appearance?
As his strength grew.
After the two External Refining Breathing Techniques engrained into instinct.
The sharpness, dominance, and noble aura exuded by Ding Ling became more intense, making him seem like a noble general rather than a healer with a benevolent heart and compassionate aura!

sentences.text: Clatter clatter clatter!
Ding Ling, Zhang Zhongjing, and their group walked up the mountain path, climbing the steps and disappearing into the greenery.
Moments later, they appeared at the entrance of the Daoist Temple.
In front of the entrance, many people were queuing, and a steady stream of people was exiting the temple.
As the Great Sun hung high.
The weather turned pleasant.
More and more people came to the temple seeking medical treatment.
The place was bustling, nothing more than this.
Under Zhang Zhongjing's leadership, Ding Ling and the others bypassed various queues and entered the temple.
This scene naturally drew dissatisfaction from many people.

But seeing a Daoist Child leading Ding Ling and the others deeper into the temple, many couldn't help but be puzzled and whispered among themselves, all speculating about the identity of these people from the mountain's foot who were receiving such careful attention from the temple's master.
Even the illustrious Da and Xiao Qiao and Zhou Yu from Lujiang County didn't receive such treatment!
Though Zhou Yu didn't receive such treatment, he still managed to secure a spot at the front of the line.
Seeing this contemptuous Ding Ling actually heading into the temple's inner courtyard, Zhou Yu was stunned, and amidst his shock and anger, he was somewhat perplexed:
"Who exactly is this person?
How could he be treated this way by Yhiuu Ji, a secluded master who disregards worldly matters and disdains joining official ranks?!"
Xiao Qiao shook her head in confusion:
"I don't know either.
It's my first time seeing him."
"It's my first time seeing him too."
Zhou Yu, puzzled and baffled:
"A foreigner can receive such courtesy from Daoist Yhiuu Ji; it must be related to that physician who just led them inside."
"Physician?"
"Correct.
I see he exudes an air of compassion and creation.
Undoubtedly, he has practiced a Medical Dao Skill similar to the Medicine King Breathing Technique.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have such an outstanding aura.
That person came and went swiftly, and in just a moment, brought those few people in.
If not for him, who else could it have been?"
Zhou Yu pinpointed the crux in a few words:
"But if you think about it, it makes sense.
A person who can earn Daoist Yhiuu Ji's favor would be a physician, and this is logical.
However, for those few on the mountain to get into Daoist Yhiuu Ji's inner courtyard through this physician, the cheating is just too blatant."
Zhou Yu sneered, scornful:
"It's clear they are lively individuals, yet they brazenly seek out Daoist Yhiuu Ji in broad daylight during this time when patients need him.
It's really selfish and shameless!"
Xiao Qiao was startled but, seeing her elder sister's pained look, nodded in agreement:
"It's indeed a bit selfish.
If you want to visit Daoist Yhiuu Ji, shouldn't you wait until we patients are done?
It's taking too long; what if something happens to the patients?"
"Exactly."
Zhou Yu whispered furiously:
"You mustn't associate with such selfish, self-centered people.
Their eyes only see themselves and ignore others.
If Diao Chan gets sicker because of them, they'll be the culprits."
Xiao Qiao, dumbfounded by Zhou Yu, just nodded blankly.
Unbeknownst to Ding Ling, visiting Yhiuu Ji through the backdoor caused Zhou Yu to further misunderstand him, deepening their misunderstanding several times.
He had now become a thorn in Zhou Yu's side.
If he knew.
Ding Ling would surely feel wronged.
What had he even done?
How did he become a foe?
At this moment.
Ding Ling, with Daoist Child and Zhang Zhongjing, had arrived at the deepest part of the inner courtyard to meet Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
He was like an Immortal with white hair and youthful face, light and nimble as the wind, as if ready to ride the wind away at any moment.
His aura was extraordinarily extraordinary.
His presence was profound and deep.
Standing there, majestic and awe-inspiring, he commanded respect!
His eyes were bright, seemingly containing a blazing sun.
He nodded toward Zhang Zhongjing, gestured for the Daoist Child to leave, then sharply turned to Ding Ling, scrutinizing him up and down, and said:
"So you are the super genius praised by Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, the unparalleled medical stronghold Ding Ling?"
"I dare not accept such praise."
Ding Ling solemnly saluted and said:
"I am Ding Ling, greetings to the senior!"
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng also hurriedly greeted with grace.
"Alright then."
Yhiuu Ji waved a hand:
"I am just a wild hermit in the mountains, unaccustomed to formalities, no need to be courteous to me.
Let's be direct."
He paused and said:
"I have never met you before and have no relations!
Logically speaking, if you seek the Dao from me, without doing a Daoist Child's work for ten or eight years, I would absolutely never teach you my Supreme Skill."
Ding Ling's expression tightened.
Zhang Zhongjing glared at Yhiuu Ji.
Yhiuu Ji coughed lightly, promptly adding:
"Of course, since Zhang Zhongjing is my friend, I can't disregard his face.
On his account, I can give you an opportunity.
Pass my assessment, and I'll teach you the Technique.
Fail, and I must ask you to turn away and leave!
From then on, our paths will not cross again.
Each may fare well."
Ding Ling's eye twitched twice, Yhiuu Ji's aloof, indifferent, reclusive nature, treating his own Supreme Skill like a treasure, was indeed no different from what Wang Yue and Hua Tuo had said.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had mentally prepared for this.
Thus, he didn't dwell on it excessively, merely nodding:
"Perfectly reasonable."
He cupped his hands:
"Please, senior, present the test!"
"Very well."
Yhiuu Ji slightly raised his eyebrows:
"Your mentality is quite good; if you were too anxious, even if I taught you the Technique, your chances of failure would be huge.
Here's what I'll do."
He pointed outside:
"Within the next three days, help me perfectly treat all the patients.
That will count as passing the first challenge."
"Can you help out?"
Zhang Zhongjing frowned and asked:
"There's so many people."
"He must do it himself."
Yhiuu Ji smiled wryly:
"If you help him, how could I assess and test him?
I just want to see if he truly has reached the Realm of Creation in the Medical Dao as you claim!
If his Medical Dao is as you describe, how could I ignore such a genius?
I would certainly give you face."
Since Yhiuu Ji said so.
Zhang Zhongjing couldn't say much else, only giving Ding Ling an encouraging and appreciative look.
Ding Ling solemnly nodded.
Then he started asking about procedures and details.
Once he understood.
He strode directly to the front courtyard, took charge from a Daoist Child, and began treating patients.
Initially, upon seeing the tall, imposing Ding Ling, patients assumed he was just passing by.
But when Ding Ling sat down and signaled he could see patients, everyone was amazed.
Neither patients nor their families could understand.
How could someone seemingly a mighty general become a physician?
"We're here to see Daoist Yhiuu Ji!"
Someone shouted.
Ding Ling was speechless.
Is it necessary to judge based on appearance?
As his strength grew.
After the two External Refining Breathing Techniques engrained into instinct.
The sharpness, dominance, and noble aura exuded by Ding Ling became more intense, making him seem like a noble general rather than a healer with a benevolent heart and compassionate aura!

chapters.title: Chapter 192 192: Xiao Qiao's Unease! Zhou Yu's Jealousy
paragraphs: Is he a healer?
Or to be precise, is he a healer with Dao practice?
Nowadays, many ordinary people can see this clearly at a glance.

Take Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, for example; their Dao practice in the Medical Dao is extremely profound, and their progress in cultivating the Medicine King Breathing Technique and the Medical Saint Breathing Technique is also quite impressive.
Thus, the saintly qi of compassion on them is very evident.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji is the same.

Although Ding Ling hasn't cultivated the related Medical Dao Breathing Techniques, he has studied medical knowledge such as the Inner Scripture, Qingnang Scripture, Five Animals Qigong, and the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases.
Therefore, compared to the appearance and temperament of a typical warrior, he appears more gentle.
But even so.
When compared to the healer's aura of Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, there is still a significant gap.
Naturally, he cannot compare to the worldly masterly aura of Daoist Yhiuu Ji either.
Their temperaments are vastly different.
It's only normal for patients not to trust him, a 'warrior'.
Ding Ling understands.
He didn't speak, just glanced at the Daoist child.
The Daoist child solemnly said:

"Ladies and gentlemen. The person sitting in front of you is a medical genius who has inherited all the knowledge of Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing! He is recognized by Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing. You must have heard of Zhang Zhongjing and Hua Tuo. Do you still have any doubts?"
"But we still want to see Daoist Yhiuu Ji."
Zhou Yu was also at the forefront, seeing Ding Ling—a person he disapproved of—about to treat Da Qiao, became uncomfortable and immediately opposed loudly:

"How can someone who looks like a quack doctor cure someone in critical condition! If his lousy medical skills cause the patient's condition to worsen, who will be responsible? Who can be responsible?!"
He raised his hand and shouted:
"I protest!"
Upon seeing Zhou Yu so concerned for her sister, Xiao Qiao was moved to tears and also shouted adorably:
"I protest!"
Zhou Yu must have practiced some breathing technique; he was elegant, handsome, noble yet domineering, with every move full of charisma.
With his words, many people were influenced and rallied around him.
For a moment.
Protests rang throughout the Ten Directions Realm.
Ding Ling was speechless, wanting to drop everything and leave; watch if you want, if not, leave! Did they really think he wanted to sit here and treat people? If it weren't for the assessment...
Diao Chan, extremely angry, stepped forward and shouted loudly:
"The protest is invalid!!"
Her voice, infused with her unique breathing technique, was even more compelling than Zhou Yu's.
Many were unconsciously drawn to her voice, and the shouts weakened substantially.
This is Diao Chan's charm!
An outstanding woman relying on her charm to reach the super-elite level!
Zhou Yu detected something amiss, secretly thinking things are unfavorable, and immediately said loudly:

"You, a woman, standing at the forefront. What, your family head can no longer speak, or is utterly incapable of defending themselves? Is it that at every critical moment, you must stand out and rescue them? Such an incompetent person, I have every reason to doubt his abilities!"
Clearly.
Zhou Yu had already known about the confrontation between Diao Chan and Ling Cao.
His apprehension and hostility towards Ding Ling deepened further.
Ding Ling also sensed something, feeling inexplicable.
Being targeted by the extremely clever genius Zhou Yu?!
What to do?!
Should he immediately act and eliminate him?
Even such a thought emerged in Ding Ling's mind.
He really feared being calculated by clever people.
But thinking about how with invincible strength, everything could be swept aside, he relieved himself.
Better if they don't come.
If they really dare come,
Ding Ling will let Zhou Yu understand what it means: 'When the scholar encounters a warrior, reasoning can't be explained'! What it means to take on a thousand!!
"Enough!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji finally appeared.
Evidently, he too was 'attracted' by the commotion here, and at this moment, he glanced at Zhou Yu with a slight frown, discontentedly saying:
"This is a Daoist temple, a place of tranquility and inactivity! Anyone continuing to cause such a disturbance can go straight down the mountain."
Without waiting for the slightly changed face of Zhou Yu to refute.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji pointed at Ding Ling and said:
"Ding Ling presiding here is allowed by me! His abilities indeed have gotten the acknowledgment of Zhang Zhongjing and Hua Tuo. In this way, what are you still worried about?"
Since Daoist Yhiuu Ji said so.
Many patients immediately felt relieved and said loudly:
"We misunderstood the Daoist. We apologize. Please don't drive us down the mountain; we came from afar, and it wasn't easy."
"The one misunderstood is not me."

Daoist Yhiuu Ji pointed at Ding Ling: "It's him! Apologize to Ding Ling. Alright, let's end this matter here, line up and come one by one, I will be watching from the side. Are you relieved in this way?"
Patients and their families hurriedly said they dared not and then collectively apologized to Ding Ling.
Except Zhou Yu!
Even when Xiao Qiao tried to apologize, Zhou Yu pulled her back.
Xiao Qiao didn't understand.
Zhou Yu whispered:

"The name Ding Ling sounds too familiar. But I am sure it is not because of medical skills that it sounds familiar. Therefore, his medical skills still need verification. Why rush to apologize? If he really has the ability to cure your sister, then apologize later."
Xiao Qiao looked slightly conflicted:
"This, it may not be good."
Especially seeing others highly respecting Ding Ling, she became even more uneasy, clutching her clothes nervously, she said:
"I'm afraid Ding Ling might misunderstand us and refuse to treat my sister."
"Didn't you see Daoist Yhiuu Ji sitting there?"
Zhou Yu sneered:

"Ding Ling wouldn't dare do anything openly! I see Ding Ling being here treating us is surely a test given by Daoist Yhiuu Ji. As for why Ding Ling is being tested, it's nothing more than a few possibilities. Haha."
He felt both jealous and envious:
"A test coveted by so many people, actually granted to Ding Ling. Annoying! I couldn't even get it!!"
He also wanted to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Skill!
Unfortunately.
Yhiuu Ji was guarding tightly, giving outsiders not a single chance.
Want an opportunity?
Fine.
Be a Daoist child for ten or eight years first!
Who can bear that?
Especially someone like Zhou Yu, asking him to be a Daoist child would be more straightforward than killing him.
Precisely because of this.
He felt envy, jealousy, and hatred towards Ding Ling who inexplicably emerged and received a testing opportunity!!
Why!
He, a local Zhou Yu, couldn't do it.
Yet Ding Ling, an outsider, could?!
Zhou Yu stared at Ding Ling, now fervently hoping Ding Ling would fail the test and then shamefully and embarrassingly roll out of the Daoist temple!
If not, he really couldn't accept the fact that an outsider not only got the opportunity he had dreamt of but also passed the test?
That would be intolerable?!
Just thinking about it, Zhou Yu felt he had the heart to die; he couldn't imagine the consequence if that happened.
At this moment, he even considered whether to stab Ding Ling in the back and sabotage him to ensure Ding Ling's test failed.
But soon.
He scratched this thought as unrealistic!
He could only glare at Ding Ling with wide eyes...

chapters.title: Chapter 193 193: Scoundrel! Let Go of Da Qiao
paragraphs: Pretending to 'pose' for pulse diagnosis, constantly scribbling prescriptions.
"Is it real or fake?"
Seeing Ding Ling flowing like water, everything smooth, akin to the profound appearance of a great doctor of virtue.
Zhou Yu's upright stance gave a jolt, his eyes widened, somewhat disbelieving, even beginning to doubt it.
But seeing Daoist Yhiuu Ji nodding approvingly on the side left him stunned, his heart overturning river and sea, almost unable to control himself:
"This guy actually has some level of skill in the Medical Dao?! Even Daoist Yhiuu Ji is gradually recognizing him! How can this be?"
Swish swish!
A flash of lightning pierced his Sea of Consciousness.
At that instant, he remembered who Ding Ling was.
"The Ding Ling who executed Yan Liang and Wen Chou, broke Jii Ling's encirclement, and defeated the Brocade Sail Pirates in the waters of the Yangtze River?!"
He was shocked, unconsciously taking a step back, a self-defensive instinctive reaction when facing a top-notch strongman.
Zhou Yu quickly came to his senses, his handsome face turning slightly red, somewhat embarrassed, somewhat annoyed.
But fortunately, no one knew that he had been afraid of Ding Ling, which allowed him to quickly compose himself, his eyes shining brightly as he looked at Ding Ling.
Several glances.
Zhou Yu had already confirmed.
This Ding Ling is most likely that Ding Ling!
Just because rumors had it that alongside Ding Ling were two charming women and an extremely valiant spear-wielding military general.
Thinking of the scenes encountered at the foot of the mountain.
Comparing the rumored face, demeanor, and Ding Ling's mount, weapon, and so on.
Zhou Yu was ninety percent sure that the man before him was Ding Ling.
He really hadn't expected to encounter this fierce guy in such a situation!
Moreover, the two sides seemed to have had an unpleasant encounter already.
He felt heavy-hearted, his complexion involuntarily turning somewhat unsightly.
If he had known earlier that this Ding Ling was the Ding Ling who commanded respect across Jiangnan, he absolutely wouldn't have been so rude.
Unfortunately...
Time cannot be rewound.
Distrust had already taken root in their hearts, making peaceful cohabitation impossible!
A myriad of calculations flooded Zhou Yu's mind, pondering whether he should conceive a plan to deal with Ding Ling in Lujiang County.
"Relax."

Ding Ling was performing acupuncture on an old man, with hands quick as lightning, kneading like clouds drifting by, occasionally massaging, pressing, manipulating, with various deft techniques constantly changing.
Like a spring breeze brushing the face, transforming the old man's expression from painful to relaxed, then to joyful.
Even a fool could see.
Ding Ling's medical methods were exceptional and extraordinary!
In just a moment's effort.
Ding Ling prescribed a medication for the old man:
"According to the prescription, go down the mountain to gather two doses of medicine yourself. Within half a month, I guarantee your recovery."
"Thank you, Divine Doctor Ding!"
The old man was immensely grateful, his face full of remorse as he apologized once more for his previous rash behavior.
Ding Ling smiled, indicating that he didn't need to.
The old man remained visibly ashamed, turned red-faced and left.
It was at this moment.
Ding Ling's mood felt a bit lightened.
One cannot deny it.
Treating others, solving medical mysteries one after another, seeing patients and their families full of gratitude, endlessly thankful, thrilled and moved, Ding Ling found it delightful, too.
He certainly was no pervert.
He, of course, deeply respected those who were helpful to others.
Thus, having the opportunity to lend a hand within reasonable conditions was also a fulfilling life experience for him.
One patient after another recovering;
Some ailments incurable, yet through Ding Ling's skills, acupuncture, and other techniques, could temporarily alleviate, with patients leaving with prescriptions.
A period of time later.
It was Da and Xiao Qiao's turn.
Xiao Qiao blushed a little looking at Ding Ling, tugging at her clothing hem, hesitantly speaking about Da Qiao's situation:

"My sister has been like this for seven days, having seen many renowned doctors, all to no avail. We had no option but to seek out the famed Daoist Yhiuu Ji. If you can cure my sister, I'll even kneel for you."
Zhou Yu's complexion darkened, too late to stop, regretting immensely.
This foolish girl!
Hadn't he told her repeatedly not to be overly respectful to Ding Ling?
Why can't she understand?
"A healer's compassion."
Ding Ling's innate acting skill took over, his eyes clear as he looked at Xiao Qiao and solemnly said:
"Healing and tending to the sick is my duty. You don't need to do this."
"Thank you."
Xiao Qiao, her face full of remorse, commented:
"I really shouldn't have...
"Cough cough."
Zhou Yu could endure no more, emitting a couple of dry coughs, pulling Xiao Qiao aside.
Xiao Qiao glanced briefly.
Zhou Yu frantically gestured with his eyes.
Xiao Qiao suddenly understood, but felt uneasy again.
After all, she differed from Zhou Yu, still at an innocent, kind-hearted, and naive age, how could she bare to speak harshly to someone tending to her sister?
She simply couldn't do it.
Zhou Yu seemed to realize this too, just reminding her not to rush to thank, to wait until the cure is effective before expressing gratitude.
Xiao Qiao could only nod blankly, somewhat anxiously watching Ding Ling.
Ding Ling checked Da Qiao's pulse.
It inevitably involved physical contact.
Jealousy flared up in Zhou Yu again.
Even he had never 'performed such rites' with Da Qiao!
Damn it!
"She seems to have been poisoned by an odorless, tasteless toxin."
Ding Ling carefully examined Da Qiao.
His hands frequently touched Da Qiao's eyes, ears, and other areas.
Xiao Qiao blushed and felt embarrassed watching.
Zhou Yu was so enraged that his eyes almost emitted flames, almost unable to restrain himself from drawing his sword and shouting 'vile thief, release Da Qiao!'

Fortunately, Ding Ling was openly treating Da Qiao's illness, and Zhou Yu truly couldn't find a reason to draw his sword. Drawing just due to physical contact might delay Da Qiao's treatment, and Xiao Qiao would never forgive him!
"How could she be poisoned?"
Xiao Qiao was dazed, astonished, puzzled.
"That's a question for you to answer yourselves."
After careful examination, Ding Ling prepared to proceed with acupuncture and massage therapy for Da Qiao, requiring them to move inside.
Unable to resist any longer, Zhou Yu voiced:
"No way! In broad daylight, even as a healer, you cannot treat a patient like this! It's too disrespectful, too vulgar!"
Ding Ling was stunned.
He truly hadn't considered it from that angle, purely intending to detoxify and treat Da Qiao.
Diao Chan, having traveled closely with Ding Ling, was quite familiar with his character. Hearing Zhou Yu's words, she was incensed, immediately pointing her sword at Zhou Yu, scolding sharply:

"Only a person with a filthy mind would misjudge others! Only a rude person would assume others were rude! I've had enough of you! From the mountain base to the summit, my lord has been nothing but courteous. And who repeatedly provoked him? You did!"
Her fury escalating, she reprimanded loudly:

"Shameless, audacious, despicable, arrogant, petty-minded, without any sense of propriety! What right do you have to bark here? If you want treatment, then proceed, if not, then take the lady and leave at once, stop hindering others from getting their treatment!"
Du Qingcheng heard, her almond-shaped eyes widening slightly, a sensation of satisfaction surging from head to toe!!

"This guy actually has some level of skill in the Medical Dao?!
Even Daoist Yhiuu Ji is gradually recognizing him!
How can this be?"
Swish swish!
A flash of lightning pierced his Sea of Consciousness.
At that instant, he remembered who Ding Ling was.
"The Ding Ling who executed Yan Liang and Wen Chou, broke Jii Ling's encirclement, and defeated the Brocade Sail Pirates in the waters of the Yangtze River?!"
He was shocked, unconsciously taking a step back, a self-defensive instinctive reaction when facing a top-notch strongman.
Zhou Yu quickly came to his senses, his handsome face turning slightly red, somewhat embarrassed, somewhat annoyed.
But fortunately, no one knew that he had been afraid of Ding Ling, which allowed him to quickly compose himself, his eyes shining brightly as he looked at Ding Ling.
Several glances.
Zhou Yu had already confirmed.
This Ding Ling is most likely that Ding Ling!
Just because rumors had it that alongside Ding Ling were two charming women and an extremely valiant spear-wielding military general.
Thinking of the scenes encountered at the foot of the mountain.
Comparing the rumored face, demeanor, and Ding Ling's mount, weapon, and so on.
Zhou Yu was ninety percent sure that the man before him was Ding Ling.
He really hadn't expected to encounter this fierce guy in such a situation!
Moreover, the two sides seemed to have had an unpleasant encounter already.
He felt heavy-hearted, his complexion involuntarily turning somewhat unsightly.
If he had known earlier that this Ding Ling was the Ding Ling who commanded respect across Jiangnan, he absolutely wouldn't have been so rude.
Unfortunately...
Time cannot be rewound.
Distrust had already taken root in their hearts, making peaceful cohabitation impossible!
A myriad of calculations flooded Zhou Yu's mind, pondering whether he should conceive a plan to deal with Ding Ling in Lujiang County.
"Relax."

Ding Ling was performing acupuncture on an old man, with hands quick as lightning, kneading like clouds drifting by, occasionally massaging, pressing, manipulating, with various deft techniques constantly changing.
Like a spring breeze brushing the face, transforming the old man's expression from painful to relaxed, then to joyful.
Even a fool could see.
Ding Ling's medical methods were exceptional and extraordinary!
In just a moment's effort.
Ding Ling prescribed a medication for the old man:
"According to the prescription, go down the mountain to gather two doses of medicine yourself.
Within half a month, I guarantee your recovery."
"Thank you, Divine Doctor Ding!"
The old man was immensely grateful, his face full of remorse as he apologized once more for his previous rash behavior.
Ding Ling smiled, indicating that he didn't need to.
The old man remained visibly ashamed, turned red-faced and left.
It was at this moment.
Ding Ling's mood felt a bit lightened.
One cannot deny it.
Treating others, solving medical mysteries one after another, seeing patients and their families full of gratitude, endlessly thankful, thrilled and moved, Ding Ling found it delightful, too.
He certainly was no pervert.
He, of course, deeply respected those who were helpful to others.
Thus, having the opportunity to lend a hand within reasonable conditions was also a fulfilling life experience for him.
One patient after another recovering;
Some ailments incurable, yet through Ding Ling's skills, acupuncture, and other techniques, could temporarily alleviate, with patients leaving with prescriptions.
A period of time later.
It was Da and Xiao Qiao's turn.
Xiao Qiao blushed a little looking at Ding Ling, tugging at her clothing hem, hesitantly speaking about Da Qiao's situation:
"My sister has been like this for seven days, having seen many renowned doctors, all to no avail.
We had no option but to seek out the famed Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
If you can cure my sister, I'll even kneel for you."
Zhou Yu's complexion darkened, too late to stop, regretting immensely.
This foolish girl!
Hadn't he told her repeatedly not to be overly respectful to Ding Ling?
Why can't she understand?
"A healer's compassion."
Ding Ling's innate acting skill took over, his eyes clear as he looked at Xiao Qiao and solemnly said:
"Healing and tending to the sick is my duty.
You don't need to do this."
"Thank you."
Xiao Qiao, her face full of remorse, commented:
"I really shouldn't have...
"Cough cough."
Zhou Yu could endure no more, emitting a couple of dry coughs, pulling Xiao Qiao aside.
Xiao Qiao glanced briefly.
Zhou Yu frantically gestured with his eyes.
Xiao Qiao suddenly understood, but felt uneasy again.
After all, she differed from Zhou Yu, still at an innocent, kind-hearted, and naive age, how could she bare to speak harshly to someone tending to her sister?
She simply couldn't do it.
Zhou Yu seemed to realize this too, just reminding her not to rush to thank, to wait until the cure is effective before expressing gratitude.
Xiao Qiao could only nod blankly, somewhat anxiously watching Ding Ling.
Ding Ling checked Da Qiao's pulse.
It inevitably involved physical contact.
Jealousy flared up in Zhou Yu again.
Even he had never 'performed such rites' with Da Qiao!
Damn it!
"She seems to have been poisoned by an odorless, tasteless toxin."
Ding Ling carefully examined Da Qiao.
His hands frequently touched Da Qiao's eyes, ears, and other areas.
Xiao Qiao blushed and felt embarrassed watching.
Zhou Yu was so enraged that his eyes almost emitted flames, almost unable to restrain himself from drawing his sword and shouting 'vile thief, release Da Qiao!'
Fortunately, Ding Ling was openly treating Da Qiao's illness, and Zhou Yu truly couldn't find a reason to draw his sword.
Drawing just due to physical contact might delay Da Qiao's treatment, and Xiao Qiao would never forgive him!
"How could she be poisoned?"
Xiao Qiao was dazed, astonished, puzzled.
"That's a question for you to answer yourselves."
After careful examination, Ding Ling prepared to proceed with acupuncture and massage therapy for Da Qiao, requiring them to move inside.
Unable to resist any longer, Zhou Yu voiced:
"No way!
In broad daylight, even as a healer, you cannot treat a patient like this!
It's too disrespectful, too vulgar!"
Ding Ling was stunned.
He truly hadn't considered it from that angle, purely intending to detoxify and treat Da Qiao.
Diao Chan, having traveled closely with Ding Ling, was quite familiar with his character.
Hearing Zhou Yu's words, she was incensed, immediately pointing her sword at Zhou Yu, scolding sharply:
"Only a person with a filthy mind would misjudge others!
Only a rude person would assume others were rude!
I've had enough of you!
From the mountain base to the summit, my lord has been nothing but courteous.
And who repeatedly provoked him?
You did!"
Her fury escalating, she reprimanded loudly:
"Shameless, audacious, despicable, arrogant, petty-minded, without any sense of propriety!
What right do you have to bark here?
If you want treatment, then proceed, if not, then take the lady and leave at once, stop hindering others from getting their treatment!"
Du Qingcheng heard, her almond-shaped eyes widening slightly, a sensation of satisfaction surging from head to toe!!

chapters.title: Chapter 194 194: Diao Chan Rebukes Zhou Yu (5/21)
paragraphs: Du Qingcheng silently praised in her heart; if it weren't a public place, she would have been more expressive.
At that moment, she wanted to leap with joy and applauded Diao Chan's words!
She had long found the young man before her quite disagreeable.
How wonderful a person Ding Ling is?
To be provoked like this!
Truly ignorant and reckless!
One should know if Ding Ling unleashes his power, there are not many in the world who can resist him.
Could the young man before them withstand it?
"You!"
Zhou Yu's handsome face turned crimson, almost unable to hold back a spurt of old blood in fury.
Unfortunately, Diao Chan's words were flawless, making it difficult to refute!
She was offering free treatment.
Watch if you like, leave if you don't!
The simplicity and bluntness left Zhou Yu speechless for a moment.
In his urgency and anger, Zhou Yu's chest heaved uncontrollably, his body beginning to tremble violently!
This was a sign of extreme agitation!
"A true man does not argue with women!"
A moment later, Zhou Yu forced out this phrase!
He was not one to easily suffer losses.
Repeatedly rebutted by Diao Chan and unable to bear it anymore, but he couldn't find a point to argue against Diao Chan's words.
He couldn't possibly just leave.
Thus, he had to show generosity.
"Humph."
Diao Chan snorted lightly, sarcastically:
"You are nothing without the strength to even bind a chicken. Even if you were to actually engage in a battle with me, you wouldn't be able to defeat me!"
Zhou Yu was speechless, feeling once again like vomiting blood from anger.
Indeed, he couldn't defeat Diao Chan!
After all, Diao Chan had defeated someone like Ling Cao!
He knew how formidable Ling Cao's skills were.
At present.
Zhou Yu could only swallow his depression and displeasure, making a mental note for revenge. If he didn't take the chance to deal with Diao Chan someday, he wouldn't be called Zhou Yu!
It's really not feasible to strike a woman. So, blame it on Ding Ling!
After all, Ding Ling is Diao Chan's master!
Da Da!
Da Qiao was carried inside.
Xiao Qiao followed all the way.
Zhou Yu also wanted to follow in.
But was blocked by Diao Chan at the door:
"Men are not allowed inside."
"Ding Ling is also a man!"
Zhou Yu's face was livid.
"He is a healer! Are you?"
Diao Chan glanced askance at Zhou Yu.
Zhou Yu's eye corners twitched violently.
He felt offended.
Moreover, he was strongly sensing that he had run into his nemesis today, a rare occurrence stirring his insides.
Why did he stumble time after time in front of a mere woman!
"Please keep your distance."
Diao Chan coldly looked at Zhou Yu:
"There should be a proper distance between men and women. I don't like you being too close to me!"
Zhou Yu remained silent, stepped back two paces, then couldn't help but say:

"I, Zhou Yu, am known far and wide for my handsomeness, talent, and intelligence. Who doesn't know about the hordes of women enamored with me? What confidence do you have to think I'd want to get close to you? Desire you? Adore you?"
"The fact that you just approached me is a fact."
Diao Chan chuckled softly:
"Besides, who longs for you to get close or adore me?"
She paused and added:
"Being liked by someone like you would make me very uncomfortable. Because you're exactly the type of person I despise most!"
Zhou Yu was ashamed and angry:
"As the ancient sayings go, only women and lowly people are hard to deal with! Indeed, it's not wrong. I, a dignified gentleman, don't want to argue with a woman like you!"
"Ha ha."
Diao Chan laughed:
"But it seems you've been debating with me from start to finish, haven't you? Hypocrite!!"
"You!"
"I also have no wish to debate with you."
Diao Chan said calmly before Zhou Yu could reply:
"So please stay away from me. If you waste more words on me, I'll take direct action next time."
Fish Guts Sword slipped from her sleeve.
She held the sword in her hand, gazing coldly at Zhou Yu:
"If you get hurt, don't blame me for showing no mercy!"
"You, you..."
Zhou Yu was so furious that veins bulged on his forehead. At such an age, when had he ever suffered such humiliation? He snorted angrily, turned, and stormed off.
Initially, he wanted to leave directly.
But thinking of Xiao Qiao and Da Qiao, he could only suppress his feelings and wait quietly off to the side.
He glanced at Diao Chan.
Saw her standing guard at the inner door like a Door God.
He couldn't help but feel both jealous and envious of Ding Ling.
If only he, Zhou Yu, had such an extraordinary woman protecting him!
Although Diao Chan had trapped him to the point where he felt ablaze with anger inside!
Yet after calming down.
Zhou Yu also quite admired the daring, eloquence, and loyalty of this woman!
Moreover, this woman is graceful, with a slender figure, captivating eyebrows and eyes, truly holds the beauty of a national treasure!
Such a perfect woman.
Treats Ding Ling so well.
How could Zhou Yu not be jealous?
Because he didn't have it, so he was envious, resentful!
He even felt that he wasn't wrong, someone as excellent as he, Zhou Yu, didn't have a woman like Diao Chan protecting him.
Why would Ding Ling have one?
Is it because his martial skills are high, and he's somewhat skilled in medicine?
Humph!
Zhou Yu pondered:

"Even the best martial skill is just for martial artists, no matter how good the medical skill is, it's just lower-class. Only governing the nation and military strategy are the best choices! Besides, how proficient is Ding Ling's medical skill, still unknown! Even if he is skilled in medicine, so what? He's still not as good as me, Zhou Yu!"
Clunk!
Sometime later.
The door to the inner chamber opened.
Xiao Qiao, along with a Daoist Child, hurried inside the courtyard to fetch medicine.
Zhou Yu intended to follow, but seeing Du Qingcheng following behind, he gave up the idea.
He was thinking.
Would Ding Ling be able to cure Da Qiao?
If he did.
Wouldn't that be a slap in Zhou Yu's face?
Zhou Yu's face carried a somewhat grave, unpleasant expression.
Yet for the moment, he also couldn't think of a flawless plan. After all, Da Qiao's illness had scoured all the renowned doctors in Yangzhou, except for Daoist Yhiuu Ji!
So he could only wait.
After a full hour.
All the patients were growing impatient from waiting.
Suddenly, from within came Xiao Qiao's shout:
"Sister!"
The voice brimming with joy and delight.
Needless to say.
Da Qiao must have been cured.
Sure enough.
With the door to the inner chamber opening once more.
Xiao Qiao supported a woman, her face slightly pale, as they emerged from within.
Compared with her previous pallid demeanour and frail figure.
The woman now appeared significantly better.
Walking with a grace akin to Xi Shi cradling her heart, with eyebrows lightly furrowed, evoking sympathy and leaving the crowd spellbound.
Ding Ling also came out from within.
He did not linger long; he soon resumed consultations, this time at a much faster pace.
Even Da Qiao didn't leave.
She just sat on the side to rest.
Zhou Yu approached and asked:
"Da Qiao, how are you feeling?"
"Much better."
Da Qiao replied with a gentle smile:
"Thank you, Young Master Zhou, for your concern."
She paused and added:
"You've been running around for me during this time, truly it's been troubling you. Once I am fully recovered, I will certainly have my father thank you properly."
"It's what I should do."
Zhou Yu glanced at Xiao Qiao, seeing her still delighted, simply gazing at her sister, he couldn't help but feel melancholic, changing the topic, he asked:
"Ding Ling didn't do anything to you just now, did he?"
As soon as the words left his mouth.
Da Qiao seemed reminded of something and her bright eyes couldn't help but glance towards Ding Ling...

chapters.title: Chapter 195 195: Zhou Yu Wants to Leave! Xiao Qiao's Eyes Turn Red
paragraphs: Da Qiao's pale face was suddenly tinged with a blush, like a shy maiden gazing at her beloved, her eyes like rippling water, full of love and reserve.
Zhou Yu looked, as if struck by lightning, stepping back abruptly in disbelief, staring at Da Qiao:
"You, you..."
"Young Master Zhou."
Da Qiao shyly:
"Don't let your imagination run wild, it's not what you think."
"But you..."
Zhou Yu was about to explain further when Xiao Qiao suddenly interjected:
"Zhou Yu! Can't you see Ding Ling in a different light?"
She was somewhat displeased, feeling sad:
"Ding Ling is doing his best to treat sister, but what about you? What did you say and do before?"
Zhou Yu's face turned slightly pale:
"I, I just..."
"You're just jealous of Ding Ling."
Xiao Qiao's eyes reddened slightly:
"I may be a bit slow, not as smart as you, but can you stop imposing your thoughts on me? I think Ding Ling has done well. He hasn't bothered us. Why do we keep disparaging him over and over?"
She glanced at Da Qiao:
"Now that he's treated sister without holding grudges, we haven't even thanked him. Do we really need to slander and mock him?"
"Xiao Qiao."
Zhou Yu couldn't believe it:
"How can you see me that way?! Would I be jealous of that guy? How could he possibly qualify to make me jealous? It's unbelievable, you're actually getting angry at me over an outsider?!"
"Ding Ling is the Divine Doctor who cured sister. How can you dismiss him as an outsider?"
Xiao Qiao looked steadily at Zhou Yu:
"Young Master Zhou, if you still look down on or reject Ding Ling, you're looking down on my sister and me."
"You, you're calling me what? Young Master Zhou?!"
Zhou Yu widened his eyes, hardly believing:
"Our relationship is so fragile that a so-called Ding Ling can shatter it into pieces? Is it really this fragile?"
"Please stop saying that, okay?"
Xiao Qiao's eyes welled up with tears:
"I've already been so rude to Ding Ling before. I haven't even apologized. Do you really want me to cause trouble with Ding Ling now? What do you see me as? A shrew?"
Zhou Yu, momentarily speechless, panicked and quickly said:
"Xiao Qiao, you've misunderstood. I didn't mean it that way."
"Then what do you mean?"
Xiao Qiao wiped her eyes, slightly bowed her head, and said softly:

"My sister and I are very grateful for your care during this period. But you really don't need to cause a scene with Ding Ling for our sake. Ding Ling is a Divine Doctor, he has already proven himself with facts. He also proved how foolish and rude our previous protest was.
At the time, everyone apologized to Ding Ling.
Except us.
Yet Ding Ling didn't hold grudges and chose to help treat sister.
He worked hard and finally cured sister.
Now you want to make things difficult for him. Don't you think that's too much?"
"I didn't."
Zhou Yu widened his eyes:
"When did I ever make things difficult for him? Heaven knows, I've done nothing."
"It's best that way."
Xiao Qiao seemed quite understanding of Zhou Yu:
"I don't want there to be more conflict or misunderstanding between you and Ding Ling!"
"...Alright."
Zhou Yu said with a sigh:
"Even if it's for you, I'll restrain myself."
"Mm."
Xiao Qiao nodded and didn't speak further.
Zhou Yu stood there, feeling somewhat embarrassed.
Especially when some patients and their families around were pointing and whispering, which pushed Zhou Yu to the brink of shame and anger!
He realized that ever since arriving at the Daoist Temple and encountering Ding Ling and Diao Chan's group, he had been down on his luck!
Ding Ling seemed like a fierce general, no, he indeed was an exceptional warrior!
How could he surpass the many famous doctors of Yangzhou?
And he's still so young!
This was too absurd!
How could one person possibly have such high standards and stages in both Martial Dao and Medical Dao at the same time?
Zhou Yu found it inconceivable!
Searching through the human history of past dynasties.
Zhou Yu couldn't find anyone so young with such top-level achievements in both Medical Dao and Martial Dao!
One must know Ding Ling in Martial Dao defeated Gan Ning!
In Medical Dao, he surpassed almost all the famous doctors known in Yangzhou!
How many people dedicated their entire lives to one path and couldn't reach Ding Ling's standard?
How old is Ding Ling?
Exactly because he pondered over the impossibility of one person excelling in both Martial Dao and Medical Dao.
Zhou Yu stood up to 'protest'!
In the end, reality hit hard!
Ding Ling managed to do it!
"This guy! How can he be so amazing?!"
Zhou Yu couldn't figure it out.
Could there be such a genius in the world?
Even if there was.
There wasn't enough time.
No matter how many geniuses they are, they can only achieve extraordinary accomplishments in one path throughout a lifetime.
How could Ding Ling, at such a young age, achieve so much in two paths?!
The more Zhou Yu thought about it, the more confused, jealous, resentful, and angry he became!
The looks from the surrounding patients and their families were like fuel to the fire, making Zhou Yu's anger even more uncontrollable!
He felt like a clown right now!
The longer he stayed here.
The more unbearable his ugliness became!
He couldn't stay any longer, so he immediately proposed that they leave with Da Qiao and Xiao Qiao.
Da Qiao looked a bit distressed:
"Ding Ling asked us to wait here. Once he's done, he'll perform acupuncture and massage for me. I was bedridden for so long and need a good therapy."
Speaking of acupuncture and massage.
Da Qiao's face turned as red as a ripe apple, shy and enticingly lovely.
The more Zhou Yu watched, the more uncomfortable he became, his jealousy boiling up, almost unable to hold back his reddening eyes.
Especially when Xiao Qiao said:
"Sister's condition is not optimistic. Although it seems to have improved, we decided to stay here for two more days before leaving."
"Two more days?!"
Zhou Yu's handsome face almost twisted:
"Just the two of you?!"
"And Ding Ling's group."
Zhou Yu's eyes twitched, he restrained again and again, eventually managing to hold himself back:
"Men and women should not be too close. I don't think Ding Ling is a good person."
He whispered:
"Look, he goes out and always brings along two graceful women, that says something.
Where do men go adventuring and bring women? And he brings two!
This clearly indicates bad character!
Only someone with strong desires would do such things!"
"Zhou Yu, you!"
Xiao Qiao's almond-shaped eyes glared roundly at Zhou Yu:
"What did you promise me before? You said you wouldn't misunderstand Ding Ling anymore. How long has it been?! You're not keeping your word, you're not a gentleman!"
"I'm not a gentleman?"
Zhou Yu felt a toothache, and his hatred for Ding Ling grew even stronger.
If not for Ding Ling.
He and Xiao Qiao wouldn't have ended up in this situation!
Originally, in a few more years.
When Xiao Qiao grew older.
He planned to marry Xiao Qiao.
But now, with the current situation.
Xiao Qiao's misunderstanding of him was deepening.

sentences.text: Da Qiao's pale face was suddenly tinged with a blush, like a shy maiden gazing at her beloved, her eyes like rippling water, full of love and reserve.
Zhou Yu looked, as if struck by lightning, stepping back abruptly in disbelief, staring at Da Qiao:
"You, you..."
"Young Master Zhou."
Da Qiao shyly:
"Don't let your imagination run wild, it's not what you think."
"But you..."
Zhou Yu was about to explain further when Xiao Qiao suddenly interjected:
"Zhou Yu!
Can't you see Ding Ling in a different light?"
She was somewhat displeased, feeling sad:
"Ding Ling is doing his best to treat sister, but what about you?
What did you say and do before?"
Zhou Yu's face turned slightly pale:
"I, I just..."
"You're just jealous of Ding Ling."
Xiao Qiao's eyes reddened slightly:
"I may be a bit slow, not as smart as you, but can you stop imposing your thoughts on me?
I think Ding Ling has done well.
He hasn't bothered us.
Why do we keep disparaging him over and over?"
She glanced at Da Qiao:
"Now that he's treated sister without holding grudges, we haven't even thanked him.
Do we really need to slander and mock him?"
"Xiao Qiao."
Zhou Yu couldn't believe it:
"How can you see me that way?!
Would I be jealous of that guy?
How could he possibly qualify to make me jealous?
It's unbelievable, you're actually getting angry at me over an outsider?!"
"Ding Ling is the Divine Doctor who cured sister.
How can you dismiss him as an outsider?"
Xiao Qiao looked steadily at Zhou Yu:
"Young Master Zhou, if you still look down on or reject Ding Ling, you're looking down on my sister and me."
"You, you're calling me what?
Young Master Zhou?!"
Zhou Yu widened his eyes, hardly believing:
"Our relationship is so fragile that a so-called Ding Ling can shatter it into pieces?
Is it really this fragile?"
"Please stop saying that, okay?"
Xiao Qiao's eyes welled up with tears:
"I've already been so rude to Ding Ling before.
I haven't even apologized.
Do you really want me to cause trouble with Ding Ling now?
What do you see me as?
A shrew?"
Zhou Yu, momentarily speechless, panicked and quickly said:
"Xiao Qiao, you've misunderstood.
I didn't mean it that way."
"Then what do you mean?"
Xiao Qiao wiped her eyes, slightly bowed her head, and said softly:
"My sister and I are very grateful for your care during this period.
But you really don't need to cause a scene with Ding Ling for our sake.
Ding Ling is a Divine Doctor, he has already proven himself with facts.
He also proved how foolish and rude our previous protest was.
At the time, everyone apologized to Ding Ling.
Except us.
Yet Ding Ling didn't hold grudges and chose to help treat sister.
He worked hard and finally cured sister.
Now you want to make things difficult for him.
Don't you think that's too much?"
"I didn't."
Zhou Yu widened his eyes:
"When did I ever make things difficult for him?
Heaven knows, I've done nothing."
"It's best that way."
Xiao Qiao seemed quite understanding of Zhou Yu:
"I don't want there to be more conflict or misunderstanding between you and Ding Ling!"
"...Alright."
Zhou Yu said with a sigh:
"Even if it's for you, I'll restrain myself."
"Mm."
Xiao Qiao nodded and didn't speak further.
Zhou Yu stood there, feeling somewhat embarrassed.
Especially when some patients and their families around were pointing and whispering, which pushed Zhou Yu to the brink of shame and anger!
He realized that ever since arriving at the Daoist Temple and encountering Ding Ling and Diao Chan's group, he had been down on his luck!
Ding Ling seemed like a fierce general, no, he indeed was an exceptional warrior!
How could he surpass the many famous doctors of Yangzhou?
And he's still so young!
This was too absurd!
How could one person possibly have such high standards and stages in both Martial Dao and Medical Dao at the same time?
Zhou Yu found it inconceivable!
Searching through the human history of past dynasties.
Zhou Yu couldn't find anyone so young with such top-level achievements in both Medical Dao and Martial Dao!
One must know Ding Ling in Martial Dao defeated Gan Ning!
In Medical Dao, he surpassed almost all the famous doctors known in Yangzhou!
How many people dedicated their entire lives to one path and couldn't reach Ding Ling's standard?
How old is Ding Ling?
Exactly because he pondered over the impossibility of one person excelling in both Martial Dao and Medical Dao.
Zhou Yu stood up to 'protest'!
In the end, reality hit hard!
Ding Ling managed to do it!
"This guy!
How can he be so amazing?!"
Zhou Yu couldn't figure it out.
Could there be such a genius in the world?
Even if there was.
There wasn't enough time.
No matter how many geniuses they are, they can only achieve extraordinary accomplishments in one path throughout a lifetime.
How could Ding Ling, at such a young age, achieve so much in two paths?!
The more Zhou Yu thought about it, the more confused, jealous, resentful, and angry he became!
The looks from the surrounding patients and their families were like fuel to the fire, making Zhou Yu's anger even more uncontrollable!
He felt like a clown right now!
The longer he stayed here.
The more unbearable his ugliness became!
He couldn't stay any longer, so he immediately proposed that they leave with Da Qiao and Xiao Qiao.
Da Qiao looked a bit distressed:
"Ding Ling asked us to wait here.
Once he's done, he'll perform acupuncture and massage for me.
I was bedridden for so long and need a good therapy."
Speaking of acupuncture and massage.
Da Qiao's face turned as red as a ripe apple, shy and enticingly lovely.
The more Zhou Yu watched, the more uncomfortable he became, his jealousy boiling up, almost unable to hold back his reddening eyes.
Especially when Xiao Qiao said:
"Sister's condition is not optimistic.
Although it seems to have improved, we decided to stay here for two more days before leaving."
"Two more days?!"
Zhou Yu's handsome face almost twisted:
"Just the two of you?!"
"And Ding Ling's group."
Zhou Yu's eyes twitched, he restrained again and again, eventually managing to hold himself back:
"Men and women should not be too close.
I don't think Ding Ling is a good person."
He whispered:
"Look, he goes out and always brings along two graceful women, that says something.
Where do men go adventuring and bring women?
And he brings two!
This clearly indicates bad character!
Only someone with strong desires would do such things!"
"Zhou Yu, you!"
Xiao Qiao's almond-shaped eyes glared roundly at Zhou Yu:
"What did you promise me before?
You said you wouldn't misunderstand Ding Ling anymore.
How long has it been?!
You're not keeping your word, you're not a gentleman!"
"I'm not a gentleman?"
Zhou Yu felt a toothache, and his hatred for Ding Ling grew even stronger.
If not for Ding Ling.
He and Xiao Qiao wouldn't have ended up in this situation!
Originally, in a few more years.
When Xiao Qiao grew older.
He planned to marry Xiao Qiao.
But now, with the current situation.
Xiao Qiao's misunderstanding of him was deepening.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 196: Disciples of Nanhua Old Immortal (7/21)
paragraphs: Will his future marriage go smoothly?
Zhou Yu currently has no confidence,
Since he was born, Zhou Yu has had smooth sailing in love, career, and studies without any obstacles!
This also made him extremely confident and flamboyant.
However, his nature also makes him regard anyone approaching and eyeing Xiao Qiao as a beastly threat!
Ding Ling staring at Xiao Qiao for just a couple of glances made him upset!
He felt offended.
Now Xiao Qiao is going to spend a few days with Ding Ling and others!
How could Zhou Yu tolerate this?
Not bursting with anger or storming off is already great restraint.
But still being criticized by Xiao Qiao for not being a gentleman.
Zhou Yu could no longer hold back, his face changed dramatically, and he turned to leave.
Yet he caught a glimpse of Xiao Qiao's delicate yet slightly forlorn expression, and his heart softened. He sighed and sat down next to Xiao Qiao:
"I'll stay with you here for a couple of days."
Xiao Qiao said nothing.
Da Qiao then said:
"Wouldn't it be too much trouble for Young Master Zhou?"
"Not at all."
Zhou Yu forcibly suppressed his negative emotions:
"I have plenty of time. I don't mind these two days."
Da Qiao expressed her thanks.
Ding Ling demonstrated with his skills what it means to be a peerless healer, with unsurpassed medical artistry!
All patients treated by him.
As long as they aren't too old and beyond saving.
Even those critically ill and near death could gradually regain vitality under his miraculous hands.
More and more people witnessed the miracles he performed.
Naturally, the admiration and commendation for him also grew.
Yhiuu Ji observed all this with astonishment.
Zhang Zhongjing stroked his beard with satisfaction, saying:

"I told you long before, Ding Ling is indeed an unparalleled and supreme talent in the Medical Dao! Searching through five thousand years, you probably couldn't find such an extraordinary genius! Did you believe it then? Now you must believe it."
"I believe it, I do."
Yhiuu Ji sighed deeply:
"Even though you're my good friend. What you said was indeed too extraordinary. It's normal for me to have doubts, right?"
"Indeed."
Zhang Zhongjing seemed to think of something, agreeing deeply:

"Perhaps Hua Tuo also considered this point; even though he praised Ding Ling extensively in the letter, he still didn't detail Ding Ling's powerful talents completely, perhaps fearing I wouldn't believe it, which would lead to a conflict with Ding Ling, or even drive Ding Ling away. But I'm different."
He smiled slightly:
"This time I came to see you myself, so naturally I can praise Ding Ling without any reservations. You didn't believe it just now, but you have no choice now. The facts are right in front of you."
"What you say is true."
Yhiuu Ji pondered for a while and said:

"But although Ding Ling has this talent of learning instantly and mastering quickly in the Medical Dao, in the Inner Refining Breathing Technique and making talismans, he may not have the same talent. Wouldn't you say?"
He smiled slightly:
"After all, these are two entirely different fields."
Zhang Zhongjing was speechless.
"Hehe."
Yhiuu Ji chuckled softly:
"The truth will be revealed in three days. Frankly, I don't believe Ding Ling can have such talent in the Inner Refining Breathing Technique and making talismans either.
After all, from ancient to present times, there hasn't been anyone who could learn and master instantly in the Inner Refining Breathing Technique or talisman making!
Even the Nanhua Old Immortal who taught me the Divine Skill Secret Manual.
He also didn't have such capabilities."
"Speaking of Nanhua Old Immortal, where is he now?"
Zhang Zhongjing turned his eyes.
"As far as I know, after giving the Taiping Sutra to Zhang Jiao, the Nanhua Old Immortal disappeared without a trace."
Yhiuu Ji sighed:
"Perhaps he vanished into thin air, or perhaps he ascended to immortality. I'm not quite sure."
"If even you, his disciple, aren't clear, then no one else could possibly know."
Zhang Zhongjing was in awe:

"Such a divine being, I really wish to see him. If he could impart some of his medical skills to me, that would be wonderful. I am currently compiling the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, collecting medical books and prescriptions from across the world. I think if Nanhua Old Immortal has medical books, they would definitely be extraordinary, and if integrated into the Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, your treatise would certainly reach great perfection more swiftly!"
"You better stop dreaming."
Yhiuu Ji was surprised and laughed:

"I couldn't even find Zuo Ci, let alone meet him. As for Nanhua Old Immortal, it's even more of a long shot. Moreover, calling him my master was merely because, like Zhang Jiao, he only gave me a volume of Secret Manual.
This Secret Manual, different from Zhang Jiao's, is called Taiping Qingling Dao!
"What's the difference?"

"According to Nanhua Old Immortal, the Taiping Sutra encompasses Inner Refining Breathing Techniques, mystical magics, medical skills, talisman making skills, and so on, being extremely comprehensive.
Meanwhile, my Taiping Qingling Dao only contains two, apart from the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, it's just the Talisman Making Skill."
He felt deeply regretful:

"Sadly, after Zhang Jiao's death, the divine book Taiping Sutra also disappeared without a trace. I've searched for it once, but to no avail, so I gave up the idea of persistently searching for it. If fate blesses me, I would be fortunate to acquire it. To lose it is my destiny. To cultivate the Taiping Qingling Dao into the Transformation Realm, perhaps is a life-long endeavor for me.
Therefore, though it's a pity, I'm not greedy."
"What about Zuo Ci?"
Zhang Zhongjing was curious:
"You once said Zuo Ci is also your fellow disciple. What did he learn?"
"Not sure, but it may be the Escape Armor Illusion Technique."
Yhiuu Ji speculated:
"Zuo Ci's Divine Travel is erratic and unfathomable, related to Escape Armor and Illusion, so I suppose he got part of the true teachings from Nanhua Old Immortal."
The conversation between Yhiuu Ji and Zhang Zhongjing.
Ding Ling did not know.
With the rapid increase in his proficiency and experience points,
his healing speed also grew faster and faster.
Already mastered the Great Success Qingnang Scripture, Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, etc.

Now with increased proficiency, Ding Ling effortlessly pinpointed the key issues in a patient with a casual gesture, and either therapeutically massaged and performed acupuncture or directly prescribed the right medicine.
His hands moved like lightning.
He wrote with divine assistance.
One by one, people temporarily regained vitality through his treatment, and one by one, people left with prescriptions.
The title of Divine Doctor for Ding Ling.
Was recognized by more and more people.
[Achievement Medal: You earned the high recognition of Xiao Qiao.]
[Note: You healed Da Qiao without holding grudges. Xiao Qiao, while feeling guilty, also grew grateful; she is pondering how to formally apologize and thank you.]
[Achievement Medal: You received the deep recognition of Da Qiao.]

[Note: You have already had physical contact with Da Qiao. Even though you were simply treating her professionally! For an unmarried young lady, your actions have already pierced her heart like a sword.
She has formed a very profound impression of you.
Unexpectedly. If your relationship develops further. She might secretly fall for you, plant seeds of affection.]
