chapters.title: Chapter 197 197: Da Qiao's Gracious Invitation
paragraphs: [Achievement Medal Earned: Divine Doctor's Skillful Hands]

[Note: In less than half a day, you efficiently and swiftly treated over a hundred patients. Each patient was highly satisfied with your skills. They feel your medical expertise surpasses all the renowned doctors in Yangzhou! They're willing to call you a Skillful Divine Doctor!]
You earned three Achievement Medals.
Among them, the second Achievement Medal.
Made Ding Ling's heart leap wildly.
He really did not expect it.
Da Qiao turned out to be as conservative and traditional as Du Qingcheng and the others.
Moreover, the main thing is, Da Qiao seemingly doesn't have a sweetheart yet!
If I were to court Da Qiao, would Sun Ce rush to fight me?
But thinking that Sun Ce is still mingling with Yuan Shu, being a stranger to Da Qiao, Ding Ling was relieved.
Besides.
Even if they are acquainted.
Ding Ling was not apprehensive.
If they anger him, a single sword strike would surely keep them subdued; if not, it's simply feasible—death is more straightforward!
Hence.
After seeing Da Qiao's related prompts, Ding Ling quickly relaxed.
He decided to let things develop naturally.
In the blink of an eye, evening came.
After finishing dinner.
Ding Ling, by the light of the oil lamp, continued with Da Qiao's therapy.
An hour later.
Da Qiao emerged from the inner room with a face flushed with bashful color.
Zhou Yu watched with an eye twitch, really wanting to shout at Ding Ling, "Beast!" "Scoundrel!"
But seeing the joyful appearance of Xiao Qiao, he had to forcibly swallow back his words.
Days like these pass quickly.
After Da and Xiao Qiao stayed for two days.
Following Ding Ling's special care, Da Qiao was already vibrant and lively.
She, accompanied by Xiao Qiao, expressed her gratitude to Ding Ling multiple times and graciously invited Ding Ling to visit the Qiao Family:
"My father would be delighted to meet you, Ding Ling."
At first, Da and Xiao Qiao called Ding Ling Divine Doctor Ding.
Ding Ling found this uncomfortable, and asked them to call him by name instead.
The two girls listened obediently and affectionately called Ding Ling by name for several days.
Two days passed.
Zhou Yu seemed to be looking thinner.
These two days, he was restless, constantly watching Ding Ling, without thinking about food or drink.
Moreover, he kept pondering why Ding Ling would possess such high talent.
When he roundabout learned some detailed information about Ding Ling from Zhang Zhongjing, he was shocked, exclaiming it couldn't be possible!
Zhang Zhongjing proudly explained to Zhou Yu with honor:
"I also think it's impossible, because it's just too overturning of common beliefs! But, it's unbeatable; this is the truth, you can only accept it!"
Since then, Zhou Yu's look at Ding Ling grew increasingly curious and wary.
He watched Xiao Qiao closely.
Fearing that Xiao Qiao would develop admiration, lauding emotions for Ding Ling!
This was the root of his looking haggard and appearing slimmer over the past two days.
But no matter how closely he watched.
Ding Ling's exceptional medical skills, his effortless acupuncture and massage techniques.
Still left Da and Xiao Qiao in wonder, and they revered him.
Seeing this, Zhou Yu felt his heart shatter; were it not that he couldn't actually defeat Ding Ling, he estimated he would have thoughts of settling the score with Ding Ling!
At this moment, seeing Da and Xiao Qiao invite Ding Ling home to meet their father, his heart tightened, and he hurriedly said:
"Ding Ling still has to complete Daoist Yhiuu Ji's test, probably won't have time to go."
"No worries."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji seemed to bring up the inconvenient topics:
"Ding Ling's test will end in half a day, you might as well stay an extra one or two days, then you can leave together."
"That's great!"
Xiao Qiao rejoiced:
"My sister has been talking about how to repay Ding Ling these days. We can't just leave like that. Let's stay two more days."
Zhou Yu became so enraged that his chest clenched, nearly spat out a mouthful of old blood!
Exactly meeting the worst fear!
Must it be like this with him?
"Xiao Qiao, didn't we say we'd stay only two days?"
Zhou Yu quietly reminded:
"It's time to go back, or else your father will worry."
"It's alright."
Xiao Qiao replied brightly:
"I already sent the guards ahead to report back safely."
Zhou Yu helplessly looked up to the heavens.
Da Qiao just happened to say at this time:
"If Young Master Zhou is eager to return, you could go ahead while I ask Ding Ling for a ride back."
"...I'm not in a hurry!"
Zhou Yu was nearly grinding his teeth, took a deep breath, and said slowly:
"No need to trouble Ding Ling. People should complete what they start; I brought them, so it's only right I take them back personally!"
He declared his authority.
He had silently warned Ding Ling countless times.
Though he had never explicitly stated.
Nor indirectly mentioned.
But the insinuation was clearly Da and Xiao Qiao were his, Zhou Yu's people! Especially Xiao Qiao, she was Zhou Yu's favored woman! Others better not entertain any thoughts.
Ding Ling naturally caught on, but he didn't bother arguing with Zhou Yu.
These days he was too tired to look at Zhou Yu, let alone talk.

Were it not for the fact that Zhou Yu hadn't actually affronted him yet, and considering here is Daoist Yhiuu Ji's Daoist Temple, during a test period, it wouldn't be appropriate to act too bold or rude in front of Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Ding Ling certainly would make Zhou Yu understand why flowers are as red as they are!
Really what absurdity!
Continuously provoking Ding Ling again and again.
Did he really think Ding Ling was a mere clay figurine?!
After the initial confusion, Ding Ling, through these days of interaction with Zhou Yu, found him to be an 'arrogant,' self-conceited, extremely egotistic person.
And now, he wasn't yet the later great success type Handsome Zhou Yu, his literacy, Martial Arts, Military Strategy, etc., hadn't reached the Transformation Realm.
Confronting such a Zhou Yu.
If Ding Ling were to slap him dead, who could do anything about it?
Precisely because he understood clearly.
Over these days, Ding Ling felt increasingly calm, relaxed, and serene.
Another half-day passed.
Ding Ling smoothly passed his first test.
[Achievement Medal Earned: E-level Achievement Medal of Recognition from Daoist Yhiuu Ji.]

[Note: Your medical skills, personal traits, and talent in the Medical Dao have impressed Daoist Yhiuu Ji. He acknowledged you. Yet, for deeper recognition, you may need to continue exhibiting exceptional performance!]
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
Having obtained recognition.
Indicating there would be no issues with this test.
But earning only E-level Achievement Medal from Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Seems like Daoist Yhiuu Ji must also be a Super-Elite Expert. Yet he was killed by Sun Ce, so perhaps not reaching marks in strength, agility? Or perhaps a Super-Elite physique?
The real story.
Remains unknown.
Perhaps when Ding Ling learns all the Techniques of Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
He will gain realization.
"Excellent."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji looked at Ding Ling with glowing admiration, praised applauding:

"Your standard of Medical Dao is extremely high. Even Zhang Zhongjing feels inadequate. Truly, it exceeds expectations. Over these past days, observing and studying your medical techniques attentively, can only say you closely inherit the true skills of Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing. If not for Talisman Water, I'm far inferior to you."

Besides.
Even if they are acquainted.
Ding Ling was not apprehensive.
If they anger him, a single sword strike would surely keep them subdued; if not, it's simply feasible—death is more straightforward!
Hence.
After seeing Da Qiao's related prompts, Ding Ling quickly relaxed.
He decided to let things develop naturally.
In the blink of an eye, evening came.
After finishing dinner.
Ding Ling, by the light of the oil lamp, continued with Da Qiao's therapy.
An hour later.
Da Qiao emerged from the inner room with a face flushed with bashful color.
Zhou Yu watched with an eye twitch, really wanting to shout at Ding Ling, "Beast!" "Scoundrel!"
But seeing the joyful appearance of Xiao Qiao, he had to forcibly swallow back his words.
Days like these pass quickly.
After Da and Xiao Qiao stayed for two days.
Following Ding Ling's special care, Da Qiao was already vibrant and lively.
She, accompanied by Xiao Qiao, expressed her gratitude to Ding Ling multiple times and graciously invited Ding Ling to visit the Qiao Family:
"My father would be delighted to meet you, Ding Ling."
At first, Da and Xiao Qiao called Ding Ling Divine Doctor Ding.
Ding Ling found this uncomfortable, and asked them to call him by name instead.
The two girls listened obediently and affectionately called Ding Ling by name for several days.
Two days passed.
Zhou Yu seemed to be looking thinner.
These two days, he was restless, constantly watching Ding Ling, without thinking about food or drink.
Moreover, he kept pondering why Ding Ling would possess such high talent.
When he roundabout learned some detailed information about Ding Ling from Zhang Zhongjing, he was shocked, exclaiming it couldn't be possible!
Zhang Zhongjing proudly explained to Zhou Yu with honor:
"I also think it's impossible, because it's just too overturning of common beliefs!
But, it's unbeatable; this is the truth, you can only accept it!"
Since then, Zhou Yu's look at Ding Ling grew increasingly curious and wary.
He watched Xiao Qiao closely.
Fearing that Xiao Qiao would develop admiration, lauding emotions for Ding Ling!
This was the root of his looking haggard and appearing slimmer over the past two days.
But no matter how closely he watched.
Ding Ling's exceptional medical skills, his effortless acupuncture and massage techniques.
Still left Da and Xiao Qiao in wonder, and they revered him.
Seeing this, Zhou Yu felt his heart shatter; were it not that he couldn't actually defeat Ding Ling, he estimated he would have thoughts of settling the score with Ding Ling!
At this moment, seeing Da and Xiao Qiao invite Ding Ling home to meet their father, his heart tightened, and he hurriedly said:
"Ding Ling still has to complete Daoist Yhiuu Ji's test, probably won't have time to go."
"No worries."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji seemed to bring up the inconvenient topics:
"Ding Ling's test will end in half a day, you might as well stay an extra one or two days, then you can leave together."
"That's great!"
Xiao Qiao rejoiced:
"My sister has been talking about how to repay Ding Ling these days.
We can't just leave like that.
Let's stay two more days."
Zhou Yu became so enraged that his chest clenched, nearly spat out a mouthful of old blood!
Exactly meeting the worst fear!
Must it be like this with him?
"Xiao Qiao, didn't we say we'd stay only two days?"
Zhou Yu quietly reminded:
"It's time to go back, or else your father will worry."
"It's alright."
Xiao Qiao replied brightly:
"I already sent the guards ahead to report back safely."
Zhou Yu helplessly looked up to the heavens.
Da Qiao just happened to say at this time:
"If Young Master Zhou is eager to return, you could go ahead while I ask Ding Ling for a ride back."
"...I'm not in a hurry!"
Zhou Yu was nearly grinding his teeth, took a deep breath, and said slowly:
"No need to trouble Ding Ling.
People should complete what they start; I brought them, so it's only right I take them back personally!"
He declared his authority.
He had silently warned Ding Ling countless times.
Though he had never explicitly stated.
Nor indirectly mentioned.
But the insinuation was clearly Da and Xiao Qiao were his, Zhou Yu's people!
Especially Xiao Qiao, she was Zhou Yu's favored woman!
Others better not entertain any thoughts.
Ding Ling naturally caught on, but he didn't bother arguing with Zhou Yu.
These days he was too tired to look at Zhou Yu, let alone talk.

Were it not for the fact that Zhou Yu hadn't actually affronted him yet, and considering here is Daoist Yhiuu Ji's Daoist Temple, during a test period, it wouldn't be appropriate to act too bold or rude in front of Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Ding Ling certainly would make Zhou Yu understand why flowers are as red as they are!
Really what absurdity!
Continuously provoking Ding Ling again and again.
Did he really think Ding Ling was a mere clay figurine?!
After the initial confusion, Ding Ling, through these days of interaction with Zhou Yu, found him to be an 'arrogant,' self-conceited, extremely egotistic person.
And now, he wasn't yet the later great success type Handsome Zhou Yu, his literacy, Martial Arts, Military Strategy, etc., hadn't reached the Transformation Realm.
Confronting such a Zhou Yu.
If Ding Ling were to slap him dead, who could do anything about it?
Precisely because he understood clearly.
Over these days, Ding Ling felt increasingly calm, relaxed, and serene.
Another half-day passed.
Ding Ling smoothly passed his first test.
[Achievement Medal Earned: E-level Achievement Medal of Recognition from Daoist Yhiuu Ji.]
[Note: Your medical skills, personal traits, and talent in the Medical Dao have impressed Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
He acknowledged you.
Yet, for deeper recognition, you may need to continue exhibiting exceptional performance!]
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
Having obtained recognition.
Indicating there would be no issues with this test.
But earning only E-level Achievement Medal from Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Seems like Daoist Yhiuu Ji must also be a Super-Elite Expert.
Yet he was killed by Sun Ce, so perhaps not reaching marks in strength, agility?
Or perhaps a Super-Elite physique?
The real story.
Remains unknown.
Perhaps when Ding Ling learns all the Techniques of Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
He will gain realization.
"Excellent."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji looked at Ding Ling with glowing admiration, praised applauding:
"Your standard of Medical Dao is extremely high.
Even Zhang Zhongjing feels inadequate.
Truly, it exceeds expectations.
Over these past days, observing and studying your medical techniques attentively, can only say you closely inherit the true skills of Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing.
If not for Talisman Water, I'm far inferior to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 198 198: Passing the Second Trial
paragraphs: Daoist Yhiuu Ji rose and spoke aloud:
"Alright. I won't drag this out with you. Let's start the second test directly."
Ding Ling sat solemnly, upright and serious.
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhou Yu, and others watched from the side and rear.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng felt greatly honored.
Da and Xiao Qiao were happy for Ding Ling.
Zhou Yu was incredibly jealous.
Zhang Zhongjing watched with pride, stroking his beard.
Zhao Yun also watched these events unfold with a smile.
He had already moved into the Daoist Temple days before, and his mount and other things were naturally looked after by the temple's Daoist Child, so there was no need to worry.

"For the second test, I'll assess your Talisman Painting skills. If you can perfectly replicate a talisman, I might consider teaching you the Talisman Water curing technique. Otherwise, don't even think about it."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji directly took out a 'talisman' and laid it on the table, saying:
"Without the ability to replicate this talisman, even if I teach you the Talisman Making Technique, you'll gain nothing."
He sighed deeply:

"Back then, I suffered greatly to make my Talisman Painting skills second nature. It took at least six or seven years of hard work to reach the ideal level. Only then did I dare to learn talisman making. Otherwise, if I learned recklessly, I'd have a ninety-nine percent chance of failure! That would be a waste of time."
"Indeed."
Zhang Zhongjing agreed deeply:
"I also learned back then. But unfortunately, I lacked talent in this area. I failed. Looking back, it really is a pity."
Hua Tuo mentioned that Zhang Zhongjing had sought Yhiuu Ji's guidance on the Talisman Water curing technique.
That must have been the time.
Zhang Zhongjing had been exposed to the Inner Refining Breathing Technique and Talisman Making Technique.
But clearly, he had only scratched the surface.
If not for that.
Zhang Zhongjing wouldn't need to bring Ding Ling to meet Yhiuu Ji; he could teach him himself.
But hearing Zhang Zhongjing's words now, it's clear that he only learned the basics and didn't grasp the True Essence.
If one can't even learn the basics.
Then there's no need to learn the True Essence; it's definitely a waste of time!
"So is this why you've kept a Daoist Child here for seven or eight years?"
Zhou Yu realized:
"To ensure the Daoist Child can perform talisman replication?"
"You could say that."
"What if I can replicate a talisman?"
Zhou Yu was eager to try:
"Can I skip the Daoist Child's time?"
"No."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji decisively refused:
"I don't know you well enough; why should I teach you?"
Zhou Yu felt a pang in his heart, having been struck once again.
He walked to the side dejectedly.
He didn't ask why Ding Ling could be taught.
Because it was obvious that Ding Ling had used connections and passed the first test!
If there truly was such a test.
He wouldn't pass the first test.
Although he was confident about the second test.
But if he couldn't pass the first, how could he proceed to the second?
"Let's begin."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji clapped his hands.
The Daoist Child prepared brush, ink, paper, inkstone, and other materials on the table.
Ding Ling solemnly stood up.
He approached the table, took up the brush, and began replicating the talisman.
His drawing skills were at Full Level.
Calligraphy skills at Full Level.
Wood carving, relief carving, paper carving, and other carving skills at Full Level.
For him to replicate a talisman.
It's like asking a doctoral student to solve elementary school problems!
Don't make it too easy!
Brush, brush!
But Ding Ling raised the brush, and moments later, it was completed.
A perfect talisman took shape.
The proportions and appearance were almost replicated one-to-one.
If you didn't look closely.
You couldn't tell the difference between the two talismans!
"Hmm?!"
Zhou Yu was wide-eyed.
"So fast?!"
Zhang Zhongjing was moved.
"How is this possible?!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was incredulous.
Zhao Yun boasted with a sense of accomplishment:

"Ding Ling knows astronomy and geography, plays music, calligraphy, painting, chess, carving, and all sorts of skills, proficient in everything! Talisman painting is just a small task for him, with no difficulty at all."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng repeatedly nodded, feeling a sense of collective honor, chiming in from time to time.
Da and Xiao Qiao looked at Ding Ling with surprise and admiration.
They truly hadn't expected it.
Ding Ling wasn't just a Military General and Divine Doctor; he knew everything, mastered everything! It's amazing!
How could there be such a perfect person in this world?!
Before, they secretly worried for Ding Ling.
Now it seems, they were overthinking.
Such a talented person surely could perfectly pass Daoist Yhiuu Ji's test and thus obtain the qualifications to learn the Talisman Making Technique and the Inner Refining Breathing Technique!
"I don't believe that there could be such a talented person in this world."
Seeing Da and Xiao Qiao's expressions, Zhou Yu's jealousy and resentment drove him to step forward and exclaim loudly:
"Unless Ding Ling can prove himself!"
"Why should I prove myself?"
Ding Ling countered:
"You can believe it or not believe it."
"That's right."
Diao Chan nodded:
"Believe it or not!"
Da and Xiao Qiao were a bit embarrassed and gave Zhou Yu frantic eye signals, indicating he shouldn't upset Diao Chan and the others.
Ultimately, Da and Xiao Qiao and Zhou Yu were lesser guests here.
Ding Ling and his group were the main guests!
They were only permitted to stay here because of Ding Ling.
If conflict arises and Ding Ling is invited elsewhere, wouldn't that make things more awkward and shameful?
"Hmph."
At that moment, Zhou Yu was nearly driven mad.
He simply didn't believe there could be such a versatile person in the world!
Someone who could use Martial Power to intimidate the Yangtze River's banks.
And cure patients with medical skills!
Plus, possess such skill in talisman replication.
If Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting were also mastered, how did he learn?
Even if he started learning from the womb.
At Ding Ling's age, it's impossible to master so much knowledge and ability!
Zhou Yu was certain of this.
Though there were rumors from Jizhou that Ding Ling had once bested Jizhou scholars in painting and other arts! But without seeing it firsthand, Zhou Yu remained highly skeptical.
So, consumed by jealousy, he ignored the consequences and stepped forward, shouting:

"Ding Ling, do you dare to make a bet with me? We'll compete in Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting. If you can beat me, I'll leave without a word, and whenever I see you, I'll avoid you by three feet. Otherwise, it's the opposite!"
"Alright."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Do you dare to raise the bet? The loser passes all martial arts skills to the winner."
"There's nothing..."
In his impulse, Zhou Yu was about to agree, but quickly swallowed his words:
"The family's Supreme Skill mustn't be shared!"
"Fine."
Ding Ling looked at Daoist Yhiuu Ji:
"Please, senior, prepare the brush, ink, paper, inkstone, chessboard, etcetera."
"No problem."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji agreed gladly, then instructed the Daoist Child to prepare them.
He also wanted to see just how skilled Ding Ling truly was.
Ding Ling's flawless talisman replication had truly astonished him!
He knew that he had suffered greatly to master talisman replication back in the day!

chapters.title: Chapter 199 199: Zhou Yu's Descent into Madness
paragraphs: Where's Ding Ling?
No comparison, no harm.
Make a comparison with Ding Ling.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji, who lived to an old age, felt a sense of shame that was almost embarrassing.
That's why.
Seeing Zhou Yu provoke Ding Ling, wanting to see Ding Ling's abilities, Daoist Yhiuu Ji agreed so readily.
He was even more eager than Zhou Yu to witness Ding Ling's capabilities.
If there truly was such a talented person in this world.
Passing on all he had learned seemed like a great idea!
After some time.
Ding Ling and Zhou Yu got ready.
The first round of the competition began.
Comparing painting.
Painting Da and Xiao Qiao.
Ding Ling's brush flew across the canvas like lightning, swiftly sketching a vivid portrait in just a moment's time.
After Da and Xiao Qiao saw it, they were amazed and applauded enthusiastically!
Da Qiao, blushing, whispered:
"I never knew I could be so beautiful!"

The portrait of Da Qiao was dignified and graceful, intelligent and charming like a delicate flower, elegant but not seductive—a true noble flower of the world, an Immortal Fairy of the Celestial Court!
Not only Da Qiao was astonished.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji and Zhang Zhongjing beside them were also impressed:
"Ding Ling, you are so adept at painting. If you have the time, please paint one for me as well."
Of course, Ding Ling did not refuse.
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun, witnessing this, became even more delighted. They felt a stronger sense of collective honor and accomplishment!
"Ding Ling."
Xiao Qiao eagerly held onto the painting, gazing at Ding Ling plaintively:
"Can this painting be given to us? Please, can it?"
"Of course. It was meant to be given to you."
Ding Ling smiled lightly.
Xiao Qiao was overjoyed, jumping and cheering.
A painting made her so happy.
It showed the level of Ding Ling's painting skills, making Xiao Qiao lose her normal composure.
Clearly, it was due to Xiao Qiao's youth, lack of experience, and her innocent, kind, and genuine nature. Her reaction was not out of the ordinary.
Seeing this, Zhou Yu looked at Ding Ling with both jealousy and admiration.
Having seen Ding Ling's painting clearly, he was deeply amazed, and upon seeing Da and Xiao Qiao's reactions, he felt chaotic, envious, and resentful!
In a surge of anger, his hand shook slightly, ruining the beautiful portrait.
An unanticipated large mole appeared on Xiao Qiao's face in the painting!
Making her lovely face look three points less attractive.
Comparing it to Ding Ling's painting, Zhou Yu's work appeared even less appealing.
Zhou Yu was anxious and angry; recalling Ding Ling's skill in reproducing talismans, he had already anticipated a larger chance of losing in comparison of calligraphy and painting!
Immediately, he tore the unfinished painting and loudly said:
"Let's compete in chess!"
"Happy to oblige!"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Xiao Qiao was slightly stunned:
"Zhou Yu, your painting..."
This was like hitting a sore spot!
Zhou Yu snorted coldly, ignoring Xiao Qiao, moved to sit across from Ding Ling, and started playing chess.
Both began to play at a fast pace.
Especially Zhou Yu.
Claiming brilliance, his chess skill was unparalleled, employing aggressive tactics and strategic layouts.
However, as the game progressed.
His moves became slower and heavier.
Eventually.
In a surge of anger, he overturned the chessboard:
"Next, let's compare playing the zither! I refuse to believe you can beat me at that too."
Ding Ling smiled without speaking.
Xiao Qiao felt ashamed of Zhou Yu's behavior.
Compared to the generous, highly capable Ding Ling, Zhou Yu appeared like a gambler who had lost his composure, lacking any elegance or grace!
The zither duel lasted for a quarter of an hour.
It ended with Ding Ling overpowering Zhou Yu.
Zhou Yu, seeing Xiao Qiao's disappointed eyes, felt sorrow, shame, frustration, anger, disbelief, and existential doubt flooding his heart.
In shock and anger.
A mouthful of blood surged up, almost spilling out of his lips.
He forced it down, tossed the zither aside, stood up, and strode away.
"Zhou Yu."
Xiao Qiao called twice.
Zhou Yu did not respond.
Now, Zhou Yu's mind was full of 'I actually lost' 'I lost to a Martial Artist and someone beneath my notice'!!
'What have I become?'
'Am I really less than someone beneath my notice?!'
He felt crazed, sprinting all the way to the foot of the mountain, yelling long into the sky, suddenly coughing and spitting out a mouthful of thick blood, which made him feel significantly better.
He turned, gave a long, deep look in the direction of the Daoist Temple, took the reins handed by his guard, mounted the horse swiftly, and rode away without looking back.
"Today's disgrace, I will certainly repay twice over!"
Inwardly, Zhou Yu swore!
The once proud and conceited young mind was shattered at this moment.
But became somewhat steadier as a result.
"If you can be so versatile! So can I!"
Zhou Yu gritted his teeth:
"If Ding Ling can do it! I surely can too. Next time, I will defeat you in front of everyone! Make you admit you are far inferior to me!"
He had never felt so disheartened!
It was the first time Zhou Yu experienced a snowballing crisis!
Towards Ding Ling.
He was deeply imprinted, almost unable to forget even in death.
[Achievement Badge Earned: You have intimidated Zhou Yu.]

[Note: Zhou Yu's life had been smooth, never experiencing major setbacks! Your appearance made him understand there are always people beyond others, and greater skies exist! He is intimidated by you, but remains unyielding! He might challenge you again in the years to come.]
Ding Ling heard the notification.
Feeling slightly surprised.
But soon he understood.
After all, it's Jiangzuo Handsome Zhou Yu!
How could he be easily defeated? This setback may actually make him more mature, causing swift growth and potentially becoming more formidable than in history.
To this, Ding Ling felt no fear.
If he mastered the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, as King Yue and others described.
Who would he fear then?
Anyone who dares provoke him.
Will face death!
"Impressive, truly impressive!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji applauded, praising:
"Today truly opened my eyes. It's the first time I've seen someone so talented and versed in all fields. I won't continue examining you further."
Ding Ling was delighted.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji stroked his beard, smiling satisfactorily at Ding Ling:
"Meeting a successor like you is a wish fulfilled. Initially thinking a person like you existed only in fantasies, I never expected to find one in reality. Luck, it's really luck!"
"So you should thank me."
Zhang Zhongjing interjected.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji laughed and nodded: "Indeed, I will properly thank you."
He quickly hushed:
"Enough words. Come with me."
He stepped forward with large strides.
Ding Ling followed closely behind.
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng wanted to follow.
But Zhang Zhongjing stopped them:
"You are not yet qualified to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique. Wait till you master the External Refining Breathing Technique instinctively. Otherwise..."

The portrait of Da Qiao was dignified and graceful, intelligent and charming like a delicate flower, elegant but not seductive—a true noble flower of the world, an Immortal Fairy of the Celestial Court!
Not only Da Qiao was astonished.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji and Zhang Zhongjing beside them were also impressed:
"Ding Ling, you are so adept at painting.
If you have the time, please paint one for me as well."
Of course, Ding Ling did not refuse.
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun, witnessing this, became even more delighted.
They felt a stronger sense of collective honor and accomplishment!
"Ding Ling."
Xiao Qiao eagerly held onto the painting, gazing at Ding Ling plaintively:
"Can this painting be given to us?
Please, can it?"
"Of course.
It was meant to be given to you."
Ding Ling smiled lightly.
Xiao Qiao was overjoyed, jumping and cheering.
A painting made her so happy.
It showed the level of Ding Ling's painting skills, making Xiao Qiao lose her normal composure.
Clearly, it was due to Xiao Qiao's youth, lack of experience, and her innocent, kind, and genuine nature.
Her reaction was not out of the ordinary.
Seeing this, Zhou Yu looked at Ding Ling with both jealousy and admiration.
Having seen Ding Ling's painting clearly, he was deeply amazed, and upon seeing Da and Xiao Qiao's reactions, he felt chaotic, envious, and resentful!
In a surge of anger, his hand shook slightly, ruining the beautiful portrait.
An unanticipated large mole appeared on Xiao Qiao's face in the painting!
Making her lovely face look three points less attractive.
Comparing it to Ding Ling's painting, Zhou Yu's work appeared even less appealing.
Zhou Yu was anxious and angry; recalling Ding Ling's skill in reproducing talismans, he had already anticipated a larger chance of losing in comparison of calligraphy and painting!
Immediately, he tore the unfinished painting and loudly said:
"Let's compete in chess!"
"Happy to oblige!"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Xiao Qiao was slightly stunned:
"Zhou Yu, your painting..."
This was like hitting a sore spot!
Zhou Yu snorted coldly, ignoring Xiao Qiao, moved to sit across from Ding Ling, and started playing chess.
Both began to play at a fast pace.
Especially Zhou Yu.
Claiming brilliance, his chess skill was unparalleled, employing aggressive tactics and strategic layouts.
However, as the game progressed.
His moves became slower and heavier.
Eventually.
In a surge of anger, he overturned the chessboard:
"Next, let's compare playing the zither!
I refuse to believe you can beat me at that too."
Ding Ling smiled without speaking.
Xiao Qiao felt ashamed of Zhou Yu's behavior.
Compared to the generous, highly capable Ding Ling, Zhou Yu appeared like a gambler who had lost his composure, lacking any elegance or grace!
The zither duel lasted for a quarter of an hour.
It ended with Ding Ling overpowering Zhou Yu.
Zhou Yu, seeing Xiao Qiao's disappointed eyes, felt sorrow, shame, frustration, anger, disbelief, and existential doubt flooding his heart.
In shock and anger.
A mouthful of blood surged up, almost spilling out of his lips.
He forced it down, tossed the zither aside, stood up, and strode away.
"Zhou Yu."
Xiao Qiao called twice.
Zhou Yu did not respond.
Now, Zhou Yu's mind was full of 'I actually lost' 'I lost to a Martial Artist and someone beneath my notice'!!
'What have I become?'
'Am I really less than someone beneath my notice?!'
He felt crazed, sprinting all the way to the foot of the mountain, yelling long into the sky, suddenly coughing and spitting out a mouthful of thick blood, which made him feel significantly better.
He turned, gave a long, deep look in the direction of the Daoist Temple, took the reins handed by his guard, mounted the horse swiftly, and rode away without looking back.
"Today's disgrace, I will certainly repay twice over!"
Inwardly, Zhou Yu swore!
The once proud and conceited young mind was shattered at this moment.
But became somewhat steadier as a result.
"If you can be so versatile!
So can I!"
Zhou Yu gritted his teeth:
"If Ding Ling can do it!
I surely can too.
Next time, I will defeat you in front of everyone!
Make you admit you are far inferior to me!"
He had never felt so disheartened!
It was the first time Zhou Yu experienced a snowballing crisis!
Towards Ding Ling.
He was deeply imprinted, almost unable to forget even in death.
[Achievement Badge Earned: You have intimidated Zhou Yu.]
[Note: Zhou Yu's life had been smooth, never experiencing major setbacks!
Your appearance made him understand there are always people beyond others, and greater skies exist!
He is intimidated by you, but remains unyielding!
He might challenge you again in the years to come.]
Ding Ling heard the notification.
Feeling slightly surprised.
But soon he understood.
After all, it's Jiangzuo Handsome Zhou Yu!
How could he be easily defeated?
This setback may actually make him more mature, causing swift growth and potentially becoming more formidable than in history.
To this, Ding Ling felt no fear.
If he mastered the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, as King Yue and others described.
Who would he fear then?
Anyone who dares provoke him.
Will face death!
"Impressive, truly impressive!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji applauded, praising:
"Today truly opened my eyes.
It's the first time I've seen someone so talented and versed in all fields.
I won't continue examining you further."
Ding Ling was delighted.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji stroked his beard, smiling satisfactorily at Ding Ling:
"Meeting a successor like you is a wish fulfilled.
Initially thinking a person like you existed only in fantasies, I never expected to find one in reality.
Luck, it's really luck!"
"So you should thank me."
Zhang Zhongjing interjected.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji laughed and nodded: "Indeed, I will properly thank you."
He quickly hushed:
"Enough words.
Come with me."
He stepped forward with large strides.
Ding Ling followed closely behind.
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and Du Qingcheng wanted to follow.
But Zhang Zhongjing stopped them:
"You are not yet qualified to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
Wait till you master the External Refining Breathing Technique instinctively.
Otherwise..."

chapters.title: Chapter 200 200: Inner Refining Breathing Technique Full Level (11/21)
paragraphs: "...Otherwise, forcing oneself to listen and learn, without a certain degree of self-discipline, can easily lead to chaotic thoughts, resulting in a collapse both internally and externally, causing severe damage."
Zhang Zhongjing's words were hard to understand:

"How many geniuses throughout history have died prematurely attempting the dual cultivation of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique? Until you've achieved a certain level in Mental Cultivation and Martial Arts Cultivation, remember not to haphazardly attempt cultivation!"
He looked towards the depths of the inner courtyard:
"Ding Ling can. That's because Ding Ling is a prodigy who has mastered the two major Breathing Techniques instinctively! Can you do that?"
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng blushed, halting their steps and waiting outside.
Da and Xiao Qiao exchanged looks, hearing for the first time that Ding Ling had instinctively mastered both major Breathing Techniques. How is that possible?!
They couldn't help but inquire about Ding Ling from Diao Chan and the others.
Talking about Ding Ling.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng couldn't help but beam with pride, almost boasting, as they recounted Ding Ling's various achievements and abilities to Da and Xiao Qiao.
When had Da and Xiao Qiao ever encountered such a person?
They listened, bewildered.
It felt as if they were hearing a myth.
"Is it true?"
Da and Xiao Qiao couldn't hide their shock.
"Of course, it's true."
Diao Chan raised her eyebrows, saying:
"I have no reason to lie to you. These lies would be easily exposed; they can be proven without difficulty."
Da and Xiao Qiao found this reasonable, feeling even more astonished.
"Then Ding Ling is simply an unparalleled hero!"
"Indeed."
Diao Chan thoroughly agreed, showing great favor towards Da and Xiao Qiao:
"The fact that you recognize this shows your excellent judgment. Unlike some people..."
She didn't finish the sentence.
Da and Xiao Qiao felt somewhat embarrassed, their faces reddening.
Zhou Yu's hostility, disdain, and contempt towards Ding Ling were barely concealed from the beginning.
But if Ding Ling were truly incompetent, it wouldn't matter.
Yet Ding Ling is astonishingly formidable, completely overwhelming genius figures like Zhou Yu!
The greater Ding Ling's magnanimity, versatility, and prowess, the more inadequate, narrow-minded, and unreasonable Zhou Yu seemed!
This only made Da and Xiao Qiao feel more embarrassed and uncomfortable.
After all, they were allied with Zhou Yu!
Fortunately, Diao Chan did not say much about Zhou Yu, instead shifting the topic back to Ding Ling.
Initially, Da and Xiao Qiao felt a bit awkward, but soon they were captivated, occasionally interjecting with questions.
Through Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Zhao Yun, and Zhang Zhongjing's narrative, their understanding, recognition, and admiration of Ding Ling gradually reached new heights.
Ding Ling was unaware he might gain two more admirers.
Presently, he was listening to Daoist Yhiuu Ji expound on the esoteric truth and essence of the "Taiqing Breathing Technique."
The "Taiqing Breathing Technique" stems from the core principles of "Taiping Qingling Dao."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji had cultivated for decades to reach the Transformation Realm but was still some way from complete instinctive mastery.
This was why he wasn't greedy for the "Taiping Sutra."
Because he knew that less is more.
"I've heard from Zhang Zhongjing that you have already mastered two External Refining Breathing Techniques. It's truly bewildering. Now, let's see you demonstrate them."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji suddenly requested Ding Ling to perform the External Refining Breathing Techniques midway through his lecture.
Ding Ling did not hesitate.
Immediately activating the Sword God Breathing Technique and Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique.
In an instant.
Ding Ling's demeanor transformed.
Becoming sharp, overbearing, and noble!
As if a Sword God soaring through the skies on a Spiritual Phoenix, gazing sharply at all living beings!
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was moved:

"This is indeed the instinctive manifestation of the External Refining Breathing Technique. Incredible! You have accomplished something no one in ancient history has achieved. Now I understand Zhang Zhongjing's unwavering confidence in you."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji pondered deeply and said:

"But since you've mastered two External Refining Breathing Techniques, attempting a third Inner Refining Breathing Technique means cultivating three Breathing Techniques altogether. No one has historically succeeded because even trying to cultivate one internal and one external technique has left countless geniuses dead or crippled. Let alone simultaneously cultivating three Breathing Techniques.
Consider wisely!
I wish not for you to aim too high and ruin your promising future due to eagerness in martial training!"
He sighed:
"Truly, I believe mastering the two Breathing Techniques is sufficient to dominate the world. The risk of pursuing a third technique is too great."
"If it proves impossible, I will stop promptly."
Ding Ling solemnly.
"Just worried it might be too late then."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji advised.
But Ding Ling remained unmoved.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji sighed and continued the lecture.
After he finished speaking.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
On a library bookshelf, a book slowly materialized:
"Taiqing Breathing Technique!"
In an instant.
[Taiqing Breathing Technique Full Level]
[Charm +0.9]
At the moment of mastery.
Rumble!
His physique and organs seemed to tremble and resonate.
The Taiqing Breathing Technique quickly transformed into an instinct, permeating throughout Ding Ling's body.
In the blink of an eye, Ding Ling's breathing pattern began to change.
With each breath.
White breaths seemed to transform into streamers, gushing from his nostrils!
Even the void seemed to crackle under the impact.
"Has it really succeeded?!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was wide-eyed, his limbs involuntarily shaking.
"Utterly astounding!"
"This, this..."
The three Breathing Techniques have all become instinctual.
Moreover, the Taiqing Breathing Technique, cultivated for decades by Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Ding Ling quickly mastered it instinctively.
This speed of cultivation.
Is this truly human? Not divine?
Daoist Yhiuu Ji's gaze towards Ding Ling changed repeatedly, from a senior's perspective to one of respect and even admiration.
Because at this moment, Ding Ling's figure in his mind expanded countless times!
Listening to others' accounts.
Though touched, it's not profound.
Yet the Taiqing Breathing Technique, which Daoist Yhiuu Ji had cultivated to an exceedingly profound level, he understood deeply the difficulty of this Breathing Technique.
One could say it is as hard as ascending to heaven, not an exaggeration!
Without unmatched insight and innate talent!
Couldn't possibly cultivate this Breathing Technique to the Transformation Realm!
But Ding Ling?
In such a short time?
He mastered it instinctively!
"No wonder Zhang Zhongjing speaks so highly of him. I now can't help but start worshipping him. Truly amazing. It overturns all beliefs, shaking one's life!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji's worldview, life's view, cultivation view began to collapse!
Ding Ling's presence was like a heavy hammer, irrevocably shattering the solid worldview he had constructed!
"Whew!"
With each breath of Ding Ling.
The white breath grew ever denser.
Like torrents of Vigorous Qi exuding from his physical form, reaching a state where it could emanate.
These Vigorous Qi continuously hammered Ding Ling's physique.
Causing Ding Ling's breathing rhythm to become increasingly steady and calm.
From rapid and heavy to peaceful, neither hurried nor slow...
